title: Omni-Woodpecker: Hallucination Correction via Evidence-Prior Rebalancing for Omni LLMs
summary: Recent Omni LLMs (OLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in joint audio-visual reasoning, yet cross-modal hallucinations remain a major challenge. Existing mitigation methods mainly operate at the output level, overlooking the entanglement of grounding evidence and learned priors within fused representations. To address this issue, we propose Omni-Woodpecker (OWP), a training-free framework that shifts hallucination mitigation from output-level manipulation to conflict-conditioned representation rebalancing. Specifically, OWP first identifies cross-modal conflicts from complementary modality-specific views. It then employs orthogonal decomposition to separate grounding evidence from competing priors within the hidden states. Finally, OWP adaptively rebalances fused representations by suppressing misleading priors and restoring ignored evidence before decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and strong cross-architecture generalization of OWP. Using Qwen2.5-Omni-7B as the backbone, OWP improves performance by 12.9 and 8.6 points on CMM and AVHBench, respectively, while consistently achieving gains of 0.67-2.25 points across four general OLLM reasoning benchmarks. Furthermore, OWP generalizes effectively to VideoLLaMA2-AV, improving performance by 4.6 and 3.9 points on the same benchmarks. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/ZiiJianLiu/Omni-Woodpecker

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的Omni-Woodpecker框架，将跨模态幻觉缓解从输出层操作转为"冲突条件下的表征再平衡"，通过正交分解分离证据与先验并自适应重加权，显著降低音视频幻觉并提升通用推理。
AI.motivation: 现有Omni LLM在音视频联合推理上能力强，但跨模态幻觉仍是主要难题。现有缓解方法多在输出层做文章，忽视了融合表征中"grounding证据"与"已学先验"相互纠缠的问题。
AI.method: 1) 从互补的单模态视角识别跨模态冲突；2) 用正交分解在隐状态中把grounding证据与竞争性先验分离；3) 在解码前自适应再平衡融合表征——抑制误导性先验、恢复被忽略的证据。全程免训练。
AI.result: 以Qwen2.5-Omni-7B为骨干，CMM提升12.9分、AVHBench提升8.6分，并在四个通用OLLM推理基准上稳定提升0.67–2.25分；迁移到VideoLLaMA2-AV同样提升4.6和3.9分，显示强跨架构泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 在表征层面处理跨模态冲突比输出层后处理更有效，且免训练、可跨架构迁移，为多模态幻觉缓解提供了新范式。

title: Revealing Inter-Channel Modality Discriminability: Channel Selective Interaction Fusion Network for Optical-SAR Object Detection
summary: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and optical imagery provide complementary structural and appearance information for remote sensing object detection. However, substantial cross-modal discrepancies and indiscriminate channel interaction inevitably introduce redundant or conflicting features. Since different feature channels encode heterogeneous semantic information and contribute unequally to cross-modal fusion, selectively highlighting task-relevant channels while suppressing redundant ones is essential. To address this issue, we propose the Channel Selective Interaction Fusion Network (CSIF-Net), which performs selective channel-level cross-modal interaction. CSIF-Net first employs a frequency decomposition module to construct frequency-aware SAR inputs, facilitating the separation of structural information from noise-related responses. It then models cross-modal channel relationships through a cross-attention channel selection module and dynamically partitions the features into shared and modality-specific components. Finally, a dual-branch fusion module performs cross-modal interaction and channel realignment for shared features while independently enhancing SAR-specific features, thereby exploiting complementary information and suppressing modality interference. Extensive experiments on the OGSOD 1.0 and M4-SAR datasets demonstrate that CSIF-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance in both horizontal and oriented object detection, surpassing the existing methods by 4.01% and 3.18% gains, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出CSIF-Net，通过频率分解、跨注意力通道选择与双分支融合实现SAR与光学影像的选择性通道级跨模态交互，在OGSOD 1.0和M4-SAR上取得水平与旋转目标检测SOTA，分别提升4.01%和3.18%。
AI.motivation: SAR与光学影像互补，但跨模态差异大、通道无差别交互会引入冗余与冲突特征；不同通道语义异质、对融合贡献不均，需选择性强化任务相关通道。
AI.method: CSIF-Net包含三部分：(1) 频率分解模块构造频率感知SAR输入，分离结构信息与噪声响应；(2) 跨注意力通道选择模块建模跨模态通道关系，动态划分共享特征与模态特有特征；(3) 双分支融合模块对共享特征做跨模态交互与通道重对齐，同时独立增强SAR特有特征。
AI.result: 在OGSOD 1.0与M4-SAR数据集上，水平框与旋转框检测均达SOTA，较现有方法分别提升4.01%与3.18%。
AI.conclusion: 选择性的通道级跨模态交互能有效利用互补信息并抑制模态干扰，验证了通道选择与频率感知设计的有效性。

title: Media Intelligence Platform: Multimodal Detection of Synthetic and Manipulated Content
comment: ECCV 2026, Workshop on AI for Multimedia Forensics & Disinformation Detection (AI4MFDD2026)
summary: The rapid progress of generative artificial intelligence has led to a significant increase in manipulated multimedia content, including synthetic faces, forged videos, AI-generated images, fake audio, and locally edited images. Existing detection approaches are typically designed for a single manipulation type, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios involving heterogeneous media sources. In this work, we present the Media Intelligence Platform (MIP), a unified web-based framework for multimodal media forensics integrating specialized modules for fake video detection, face morphing detection, AI-generated image detection, audio deepfake detection, localized image manipulation detection, and text analysis. Its modular architecture enables flexible integration of heterogeneous models and supports future extensions for emerging manipulation techniques. Experimental results on representative benchmark datasets demonstrate reliable detection performance across multiple media modalities while providing a practical and user-friendly interface for forensic investigations. The platform highlights the potential of unified multimodal systems for comprehensive deepfake detection in real-world environments, and is accompanied by a public demonstrator released with this workshop submission to support reproducibility and community evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的网页平台MIP，集成假视频、人脸变形、AI生成图像、音频深度伪造、局部图像篡改及文本分析等多个专用模块，实现多模态媒体取证，并在代表性基准上验证了可靠性能，附带公开演示系统。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI使伪造多媒体内容（合成人脸、伪造视频、AI图像、假音频、局部编辑图像）激增；而现有检测方法大多只针对单一篡改类型，难以应对真实场景中来源异构的混合媒体，因此需要一个统一的多模态取证框架。
AI.method: 构建基于Web的Media Intelligence Platform（MIP），采用模块化架构集成六类专用检测模块：假视频检测、人脸变形检测、AI生成图像检测、音频深伪检测、局部图像篡改检测与文本分析；模块化设计支持异构模型灵活接入与新兴篡改技术的后续扩展，并提供用户友好的取证操作界面与公开演示系统。
AI.result: 在多个代表性基准数据集上的实验表明，系统跨多种媒体模态均能实现可靠的检测性能，同时提供实用、易用的取证界面；随文发布的公开演示系统支持可复现性与社区评测。
AI.conclusion: 统一的多模态取证系统在真实环境的综合性深度伪造检测中具有显著潜力；模块化Web平台为异构媒体来源的取证提供了可行路径，但需持续扩展以应对新兴篡改技术。

title: Learning from Past Mistakes: AI-Assisted Analytics of Software Defects and Their Fixes for Future Defect Prevention - An Industrial Case Study
summary: Context. Despite advances in software testing and quality assurance, defects continue to recur in industrial software systems. Defect data are routinely collected in issue-tracking systems, but their use is largely confined to detection, reporting, and short-term resolution, leaving the knowledge embedded in historical defects and their fixes under-exploited for prevention and long-term improvement. Objective. This paper investigates how historical defect and defect-fix data can be analyzed, with AI assistance under human oversight, to identify the human-error origins of recurring defects and to feed that understanding back into prevention and QA improvement. Method. We developed an AI-assisted, human-in-the-loop analytics approach that classifies defects by failure type and by human-error origin across the SDLC, determines how each could have been prevented, and synthesizes engineer-focused capability-building insights. It was deployed and evaluated in a large software company through an industrial case study, using practitioner surveys and interviews, classification-reliability checks, and an effort-normalized analysis of defect density. Results. Practitioners and independent review judged the classifications accurate; the outputs were rated useful and actionable; and defect density decreased after the introduction of the feedback, a tentative association we interpret as consistent with, but not proof of, a positive effect, given the study's uncontrolled pre/post design. Conclusion. AI-assisted, human-governed analysis of defect-fix data can help shift organizations from defect detection toward prevention, continuous learning and improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种AI辅助、人在环中的缺陷数据分析方法，对历史缺陷及其修复数据按失效类型和人为错误根源分类，并推导预防与能力建设洞见；在一家大型软件公司开展工业案例研究，结果显示分类准确、输出可用，且引入反馈后缺陷密度下降（为相关性而非因果证明）。
AI.motivation: 尽管测试与质量保证不断进步，工业软件中缺陷仍反复出现。缺陷数据虽被记录在问题跟踪系统中，但使用多局限于检测、报告与短期修复，历史缺陷及其修复中所蕴含的知识未被充分用于预防和长期改进。
AI.method: 开发了一套AI辅助、人类监督的闭环分析（human-in-the-loop）方法：按失效类型和跨SDLC的人为错误根源对缺陷分类，判定每个缺陷本可如何被预防，并综合出面向工程师的能力建设洞见。在大型软件公司部署并开展工业案例研究，采用从业者问卷与访谈、分类可靠性检查以及按工作量归一化的缺陷密度分析进行评估。
AI.result: 从业者与独立评审认为分类准确；输出被评为有用且可执行；引入反馈后缺陷密度下降。由于研究为无对照的前后设计，作者将这一下降解释为与正向效果一致的相关性，而非因果证据。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助、人类治理的缺陷-修复数据分析可帮助组织从缺陷检测转向缺陷预防、持续学习与改进。

title: EGGHead: Efficient Generalizable Gaussian Heads from a Single Image
summary: Creating photorealistic human heads typically involves trade-offs between representation power, efficiency, and generalizability. Traditional mesh-based solutions relying on 3DMMs generally sacrifice representation power but are efficient to render. On the other hand, NeRF-based methods improve representation power and fidelity while sacrificing efficiency. Gaussian splatting methods attempt to resolve these trade-offs by offering both high representation power and efficiency with real-time rendering. However, their efficiency nonetheless depends on the number of rasterized Gaussians, and the time needed to optimize and prepare the head (the enrollment time) is often high. In light of this, we propose EGGHead, which introduces a novel Gaussian allocation algorithm that efficiently assigns Gaussians to the head's semantic regions given a fixed Gaussian budget. Our algorithm reduces the number of Gaussians needed while minimizing the impact on representation power. EGGHead operates in a single forward pass and outperforms previous single-image face modeling methods in reconstruction quality, novel view synthesis, and rendering speeds.

AI.tldr: 提出EGGHead，一种基于高斯泼溅的单图人脸建模方法，通过新颖的高斯分配算法在固定高斯预算下按语义区域高效分配高斯，实现质量、效率与泛化性的良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的人头建模方法面临表示能力、效率与泛化性的权衡：3DMM网格渲染高效但表示能力弱，NeRF保真度高但效率低，高斯泼溅虽兼顾两者，但其效率依赖高斯数量，且优化与准备的注册(enrollment)时间往往很长。
AI.method: EGGHead引入一种新的高斯分配算法，在给定固定高斯预算的前提下，将高斯高效地分配到人头的各个语义区域，从而在减少所需高斯数量的同时尽量降低对表示能力的影响；整个建模过程仅需单次前向传播。
AI.result: 在重建质量、新视角合成以及渲染速度上均优于以往的单图人脸建模方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过在语义区域层面进行预算受限的高斯分配，EGGHead在单次前向推理中同时提升了表示效率与渲染效率，证明了语义引导的高斯分配是解决人头建模多目标权衡的有效途径。

title: Navalia: Advancing Cowork Agents through Verifiable Task Synthesis and Long-Horizon Post-Training
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from conversational assistants into Cowork Agents capable of autonomous planning, tool use, and complex task execution. Financial analysis requires these agents to integrate cross-document evidence and perform multistep numerical reasoning, but expert task authoring is costly, while direct LLM synthesis struggles to produce challenging tasks with reliable answers. We introduce Navalia, a framework for Cowork Agents that combines verifiable task synthesis with long-horizon post-training. Using corporate financial reports as its data source, Navalia semantically selects supporting evidence from complete fact sets and constructs executable computation chains to generate analytical tasks with traceable evidence and actual data dependencies between steps. We further use independent LLM review and programmatic checks to verify evidence consistency and answer correctness. The verified tasks are then used for trajectory collection, cold-start supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL) to improve long-horizon task execution. Navalia, initialized from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, achieves consistent gains over the base model across all five benchmarks: OfficeQA Pro, FinSearchComp, Finance Agent Benchmark, APEX-Agents-AA, and Workspace-Bench-Lite. These results demonstrate that Navalia improves evidence integration, tool use, and long-horizon task execution capabilities and generalizes to broader Cowork settings, including general office tasks.

AI.tldr: Navalia：以企业财报为数据源，通过可验证的任务合成与长程后训练，构建具备跨文档证据整合和多步数值推理能力的金融分析Cowork Agent。
AI.motivation: LLM Agent正从对话助手演化为可自主规划、调用工具、执行复杂任务的Cowork Agent。金融分析需要跨文档证据整合与多步数值推理，但专家标注成本高，直接用LLM合成又难以生成兼具挑战性与答案可靠性的任务。
AI.method: 以企业财报为数据源，从完整事实集中语义选取支撑证据，构建可执行计算链，生成带可追溯证据且步骤间存在真实数据依赖的分析任务；用独立LLM评审与程序化检查验证证据一致性与答案正确性；将验证后的任务用于轨迹采集、冷启动SFT与强化学习，进行长程后训练。
AI.result: 基于Qwen3.6-35B-A3B初始化，在OfficeQA Pro、FinSearchComp、Finance Agent Benchmark、APEX-Agents-AA、Workspace-Bench-Lite五个基准上均优于基座模型。
AI.conclusion: Navalia提升了证据整合、工具使用与长程任务执行能力，并可泛化到更广泛的Cowork场景（含通用办公任务）。

title: MOSS: A Production Framework for Monitoring and Diagnosing Semantic Failures in Search and Recommendation Systems
comment: 10 pages. A prior version of this work was presented at the non-archival Unified Search and Recommendation Workshop (USRW), co-located with ACM RecSys 2026. This manuscript is currently under review at IEEE BigData 2026
summary:
Detecting semantic failures in production recommendation and search systems is hard: behavioral metrics lag by days, manual review does not scale, and most LLM evaluation frameworks are designed for offline, fixed datasets rather than continuous operational monitoring. We present Model Sanity Service (MOSS), a production framework that addresses this operational gap by embedding LLM-based relevance scoring into a recurring monitoring loop with targeted sampling, strategy-aware prompting, structured alerting, and diagnostic follow-up prompting that categorizes failures into actionable root causes.
  MOSS has been running in production at a large U.S. retailer for over six months across recommendation, search, and offer surfaces, and has surfaced two confirmed serving defects. For one of these, a backfill blending defect, MOSS quantified the impact of the proposed fix offline as a 76.4\% relative reduction in alert rate. On a 498-pair human-annotated recommendation benchmark, frontier LLM judges achieve higher F1 and AUC point estimates than non-LLM baselines (internal production embeddings and SBERT), with the largest gains on strategy-dependent tasks requiring intent-level relational reasoning. The same judge, score scale, and threshold transfer to a 466-pair search benchmark spanning 21 queries with only a surface-specific prompt adaptation, achieving strong F1 and AUC without retuning. These results show that a single LLM monitoring framework can provide useful, actionable quality signals across multiple product discovery surfaces in a large-scale e-commerce setting.

AI.tldr: 提出生产级LLM监控框架MOSS，将LLM相关性打分嵌入循环监控流程，在大型零售商多个推荐/搜索场景中运行六个月，发现两个真实服务缺陷，并在人工标注基准上优于非LLM基线且可跨场景迁移。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中推荐与搜索的语义失败难以发现：行为指标有数天滞后、人工评审无法扩展，而现有LLM评估框架多面向离线固定数据集，不适合持续运营监控。
AI.method: MOSS框架：带针对性采样的周期性监控循环、策略感知提示、结构化告警，以及可将失败归因到可执行根因的诊断式追问提示；用前沿LLM作为相关性评判器。
AI.result: 在生产运行6个月以上，覆盖推荐、搜索、优惠等场景，发现两个已确认的线上缺陷；对回填混合缺陷，离线量化修复可使告警率相对下降76.4%。498对人工标注推荐基准上，LLM评判器F1/AUC点估计高于内部生产embedding与SBERT基线，在需意图级关系推理的策略相关任务上优势最大；同一评判器、分值和阈值仅做表面适配即迁移到21个查询、466对搜索基准，无需重调。
AI.conclusion: 单一LLM监控框架可在大型电商多产品发现场景中提供有用、可执行的质量信号，并具备跨场景可迁移性。

title: High-dimensional layer-state trajectories reveal the internal dynamics of transformer inference
comment: Expanded preprint with 17 main figures and 13 supplementary figures. Source data and code are archived on Zenodo
summary: Mechanistic studies of large language models localize function in parameters, attention heads or neurons, but those parts do not specify how one inference unfolds. We treat the ordered layer-state trajectory as the empirical process and test whether layer order defines a measurable computation. Across representative Qwen, Llama and Gemma checkpoints, realized order produced paths 1.60--2.24 times as aligned with their endpoint chord as endpoint-preserving shuffles. The order effect transferred to a lexical task, but was stronger in three random initializations of the same Qwen architecture, identifying an architecture-compatible scaffold rather than a training-specific law. Direct hidden states provided stronger mechanism coordinates than vocabulary readbacks, and a task-defined coordinate made candidate competition computable. After additive interventions failed, local transition actuators selectively controlled internal trajectories across checkpoints. A confidence gate then drove 17 of 87 held-out Qwen closure trajectories across the full-vocabulary top-1 candidate boundary while leaving all 203 non-closure top-1 outputs unchanged. Safety-matched action reassignment performed similarly, locating the gain in selective gating and the bounded actuator family rather than fine-grained dose assignment. Layer order exposes an observable, computable and behaviourally consequential process of transformer inference without establishing a complete theory of LLM dynamics or control of answer correctness.

AI.tldr: 该论文把有顺序的层状态轨迹当作经验过程，检验层序是否构成可测量计算，并提出"局部转移执行器+置信门"的内部轨迹控制方法。
AI.motivation: 现有机制研究把功能定位在参数、注意力头或神经元，但这些部件无法说明单次推理如何展开；作者因此想检验层序本身是否是一个可测量的计算过程。
AI.method: 在Qwen、Llama、Gemma的代表性检查点上，将实现顺序与保持端点不变的层序打乱做对比，测量层状态轨迹与其端点弦的一致性；并迁移到词汇任务、对比随机初始化、比较隐状态与词表回读、用任务定义的坐标计算候选竞争；在加性干预失败后，改用局部转移执行器配合置信门对内部轨迹进行选择性控制。
AI.result: 实现顺序的轨迹与端点弦对齐度是打乱顺序的1.60--2.24倍；顺序效应可迁移到词汇任务，而在同架构三个随机初始化中更强，指向架构兼容的"脚手架"而非训练特异的规律；直接隐状态比词表回读提供更强的机制坐标；置信门在87条留出Qwen闭包轨迹中驱动17条越过全词表top-1候选边界，同时203条非闭包top-1输出全部不变；安全匹配的动作重分配效果类似，说明增益来自选择性门控与有界执行器族而非精细剂量分配。
AI.conclusion: 层序揭示了一个可观测、可计算且具有行为后果的Transformer推理过程，但尚未建立完整的LLM动力学理论或对答案正确性的控制。

title: Migrate Computation, Not Data: Fault Recovery in Neuromorphic Many-Core Systems
summary: As neuromorphic systems scale to thousands of near-memory cores, aging-induced permanent faults in neuron-update datapaths become an important obstacle to long-term deployment. Existing online recovery methods typically retire a faulty core and migrate its neurons, along with their weights and membrane states, to healthy cores. This whole-core treatment incurs high recovery traffic and makes recovery depend on scarce destinations; at high utilization, there may be enough surviving compute capacity but insufficient free storage to copy the affected neuron context. This paper presents SpikeRelay, an online recovery framework for diagnosed compute-unit faults. SpikeRelay exploits the fact that, in many neuromorphic cores, the compute datapath, local SRAM, and router are distinct modules: a compute fault need not destroy stored weights and states or disconnect the core from the NoC. Instead of retiring a faulty core and migrating its neuron data, SpikeRelay converts the faulty core into a storage-and-forwarding node while offloading neuron-update computation to a healthy rescue core. This decoupling of storage and computation eliminates recovery-time data migration and greatly reduces spare-SRAM requirements. Consequently, SpikeRelay sustains 100\% recovery at 92.2\% SRAM utilization and a 50\% fault rate, whereas the best baseline achieves only 22.1\%.

AI.tldr: SpikeRelay 是一种面向神经形态计算芯片的在线容错恢复框架：它把出现故障的计算核心改造成"存储转发节点"，只把神经元更新计算卸载到健康的救援核心，从而避免整核迁移带来的巨大数据流量与空闲存储依赖，在 92.2% SRAM 利用率和 50% 故障率下仍实现 100% 恢复率（最佳基线仅 22.1%）。
AI.motivation: 神经形态系统向数千个近存核心扩展时，老化导致的神经元更新数据通路永久故障威胁长期部署。现有在线恢复方法采用"整核退役+神经元迁移"策略，需搬运权重与膜电位状态，恢复流量高；且迁移依赖稀缺的空闲目标核——高利用率下虽然存活算力足够，却缺乏足够空闲 SRAM 来存放被迁移的神经元上下文，导致恢复失败。
AI.method: 利用许多神经形态核心中计算数据通路、本地 SRAM 与路由器是相互独立模块的特点，计算故障并不破坏已存权重/状态，也不切断核心与 NoC 的连接。SpikeRelay 因此不退役故障核，而是将其转为存储与转发节点，仅把神经元更新计算卸载到健康救援核，实现存储与计算的解耦，从而消除恢复时的数据迁移并大幅降低对备用 SRAM 的需求。
AI.result: 在 92.2% 的 SRAM 利用率和 50% 故障率条件下，SpikeRelay 仍保持 100% 恢复成功率；而表现最好的基线方法只能达到 22.1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将故障核复用为存储转发节点、只迁移计算任务，SpikeRelay 以极低的开销和存储需求实现了高利用率、高故障率下的可靠在线恢复，为大规模神经形态系统的长期可靠运行提供了可行方案。

title: H2DF: Calibrated Target Bands for Controllable Language-Model Unlearning
summary: Gradient ascent (GA) is a simple language-model unlearning baseline, but it continues increasing forget loss after useful forgetting has occurred. This unbounded pressure can damage retained utility and make forgotten examples abnormally high-loss. We introduce H2DF, a calibrated target-band objective that applies GA-like pressure below a data-dependent lower target and suppresses, or reverses, that pressure after the target region is reached. The targets are estimated from matched non-member examples before training, so the base objective requires one forget-batch forward/backward pass per optimization step; our reported TOFU variant adds sparse retain replay every tenth step. We instantiate a one-sided objective for TOFU question answering and a two-sided objective for MUSE-News language modeling. Across three TOFU seeds, H2DF obtains a forget NLL of 1.528 with margin 0.049 and retain NLL of 1.165 with margin 0.047, matching GradDiff while using retain replay only every tenth step and showing substantially lower variability than GA. On MUSE-News, H2DF improves retention over GA and NPO and is competitive with SimNPO, but does not dominate it. Ablations show that the upper target reduces overshoot and that validation-based checkpoint selection is important. These results support calibrated target bands as a practical mechanism for controlling forgetting strength, while also exposing sensitivity to random seed and calibration quality.

AI.tldr: H2DF：为梯度上升式机器遗忘设计“校准目标带”目标，达到目标区间后抑制或反转遗忘压力，在TOFU上以稀疏回放匹配GradDiff，在MUSE-News上优于GA/NPO但未超过SimNPO。
AI.motivation: GA是无界的遗忘压力：有用遗忘已发生后仍继续提高遗忘损失，损害保留效用并使被遗忘样本损失异常偏高。作者希望给遗忘强度设一个可控的目标区间，而非无限增大。
AI.method: 预先用匹配的非成员样本估计依赖于数据的上下目标值；目标带以下施加类GA压力，进入目标区域后抑制甚至反转该压力。基础目标每步只需一次遗忘批次前向/反向；TOFU变体每十步加入稀疏保留回放。对TOFU问答用单侧目标，对MUSE-News语言建模用双侧（含上目标）目标。
AI.result: TOFU三个种子：遗忘NLL 1.528（margin 0.049），保留NLL 1.165（margin 0.047），与GradDiff相当但回放频率仅1/10，波动显著低于GA。MUSE-News上保留效果优于GA与NPO、与SimNPO相当但未占优。消融显示上目标可减少过冲，基于验证集的检查点选择很关键；同时对随机种子与校准质量敏感。
AI.conclusion: 校准目标带是控制遗忘强度的实用机制，但存在种子敏感性与校准质量依赖，整体上尚非全面领先的方案。

title: Certifying Repeatable Entry-Replay Witnesses for COBOL-to-Java Migration
summary: Producing synthetic data for comparison testing a migrated COBOL application is a major challenge that agentic migrations face today. Our prior paper, the Agentic Method for Deterministic Validation of Legacy Code Migration, presents a deterministic oracle to facilitate such migrations, the Locksmith Loop. We now propose a novel method for achieving high branch and paragraph coverage through generated synthetic end-to-end test cases, by means of entry-replay test-case certification by observing the code execution trace on a surrogate COBOL program that mocks external interactions via a chronological external-operation tape. We applied our method to a very large COBOL program with 33,429 lines of code to generate 849 synthetic end-to-end test cases covering 2,973/3,806 source branches (78.1%) and 989/1,033 main-AST paragraphs (95.7%). Using the Locksmith Loop's projected-agreement validation, the generated Java code matched the COBOL surrogate on the specified observations across all 849 certified synthetic end-to-end test cases. During the campaign we detected 61 defects and fixed the Java generator accordingly. To test whether the coding agent could silently introduce business logic bugs, we seeded 450 defects into the Java code, such as deleted writes, deleted paragraph calls, and altered rounding, to verify how many of these would be detected by the gating methodology. The gate detected 47.6%, including all deleted writes and paragraph calls in executed code, but was unable to detect the rounding and precision defects.

AI.tldr: 提出一种为迁移COBOL应用生成合成端到端测试用例的新方法，通过"外部操作磁带"代理程序记录执行轨迹并用entry-replay认证用例，在33429行COBOL程序上生成849个用例，覆盖78.1%分支与95.7%段落，并用种子缺陷检验门控检出能力。
AI.motivation: COBOL应用迁移时缺乏可比较测试的合成数据，是当前代理式迁移面临的重大挑战；此前工作Locksmith Loop提供了确定性oracle，但仍需高效手段生成高覆盖率的端到端测试用例。
AI.method: 构建一个代理COBOL程序，用按时间顺序的"外部操作磁带"模拟外部交互；观察其执行轨迹，对生成的合成端到端测试用例进行entry-replay认证；利用Locksmith Loop的projected-agreement验证Java生成代码与COBOL代理在指定观测上的一致性。
AI.result: 在33429行的大型COBOL程序上生成849个合成端到端用例，覆盖2973/3806源分支（78.1%）与989/1033主AST段落（95.7%）；849个用例全部通过验证；过程中发现61个缺陷并修复Java生成器；注入450个种子缺陷，门控检出47.6%，能检出被执行代码中的全部删除写操作与段落调用，但无法检出舍入与精度缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可有效生成高覆盖率的合成端到端测试用例并实现确定性验证，但当前门控对舍入/精度类缺陷存在盲区，需进一步补充检测手段。

title: Beckmann World Models: Direct Terminal-Map Learning for One-Step Action-Conditioned Prediction
summary: Action-conditioned world models support planning and policy evaluation by predicting future states. However, learning an accurate one-step predictor can require substantial training computation. We introduce Beckmann World Models (BWM), which learn a direct map from noise, visual history, and actions to future frames without a pretrained generative teacher. We adapt the terminal-map conservation law of Beckmann Transport Models to action-conditioned video prediction, training directly from noise-data pairs without conditional populations of generated samples required by DriftWorld. However, transport consistency on interpolated inputs does not ensure accurate prediction from the pure noise used at inference. We address this gap with endpoint-aligned training that directly supervises the source prediction, emphasizes motion and spatial structure, and teaches recovery from generated histories. All components train the same map and retain one network call per future chunk. On PushT and Robomimic Can, the final model reduces 64-frame prediction MSE by 68% and 57%, respectively, relative to same-backbone regression baseline. For policy evaluation, BWM achieves the lowest mean IoU error among the evaluated models, 0.0100, at 24.8 ms per four-frame PushT prediction. On Robomimic Can, the BWM stage trained with motion supervision and generated histories achieves 3.3 times higher throughput and 78% lower peak memory than local one-step DriftWorld. In a latent-space extension to RT-1 and Bridge-V2, equal-update controls show that feature supervision under generated histories improves perceptual prediction. These findings show how terminal-map learning can combine efficient training with accurate one-step visual prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出 Beckmann World Models (BWM)，将 Beckmann Transport Models 的终端映射守恒定律迁移到动作条件视频预测，直接从噪声-数据对训练从噪声、视觉历史与动作到未来帧的映射，无需预训练生成教师，实现高效且准确的单步视觉预测。
AI.motivation: 动作条件世界模型依赖准确的一步预测器进行规划与策略评估，但训练此类预测器计算开销大（通常需要预训练生成教师或条件样本群体）。作者希望用更高效的训练方式直接学习噪声到未来帧的映射。
AI.method: 1) 将 Beckmann Transport Models 的终端映射守恒定律适配到动作条件视频预测，直接由噪声-数据对训练，避免 DriftWorld 所需的生成样本群体；2) 提出端点对齐训练，直接监督源端预测、强调运动与空间结构、并教会模型从生成历史中恢复；3) 所有组件训练同一映射，每个未来 chunk 仅需一次网络调用；另在 RT-1 与 Bridge-V2 上做潜空间扩展。
AI.result: PushT 与 Robomimic Can 上，64 帧预测 MSE 相较同骨干回归基线分别降低 68% 和 57%；策略评估中 BWM 平均 IoU 误差最低（0.0100），PushT 四帧预测耗时 24.8 ms；Robomimic Can 上引入运动监督与生成历史的 BWM 阶段比局部单步 DriftWorld 吞吐高 3.3 倍、峰值内存低 78%；RT-1/Bridge-V2 等更新对照显示生成历史下的特征监督改进感知预测。
AI.conclusion: 终端映射学习可同时实现高效训练与准确的一步视觉预测，为动作条件世界模型提供了一条无需生成教师的实用路径。

title: Large language model and reinforcement learning based autonomous construction and progress updates
summary: Due to the rapid growth of the global population, traditional construction methods are gradually unable to meet the current housing demand. The advancement of machine learning algorithms has encouraged researchers to explore their applications in the construction industry, leading to more intelligent and efficient building processes. In particular, the rise of large language models in recent years has provided more possibilities for the transformation from traditional construction to smart construction. In this study, a large language model and reinforcement learning based autonomous construction method is proposed. An enhanced soft actor-critic reinforcement learning algorithm is developed to plan actions for a mobile crane according to construction tasks. Robot kinematics and control algorithms are used to ensure that the actions generated by the reinforcement learning algorithm can be executed by the crane. In addition, a customized embedding model is developed to extract information from the construction environment according to user interests. Then, a large language model, ChatGPT 5, is used to update construction progress, provide safety information to control system, and generate construction progress reports. The feasibility of proposed method is verified through several full-scall retaining wall construction experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种大语言模型与强化学习结合的自主建造方法：用改进的SAC算法为移动起重机规划动作，结合机器人运动学与控制保证可执行性，并用定制嵌入模型+ChatGPT 5处理施工环境信息与进度、安全、报告生成，通过足尺挡土墙施工实验验证可行性。
AI.motivation: 全球人口快速增长导致传统建造方式难以满足住房需求，机器学习尤其是大语言模型的兴起为传统建造向智能建造转型提供了新可能，因此需要一种能自主规划与执行施工任务的方法。
AI.method: 1) 开发增强型soft actor-critic强化学习算法，根据施工任务为移动起重机规划动作；2) 利用机器人运动学与控制算法确保RL生成动作可被起重机执行；3) 开发定制嵌入模型，依据用户兴趣从施工环境中提取信息；4) 使用大语言模型ChatGPT 5更新施工进度、向控制系统提供安全信息并生成施工进度报告。
AI.result: 通过若干足尺（full-scale）挡土墙施工实验验证了所提方法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型与强化学习结合的自主建造框架在真实规模的挡土墙施工中可行，为实现智能建造转型提供了新思路，但摘要未给出量化性能指标。

title: GRaSP: Latency-Aware Optimization for Geo-Distributed Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: Accepted at the 4th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Information Retrieval in the Asia Pacific (SIGIR-AP 2026)
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is increasingly served across geo-distributed cloud and edge infrastructures, where wide-area latency, cross-region egress cost, and data-residency rules compete with retrieval quality. Conventional pipelines rank by semantic similarity alone and ignore where content lives, inflating tail latency and cost. We formalize the Geo-RAG Selection Problem (GRaSP), a drop-in re-scoring layer that decays relevance by latency and adds an optional cost penalty under a cardinality budget and per-region caps, with no retraining. We first settle its complexity: the base formulation is a linear objective over a partition matroid, solved optimally by an O(N log N) greedy algorithm, rather than NP-hard as a knapsack framing suggests, with hardness entering only under an additive egress budget. On a five-node CloudLab testbed emulating a four-region WAN over the Natural Questions corpus (2.68M passages), GRaSP's benefit is placement-dependent: under uniform placement it cuts fetch latency at negligible quality cost; under topical (residency-like) placement it traces a recall-latency Pareto frontier that dominates relevance-only, nearest-k, and a latency-budgeted baseline. At a moderate latency setting, GRaSP lowers P90 fetch latency by 41% while retaining 78% of relevance-only's recall, with sub-millisecond selection overhead, stable to 200 queries/s. Findings generalize across four public BEIR benchmarks. In end-to-end question answering, GRaSP reduces context-fetch latency by 43% while remaining within 0.062 absolute EM of relevance-only retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化"地理感知RAG选择问题"(GRaSP)，作为免训练的重打分层，在延迟衰减与成本惩罚下优化检索选择，证明其可被O(N log N)贪心算法最优求解，并在多区域WAN测试中显著降低拉取延迟而保持检索质量。
AI.motivation: RAG正部署于地理分布式云边环境，广域延迟、跨区出网成本和数据驻留规则与检索质量相互冲突；传统流水线仅按语义相似度排序，忽略内容所在位置，导致尾延迟和成本被放大。
AI.method: 提出GRaSP：在基数预算与分区上限约束下，按延迟衰减相关性并加可选成本惩罚的重打分层，无需重训练。作者厘清复杂度：基础形式为划分拟阵上的线性目标，可用O(N log N)贪心最优求解，仅在加性出网预算下才变难。实验在五节点CloudLab测试台上仿真四区域WAN，使用Natural Questions语料(268万段落)，并在四个BEIR基准上验证，含端到端QA评测。
AI.result: 效果依赖内容放置：均匀放置时以极小质量代价降低拉取延迟；主题式(类驻留)放置时其召回-延迟Pareto前沿优于仅相关性、nearest-k及延迟预算基线。中等延迟设置下P90拉取延迟降低41%而保留仅相关性召回的78%，选择开销亚毫秒，在200查询/秒下稳定。端到端QA中上下文拉取延迟降低43%，EM与仅相关性检索相差0.062以内。
AI.conclusion: GRaSP以轻量、免训练、理论最优的选择层在保持检索质量的同时有效降低地理分布式RAG的延迟与成本，其收益取决于数据放置，且在多个公开基准上具有泛化性。

title: Steerable Pluralistic Policy Alignment from Anonymized Crowd Feedback
summary: Pluralistic alignment requires AI systems to learn from diverse populations whose preferences may reflect heterogeneous or even conflicting objectives, and to personalize their behavior to individual users. Existing approaches in pluralistic alignment often assume access to annotator identities and rely on powerful pretrained representations to model individual preference variations. We propose Preference-PCA Pluralistic Learning (P3L), a novel framework for pluralistic alignment that jointly learns trajectory embeddings and the shared basis of preference directions via PCA decomposition from heterogeneous crowd feedback without requiring annotator identities. At test time, our approach enables rapid and accurate personalized reward learning and downstream policy optimization. Experiments across multiple embodied control tasks demonstrate that P3L enables steerable personal alignment that generalizes beyond the offline dataset to out-of-distribution new users and attains competitive RL and test performance, while substantially reducing computational cost and supporting variable adaptation query budgets.

AI.tldr: P3L：无需标注者身份的多元偏好对齐框架，用PCA联合学习轨迹嵌入与偏好方向共享基，实现快速个性化奖励学习。
AI.motivation: 多元对齐需从异质甚至冲突的群体偏好中学习并个性化到个体用户；现有方法依赖标注者身份和强预训练表示来建模个体偏好差异，成本高且受限。
AI.method: 提出Preference-PCA Pluralistic Learning (P3L)，从异质众包反馈中通过PCA分解联合学习轨迹嵌入与偏好方向的共享基，不依赖标注者身份；测试时基于该共享基进行快速、准确的个性化奖励学习与下游策略优化，并支持可变的查询预算。
AI.result: 在多个具身控制任务上，P3L实现可引导的个性化对齐，能泛化到离线数据集之外的新用户（OOD），RL与测试表现具竞争力，同时显著降低计算成本并适配不同自适应查询预算。
AI.conclusion: P3L表明无需标注者身份、借助PCA共享偏好基即可实现高效可扩展的多元个性化对齐，并具备对未见用户的泛化能力。

title: Multi-Objective Evolutionary Semi-Supervised Learning for Resource-Aware Smart City Classification
comment: ICSC-CITIES 2026. IX Ibero-American Congress of Smart Cities
summary: Smart-city applications often combine scarce labeled data with abundant unlabeled observations. Semi-supervised learning (SSL) exploits both labeled and unlabeled data to improve classification under limited supervision. This article presents MOEA-SSL, a multi-objective evolutionary approach for lightweight semi-supervised tabular classification that jointly optimizes predictive quality and feature usage. Experimental evaluation on three Smart City classification datasets, considering 1\%, 5\%, and 10\% labeled data, shows that MOEA-SSL achieves competitive predictive performance compared with established lightweight SSL methods while significantly reducing feature usage relative to EA-SSL in all evaluated conditions. The computed Pareto fronts also provide lower-feature-use alternatives with limited degradation in classification performance.

AI.tldr: MOEA-SSL是一种多目标进化方法，用于轻量级半监督表格分类，同时优化预测质量和特征使用量，在智慧城市数据集上以少量标注数据实现有竞争力的性能并显著降低特征使用。
AI.motivation: 智慧城市应用中标注数据稀缺而无标注数据丰富；现有轻量级半监督方法（如EA-SSL）在特征使用上代价较高，需要在保证分类性能的同时降低特征使用。
AI.method: 提出MOEA-SSL，一种多目标进化算法，联合优化预测质量与特征使用两个目标，面向轻量级半监督表格分类。
AI.result: 在三个智慧城市分类数据集、1%、5%、10%标注比例下，性能与现有轻量级SSL方法相当；相比EA-SSL在所有条件下均显著减少特征使用；得到的Pareto前沿还提供特征更少而性能损失有限的折中方案。
AI.conclusion: 多目标进化优化能在保持竞争性分类性能的同时有效降低特征使用，为标注稀缺的智慧城市场景提供可权衡的轻量级SSL方案。

title: AutoTerm-SST: Adaptive Terminology Memory with Zero Session-Time Setup for Streaming Speech Translation
comment: Submitted to EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations. Code available at https://github.com/luojiaxuan/autoterm-sst
summary: Retrieval-augmented speech translation improves rare terminology, but systems such as RASST still assume that users provide a glossary before each session. That assumption is inconvenient for live talks, while merging every domain into one growing glossary eventually places too many irrelevant terms in the same retrieval and prompt competition. We present AutoTerm-SST, an interactive system that removes session-time glossary upload and domain selection. It organizes a large offline terminology catalog into topic slices, matches recent streaming translation context to bilingual slice prototypes, and activates a compact multi-slice working set under fixed retrieval and prompt budgets. On five ACL and five ESO oncology talks, AutoTerm matches a known-domain reference in terminology accuracy (88.3% vs. 88.1%) and mWER-resegmented BLEU (45.09 vs. 45.19), while requiring no domain input. Compared with a one-million-entry merged glossary, it improves terminology accuracy by 3.9 points and BLEU by 2.30. Routing plus four-slice retrieval remains lightweight: the complete system runs at 0.406 RTF, and the vLLM host sustains 32 real-time sessions. The live demo exposes active slices and retrieved terminology as the topic changes, providing zero-setup terminology-aware streaming translation.

AI.tldr: AutoTerm-SST 是一个交互式同声传译系统，取消会前术语表上传与领域选择，自动从大规模术语库中激活紧凑的多切片工作集，实现零配置的术语感知流式翻译。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强语音翻译系统（如 RASST）要求用户在每次会话前提供术语表或选择领域，这对现场演讲不便；而把所有领域合并成一个大术语表又会让大量无关术语挤占同一检索与提示竞争空间。
AI.method: 将大型离线术语目录组织为话题切片；用最近流式翻译上下文与双语切片原型匹配；在固定检索和提示预算下激活紧凑的多切片工作集；并搭建实时演示界面展示当前活跃切片与检索到的术语。
AI.result: 在 5 场 ACL 和 5 场 ESO 肿瘤学演讲上，术语准确率 88.3%（对比已知领域参考 88.1%），mWER-resegmented BLEU 45.09（对比 45.19），且无需领域输入；相比百万条目合并术语表，术语准确率提升 3.9 点、BLEU 提升 2.30；完整系统 RTF 0.406，vLLM 主机支持 32 路实时会话。
AI.conclusion: 通过话题切片匹配与预算受限的多切片激活，可在不牺牲翻译质量的情况下实现零配置、轻量可扩展的术语感知流式语音翻译，并支持实时多会话演示。

title: A Hybrid Information Flow Analysis Framework for Android Hybrid Apps
summary: The WebView interface in Android (hybrid) applications enables the native side (e.g., Java) to exchange data with the Web (e.g., JavaScript). This creates cross-language information flow channels that existing single-language analyzers cannot analyze. Existing hybrid app analyses address only part of the problem: some build bridge-aware call graphs but provide limited information-flow analysis, some rely on coarse assumptions, and some focus only on web vulnerabilities. We present MifDroid, a static-analysis- guided dynamic-analysis framework with a lifecycle-aware per-WebView call graph, a bridge-aware type-and-effect system, and a modular JavaScript analysis engine. We evaluated MifDroid on 338 apps from the F-Droid repository (out of 4,126 total) that use addJavascriptInterface, enabling active communication between Java and JavaScript. Our guided dynamic phase adds 662 entries to the 444 produced by static analysis, raising the resolution rate from 36.5% to 74.5%, produces the resolved bridge-related entries for 115 apps that static analysis leaves empty. MifDroid reported 14 vulnerable cross-language information flows, five of which have been accepted and fixed by the maintainers.

AI.tldr: MifDroid：静态引导的动态分析框架，用生命周期感知的每-WebView调用图、桥接感知的类型与效果系统及模块化JS引擎，解决Android混合应用跨语言信息流分析问题。
AI.motivation: Android WebView使Java与JavaScript可交换数据，形成现有单语言分析器无法处理的跨语言信息流通道；已有混合应用分析只解决部分问题——有的构建桥接感知调用图但信息流分析有限，有的依赖粗糙假设，有的只关注Web漏洞。
AI.method: 提出MifDroid静态分析引导的动态分析框架，包含三部分：生命周期感知的per-WebView调用图、桥接感知的类型与效果系统、模块化JavaScript分析引擎。
AI.result: 在F-Droid的4126个应用里338个使用addJavascriptInterface的应用上评估：引导式动态阶段在静态分析444个条目基础上新增662个，解析率从36.5%升至74.5%；为115个静态分析结果为空的应用程序生成已解析的桥接相关条目；报告14个易受攻击的跨语言信息流，其中5个已被维护者接受并修复。
AI.conclusion: MifDroid通过静态引导的动态分析有效提升了跨语言桥接条目的解析率，并发现真实漏洞，验证了静态与动态结合分析混合应用信息流的可行性与实用价值。

title: Uncertainty Gates the Gradient: Adaptive Updates for Generalized Few-Shot 3D Segmentation
summary: In generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation, support annotations are often compromised by sparsity and occlusion. Blindly adapting to such low quality samples risks learning spurious geometric patterns rather than robust novel concepts. Although 3D Vision-Language Models have been introduced to sup plement supervision, the potential of uncertainty to actively govern adaptation dynamics remains underexplored. Existing signal-level methods like loss reweight ing fail to prevent unreliable episodes from steering the optimization trajectory. To address this, we propose Uncertainty-Gated Adaptive (UGA), to the best of our knowledge the first framework that elevates uncertainty to update-level gating for generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation. The core mod ule, Uncertainty-Gated Update (UG-Update), estimates episodic reliability via intra-class dispersion over merged support and pseudo-labeled novel supervision, and selectively gates residual gradient updates. This encourages the model to learn novel semantics from reliable episodes while attenuating updates during unreliable ones. Complementing this, we introduce an Uncertainty-Based Pseudo Label Filter (UB-Filter) to enforce learning from high-confidence dense signals. On ScanNet200 and ScanNet++ (1-/5-shot), UGA sets new state of the art with an average +3.08 HM IoU over the strongest prior baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 Uncertainty-Gated Adaptive (UGA)，首个将不确定性提升到"更新级门控"的广义少样本3D点云分割框架，通过不确定性门控残差梯度更新，在 ScanNet200 与 ScanNet++ 上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 广义少样本3D点云分割中，支撑集标注受稀疏与遮挡影响质量低，盲目适配易学到虚假几何模式；现有3D视觉语言模型虽补充监督，但不确定性的作用仍停留在信号级（如损失重加权），无法阻止不可靠的 episode 影响优化轨迹。
AI.method: 核心模块 UG-Update 通过合并支撑集与伪标签新类监督上的类内离散度估计 episode 可靠性，并选择性地门控残差梯度更新；辅以 UB-Filter 伪标签过滤器，强制从高置信度稠密信号中学习。
AI.result: 在 ScanNet200 和 ScanNet++ 的 1-shot/5-shot 设置上达到新 SOTA，相比最强基线平均提升 +3.08 HM IoU。
AI.conclusion: 将不确定性从信号级提升到更新级，可有效抑制不可靠 episode 对优化的干扰，使模型从可靠样本中稳健学习新类语义。

title: Pareto-Optimal RTL Code Generation via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning with Large Language Models
summary: Recent studies have proposed reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) methods that enable LLMs to generate high-quality RTL circuits from natural-language specifications. Existing approaches optimize circuit PPA (Power, Performance, Area) by aggregating multiple objectives into a single scalar reward, making it difficult to simultaneously generate diverse Pareto-optimal solutions across different trade-offs such as low power, low latency, and small area. However, in practical design, the relative importance of each objective varies depending on product requirements and design constraints; thus, obtaining a diverse and high-quality candidate set is beneficial in that designers can choose a preferred trade-off a posteriori. In this work, we are the first to propose a learning method for LLM-based circuit generation that optimizes, not the quality of a single circuit, but the quality and diversity of the entire circuit set obtained through multiple generations in the PPA objective space. The proposed method consists of (1) a generation-based training pipeline that reformulates coverage improvement of the entire Pareto solution set into a sequential circuit generation problem, and (2) a reward function based on Hypervolume Contribution (HVC) that measures how much a generated circuit contributes to the Pareto front. Evaluation on the RTLLM v2 benchmark shows that the proposed method achieves +13.3 percentage points in relative Hypervolume over a baseline without PPA optimization and +14.4 percentage points over a single-objective reinforcement learning method, while also demonstrating superiority in circuit diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向LLM电路生成的"集合级"强化学习方法，不优化单个电路，而是优化多次生成所得整个电路集合在PPA目标空间中的质量与多样性，通过基于超体积贡献(HVC)的奖励和顺序生成训练流程实现Pareto前沿覆盖。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法把PPA多目标聚合成单一标量奖励，难以同时生成低功耗、低延迟、小面积等不同权衡下的多样化Pareto最优解。而实际设计中各目标重要性随产品需求变化，设计师需要后验地选择合适权衡，因此高质量的多样化候选集合更有价值。
AI.method: (1) 基于生成的训练流程：将整个Pareto解集覆盖率的提升重构为顺序电路生成问题；(2) 基于超体积贡献(HVC)的奖励函数：度量每个生成电路对Pareto前沿的贡献大小。
AI.result: 在RTLLM v2基准上，相对超体积比无PPA优化基线提升13.3个百分点，比单目标强化学习方法提升14.4个百分点，并在电路多样性上表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 以集合级超体积贡献为奖励的多目标RLVR训练能有效提升LLM生成电路的Pareto前沿覆盖质量与多样性，为设计者提供可后验选择的高质量候选集。

title: UIBK-Embedding: Effective Text Retrieval by Unifying Dense and Late-Interaction Retrieval
summary: Dense bi-encoders and late-interaction retrievers are usually treated as alternatives, yet they fail on different queries: one vector captures what a text is about, token-level matching finds its exact entities and phrases. Using both today means two models, two indexes and a score-fusion step. We present UIBK-Embedding-v1, a 179M-parameter English encoder that produces both representations in one pass and scores them with one unmodified MaxSim. The dense embedding is written into the list of token vectors as three extra vectors, and a one-dimensional tag keeps the two kinds of vectors from matching each other, so that plain MaxSim equals the token-level MaxSim plus a weighted dense cosine. The model therefore runs in a standard late-interaction index without changes; we test it with PLAID. A shared 18-layer trunk with a separate 4-layer top per head, and a cross-encoder distilled into the fused score, turn the two heads into one retriever. On BEIR, UIBK-Embedding-v1 reaches 59.79 nDCG@10. This is 2.57 points above LateOn, the strongest model of its size, and 2.10 points above it when both models read documents of the same length; UIBK-Embedding-v1 is ahead on all 15 datasets. On a decontaminated version of BEIR it stays ahead on average (61.55 against 60.36) and on 8 of 12 datasets. Among the 156 models with complete BEIR results in the MTEB results repository, only models with at least 1.5B parameters score higher. Code, model weights, and a technical blog post are available at https://github.com/DataScienceUIBK/uibk-embedding , https://huggingface.co/DataScience-UIBK/uibk-embedding-v1 , and https://huggingface.co/blog/abdoelsayed/uibk-embedding-v1 .

AI.tldr: UIBK-Embedding-v1 用一个 179M 参数的编码器在一次前向中同时产出稠密向量与 token 级向量，并用未改动的 MaxSim 完成统一打分，在 BEIR 上达到 59.79 nDCG@10。
AI.motivation: 稠密双编码器擅长语义主题，迟交互检索器擅长精确实体与短语匹配，二者在不同查询上各有短板；同时使用需两个模型、两套索引与分数融合步骤，成本高且工程复杂。
AI.method: 将稠密向量作为 3 个额外向量写入 token 向量列表，并加一维标签阻止两类向量互相匹配，使普通 MaxSim 等价于 token 级 MaxSim 加加权稠密余弦；共享 18 层主干、每个头独立 4 层顶层，并以交叉编码器蒸馏进融合分数；可直接运行于标准迟交互索引（以 PLAID 验证）。
AI.result: BEIR 上 59.79 nDCG@10，比同规模最强模型 LateOn 高 2.57 分，等长文档条件下高 2.10 分，15 个数据集全部领先；去污染 BEIR 上平均 61.55 对 60.36，12 个数据集中 8 个领先；MTEB 仓库 156 个完整 BEIR 结果模型中，仅 1.5B 以上参数模型更高。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明稠密与迟交互表示可在单一模型、单一索引、单一打分规则下统一，在小参数量下取得接近大模型的检索效果，并已开源代码、权重与博客。

title: Expert-Guided Rubrics as Dense Reward Signals for Reinforcement Learning in Non-Verifiable Domains
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, RL4LLM-Agents workshop ICAIF ACM
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in non-verifiable domains such as financial services, where they must interpret user intent, rewrite queries, and retrieve information under domain-specific constraints. Although reinforcement learning (RL) can train such agents from the consequences of their actions, recent successes largely rely on verifiable tasks with automatically computed binary rewards. In non-verifiable retrieval tasks, assessing query quality requires scarce subject-matter expert (SME) judgment that is inherently graded rather than binary. With Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), sparse rewards yield no useful learning signal when all sampled outputs within a group receive the same outcome, causing optimization to stall. We introduce a method that converts a small, fixed investment of SME judgment into a dense reward and combines it with retrieval-based metrics to form a hybrid, GRPO-compatible training signal. Experiments show improvements of up to 6\% in Recall@3 and 6.7\% in MRR@3 compared with sparse-reward baselines.

AI.tldr: 针对非可验证领域的检索式LLM智能体，将少量专家(SME)的评分判断转化为稠密奖励，并与检索指标混合，构建GRPO可用的混合奖励信号，缓解稀疏奖励导致的学习停滞。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体被用于金融服务等非可验证领域，需要理解意图、改写查询并在领域约束下检索。现有RL进展多依赖可自动计算二元奖励的可验证任务，而查询质量需稀缺专家进行分级(非二元)判断。GRPO中稀疏奖励在同组样本结果相同时无有效学习信号，优化停滞。
AI.method: 提出将小规模、固定的SME判断投入转化为稠密奖励，并与基于检索的指标组合，形成混合的、与GRPO兼容的训练信号。
AI.result: 与稀疏奖励基线相比，Recall@3最高提升6%，MRR@3最高提升6.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过少量专家判断构造稠密混合奖励，可有效改善非可验证检索任务中LLM智能体的GRPO训练效果。

title: WaveCommitments: Private and Verifiable Speech-Agent Marketplaces
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, under review for a conference
summary: Modern speech systems are evolving into ecosystems of autonomous speech agents that speak together, negotiate, and trade assets such as embeddings, spectrograms, or raw data. In such markets, sellers cannot reveal assets for evaluation due to privacy constraints, and buyers cannot price what they cannot test. Thus, we open-source WaveCommitments, an end-to-end design that pairs confidential asset valuation via Data Shapley inside a trusted execution environment with multivariate polynomial commitments. It enables selective openings and tamper-evident provenance to prove that a delivered asset matches the valuation while hiding everything else. Our extensive experiments across three known datasets and various tasks with state-of-the-art encoders, including Whisper, reveal that we speed up the best benchmarks by up to 20x while reducing their proof sizes by up to 39x. We also systematically study how a speaker's value shifts across tasks and encoders, revealing agent-level market prices.

AI.tldr: 提出 WaveCommitments，将 TEE 内 Data Shapley 估值与多元多项式承诺结合，实现语音资产隐私估值与可验证交付，性能提升最高 20 倍、证明体积缩小 39 倍。
AI.motivation: 语音智能体生态中资产（嵌入、频谱图、原始数据）交易面临两难：卖方因隐私不能公开资产供评估，买方无法测试则无法定价，缺少兼顾隐私与可信定价的机制。
AI.method: 端到端设计：在可信执行环境（TEE）内用 Data Shapley 完成机密资产估值，配合多元多项式承诺实现选择性开放与防篡改来源证明，证明所交付资产与估值一致而隐藏其余信息。
AI.result: 在三个数据集及多种任务、包括 Whisper 等 SOTA 编码器上实验，相较最佳基线最高提速 20 倍、证明体积缩小 39 倍；并系统分析了说话人价值随任务与编码器的变化，揭示智能体级市场价格。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为隐私约束下的语音数据市场提供了可验证、可定价的开源方案，并展示了说话人数据的市场价格结构。

title: k-Submodular Cover Problem with a Matroid Constraint
summary: We investigate k-submodular cover problem with a matroid constraint on an n-element ground set V , which seeks k disjoint subsets of V with minimal cost, where their union is an independent set for some matroid defined on V and the k-submodular utility function surpasses a specified threshold. This problem generalizes the k-submodular cover problem and has a wide range of applications in artificial intelligence and combinatorial optimization. In this paper, we propose a matroid extended greedy algorithm for this problem, analyze its bi-criteria approximation ratio, and further derive an improved approximation ratio under the special case of unit costs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带拟阵约束的 k-子模覆盖问题：在 n 元集合 V 上选取 k 个不相交子集，使其并集为某个拟阵的独立集且 k-子模效用达到阈值，代价最小；提出拟阵扩展贪心算法并给出双标准近似比，单位代价情形下得到更优近似比。
AI.motivation: k-子模覆盖问题在人工智能与组合优化中有广泛应用，而实际场景常附加拟阵约束（如独立性/多样性限制）。已有工作缺少对"k-子模覆盖 + 拟阵约束"这一更一般模型的算法与近似保证，因此需要填补该空白。
AI.method: 将该问题建模为带拟阵约束的 k-子模覆盖问题（推广了经典 k-子模覆盖问题）；设计"拟阵扩展贪心算法"（matroid extended greedy），在贪心选择中同时兼顾 k-子模边际增益与拟阵独立性约束，并对其进行双标准近似比分析；随后针对单位代价特例进一步改进分析。
AI.result: 给出了该算法在一般代价下的双标准近似比（即允许覆盖阈值或代价约束之一被放松的近似保证），并在单位代价这一特殊情形下导出了改进的（更强）近似比。
AI.conclusion: 所提拟阵扩展贪心算法为带拟阵约束的 k-子模覆盖问题提供了理论可证的近似保证，推广并统一了已有的 k-子模覆盖结果；单位代价情形下的改进比值显示约束结构对近似性的影响，未来可探索更紧的界与更一般的约束形式。

title: XRust: Detecting Logical Races in Rust Linux Drivers
summary:
Rust is increasingly used in Linux to improve memory safety, but its guarantees do not prevent logical races: individually synchronized operations can still interleave in ways that violate higher-level invariants. Detecting such bugs typically requires manually written specifications and carefully controlled execution environments.
  We present XRust, a technique for detecting logical races in Linux Rust drivers without manually specified invariants. Using Logical Happens-Before (LHB) analysis, XRust identifies shared-state accesses relevant to logical ordering, automatically constructs operation-pair harnesses, and uses serial differential oracles to detect concurrent executions inconsistent with either serial order. XRust also uses lightweight userspace abstractions to execute driver code under reproducible schedules. Applied to Linux 7.3-rc2, XRust identifies 17 shared objects across 102 Rust files from ten drivers, constructs 1,654 executable harnesses, and discovers two previously unknown logical races. The rnull block-driver race has been confirmed by Linux maintainers, with a fix accepted into the Linux block subsystem tree.

AI.tldr: XRust：面向 Linux Rust 驱动的逻辑竞态检测技术，基于 Logical Happens-Before 分析自动生成操作对 harness，用串行差分预言机检测并发执行与任一串行顺序不一致的情况，无需手写不变式。
AI.motivation: Rust 的内存安全保证无法阻止逻辑竞态：各自同步的操作仍可能以违反高层不变量的方式交错。现有检测需要人工编写规格说明和精心控制的执行环境，成本高且难以推广。
AI.method: 1) 用 LHB（Logical Happens-Before）分析识别与逻辑顺序相关的共享状态访问；2) 自动构造操作对（operation-pair）harness；3) 使用串行差分预言机，检测并发执行结果与任一串行顺序均不一致的情况；4) 借助轻量级用户态抽象在可复现调度下执行驱动代码。
AI.result: 在 Linux 7.3-rc2 上，从十个驱动的 102 个 Rust 文件中识别出 17 个共享对象，构造 1,654 个可执行 harness，发现两个此前未知的逻辑竞态。其中 rnull 块驱动竞态已获 Linux 维护者确认，修复已合入 Linux block 子系统树。
AI.conclusion: XRust 表明无需人工规格即可在真实内核 Rust 驱动中有效发现逻辑竞态，并已产生被上游接受的实用修复，具备实际工程价值。

title: Memory Internalization via Test-Time Training for Long-Video Understanding
summary: Long-video understanding often requires answering many questions about a single video whose evidence is distributed across extended temporal contexts. Conventional video-language models repeatedly encode frames or retrieve visual evidence for every question. Parameterized video memory offers a write-once alternative, but existing methods rely primarily on synthesized text and fixed adaptation configurations, leaving open where video knowledge should be written and how visual evidence should shape the memory. We introduce Memory Internalization via Test-Time Training (MIT^3), a per-video adaptation framework that writes each long video into compact, video-specific adaptive parameters for video-free, text-only question answering. Under compact multi-scale supervision, causal tracing measures the causal memory utility of each model layer for video-grounded answering and selects video-specific adaptation locations. Visual memory distillation then trains the text-only memory to reproduce the representation change induced by the relevant video clip, preserving the internal effect of visual evidence beyond textual supervision. Across LVBench, LongVideoBench, and Video-MME, MIT^3 achieves data-efficient video-free question answering with substantially fewer synthesized samples than prior parameterized video-memory methods, demonstrating that effective video internalization depends on both where knowledge is written and how visual evidence is distilled into the model.

AI.tldr: MIT^3 是一种逐视频的测试时训练框架，把长视频"写入"紧凑的视频专属自适应参数，之后无需视频、仅凭文本即可问答；其核心是"在哪里写"(因果追踪选层)与"如何写"(视觉记忆蒸馏)两个设计。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解中证据分散在长时间跨度上。传统视频语言模型需对每个问题重复编码帧或检索证据，开销大；已有的参数化视频记忆虽"一次写入、多次读取"，但主要依赖合成文本且适配配置固定，未解决"视频知识应写入何处"以及"视觉证据应如何塑造记忆"这两个问题。
AI.method: 1) 在紧凑多尺度监督下，用因果追踪(causal tracing)量化各模型层对视频落地问答的因果记忆效用，从而为每个视频选择专属的适配层位置；2) 视觉记忆蒸馏：训练纯文本记忆去复现相关视频片段所引起的表示变化，使视觉证据的内部效应在文本监督之外得以保留。
AI.result: 在 LVBench、LongVideoBench、Video-MME 三个基准上，MIT^3 实现了数据高效的无视频问答，所需合成样本显著少于以往参数化视频记忆方法。
AI.conclusion: 有效的视频内部化同时取决于"知识写入何处"与"视觉证据如何蒸馏进模型"，二者结合可在极少数据下实现高效的长视频记忆。

title: MedPAO-Assist: Edge-Deployable, Modality-Aware Agentic AI for Radiology Report Structuring
comment: The paper has been accepted at MICCAI Workshop Agentic AI for Medicine, 2026
summary: The adoption of Large Language Models for radiology report structuring has been largely dominated by either proprietary cloud-based models or large open models requiring high-end GPUs for deployment, which is a critical bottleneck for clinical adoption in radiology workflows that demand data privacy and offline operation. To address this, we present MedPAO-Assist, an edge-deployable agentic framework that generates structured radiology reports directly from radiologist dictation and voice commands, requiring only $\approx3.3$ GB peak RAM and achieving an average end-to-end latency of $\approx31$ seconds on a standard laptop CPU through an asynchronous, multi-threaded execution pipeline. The system currently supports four major imaging modalities -- Chest X-ray, Chest CT, Abdomen CT, and Brain MRI. To our knowledge, it is among the earliest agentic systems to run its entire pipeline with a Small Language Model (SLM) in the 0.6B-parameter range. This multi-agent architecture, built around an Extract-Ground-Generate paradigm, performs concept extraction, SNOMED-CT grounding, and structured report generation, followed by a speech-driven human-in-the-loop correction phase, together forming a fully "no-touch" reporting workflow that requires no keyboard input, external API calls, or internet connectivity. We evaluate each pipeline stage individually -- concept extraction, ontology grounding, and concept categorization and report hardware profiling results demonstrating the system's feasibility for real-time, CPU-only clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出MedPAO-Assist，一种可在边缘设备（普通笔记本CPU、峰值RAM约3.3 GB、端到端延迟约31秒）离线运行的智能体框架，用0.6B级小模型从放射科医生口述与语音指令直接生成结构化报告。
AI.motivation: 现有放射报告结构化方案依赖专有云模型或需高端GPU的大模型，难以满足临床对数据隐私与离线运行的要求，成为落地的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用多智能体架构与Extract-Ground-Generate范式：概念抽取、SNOMED-CT本体接地、结构化报告生成，之后加语音驱动的人在回路纠错，配合异步多线程流水线实现"无接触"报告流程，无需键盘、外部API或联网。支持胸部X线、胸部CT、腹部CT、脑MRI四种模态。
AI.result: 对概念抽取、本体接地、概念分类各阶段分别评估，并给出硬件性能剖析，证明CPU专用实时临床部署的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 据称是较早实现全流程0.6B级小模型运行的智能体系统，验证了隐私友好、离线、低资源的结构化报告生成可行，但其价值最终取决于各阶段准确率与临床场景下的实测表现。

title: Neighborhood-Aware Unlearning for Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation predicts items by autoregressively generating semantic identifiers (SIDs), whose tokens are shared across semantically related items. With this paradigm gaining adoption, the question of how to support unlearning in it has become pressing. If training interactions must later be removed, such as injected spam or interactions with items a user no longer wants, this sharing lets an unlearning update unintentionally affect the predictions for the interactions' neighbors. We show that this effect is locally structured and hidden by global metrics: unlearning can leave recommendation utility on the whole test set nearly unchanged while substantially degrading it on neighborhoods of the forgotten interactions' SIDs. We propose Neighborhood-Aware Unlearning (NAU), which augments interaction-level unlearning with explicit control over the probability mass assigned to the forgotten items' neighborhoods. Across three datasets and four SID tokenizers, NAU restores spam-induced exposure toward the retrained reference while retaining more than 95% of retrained utility, and recovers the neighborhood utility that forget-and-repair unlearning loses at no global cost. We identify local probability redistribution as an important failure mode of unlearning in SID-based generative recommenders and show that explicitly controlling this redistribution can mitigate its effects.

AI.tldr: 生成式推荐中使用共享语义标识符(SID)，导致遗忘学习会意外影响邻居物品的预测；作者提出邻域感知遗忘(NAU)以显式控制遗忘物品邻域的概率质量分配。
AI.motivation: 基于SID自回归生成的生成式推荐中，token在语义相关物品间共享。当需要移除训练交互（如垃圾信息注入或用户不再想要的物品交互）时，这种共享会使遗忘更新意外波及邻居物品的预测。而全局指标掩盖了该问题：整体测试集效用几乎不变，但遗忘交互SID邻域上的效用显著下降。
AI.method: NAU在交互级遗忘的基础上，显式控制分配给被遗忘物品邻域的概率质量，从而约束遗忘更新导致的局部概率重分配。
AI.result: 在三个数据集和四种SID分词器上，NAU将垃圾信息导致的曝光恢复至重训练参考水平，同时保留超过95%的重训练效用，并以无全局代价的方式恢复forget-and-repair方法丢失的邻域效用。
AI.conclusion: 论文识别出局部概率重分配是SID生成式推荐遗忘学习的重要失效模式，并证明显式控制这种重分配可有效缓解其影响。

title: Beyond Policy Discrepancy: Capability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates domain specialists into a shared student, but determining how strongly each teacher should supervise remains challenging. Existing discrepancy-based allocation can assign strong supervision even when the student already matches or exceeds the teacher's task performance, since behavioral mismatch does not necessarily imply a remaining capability deficit. We propose Capability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (CA-MOPD), which combines specialist merging with capability-guided allocation to account for what the student has already learned. CA-MOPD first merges reinforcement-learning specialists into a strong student initialization, then uses verifier-estimated teacher--student capability gaps to adjust domain-level distillation strength. Supervision decreases as capability gaps close and increases when estimated student capability regresses, while dense token-level guidance remains provided by the teachers. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and instruction following, CA-MOPD achieves an average score of 32.22, outperforming naive MOPD, Open-MOPD, and the merged initialization by 0.86, 0.83, and 0.74 points, respectively. Controlled comparisons further support the benefits of merged initialization and capability-gap guidance under matched training budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出 CA-MOPD，将专家合并初始化与"能力差距引导"结合：用验证器估计师-生能力差距来调节各领域蒸馏强度，差距缩小则减弱监督、能力回退则增强，同时保留 token 级密集指导。六个基准（数学、代码、指令跟随）平均分 32.22，优于 naive MOPD、Open-MOPD 与合并初始化 0.86/0.83/0.74 分。
AI.motivation: 多教师 on-policy 蒸馏（MOPD）需决定各教师监督强度。已有基于差异（discrepancy）的分配方式存在缺陷：行为不一致≠能力欠缺，学生在已匹配甚至超过教师表现的领域仍被施加强监督，浪费或干扰容量。
AI.method: 两阶段：(1) 先将 RL 专家合并为强学生初始化；(2) 以验证器估计的师生能力差距调整领域级蒸馏强度——差距收敛则降低监督权重，检测到学生能力回退则提高权重，教师仍提供密集 token 级指导。
AI.result: 数学、代码生成、指令跟随三类共六个基准上平均 32.22 分，分别高出 naive MOPD、Open-MOPD 与纯合并初始化 0.86、0.83、0.74 分；等训练预算下的对照实验进一步验证了合并初始化与能力差距引导的收益。
AI.conclusion: 以"能力缺口"而非"行为差异"作为蒸馏强度依据更合理，配合专家合并初始化可在多域蒸馏中稳定提升综合性能。

title: Multimodal Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition with Bidirectional Audio--Text Cross-Attention
summary: Ambivalence and hesitancy (A/H) are subtle behavioural states that can be expressed through both what a person says and how it is spoken. This paper presents an audio--text framework for video-level A/H recognition. Full-video transcripts and speech waveforms are encoded using pre-trained multilingual BERT and wav2vec~2.0, respectively, and projected into a shared representation space. Two stacked bidirectional cross-attention blocks allow linguistic tokens to attend to acoustic frames and acoustic frames to attend to linguistic context without requiring explicit temporal alignment. The resulting sequences are aggregated through masked mean pooling and combined using concatenation, element-wise products, and absolute differences for binary classification. We evaluate the model on the subject-independent split of the Behavioural Ambivalence/Hesitancy (BAH) dataset. The proposed system achieves 72.19\% accuracy, 75.00\% precision, 81.13\% recall, 77.95\% A/H F1-score, and 70.16\% Macro-F1 on the test set. These results demonstrate the potential of jointly modelling linguistic and acoustic information for automatic A/H recognition.code at:https://github.com/DorriG/ECCV.

AI.tldr: 提出音文跨注意力框架用于视频级矛盾/犹豫(A/H)识别，在BAH数据集subject-independent划分上取得72.19%准确率与77.95% F1。
AI.motivation: 矛盾与犹豫(A/H)是微妙的行为状态，既体现在说话内容也体现在说话方式上，因此需要同时利用语言与声学信息进行识别；但两种模态缺乏显式时间对齐。
AI.method: 用多语言BERT编码全视频转写文本、wav2vec 2.0编码语音波形，投影到共享表示空间；堆叠两层双向交叉注意力使语言token与声学帧互相注意（无需显式时间对齐）；再用掩码均值池化聚合，通过拼接、逐元素乘积、绝对差三种方式融合后做二分类。
AI.result: 在BAH数据集subject-independent测试集上：准确率72.19%，精确率75.00%，召回率81.13%，A/H F1 77.95%，Macro-F1 70.16%。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模语言与声学信息对自动A/H识别具有潜力；代码已开源。

title: Fundamental Impossibility Results in AI Safety: Trading Off between Desiderata
summary: Is there a fundamental tradeoff between desiderata for safe AI systems, such as harmlessness and helpfulness? We answer by formalizing the interaction between AI systems and users as a game with three players: a defender and an attacker that are computationally or informationally bounded, and an AI that provides public advice and is less constrained. Our main result shows that there is a fundamental tradeoff in providing advice that helps the defender while advice remains public. We also consider whether the information that the AI shares can be manipulated to benefit only the defender and conclude with a discussion of how we can use these results in designing safer AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将AI系统与用户的交互建模为防御者、攻击者和AI三方博弈，证明了在提供公开建议时，"有用性"与"无害性"之间存在根本性权衡。
AI.motivation: 探讨安全AI系统的各项目标（如无害性与有用性）之间是否存在根本性权衡，为设计更安全的AI系统提供理论依据。
AI.method: 将AI系统与用户的交互形式化为三方博弈：计算或信息受限的防御者、攻击者，以及提供公开建议且约束较少的AI；分析AI所分享的信息能否被操纵以仅利于防御者。
AI.result: 主要结果表明：只要建议是公开的，提供既帮助防御者又保持无害的建议存在根本性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 讨论了如何利用这些结果来设计更安全的AI系统。

title: Characterizing Post-Incident Software Evolution
summary: BACKGROUND: After a software incident, organizations attempt to improve the reliability of their software systems by conducting post-incident analysis and identifying actions to prevent or mitigate similar future incidents. Despite the importance of this activity, there is a limited understanding of the nature and characteristics of the software evolution triggered by the analysis process. AIMS: This study seeks to bridge this gap by providing the first empirical characterization of post-incident software evolution. We aim to establish an understanding of how these changes manifest, specifically focusing on how their characteristics (such as effort, location, and timing) differ from standard maintenance and evolutionary changes. METHOD: We conducted a mixed-methods analysis of a 10-year longitudinal dataset from Wikimedia, examining 1,302 tasks and 2,203 code reviews. We categorized these changes across five dimensions: target, effort, abandonment rate, prioritization, and time-to-resolve. RESULTS: Our results show that the post-incident evolution is distinct from other change types. Post-incident changes are more time-consuming, with a median completion time over twice that of other changes and are disproportionately concentrated in a server configuration repository. CONCLUSION: By identifying a few of the characteristics of post-incident evolution, this work provides a foundation for future research into reliability engineering and learning from failure. We highlight further avenues for exploration necessary to fully understand post-incident evolution. Lastly, our work enables researchers to move beyond high-level analysis and begin developing specialized methods and tooling tailored to the nature of post-incident evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对"事故后软件演进"进行实证刻画：基于Wikimedia十年数据（1,302个任务、2,203次代码评审），从目标、工作量、放弃率、优先级和解决时长五个维度分析事故后变更，发现其与常规维护和演进性变更存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 事故后分析被组织广泛用于识别改进措施以防范未来事故，但人们对这类分析所触发的软件演进的性质和特征理解有限，缺乏关于事故后变更在形态与特征上如何区别于常规维护与演进的系统性认识。
AI.method: 采用混合方法，对Wikimedia长达10年的纵向数据集进行实证分析，覆盖1,302个任务与2,203次代码评审；从五个维度对变更进行分类：变更目标、工作量、放弃率、优先级和解决时长。
AI.result: 事故后演进具有独特性：事故后变更更耗时，中位完成时长是其他变更的两倍以上；且在服务器配置代码库中高度集中。其余维度（放弃率、优先级等）也呈现与其他变更类型的差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了事故后演进的部分特征，为可靠性工程与"从失败中学习"的后续研究奠定基础；指出需进一步探索以全面理解事故后演进，并使研究者能够超越高层分析，开发针对事故后演进特性的专用方法与工具。

title: CodecMotion-OAD: Efficient Online Action Detection with Compressed-Domain Motion
summary: Online action detection (OAD) identifies ongoing actions in streaming videos. Many existing OAD systems combine RGB appearance with optical flow, but dense-flow extraction remains a major computational bottleneck. Codec motion vectors (MVs) are available during decoding, avoiding a separate optical-flow computation. On THUMOS'14, optical flow exceeds MVs by 11.2 mAP points with motion-only inputs, whereas the gap narrows to 3.7 points after RGB fusion, with the largest reduction in action-category discrimination. We propose CodecMotion-OAD, which replaces optical flow with decoder-provided MVs while retaining existing temporal detector architectures. Its two-stage training first aligns MV features with a pretrained flow-feature interface without action labels and then trains RGB+MV detectors using ground-truth labels and soft predictions from a frozen RGB+Flow teacher. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of codec MVs to frame-level OAD. On THUMOS'14 with MiniROAD, CodecMotion-OAD achieves 68.3 mAP versus 70.9 mAP for matched-distillation RGB+Flow, while reducing decoder-to-prediction processing time by 11.48-fold on CPU and 2.04-fold on GPU.

AI.tldr: CodecMotion-OAD用解码器提供的码流运动矢量替代光流，通过两阶段训练嵌入现有OAD检测器，在THUMOS'14上以68.3 mAP（对比RGB+Flow的70.9）换取CPU 11.48倍、GPU 2.04倍的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有在线动作检测（OAD）系统通常结合RGB外观与光流，但稠密光流提取是主要计算瓶颈。码流中的运动矢量（MV）在解码时即可获得，无需额外计算。作者分析发现：仅用运动输入时，光流在THUMOS'14上比MV高11.2 mAP，而RGB融合后差距缩小到3.7 mAP，且差距主要来自动作类别区分能力，说明MV在融合框架下具有可行性。
AI.method: 提出CodecMotion-OAD，保留现有时序检测器架构，用解码器提供的MV替代光流。两阶段训练：第一阶段不使用动作标签，将MV特征与预训练的光流特征接口对齐；第二阶段使用真实标签及冻结的RGB+Flow教师模型的软预测，训练RGB+MV检测器。
AI.result: 在THUMOS'14上使用MiniROAD，CodecMotion-OAD达到68.3 mAP，而同等蒸馏的RGB+Flow为70.9 mAP；同时将解码到预测的处理时间在CPU上降低11.48倍、GPU上降低2.04倍。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是码流MV首次应用于帧级在线动作检测。以约2.6 mAP的精度损失换取大幅效率提升，说明码流MV可作为光流的实用替代方案。

title: DataPraxis: Scaling Analytics Tasks via Verified Workspace Evolution
summary: General-purpose agents are increasingly expected to perform professional analytics work, which requires sustained reasoning, iterative investigation, and reliable evidence. Training these capabilities requires diverse and challenging tasks. However, generating tasks directly from raw data often overlooks deeper questions that emerge through analysis and provides limited evidence for verification. To address these limitations, we introduce DataPraxis, an analytics task synthesis framework based on verified workspace evolution. The framework progressively enriches workspaces with validated findings and artifacts, then inherits and combines these workspaces to uncover deeper questions. It constructs tasks from accumulated findings and their dependencies, verifying analytical results both during evolution and after task assembly. Using this framework, we construct DataPraxis-5K, a dataset of 5,000 verified trajectories spanning diverse domains and output formats, to train DataPraxis-27B and DataPraxis-35B-A3B. DataPraxis-27B achieves 55.11 on DABStep and 51.9 on JobBench, matching or surpassing frontier models such as GLM-5.2. DataPraxis-5K is available at huggingface.co/datasets/stargazerhust/DataPraxis-5k

AI.tldr: DataPraxis：基于验证式工作区演化的数据分析任务合成框架，构建5K验证轨迹训练通用智能体，27B模型在DABStep/JobBench上媲美前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 通用智能体需具备专业数据分析能力（持续推理、迭代探究、可靠证据），但直接从原始数据生成任务往往忽视分析过程中涌现的深层问题，且缺乏可用于验证的证据。
AI.method: 提出DataPraxis框架：通过验证发现与产物逐步丰富工作区，继承并组合工作区以挖掘更深层问题；基于累积发现及其依赖构建任务，在演化过程与任务组装后双重验证分析结果。据此构建DataPraxis-5K数据集（5000条验证轨迹，覆盖多领域与多种输出格式），并训练DataPraxis-27B与DataPraxis-35B-A3B。
AI.result: DataPraxis-27B在DABStep取得55.11、JobBench取得51.9，达到或超过GLM-5.2等前沿模型水平。
AI.conclusion: 以工作区演化与双重验证为核心的任务合成能提供更深入、可验证的分析任务，有效提升智能体专业分析能力；数据集已开源。

title: FLINT: Fixed-budget Late Interaction
summary: Multi-vector retrieval models such as ColBERT often outperform single-vector models of comparable scale by matching queries and documents at the token level. However, retaining a vector for every token substantially increases storage requirements and slows retrieval compared to single-vector bi-encoders, limiting their scalability. We introduce FLINT (Fixed-budget Late INTeraction), an architecture that uses attention-based pooling to represent each query and document with a fixed number of embedding vectors. Unlike architectures that pool only document representations while retaining token-level queries, FLINT applies pooling symmetrically to both sides, limiting document storage and the number of vector comparisons needed during retrieval. FLINT achieves comparable ranking effectiveness to the closest baselines on BEIR and outperforms them on several benchmarks with longer and more complex queries, including BrowseComp+, CRUMB, and TREC Tip-of-the-Tongue 2025. We demonstrate that FLINT's effectiveness-efficiency benefits extend across encoder architectures, testing it on two separate backbones (BERT and ModernBERT). On long-query corpora, FLINT delivers 1.5-2.8 times faster end-to-end retrieval than ConstBERT, the closest baseline. FLINT also reduces index size by 5.3-9.3 times relative to token-level late-interaction models such as ColBERTv2.

AI.tldr: 提出 FLINT，用注意力池化把查询和文档都压缩为固定数量的向量，在保持后期交互效果的同时大幅降低存储和检索开销。
AI.motivation: 多向量检索（如 ColBERT）在 token 级匹配上优于同规模单向量模型，但为每个 token 保留向量使存储量剧增、检索变慢，限制可扩展性。已有池化方案多只压缩文档而保留 token 级查询，未能对称压缩。
AI.method: FLINT（Fixed-budget Late INTeraction）采用注意力池化，对查询和文档对称地各表示为固定数量的嵌入向量；相比仅池化文档的方案，同时限制了文档存储量以及检索时的向量比较次数，并可在 BERT 和 ModernBERT 两种骨干上使用。
AI.result: 在 BEIR 上与最接近的基线效果相当，在查询更长更复杂的基准（BrowseComp+、CRUMB、TREC Tip-of-the-Tongue 2025）上更优；长查询语料上端到端检索比 ConstBERT 快 1.5–2.8 倍；索引大小相对 ColBERTv2 等 token 级后期交互模型缩减 5.3–9.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 对称的固定预算池化能在多向量检索中实现效果与效率的良好平衡，优势可跨编码器架构迁移，是一种可扩展的后期交互替代方案。

title: Dynamic System Inspired Continuous Large Language Model for AI4Science Tasks
summary: Scientific foundation models increasingly operate on continuous phenomena, yet still use discrete residual computation. We ask whether pretrained residual transformations can support additional latent computation without expanding the backbone. To test this possibility, we introduce Continuum-LM, which reuses these transformations as dynamical operators in a continuous-depth language model. Its hidden states evolve through an ordinary differential equation evaluated by higher-order numerical integration, with solver order and step size controlling computation. Across eight scientific tasks, Continuum-LM trains stably and improves mean exact-match accuracy by 7.77 and 10.96 percentage points over discrete counterparts at the 0.6B and 1.7B scales, respectively. At 0.6B, it also outperforms an Ouro-style recurrent control under matched parameter and residual-function evaluation budgets. Together, these results support extensible computational depth through parameter reuse, identifying continuous hidden-state evolution as a practical design dimension for scientific language models beyond parameter scaling.

AI.tldr: Continuum-LM将预训练残差变换复用为连续深度语言模型中的动力算子，隐藏状态用ODE高阶数值积分演化，在不扩大骨干的前提下通过求解器阶数与步长调节计算量，在八个科学任务上稳定训练并显著超越离散基线。
AI.motivation: 科学基础模型处理连续现象，却仍采用离散残差计算。作者想验证：能否在不扩展骨干网络的条件下，用预训练的残差变换支持额外的潜空间计算，即通过参数复用来获得可扩展的计算深度，而非依赖参数规模扩张。
AI.method: 提出Continuum-LM：把预训练残差变换当作常微分方程中的动力算子，隐藏状态由一个ODE描述，并用高阶数值积分求解，计算量由求解器阶数和步长控制。在八个科学任务、0.6B与1.7B两个规模上与离散对应模型比较，并在参数与残差函数评估预算匹配下与Ouro式循环控制对比。
AI.result: Continuum-LM训练稳定；在0.6B和1.7B规模下，平均精确匹配准确率分别比离散对应模型高7.77和10.96个百分点；0.6B规模下在参数与残差函数评估预算匹配时也优于Ouro式循环控制。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可通过参数复用实现可扩展的计算深度，连续隐藏状态演化是科学语言模型中超越参数扩展的实用设计维度。

title: Mixture of Phonetic Experts Based Low-Rank Adaptation of Conformer Models for Accented English Speech Recognition
comment: Accepted at Interspeech 2026 (Sydney, 27 September to 1 October 2026). 5 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
summary: We present Mixture of Phonetic Experts based Low-Rank Adaptation (MoPE-LoRA), a parameter-efficient adaptation framework for accented English speech recognition. Recent mixture-of-experts approaches typically allocate experts per accent, implicitly treating accent identity as the primary axis of variation. In contrast, we organize adaptation along phonetic categories, motivated by the observation that accent differences are often expressed as systematic distortions of phoneme realization. MoPE-LoRA introduces a fixed set of six low-rank experts aligned with manner-of-articulation classes and performs frame-level routing through a hybrid mechanism that combines phoneme supervision with learned acoustic gating. Because the expert set is shared across accents, the model does not require accent-specific modules and naturally extends to previously unseen accents. Experiments on L2-ARCTIC show that MoPE-LoRA consistently improves over single LoRA and full fine-tuning. In zero-shot evaluation where one accent is held out during training, the proposed method yields a 12.3% relative improvement over single LoRA. These results indicate that phonetic-category-based decomposition offers a scalable and transferable alternative to accent-level adaptation.

AI.tldr: MoPE-LoRA提出按语音发音方式类别组织的六个低秩混合专家，用音素监督与声学门控的帧级路由实现参数高效的口音语音识别自适应，并天然支持未见口音。
AI.motivation: 现有混合专家方法多以口音身份划分专家，隐式把口音当作主要变化轴；但口音差异往往表现为音素实现方式的系统性偏移，按口音分配专家缺乏可迁移性，难以处理未见口音。
AI.method: MoPE-LoRA构建与发音方式类别（manner-of-articulation）对应的固定六个低秩专家；采用结合音素监督与可学习声学门控的混合机制进行帧级路由；专家集在所有口音间共享，无需口音专用模块。
AI.result: 在L2-ARCTIC上，MoPE-LoRA稳定优于单一LoRA与全参数微调；在留一口音做零样本评测时，相对单一LoRA取得12.3%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 按语音类别而非口音层级分解自适应，是一种可扩展且可迁移的替代方案。

title: Simple Strategy-Iteration with Dantzig's Rule is not Strongly Polynomial on Turn-Based Deterministic Games
summary: We study turn-based deterministic zero-sum games with discounted and long-run average costs. For discounted costs, we establish exponential and superpolynomial iteration lower bounds for the simple strategy-iteration method with Dantzig's rule under unrestricted costs and unit weights, respectively. To the best of our knowledge, this shows for the first time that the method is not strongly polynomial even when all action costs belong to $\{-1,0,1\}$. For long-run average costs, we establish an exponential iteration lower bound for termination of a Dantzig counterpart with unrestricted costs and prove that it admits a strongly polynomial implementation with unit weights.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了折扣成本与长期平均成本下的回合制确定性零和博弈，证明了Dantzig规则下简单策略迭代方法在折扣成本情形下即使动作成本取{-1,0,1}也不是强多项式的，并对长期平均成本情形给出指数级下界及单位权重下的强多项式实现。
AI.motivation: 此前不清楚简单策略迭代（Dantzig规则）在回合制零和博弈中是否具有强多项式复杂度，尤其是成本受限（如{-1,0,1}或单位权重）时；本文旨在厘清其复杂度边界。
AI.method: 针对折扣成本博弈，构造反例给出简单策略迭代配合Dantzig规则的指数级与超多项式迭代下界（分别对应无限制成本与单位权重）；针对长期平均成本博弈，分析Dantzig对应算法的终止行为并设计强多项式实现。
AI.result: 折扣成本下：无限制成本得到指数迭代下界，单位权重得到超多项式下界，且证明即使动作成本属于{-1,0,1}该方法也非强多项式（首次）。长期平均成本下：无限制成本下Dantzig对应算法终止有指数迭代下界，而在单位权重下存在强多项式实现。
AI.conclusion: Dantzig规则下的简单策略迭代在一般（甚至受限）成本下不具强多项式性，但在长期平均成本的单位权重情形可通过强多项式实现，明确了该算法的复杂度分界。

title: Documentation Drift in AI-Generated Pull Requests
summary: AI coding agents now contribute to software repositories at scale, yet their documentation practices remain uncharacterised. We analyse 29,669 AI-generated pull requests from 2,585 repositories in the AIDev dataset, measuring documentation co-change: whether code-file modifications are accompanied by a documentation-file update in the same PR. We find that 63.2% of AI PRs change code without updating any documentation. This varies sharply by task type: 55.2% for features and 77.5% for refactoring. Undocumented code files are followed by a fix to the same file 8.6 to 11.7% more often than documented files across 30 to 90-day windows. A raw PR-level comparison shows the opposite because documented PRs are 3.9 times larger and therefore attract more fixes. Controlling for size exposure reverses this result. Documented changes also merge faster despite their larger size (median: 40 seconds versus 184 seconds), although merging is largely automated in this dataset. Documentation drift also compounds: within 90 days, a file changed without documentation is later re-documented at roughly half the rate of a file changed with documentation (24% versus 48%). This suggests that documentation debt tends to accumulate rather than be revisited.

AI.tldr: 对 2,585 个仓库的 29,669 个 AI 生成 PR 分析文档共变（documentation co-change），发现 63.2% 的 AI PR 只改代码不更新文档，未文档化代码后续更易被修复、且文档债会累积而非偿还。
AI.motivation: AI 编码代理已大规模参与软件仓库贡献，但其文档编写实践尚未被刻画，因此需要量化 AI 生成 PR 的文档行为及其后果。
AI.method: 使用 AIDev 数据集中 2,585 个仓库的 29,669 个 AI 生成 PR，测量代码文件修改是否伴随同一 PR 内的文档文件更新；按任务类型分组统计，并在 30–90 天窗口内追踪同一文件后续修复与再文档化情况；通过控制规模暴露（size exposure）修正文档化 PR 体量更大的混杂。
AI.result: 63.2% 的 AI PR 改代码而未更新文档，功能类为 55.2%，重构类高达 77.5%。未文档化文件在 30–90 天内被修复的概率比已文档化文件高 8.6%–11.7%；PR 层面原始比较结果相反，因文档化 PR 体量是前者 3.9 倍，控制规模后结论反转。文档化变更合并更快（中位数 40 秒 vs 184 秒，尽管体量更大，但合并多为自动化）。90 天内未文档化改动被再次文档化的比例约为 24%，而已文档化改动为 48%。
AI.conclusion: AI 编码代理普遍忽视文档更新，未文档化代码更易产生后续修复，且文档债倾向于累积而非被重新审视。原始 PR 级比较会因规模混杂产生误导，需控制规模暴露。

title: GTSM: Gaussian Splatting with Thermal State-Space Dynamics for Spatio-Temporal Thermal Field Reconstruction and Prediction
summary: Temperature-field reconstruction and prediction are important for condition monitoring, process analysis, and state assessment in industrial and dynamic environments. This work aims to recover a four-dimensional spatio-temporal thermal state field directly from two-dimensional observations, without requiring a predefined 3D model, prescribed thermodynamic equation, or predefined heating/cooling trajectory. To this end, we propose the Gaussian Thermal State-Space Model (GTSM), which represents thermal evolution through a shared scene-level latent process and Gaussian-specific local thermal states. The resulting continuous dynamics are propagated using differentiable RK2 integration, allowing thermal evolution to be inferred from multi-view and multi-temporal observations and continuously extrapolated beyond the observed interval. GTSM is designed as a backbone-agnostic thermal dynamics module for Gaussian representations and can be integrated with both static 3D Gaussian Splatting and dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting, supporting thermal reconstruction and prediction under both static and time-varying target geometry. The reconstructed representation further enables novel-view thermal rendering and future-time thermal-state prediction. Experiments on real infrared sequences and synthetic dynamic thermal data demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy and substantially stronger temporal extrapolation than representative baselines, while also validating the applicability of GTSM to deforming targets.

AI.tldr: 提出高斯热状态空间模型GTSM，从二维观测直接重建四维时空热场，并可用可微RK2积分外推预测热演化。
AI.motivation: 工业与动态场景中温度场重建与预测对状态监测、过程分析很重要；现有方法依赖预定义3D模型、热力学方程或预设加热/冷却轨迹。
AI.method: 用共享的场景级隐过程加高斯特定的局部热状态表示热演化；用可微RK2数值积分传播连续动力学；作为与backbone无关的热动力学模块，可接入静态3DGS与动态4DGS，支持多视角多时刻观测推断与时间外推。
AI.result: 在真实红外序列与合成动态热数据上，重建精度优于代表性基线，时间外推能力显著更强，并验证了对形变目标的适用性。
AI.conclusion: GTSM实现了无需预定义模型/方程的四维热场重建与预测，支持新视角热渲染与未来时刻热状态预测，可推广至形变目标。

title: Industrial Agentic AI: LLM-Driven New-Generation Agents for Smart Manufacturing
