summary: Large language models (LLMs) are enabling agents to move beyond predefined workflows toward autonomous planning and execution, creating new opportunities for smart manufacturing. However, dynamic environments, complex physical constraints, and stringent reliability requirements hinder the direct deployment of general-purpose agents in smart manufacturing. This article presents a systematic overview of LLM-driven industrial agents. First, we analyze five key challenges and discuss the concept and core characteristics of industrial agents. We then establish a unified taxonomy covering application scenarios, embodiment forms, and five capability levels. Next, we propose a four-layer system architecture and detail its core modules and operational mechanisms for closed-loop task execution. Finally, we review representative applications across the industrial lifecycle and outline future research directions. This article provides a structured reference for the design, development, and application of industrial agents.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述LLM驱动的工业智能体，提出统一分类体系与四层系统架构。
AI.motivation: LLM使智能体从预定义工作流迈向自主规划与执行，为智能制造带来机遇；但动态环境、复杂物理约束和高可靠性要求阻碍通用智能体直接落地，缺乏系统性的设计参考。
AI.method: 综述性研究：分析五项关键挑战，界定工业智能体概念与核心特性；建立涵盖应用场景、具身形态和五个能力等级的统一分类法；提出四层系统架构并阐述核心模块与闭环任务执行机制。
AI.result: 形成挑战—概念—分类—架构的完整框架，并梳理工业全生命周期中的代表性应用，给出未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 为工业智能体的设计、开发与应用提供结构化参考体系。

title: Conversational AI for Perceived Cognitive Decline Screening in Older Adults
summary: Early detection of cognitive decline in older adults remains challenging due to the resource demands of standard neuropsychological assessments. Chatbot-based Intelligent Cognitive Assistants (ICAs) provide a scalable alternative by eliciting open-ended responses rich in linguistic, semantic, and autobiographical cues. This study evaluates whether ICA question-answer (Q/A) interviews with older adults can screen for participant-reported perceived cognitive decline and related cognitive, functional, and personality outcomes. We compare traditional machine learning, frozen transformer embeddings, fine-tuned transformers, and large language model (LLM) reasoning strategies across Global Q/A, Single Q/A confidence averaging, and Aggregated Q/A pipelines. Among text-based methods, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite (1-example-per-class, Aggregated Q/A) achieved the highest held-out test performance (0.742 accuracy, 0.739 balanced accuracy, 0.728 macro-F1). Given the small test set (n = 31), these results are interpreted descriptively. Frozen clinical transformer embeddings with a random forest head led non-LLM text methods, whereas fine-tuned models showed limited generalization. Models utilizing structured questionnaires, cognitive tasks, and personality traits outperformed text-based models in classification. Continuous regression analyses revealed modest predictive signals for AD8, FAQ, IQCODE, neuroticism, and conscientiousness. Exploratory prompt-level analyses identified both direct symptom-related and indirect autobiographical questions with strong test metrics, though sample sizes varied across prompts. These findings indicate that ICA chatbot interviews capture meaningful signals of perceived cognitive decline, supporting scalable screening research. Larger, clinically diverse cohorts with validated clinical outcomes are needed for clinical translation.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估基于聊天机器人（ICA）的开放式问答访谈能否筛查老年人自报的认知下降及其相关认知、功能与人格结果，比较传统机器学习、冻结/微调Transformer与LLM推理等多种策略。
AI.motivation: 标准神经心理学评估资源消耗大，老年人认知衰退早期检测困难；基于聊天机器人的智能认知助手可低成本地获取富含语言、语义与自传体线索的开放式回答，有望成为可扩展的筛查替代方案。
AI.method: 收集ICA问答访谈数据，构建Global Q/A、单题Q/A置信度平均、Aggregated Q/A三种流程；对比传统机器学习、冻结Transformer嵌入、微调Transformer及LLM推理策略；并以结构化问卷、认知任务和人格特质模型作为对照，另做连续回归与提示级探索分析。
AI.result: 文本方法中Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite（每类1示例、Aggregated Q/A）留出测试表现最佳（准确率0.742、平衡准确率0.739、macro-F1 0.728），但测试集仅n=31，仅作描述性解读；冻结临床Transformer嵌入+随机森林领先非LLM文本方法，微调模型泛化有限；结构化问卷/认知任务/人格特质模型优于文本模型；回归对AD8、FAQ、IQCODE、神经质与尽责性有微弱信号。
AI.conclusion: ICA聊天机器人访谈可捕捉有意义的自报认知下降信号，支持可扩展筛查研究；但需更大规模、临床多样化且带验证临床结局的队列才能实现临床转化。

title: Transformers Learn Two Competing Sorting Algorithms, and Only One Length-Generalizes
summary: We show that two-layer transformers trained to near-zero loss on a sorting task converge to one of two mechanistically distinct solution classes depending on their initialization. One solution class consists of solutions that do not use the second attention layer to sort, but also fail to length-generalize. The other, which uses both attention layers, length-generalizes perfectly, despite only being trained to sort sequences of a fixed length. By carefully choosing the weight initialization, we demonstrate that we can steer the model toward learning one solution or the other. We identify input types that are rare at the training length but increasingly common at longer sequence lengths as a source of this disparity in length-generalization, and find that layer-wise specialization of the second class of solutions allows them to handle these rare sequences more accurately. In the second class, we discover a mechanism by which the second layer attention can use the contextual information gathered by the first layer attention to reduce its search space. On the related task of finding the minimum of a sequence, we find a similar two solution-type phenomenon, but with the opposite generalization pattern, where a different form of layer-wise specialization causes the two-layer solution to length-generalize worse than the single-attention solution.

AI.tldr: 两层Transformer在排序任务上训练至接近零损失后，会依初始化收敛到两类机制上不同的解：一类不使用第二注意力层、无法长度泛化；另一类使用两层注意力、完美长度泛化。作者发现稀有输入类型与逐层特化是差异来源，并在求最小值任务上观察到相反的泛化规律。
AI.motivation: 探究Transformer为何有时能长度泛化、有时不能：解的非唯一性及其与初始化、机制之间的关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在固定长度的排序任务上训练两层Transformer至接近零损失；通过控制权重初始化引导模型学向不同解类别；进行机制分析（注意力层使用、逐层特化、第二层如何利用第一层的上下文信息缩小搜索空间）；并在求序列最小值任务上做对比实验。
AI.result: 发现两类机制不同的解：单层有效解不长度泛化；双层解完美长度泛化，尽管只在固定长度上训练。可通过对初始化选择来引导模型学到其中一类。指出在训练长度上稀有、在更长序列中更常见的输入类型是泛化差异的来源，第二类解的逐层特化使其更准确地处理这些稀有序列，并揭示第二层注意力利用第一层上下文信息缩小搜索空间的机制。求最小值任务呈现类似的二解现象，但泛化模式相反：某种逐层特化使双层解的长度泛化劣于单注意力解。
AI.conclusion: 长度泛化由具体学到的机制而非模型结构本身决定，且取决于初始化；逐层特化对泛化的影响依任务而异，说明"更多层更好"并不普遍成立。

title: AtomSD: Procedural Atom-Guided Self-Distillation for LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) possess broad factual knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, but solving complex tasks also requires procedural knowledge about how to act. Existing approaches often represent procedural knowledge through trajectories or bundled skills, limiting flexible reuse across interaction histories. This paper introduces Procedural Atoms, fine-grained and independently applicable units that represent Intent, When, Do, and Avoid guidance. Building on this representation, we propose AtomSD, an Atom-guided Self-Distillation framework in which the learner continually extracts Procedural Atoms from its own successful trajectories and distills them into the evolving policy through Atom-conditioned supervision and task-reward optimization. Comprehensive experiments show that AtomSD consistently outperforms strong reward-based and distillation methods, exceeding the state-of-the-art baseline by up to 9.31 points in average performance. Further analyses demonstrate that the proposed Procedural Atoms provide effective guidance, highlighting the value of atom-level procedural knowledge for policy learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"过程原子"（Procedural Atoms）这一细粒度、可独立复用的过程知识表示，并基于此构建AtomSD自蒸馏框架，让学习器从自身成功轨迹中提取过程原子并通过原子条件监督与任务奖励优化蒸馏进策略，平均性能超过最强基线最多9.31分。
AI.motivation: LLM具备丰富事实知识与强推理能力，但解决复杂任务还需要"如何行动"的过程性知识；现有方法用轨迹或捆绑式技能表示过程知识，难以在交互历史间灵活复用。
AI.method: 1) 提出Procedural Atoms，将过程知识表示为Intent、When、Do、Avoid四个细粒度可独立应用单元；2) 提出AtomSD框架，学习器持续从自身成功轨迹中提取过程原子，并通过"原子条件监督"与"任务奖励优化"将之蒸馏进不断演化的策略。
AI.result: 实验表明AtomSD稳定优于强奖励基线与蒸馏方法，平均性能较SOTA基线最高提升9.31分；进一步分析证明所提过程原子能提供有效引导。
AI.conclusion: 原子级过程知识对策略学习具有明确价值，细粒度可复用的知识表示优于轨迹/捆绑技能表示。

title: Extending Mechanisms
summary: Given an incentive-compatible mechanism for a single agent on a restricted domain of valuations, we consider its incentive-compatible extensions to the entire valuation space. We identify two extreme extensions: the "keep-the-menu" extension, which minimizes buyer payoffs and maximizes canonical prices pointwise, and the "keep-the-pricing" extension, which maximizes buyer payoffs and minimizes canonical prices pointwise.

AI.tldr: 研究受限估值域上单代理激励相容机制的全局扩展，识别出"保留菜单"与"保留定价"两种极端扩展。
AI.motivation: 单代理机制通常只在受限估值域上设计，但真实估值可能落在整个空间内，需要理解如何将其激励相容地扩展到全域，并刻画扩展的自由度边界。
AI.method: 从不变量视角出发，对给定机制的所有激励相容扩展进行分析，构造并刻画两个极端扩展：最小化买方收益/逐点最大化规范价格的"保留菜单"扩展，以及与之对偶的"保留定价"扩展。
AI.result: 证明了这两种扩展在所有激励相容扩展中处于极端位置：一个逐点最大化规范价格、最小化买方收益，另一个逐点最小化规范价格、最大化买方收益。
AI.conclusion: 激励相容扩展的范围由这两个极端扩展界定，为受限域机制的全域稳健性与收益比较提供了清晰的基准工具。

title: Standards-Guided and Dependency-Aware Code-Level Documentation Generation
summary: Automatically generating high-quality documentation for software repositories remains challenging: existing approaches largely treat documentation as unconstrained text generation, lacking explicit quality specifications, depending heavily on long-context prompts over raw code, and offering limited support for reproducible evaluation. We argue that code-level documentation generation should instead be a standards-guided software engineering task, in which documentation is generated and assessed against explicit, reusable quality requirements derived from authoritative standards. We define code documentation as natural-language descriptions of repository functions and classes, organized by source-code path. We present CODEDOC, a standards-guided and dependency-aware framework that identifies dependencies between code entities via static call-graph and AST analysis and constructs dependency-aware structured prompts combining local code context, repository paths, and documentation criteria drawn from authoritative standards and style guides. We further introduce an interactive LLM-as-a-judge protocol that supplies criterion-aligned feedback to refine generated documentation along fine-grained dimensions from formal and practice-oriented standards. Experiments on ten open-source Python repositories show that CODEDOC produces higher-quality documentation than RepoAgent and a long-context baseline under standards-aligned evaluation, with relative improvements of 11.6%-17.0% and 21.4%-29.6%, respectively, while consuming roughly an order of magnitude fewer tokens per documentation entity than the long-context baseline. A human study confirms substantial alignment between LLM-based and human judgments (Spearman's rho = 0.72), and the relative findings hold across different judge LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/ControllableModel/CodeDoc.

AI.tldr: CODEDOC 提出将代码级文档生成视为"标准引导的软件工程任务"，利用依赖感知的结构化提示与 LLM-as-a-judge 交互式反馈，生成并评估符合权威标准的文档。
AI.motivation: 现有文档生成方法把文档当作无约束文本生成，缺乏明确质量规范、依赖长上下文原始代码、且难以可复现评估，质量难以保证。
AI.method: 把代码文档定义为按源码路径组织的函数与类自然语言描述；通过静态调用图与 AST 分析识别代码实体依赖，构建融合局部代码上下文、仓库路径与权威标准/风格指南准则的依赖感知结构化提示；并引入交互式 LLM-as-a-judge 协议，按细粒度标准维度提供准则对齐反馈以迭代精炼文档。
AI.result: 在 10 个开源 Python 仓库上，标准对齐评估下相对 RepoAgent 提升 11.6%–17.0%，相对长上下文基线提升 21.4%–29.6%，且每个文档实体的 token 消耗约低一个数量级；人工研究显示 LLM 与人类判断高度一致（Spearman's rho = 0.72），结论在不同评判 LLM 下稳健。
AI.conclusion: 以显式、可复用质量标准引导的依赖感知文档生成能显著提升质量并降低 token 成本，且 LLM 评判可作为可靠、可复现的评估手段。代码已开源。

title: Controllable Multi-Object Insertion for Detection Data Augmentation
summary: Controllable object insertion provides a targeted approach to augmenting object detection datasets that require category--count fidelity, annotation alignment, and source-content preservation beyond visual realism. Several approaches have been proposed to address this grand challenge, but most suffer from different constraints in precise category--count requests and visual consistency, limited coordination across categories and instances, and poor localization of multiple objects of specific category and count. We design SceneP2F, a two-stage trainable framework that connects scene-aware joint planning with layout-aligned generation leveraging explicit instance-level layouts. SceneP2F consists of two novel designs. The first is ScenePlan which allocates one class-labeled query per requested instance, jointly predicts scene-compatible object centers, and separately estimates box sizes conditioned on the planned centers and scene context. The second is SceneAlign-Fill which combines geometry- and appearance-aware conditioning, box--class-guided regional attention, and an annotation-region-weighted flow-matching objective to render the planned objects while limiting unintended changes to source content. Extensive experiments on three challenging benchmarks UAVDT, VisDrone, and BDD100K show that SceneP2F outperforms representative general-purpose editors and object-insertion methods consistently, demonstrating the value of coordinating instance-level planning and generation for category-targeted detection augmentation.

AI.tldr: SceneP2F：两阶段可控物体插入框架，先用ScenePlan联合规划实例级布局，再用SceneAlign-Fill按布局生成物体，实现满足类别-数量要求的检测数据增强。
AI.motivation: 增强目标检测数据集时，需要满足类别-数量保真、标注对齐与源内容保持，而不仅是视觉真实感。现有方法在精确类别-数量请求、视觉一致性、跨类别与实例协调、特定类别多目标定位方面存在局限。
AI.method: 两阶段可训练框架。1) ScenePlan：为每个请求实例分配一个带类别标签的query，联合预测场景兼容的物体中心，并在规划中心与场景上下文条件下分别估计边框尺寸；2) SceneAlign-Fill：结合几何与外观感知条件、框-类引导的区域注意力，以及标注区域加权的flow-matching目标进行渲染，同时限制对源内容的非预期改动。
AI.result: 在UAVDT、VisDrone、BDD100K三个基准上，一致优于代表性通用编辑方法与物体插入方法。
AI.conclusion: 协调实例级规划与生成对类别定向的检测数据增强具有实际价值。

title: Fix, Not Just Resample: Bounded Compiler-Guided Repair in Lean 4
summary: Automated theorem provers often rely on sampling language models, but proof assistants like Lean reject each failed step with a precise error message --- information that pure sampling discards. To overcome this, we introduce a bounded, online step-level repair module. Our search samples $K$ candidate tactics at each step and repairs a failed tactic at most $R$ times. Instead of discarding failed tactics, we feed the compiler's error message to a pretrained repair model to fix individual rejected steps in place. This approach improves the solve rate over a sampling-only baseline across all tested candidate budgets ($K \in \{1,3,5,8\}$), achieving up to a $32\%$ relative gain and solving $82$ additional theorems on a $1{,}990$-theorem subset of the LeanDojo benchmark. Repair is not free: it trades extra runtime for reachable proofs. But the trade is predictable: repair pays most when sampling is constrained; its return is front-loaded, with the first repair attempt capturing $84\text{--}96\%$ of the total gain; and the gain comes almost entirely from shallow tactic-execution failures rather than structural errors such as type mismatches. This targeted repair successfully replicates on a second benchmark (Lean Workbook), nearly doubling the solve rate with zero regressions.

AI.tldr: 提出有界在线步级修复模块：利用Lean编译器错误信息修复失败tactic，而非丢弃重采样，在LeanDojo子集上相对提升至多32%、多解82个定理，并在Lean Workbook上近乎翻倍。
AI.motivation: 自动定理证明器依赖语言模型采样，但Lean等证明助手会对每一步失败给出精确错误信息，而纯采样策略丢掉了这一宝贵信号，造成信息浪费与效率低下。
AI.method: 在每步采样K个候选tactic，对失败tactic最多修复R次；将编译器错误信息喂给预训练修复模型，就地进行单步修复，而非丢弃重采样。是一种有界的在线步级修复模块。
AI.result: 在K∈{1,3,5,8}所有预算下均优于纯采样基线，最高相对提升32%，在LeanDojo的1990定理子集上多解82个定理；首次修复贡献总收益的84–96%，收益主要来自浅层tactic执行错误而非类型不匹配等结构性错误；在Lean Workbook上近乎翻倍且零退步。
AI.conclusion: 修复以额外运行时间换取可达证明，且该权衡可预测：采样受限时收益最大、收益前置、来源集中于浅层错误，方法可跨基准复现。

title: Baseline and Incremental: User, Item, and Request Debiasing in Instagram Feed Ranking
summary: A feed ranker scores candidates with a value model, a weighted sum of engagement predictions. Each prediction conflates a baseline, what this viewer, item or request would produce anyway, with the incremental amount by which this candidate exceeds it. The literature mostly removes the baseline. We argue that a multi-signal value model should keep the raw prediction and add the incremental part as a separately weighted term. On Instagram Feed, three debiasing families deployed independently, for viewer habit, item popularity and request context, are one parameterised operator, and a design procedure picks a point in it. Media-type (format) bias goes instead to a debiased label chosen by the same procedure. In a controlled four-arm ablation of deployed Feed terms (neither term, each alone, both), the two-term arm beats both single-term arms at production weights on point estimates in 11 of 13 judged (term, metric) pairs. Of the 26 direct contrasts, 17 are significantly for it and only 1 against it, on impressions. The ablation also suggests that the offline diagnostic should screen signals, not rank them. Such terms have served Instagram Feed production for most of a year. Beyond Feed, Meta, whose apps serve billions of people, has adopted the operator across surfaces, apps and both ranking stages. Its launches there drive sessions and daily active users, the core visitation and retention metrics.

AI.tldr: 该论文主张Feed排序的价值模型应同时保留原始预测（baseline+increment）与单独加权的增量项，将三种debias族统一为一个参数化算子并通过设计流程选点，在Instagram Feed的四臂消融中双项方案在13个被评判的(项,指标)对中11个胜出。
AI.motivation: 现有文献大多直接移除baseline，但排序真正关心的是候选带来的增量；单一处理方式无法同时兼顾原始信号与去偏增量，且不同偏差类型（观众习惯、内容热度、请求上下文、媒体格式）需要统一且可调的设计方法。
AI.method: 提出多项信号价值模型：保留raw prediction并额外加入单独权重的增量项；将观众习惯、内容热度、请求上下文三类debias部署统一为一个参数化算子，用设计流程在其中选点；媒体格式偏差改用同一流程选择的去偏标签。在Instagram Feed部署的项上做受控四臂消融（两项皆无、各自单独、两者兼有）。
AI.result: 四臂消融中，双项臂在生产权重下于13个被评判(项,指标)对中11个点估计优于两个单项臂；26组直接对比中17组显著支持双项、仅1组反对（基于impressions）。消融还提示离线诊断宜用于筛选信号而非排序信号。
AI.conclusion: 保留原始预测并叠加单独加权的增量项优于单独使用任一项；该算子已服务Instagram Feed生产近一年，并被Meta推广至多界面、多应用和两个排序阶段，上线带来sessions与DAU等核心指标提升。

title: Latent Projection for Latent Planning
comment: Accepted to the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Modeling Uncertainty in Robotic World Models
summary: Latent world models let an agent plan in latent space. The planner searches for an action sequence that minimizes a cost, and that cost is often the $\ell_2$ distance between the predicted terminal latent and the goal latent. The latent, however, is partly noise: the regularizer that prevents collapse during world model training promotes variance in the directions carrying no signal. We show that the same regularizer also supplies the structure to prune that noise in the latent. SIGReg drives the latent marginal to a standard Gaussian at every step, and assuming further that the latent sequence is a Gauss-Markov process, the transition is linear with its covariance pinned by the map itself, $z' \mid z \sim \mathcal{N}(Az,\, I - AA^\top)$. Fitting the state dynamics $A$ therefore yields the covariance at no additional cost, and in its eigenbasis each latent direction carries its own uncertainty. Furthermore, constraining $A$ to be a normal matrix fixes that basis across timesteps, so one eigenbasis measures the uncertainty over an arbitrary number of steps and serves as a stable basis to compute the planning cost on. We then restrict the $\ell_2$ cost to the $k$-dimensional subspace the state dynamics carry forward with the least uncertainty. The correction is post hoc: the encoder, the predictor, the rollout, and the planner are all left untouched, and only a single constrained matrix, $A$, is fit. We evaluate across six environments and show large gains on the 2D navigation tasks, TwoRoom and PointMaze, raising success rate over the plain $\ell_2$ cost by up to $+54.7$ points under a harder planning setting. Code is available at https://github.com/yjang43/lp2.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种事后(post hoc)修正方法：利用SIGReg正则化使隐空间边缘服从标准高斯，结合Gauss-Markov假设得到转移协方差，通过拟合约束为正规矩阵的状态动力学A，在不确定性最小的k维子空间上计算规划cost。
AI.motivation: 隐世界模型中，潜在表征部分含噪声（正则项在无信号方向上鼓励方差），而规划cost常用的ℓ2距离未区分信号与噪声方向，导致规划受噪声干扰。
AI.method: 假设潜在序列为Gauss-Markov过程，且SIGReg使每步边缘为标准高斯，则转移为线性且协方差由映射固定为 N(Az, I-AA^T)。拟合A即可免费得到协方差；将A约束为正规矩阵使特征基跨时间步稳定，该特征基用于度量多步不确定性并作为稳定基底计算规划cost。最终把ℓ2 cost限制在状态动力学不确定性最小的k维子空间中。编码器、预测器、rollout和规划器均不改动，仅拟合一个约束矩阵A。
AI.result: 在六个环境上评估，TwoRoom和PointMaze二维导航任务提升显著，在更难规划设定下成功率较纯ℓ2 cost最高提升+54.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 利用正则化带来的潜在高斯结构可无额外代价地估计方向性不确定性，据此剪除噪声子空间能显著改善基于ℓ2的规划；方法轻量、即插即用，代码开源。

title: Do We Need the Largest LLMs for Every Clinical Decision?
summary: Large clinical language models often require multi-GPU infrastructure, limiting local deployment. We introduce CERTA, a decision-level statistical certificate that determines when a quantized model may substitute for its native BF16 reference and escalates decisions that cannot be certified to it. Across eleven instruction-tuned models, both general-purpose and domain-adapted, from three families (7-72B), we evaluated 2,500 clinical-verification decisions from de-identified patient contexts (2,484 patients), with patient-disjoint calibration and testing. In the higher-power operational analysis, round-to-nearest 8-bit quantization at BF16 storage served 99.8-100% of held-out decisions across all eleven models; formal finite-sample guarantees were assessed separately using the exact split-sample procedure. In the same operational analysis, the class-conditional 4-bit frontier reduced the amortized, BF16-equivalent deployment cost to 25.8% and 27.3% of the BF16 reference for Qwen2.5-72B and HuatuoGPT-o1-72B, respectively, with measured peak memory of 43.0 and 42.7 GB, below the nominal capacity of a single 48 GB accelerator. Deployment on that specific hardware was not directly tested. Under the exact split-sample certificate, which also accounts for configuration selection, these costs were 26.7% and 27.9%. On external disease named-entity benchmarks against human annotations, the frontier-selected NF4 configurations had a mean absolute F1 change of 0.045 on both datasets, with substantial model-specific variation. CERTA converts compression from a fixed precision choice into a risk-controlled deployment policy for this verification task.

AI.tldr: 提出CERTA，一种决策级统计证书框架，判断量化模型何时可替代BF16参考模型，无法认证的决策升级给参考模型。在11个临床验证任务模型上，8-bit可服务99.8-100%决策，4-bit前沿可将部署成本降至约26-28%，单卡48GB可容纳72B模型。
AI.motivation: 大型临床语言模型通常需要多GPU基础设施，制约本地部署。量化虽能降低资源需求，但缺乏对"量化模型能否安全替代原模型做出临床决策"的严格控制机制。
AI.method: CERTA作为决策级统计证书：对每个决策判断量化模型能否认证，不能认证则升级至BF16参考模型。评估11个指令微调模型（通用与领域适配，三大家族，7-72B），2,500条来自去标识患者情境的临床验证决策（2,484名患者），采用患者不相交的校准与测试；并用精确分割样本程序提供有限样本保证，同时计入配置选择。
AI.result: 操作分析中，BF16存储的round-to-nearest 8-bit量化服务99.8-100%的留出决策。类条件4-bit前沿使Qwen2.5-72B与HuatuoGPT-o1-72B的摊销部署成本降至BF16的25.8%和27.3%，峰值内存43.0/42.7 GB，低于单块48GB加速器标称容量（未直接实测该硬件）。精确分割样本证书下成本为26.7%与27.9%。外部疾病NER基准上，NF4配置F1平均绝对变化0.045，模型间差异较大。
AI.conclusion: CERTA将压缩从固定的精度选择转变为风险可控的部署策略，适用于该临床验证任务。

title: Fixed Sets and the Hardness of Computing Correlated Equilibria
summary: We show that computing an approximate correlated equilibrium of a polytope game is PPAD-complete, and thus polynomial-time equivalent to finding a Nash equilibrium. This challenges the conventional view in game theory that correlated equilibria are more tractable objects than Nash equilibria. From a conceptual standpoint, we connect correlated equilibria to a natural generalization of fixed points, which we call fixed sets. A fixed set of a continuous function $f$ is a nonempty finite set $S$ such that $S \subseteq \operatorname{conv} f(S)$. Our main technical contribution is to prove that computing a fixed set is PPAD-hard even at inverse polynomial precision.

AI.tldr: 计算多面体博弈的近似相关均衡是 PPAD-完全的，与求纳什均衡多项式时间等价。
AI.motivation: 挑战博弈论中"相关均衡比纳什均衡更易计算"的传统观点，并从概念上把相关均衡与不动点的一般化联系起来。
AI.method: 提出"固定集"（fixed set）概念：连续函数 f 的固定集是满足 S ⊆ conv f(S) 的非空有限集 S；核心技术创新是证明即使在逆多项式精度下计算固定集也是 PPAD-难的，由此归约得到相关均衡的 PPAD-完全性。
AI.result: 计算多面体博弈的近似相关均衡是 PPAD-完全的，且与求纳什均衡多项式时间等价；计算固定集在逆多项式精度下即为 PPAD-难。
AI.conclusion: 相关均衡在计算复杂度上并不比纳什均衡更简单，二者同属 PPAD-完全；固定集提供了一种连接相关均衡与不动点的自然框架。

title: Knowledge as Code
summary: For millennia, knowledge has been carried by language, and large language models still put language at the center. Yet the coding agents built on these models mostly write code. This paper is a contribution to epistemology, which asks what kind of knowledge code is and how it is obtained. We define knowledge as code as knowledge written in a programming language or in a machine-parsable data format, whose validity can be checked by executing it. We define thirteen epistemic properties of knowledge media and show that code is the first medium to have all of them. We distinguish two ways in which knowledge enters code, encoding and learning by execution, where code is both the experiment and the record of its result. Agents make learning by execution observable, since their trajectories record every probe, observation and line of code they keep. Code is thus not only a tool of knowledge work but a knowledge medium in its own right, the first that can check what it holds.

AI.tldr: 本文从认识论角度论证"代码"是一种独立的知识媒介：代码是首个满足全部十三项认识论属性的媒介，并能通过执行检验自身所承载的知识。
AI.motivation: 上千年来知识由语言承载，大模型仍以语言为中心，但基于大模型构建的编码智能体却主要在写代码。本文追问：代码是什么类型的知识、如何获得？即从认识论层面重新界定代码的知识地位。
AI.method: 概念与理论分析：将"代码即知识"定义为以编程语言或机器可解析数据格式书写、其有效性可通过执行检验的知识；提出十三项知识媒介的认识论属性，论证代码是首个全部具备的媒介；区分知识进入代码的两种方式——"编码"与"通过执行学习"（代码既是实验也是结果记录）；并指出智能体使"通过执行学习"变得可观察，因其轨迹记录了每次探测、观察与保留代码行。
AI.result: 论证表明代码是唯一同时具备全部十三项认识论属性的知识媒介；智能体的可观测轨迹为"通过执行学习"提供了经验证据。
AI.conclusion: 代码不仅是知识工作的工具，更是独立的知识媒介——首个能检验自身所承载内容的媒介。

title: CaMeWM: A Causal Medical World Model for Generative Tumor Evolution and Treatment Planning
summary: Treatment planning is intrinsically counterfactual: clinicians must compare how a patient's tumor and survival would evolve under competing regimens, whereas a retrospective cohort records only the regimen received and one follow-up scan. A treatment-conditioned generator trained on such data can therefore reproduce historical treatment allocation rather than simulate the interventional disease dynamics needed to rank regimens. We introduce \textbf{CaMeWM}, a causal medical world model for supported post-TACE tumor evolution and treatment planning. CaMeWM implements one intervention-to-decision loop rather than three independent prediction tasks: it first admits a queried regimen only for clinically comparable histories with empirical treatment support; it then generates a distribution of lesion-local follow-up worlds through an action-conditioned response descriptor, deterministic anchor, and residual 3D diffusion transition; and it finally maps sampled worlds to restricted mean survival time (RMST) with a response-Cox utility model. Under pre-treatment adjustment and positivity, this loop estimates a prespecified, support-restricted g-formula target; all selection and nuisance estimation are fold-local, and the induced policy is evaluated by cross-fitted, censoring-adjusted doubly robust estimation. Across 79 paired out-of-fold episodes, CaMeWM achieves 0.618 SSIM and 0.528 change-map SSIM for follow-up CT transition, while its generated-world survival pathway attains a 0.615 C-index; factual-only AIPW estimates a 9.60-week RMST gain (95\% CI 0.61--18.13) for the frozen policy. CaMeWM provides an inspectable basis for retrospective, support-restricted treatment planning.

AI.tldr: CaMeWM 是一个因果医学世界模型，将 TACE 治疗决策建模为"干预到决策"的单循环，在治疗支持约束下生成随访病灶世界并估计生存获益，用于回顾性、受支持限制的治疗规划。
AI.motivation: 治疗规划本质是反事实的：需比较竞争方案下肿瘤与生存如何演变，但回顾性队列只记录实际接受方案与一次随访影像。直接训练治疗条件生成器会复现历史治疗分配（混杂），而非模拟可比较方案的干预性病程动态。
AI.method: 单干预-决策循环三步：(1)仅对具经验治疗支持的可比病史接纳查询方案；(2)经动作条件响应描述子、确定性锚点与残差 3D 扩散转移，生成病灶局部随访世界分布；(3)用响应-Cox 效用模型将采样世界映射到 RMST。在预治疗调整与正性假设下估计预设、受支持限制的 g-formula 目标；选择与冗余参数估计均 fold-local，策略用交叉拟合、删失校正的双稳健估计评估。
AI.result: 79 个配对折外 episode 上，随访 CT 转移达 0.618 SSIM、变化图 SSIM 0.528；生成世界生存通路 C-index 0.615；仅事实 AIPW 估计冻结策略 RMST 增益 9.60 周（95% CI 0.61–18.13）。
AI.conclusion: CaMeWM 为回顾性、受支持限制的治疗规划提供了可检查的基础。

title: MAMath-Bench: Process-Aware and Robust Evaluation of Multimodal Multi-Agent Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Mathematical reasoning is a fundamental capability for educational applications of Large Language Models (LLMs), where reliable problem solving requires not only correct answers but also coherent and verifiable reasoning processes. Multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown growing potential in this domain by leveraging collaboration and verification among multiple LLM agents. However, existing evaluations primarily focus on the correctness of final answers in text-only settings, offering limited insight into multimodal reasoning capabilities, the reliability of intermediate reasoning steps, and robustness against reasoning errors. To address these limitations, we introduce MAMath-Bench, a process-aware benchmark designed to evaluate the multimodal mathematical reasoning capabilities of MASs. MAMath-Bench comprises 1,003 problems spanning 11 mathematical categories, multiple difficulty levels, and several modalities, including text, images, and audio. It features fine-grained milestone annotations to evaluate systems across three dimensions: problem-solving correctness, reasoning-process reliability, and robustness to adversarial reasoning-chain perturbations. Our evaluation yields three key findings. First, multi-agent collaboration does not consistently improve final-answer accuracy over strong single LLMs. Second, collaboration can substantially enhance the coverage of intermediate reasoning, but such gains may come at the cost of increased reasoning redundancy. Third, current systems remain vulnerable to adversarial reasoning errors, particularly those involving subtle structural perturbations. The dataset is available at https://github.com/mira-ai-lab/AgentMath.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MAMath-Bench，一个面向多智能体系统（MAS）多模态数学推理的过程感知基准，从答案正确性、推理过程可靠性和对抗鲁棒性三个维度进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有针对多智能体数学推理的评估主要关注纯文本设定下的最终答案正确性，缺乏对多模态推理能力、中间推理步骤可靠性以及抗推理错误鲁棒性的洞察。
AI.method: 构建包含 1,003 道题目的基准，覆盖 11 个数学类别、多难度层级及文本/图像/音频多种模态，并提供细粒度里程碑标注，用于三方面评估：解题正确性、推理过程可靠性、对对抗性推理链扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 评估得出三点发现：(1) 多智能体协作相较强单模型并不能持续提升最终答案准确率；(2) 协作可显著提升中间推理覆盖度，但可能以推理冗余增加为代价；(3) 现有系统易受对抗性推理错误影响，尤其是细微的结构性扰动。
AI.conclusion: MAMath-Bench 揭示了 MAS 数学推理的能力边界，强调需从答案到过程、从单模态到多模态、从静态到对抗的全面评估，数据集已公开。

title: Robustness Analysis of Pareto-based Joint Evaluation of Fairness and Relevance in Recommender Systems
comment: Accepted to ACM Transactions on Recommender Systems (TORS). Extension of arXiv:2502.11921(1)
summary: Recommender Systems (RSs) can be evaluated for many aspects, two of them being recommendation relevance and fairness. These two aspects can be evaluated either in isolation, using a measure for each aspect; or jointly with a single`relevance-aware' fairness measure that quantifies fairness with respect to relevance. Yet, neither approach provides a simultaneous evaluation of both relevance and fairness: the first approach may result in two different rankings of models, each corresponding to an evaluation aspect; the second approach often provides an imbalanced evaluation of the two aspects. To address this gap, we propose Distance to Pareto Frontier (DPFR), a new approach to jointly evaluate RS fairness and relevance. DPFR is based on a Pareto frontier of relevance and fairness scores from existing measures. The frontier is generated from user-item interaction data and represents various Pareto-optimal trade-offs between the two aspects. Thus, the distance from a point in the frontier provides a joint score of fairness and relevance. As DPFR can be used with existing measures, it is modular and intuitive. Our experiments with 4 recommenders and 3 fairness-aware re-rankers on 6 real-world datasets reveal inconsistent associations between existing measures and DPFR, showing that they are not reliable proxies for evaluations based on Pareto optimality. We further examine the robustness of DPFR as a joint evaluation approach for fairness and relevance by conducting experiments with artificial recommendations and with various fairness-relevance trade-offs, as well as by analysing DPFR's agreement to simple measures of fairness and relevance. These analyses show that DPFR is more robust than existing joint evaluation approaches. Finally, we provide guidelines for evaluating fairness and relevance jointly with DPFR. Our code: https://github.com/theresiavr/robustness-DPFR-recsys-evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出DPFR（到帕累托前沿的距离），一种联合评估推荐系统相关性与公平性的新方法，基于用户-物品交互数据构建的相关性-公平性帕累托前沿，用样本点距前沿的距离给出联合评分。实验表明现有联合评估指标并非基于帕累托最优评估的可靠代理，DPFR更鲁棒，并给出使用指南。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统评估中，相关性（relevance）与公平性（fairness）要么被分别孤立评估（可能产生两套不一致的模型排序），要么用单一的"相关性感知"公平性指标联合评估（往往对两方面评估不平衡）。缺少一个能同时、平衡评估两者的方法，因此需要新的联合评估框架。
AI.method: DPFR以现有相关性度量和公平性度量为基础，从用户-物品交互数据生成相关性-公平性得分的帕累托前沿，该前沿代表两方面的多种帕累托最优权衡；某个模型点到前沿的距离即构成相关性与公平性的联合评分。由于复用现有度量，方法具有模块化和直观性。实验方面，在6个真实数据集上评估4个推荐器与3个公平性感知重排序器，并用人工推荐、不同公平性-相关性权衡以及DPFR与简单公平/相关度量的一致性分析来检验鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实验显示现有度量与DPFR之间关联不一致，说明它们不是基于帕累托最优评估的可靠代理；在人工推荐与各种权衡设置下，以及在与简单公平性和相关性度量的一致性分析中，DPFR比现有联合评估方法更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: DPFR为推荐系统相关性与公平性的联合评估提供了模块化、直观且更鲁棒的方案，并论文给出了使用DPFR进行评估的实践指南；代码已开源。

title: CoASFL: Coupled Consistency Optimization for Asynchronous Split Federated Learning
summary: Split Federated Learning (SFL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training large-scale deep models on resource-constrained edge devices. Although asynchronous SFL alleviates the straggler bottleneck caused by system heterogeneity, it inevitably introduces two coupled dimensions of inconsistency: horizontal inconsistency across clients and vertical inconsistency between clients and the server. These inconsistencies, further exacerbated by statistical heterogeneity, result in biased activation representations, model divergence, and severe client drift. To address these challenges, we propose CoASFL, an inconsistency-aware asynchronous SFL framework that incorporates a dynamic activation merging mechanism and a consistency-aware model aggregation mechanism. Specifically, CoASFL constructs more consistent activation sequences from heterogeneous clients to alleviate horizontal inconsistency, and dynamically adjusts aggregation weights according to client participation frequencies and progress gaps to mitigate vertical inconsistency. By jointly coordinating activation-level and model-level consistency, CoASFL effectively suppresses inconsistency propagation during asynchronous training. Extensive experiments on an 80-device heterogeneous edge testbed demonstrate that CoASFL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art SFL approaches, accelerating training by 1.61$\times$ to 3.74$\times$ and improving final model accuracy by up to 3.26\% under heterogeneous scenarios.

AI.tldr: CoASFL是一个面向资源受限边缘设备的异步分割联邦学习框架，通过动态激活合并机制和一致性感知模型聚合机制，联合缓解客户端间（水平）与客户端-服务器间（垂直）的不一致性，在80设备异构测试床上实现1.61×–3.74×加速并将精度最高提升3.26%。
AI.motivation: 异步SFL虽缓解了系统异构带来的掉队者瓶颈，但引入了两类耦合的不一致：客户端间的水平不一致和客户端与服务器间的垂直不一致；在统计异构加剧下，导致激活表示有偏、模型发散和严重的客户端漂移。
AI.method: 提出CoASFL框架，包含两个机制：（1）动态激活合并机制，从异构客户端构造更一致的激活序列以缓解水平不一致；（2）一致性感知模型聚合机制，依据客户端参与频率和进度差距动态调整聚合权重以缓解垂直不一致；在激活层与模型层协同协调一致性，抑制异步训练中的不一致传播。
AI.result: 在80设备异构边缘测试床上的大量实验表明，CoASFL持续优于最先进的SFL方法，训练加速1.61×至3.74×，异构场景下最终模型精度最高提升3.26%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在激活层和模型层联合管理一致性，CoASFL可有效应对异步SFL中的双向不一致问题，在不一致的异构边缘环境下兼顾训练效率与模型精度。

title: The Bottleneck Is Retrieval, Not Reading: Diagnosing Evidence-Based Generation with RAG for Long Context Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is the dominant paradigm for grounding large language models in external corpora, but its similarity-driven, chunked pipeline has structural blind spots: it cannot anticipate which passages a question requires and discards document-level context that resolves cross-passage references. We introduce evidence-based generation (EBG), requiring models to return an answer with line-level citations, and a joint Ans+Evid metric that scores correctness and grounding simultaneously. We reformulate two corpora into evidence-grounded multi-document QA benchmarks- MultiHop-RAG and QASPER-MP, a multi-paper adaptation of QASPER with realistic short paper cues, and pair them with a controlled synthetic two-hop haystack and an evidence-augmented NoLiMa spanning 10K-1M characters. Across ten proprietary frontier and three open-weight LLMs, EBG isolates two RAG limitations that long-context models avoid: similarity retrieval surfaces any relevant chunk far more reliably than all required chunks for multi-fact queries, and chunking destroys document meta-information needed to resolve identity-bearing queries. EBG also exposes grounding failures invisible to answer-only evaluation, including incomplete citations in two-needle settings and a widening gap between Ans and Ans+Evid when context contradicts parametric knowledge. Data and code are available at https://github.com/debobanerjee/LC-EBG.

AI.tldr: 论文提出证据式生成(EBG)范式与Ans+Evid联合指标，用行级引用评测RAG结构化盲点，在多个基准和13个LLM上揭示相似度检索与分块的两大缺陷。
AI.motivation: RAG的相似度驱动、分块流水线存在结构性盲点：无法预判问题所需的全部段落，且丢弃了解决跨段落指代所需的文档级上下文；现有仅评答案的评测无法暴露接地失败。
AI.method: 提出EBG：要求模型给出答案并附行级引用；设计同时评估正确性与接地性的Ans+Evid指标；将MultiHop-RAG和QASPER改编为多文档QA基准QASPER-MP（含真实短论文线索），并构建受控合成两跳haystack及10K–1M字符的证据增强NoLiMa。
AI.result: 在10个闭源前沿模型和3个开源LLM上，EBG分离出两项RAG局限（长上下文模型可避免）：检索能可靠返回任一相关块，却难以覆盖多事实查询所需的全部块；分块破坏解决身份类查询所需的文档元信息。此外还暴露仅评答案看不到的接地失败：两针场景引用不完整、上下文与参数知识冲突时Ans与Ans+Evid差距扩大。
AI.conclusion: 基于证据的评测能系统揭示RAG与长上下文模型的差异及隐性的接地缺陷，数据和代码已开源，为RAG评估提供更严格的诊断工具。

title: Best-of-Both Worlds Proportionality in Structured Committee Elections
summary: We study randomized committee elections with additive preferences, where we seek best-of-both-worlds proportionality. That is, we strive for strong guarantees for the selection probabilities ex ante and each realized committee ex post. We focus on structured preferences and introduce antichain single-peakedness, a restricted domain generalizing single-peaked additive preferences as well as several well-studied approval domains. Our approach first computes a fractional committee and then decomposes it through a rounding rule called systematic rounding. Among profile-oblivious rounding rules, we characterize systematic rounding as the unique rule satisfying natural quota guarantees, and thereby the only promising rule for our two-step approach. We show that ex-ante core stability is incompatible with ex-post justified representation $JR$, even under single-peaked preferences. However, applying systematic rounding to certain fractional allocations that form so-called Lindahl equilibria yields ex-ante core stability and ex-post core stability up to one. Alternatively, we retain exact ex-post proportionality and approximate the ex-ante core using two parameters: $α$ raises the utility gain required for a deviation, while $β$ reduces the coalition's proportional share. We establish the tight threshold $αβ$=2. Below it, ex-post JR is incompatible even under single-peaked preferences; at and above it, adapting a fractional rule called BestRepresentative [Pierczyński and Skowron, 2022] and applying systematic rounding to its output yields ex-ante $α, β$-fractional core stability and ex-post PJR under antichain single-peaked preferences.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究带加性偏好的随机委员会选举中的"两全其美"比例性：同时保证选前(选择概率)与选后(每个实现委员会)的强比例性保证。作者提出反链单峰性(antichain single-peakedness)这一结构化偏好域，采用先算分数委员会再经"系统化舍入"(systematic rounding)分解的两步法，刻画了系统化舍入是唯一满足自然配额保证的profile-oblivious规则，并给出选前核心稳定性与选后JR/比例性之间的紧阈值αβ=2。
AI.motivation: 随机委员会选举希望同时获得选前强比例性(选择概率层面)与选后强比例性(每个实现委员会层面)的"两全其美"保证。但已有工作多针对一般偏好域，缺乏对结构化偏好的细粒度刻画，且选前核心稳定性与选后比例性之间的相容性边界尚不清楚。论文旨在明确在何种偏好域、何种阈值下二者可兼容。
AI.method: 1) 引入反链单峰性，推广单峰加性偏好及若干审批域；2) 先计算分数委员会，再用系统化舍入分解为整数委员会；3) 在profile-oblivious舍入规则中，证明系统化舍入是唯一满足自然配额保证的规则(因而两步法必用它)；4) 对构成Lindahl均衡的分数分配施加系统化舍入；5) 提出αβ双参数近似选前核心(α抬高偏离所需效用增益，β缩小联盟比例份额)，并改造BestRepresentative分数规则后舍入。
AI.result: 证明选前核心稳定性与选后JR即使单峰偏好下也不相容；但系统化舍入作用于Lindahl均衡型分数分配可同时实现选前核心稳定性与"至多差一"的选后核心稳定性。在αβ参数化下得到紧阈值αβ=2：低于2时选后JR即使在单峰偏好下也与之不相容；达到或高于2时，改造BestRepresentative再经系统化舍入可同时获得选前(α,β)-分数核心稳定性与反链单峰偏好下的选后PJR。
AI.conclusion: 论文确立了随机委员会选举中选前与选后比例性的不可能性与可能性边界：完全核心相容不可行，但通过系统化舍入+Lindahl均衡可得选后核心稳定性至多相差一；在双参数近似框架下αβ=2是紧阈值，恰可实现选前(α,β)-分数核心稳定性与选后PJR的兼得。

title: Enhancing Bug-Exposing Test Generation via Step-Level Credit Assignment and Self-Distillation from Valuable Failures
summary: Large Language Models have shown strong code generation capabilities, yet their outputs often contain subtle bugs. Automatically repairing such code requires informative tests: inputs that expose faulty behavior, paired with correct expected outputs. Recent RL-based test generation methods apply the same outcome reward to all reasoning steps, which can discourage useful reasoning and reinforce flawed steps. They also fail to effectively learn from trajectories that find bug-triggering inputs but predict incorrect outputs, leaving their verified bug-triggering progress insufficiently exploited. To address these limitations, we propose SCALF, a process-supervised RL approach that combines Step-level Credit Assignment with targeted Learning from valuable Failed trajectories. SCALF derives step-specific advantages from process rewards, allowing each reasoning stage to receive its own learning signal. It further routes trajectories that expose bugs but predict incorrect outputs to on-policy self-distillation, using execution feedback to learn from their valuable bug-triggering progress. Across three benchmarks, SCALF outperforms strong prompting and post-training baselines by up to 2.97, 5.26, and 3.53 percentage points in joint success rate, output correctness rate, and bug-triggering rate, respectively. Our code and datasets are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SCALF-F4D1.

AI.tldr: SCALF：一种过程监督强化学习框架，通过步骤级信用分配与从有价值失败轨迹中定向学习，为代码自动修复生成更有效的测试用例。
AI.motivation: 大模型代码生成常有隐蔽bug，自动修复需能触发bug且给出正确期望输出的测试。现有RL测试生成方法对所有推理步骤施加同一结果奖励，会抑制有用推理、强化错误步骤；且对“找到触发bug输入但输出预测错误”的轨迹利用不足，浪费了宝贵的bug触发进展。
AI.method: 提出SCALF：(1) 步骤级信用分配——从过程奖励推导各步骤专属优势，让每个推理阶段获得独立学习信号；(2) 定向失败轨迹学习——将暴露出bug但输出错误的轨迹路由到在线策略自蒸馏，借助执行反馈从其中有价值的bug触发进展中学习。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，SCALF在联合成功率、输出正确率和bug触发率上分别比强提示与后训练基线最高提升2.97、5.26、3.53个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度过程监督加针对性利用失败轨迹，可显著提升基于RL的测试生成效果，为自动代码修复提供更可靠测试。

title: SuperClip Pyramid for Video Temporal Grounding
summary: With the rapid expansion of online video content, video temporal grounding has become essential for localizing moments based on user-specific queries, comprising two subtasks: moment retrieval (MR) and highlight detection (HD). While recent approaches adopt DETR-style decoders or temporal pyramid architectures, they rely on single-scale feature maps or uniformly downsampled representations, limiting their ability to capture semantic boundaries and variable-length events. In this paper, we present SuperClip Video Temporal Grounding (SCVTG) built on a multi-scale temporal hierarchy that better captures distinctive events at various granularities. SCVTG constructs a SuperClip pyramid by grouping adjacent clips into semantically coherent segments, termed SuperClips. Further, to aggregate these SuperClips having variable duration and temporal location, we introduce a temporally adaptive kernel that aggregates SuperClips through temporally conditioned weights, enabling flexible aggregation. On top of this, we design relative saliency losses to guide the model in learning inter-clip importance, enhancing its ability to distinguish relevant events. Extensive experiments show that SCVTG achieves the best performance across five video temporal grounding benchmarks with promising gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SCVTG，通过构建多尺度 SuperClip 时序金字塔、时序自适应聚合核和相对显著性损失，提升视频时序定位（MR+HD）性能，在五个基准上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有 DETR 式解码器或时序金字塔方法依赖单尺度特征图或均匀下采样表示，难以捕捉语义边界和变长事件，限制了对不同粒度事件的建模能力。
AI.method: 构建 SuperClip 金字塔：将相邻 clip 分组成语义连贯的 SuperClip 段；引入时序自适应核，通过时序条件化权重对变长、不同位置的 SuperClip 进行灵活聚合；并设计相对显著性损失，引导模型学习 clip 间重要性以区分相关事件。
AI.result: 在五个视频时序定位基准上均取得最佳性能，且有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度语义分段的时序金字塔结合自适应聚合与显著性监督，是提升时刻检索与高光检测的有效方案。

title: LightCRS: Lightweight Multi-Domain Conversational Recommendation System
summary: Conversational recommender systems have recently adopted vision-language models to match user dialogue intents with multimodal product information. However, extending these methods to many product domains faces a dilemma: deploying a separately adapted VLM per domain scales cost linearly with the number of domains and requires routing each dialogue to the right model, while naively merging all domains into a single VLM degrades accuracy because product characteristics vary widely across categories. We propose LightCRS, a lightweight, query-conditioned framework for unified multi-domain multimodal conversational recommendation. LightCRS precomputes multimodal product representations once offline with frozen encoders. Online, a compact 5.3M-parameter module fuses this evidence for each dialogue via query-conditioned cross-attention, whose parameters are shared across all domains, and compares candidates jointly with an inter-candidate Transformer. To enable rigorous evaluation, we construct MM-R2A-25, a 25-domain benchmark pairing natural Reddit recommendation-seeking conversations with Amazon product listings. LightCRS achieves state-of-the-art average HR@1, NDCG@5, and MRR, improving HR@1 by 35.4\% over the strongest baseline while reducing per-query latency by 266 times. Joint multi-domain training itself improves HR@1 by 15.2\% over separately trained single-domain models.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量查询条件化框架LightCRS，用冻结编码器离线预计算多模态商品表示，在线用5.3M参数共享模块实现统一多域多模态对话推荐，并构建25域基准MM-R2A-25，HR@1领先最强基线35.4%，延迟降低266倍。
AI.motivation: 将视觉语言模型用于对话推荐扩展到多商品域时存在两难：每域单独适配VLM成本随域数线性增长且需为对话路由正确模型；而简单把所有域合并进单一VLM又会因商品类别差异大而降低准确率。
AI.method: LightCRS先用冻结编码器离线预计算多模态商品表示；在线阶段由紧凑的5.3M参数模块通过查询条件化交叉注意力为每条对话融合证据，参数在所有域间共享，并用候选间Transformer联合比较候选商品。同时构建MM-R2A-25基准（25个域，Reddit求助对话+Amazon商品列表）。
AI.result: 平均HR@1、NDCG@5、MRR均达SOTA，HR@1较最强基线提升35.4%，每查询延迟降低266倍；联合多域训练相比单独训练的单域模型HR@1提升15.2%。
AI.conclusion: 共享参数+查询条件化融合可同时避免多域线性成本与合并精度损失，多域联合训练本身即有益，并为多域多模态对话推荐提供严格评测基准。

title: SPAR: Stepwise Personalized Autoregressive Recommendation with Prefix-Balanced Semantic IDs
summary: Semantic ID (SID)-based generative recommendation retrieves items through successive token-level decisions, making personalization at each decoding step essential. However, existing methods insufficiently account for prefix-dependent user evidence and imbalanced historical interaction loads among candidate branches. This can cause irreversible branch-selection errors and favor popular paths. We propose SPAR, a generative recommendation framework that jointly improves stepwise personalization and SID construction. Its PATH Decoder retrieves prefix-relevant evidence from compressed long-term user memories and combines it with recent behavior, user profiles, and event context to guide each token decision. Its RQ-PIB module balances historical interaction loads among sibling branches under each parent prefix while preserving semantic structure. Experiments on large-scale Youku production data show an average relative HitRate improvement of 2.66% over the strongest baseline. SPAR also increases target-prefix retention by 5.79 percentage points and reduces the traffic-weighted largest child-branch share by 32.84% across SID levels. In a 7-day online A/B test, SPAR serves 10% of Youku's production traffic and improves average watch time per user by 3.95% and play conversion rate by 3.38%. These results demonstrate more reliable hierarchical decoding, balanced SID branches, and improved user engagement in industrial recommendation.

AI.tldr: SPAR 是一个 SID 生成式推荐框架，通过 PATH Decoder 做前缀感知的逐步个性化，并用 RQ-PIB 平衡同级分支的交互负载，在优酷离线与线上 A/B 实验中均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: SID 生成式推荐通过逐 token 决策检索物品，因此每一步解码的个性化至关重要。但现有方法未充分考虑"依赖前缀的用户证据"以及候选分支间历史交互负载不均衡的问题，导致不可逆的分支选择错误，并偏向热门路径。
AI.method: 提出 SPAR 框架，联合改进逐步个性化与 SID 构建：(1) PATH Decoder 从压缩的长期用户记忆中检索与当前前缀相关的证据，并与近期行为、用户画像、事件上下文结合，指导每个 token 决策；(2) RQ-PIB 模块在每个父前缀下平衡兄弟分支的历史交互负载，同时保持语义结构。
AI.result: 优酷大规模生产数据上平均 HitRate 相对提升 2.66%；目标前缀保留率提升 5.79 个百分点；流量加权的最大子分支占比下降 32.84%。7 天线上 A/B（10% 流量）中人均观看时长提升 3.95%，播放转化率提升 3.38%。
AI.conclusion: SPAR 实现了更可靠的分层解码、更均衡的 SID 分支以及更好的用户参与度，验证了其工业落地价值。

title: CorteXforge: Scenario-Based RF Dataset Generation on Real Testbeds
summary: Deep learning for radio frequency (RF) signal analysis relies on large annotated datasets, yet synthetic datasets trade physical realism for controllability, while uncontrolled over-theair measurements offer realism but limited reproducibility. We present CorteXforge, a scenario-based framework for generating realistic and reproducible RF datasets on programmable software defined radio (SDR) testbeds. High-level RF scenarios are automatically translated into synchronized experiments executed on the SLICES-RI/CorteXlab platform, producing fully annotated Signal Metadata Format (SIGMF) datasets that capture hardware impairments and propagation effects. We validate CorteXforge through automatic modulation classification using ModForge, an over-the-air (OTA) dataset generated with the framework. Cross-domain experiments reveal a synthetic-to-real performance gap and show that synthetic pretraining remains beneficial for adaptation to OTA data. CorteXforge provides a practical foundation for reproducible RF dataset generation and future research on domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出CorteXforge：基于可编程SDR测试床（SLICES-RI/CorteXlab）的场景化框架，将高层RF场景自动转换为同步实验，生成真实且可复现、带完整标注的SIGMF数据集，并用ModForge数据集验证其在调制识别与跨域泛化研究中的价值。
AI.motivation: RF信号深度学习依赖大规模标注数据，但现有数据存在两难：合成数据集可控制但缺乏物理真实性，真实空口采集数据真实但难以复现。
AI.method: CorteXforge把高层RF场景自动翻译为在CorteXlab平台上执行的同步SDR实验，产出含硬件损伤与传播效应的全标注SIGMF数据集；基于该框架生成OTA数据集ModForge，并开展自动调制分类的跨域实验（合成与真实对比、合成预训练迁移）。
AI.result: 跨域实验揭示了合成到真实的性能差距，同时表明合成数据预训练对适应OTA数据仍然有益。
AI.conclusion: CorteXforge为可复现的RF数据集生成及未来域泛化研究提供了实用基础。

title: A Multi-granularity Interaction Network for Relational Triple Extraction
summary: Relational triple extraction identifies entity relations from raw sentences without depending on entity type information. The performance of traditional methods is seriously degenerated by ``unseen'' entities, because these methods can't build contextual dependencies relevant ``unseen'' entities. This paper addresses this challenge by proposing a multi-granularity interaction network that leverages word-word, entity-relation, and head-tail interactions to capture deep semantic dependencies. By incorporating multiple iterations, the multi-granularity interaction network is effective to refine the representations corresponding to head and tail entities. It enhances the global semantic features associated with relational triples, aiding in the remediation of triples that may have been overlooked or omitted in earlier steps. Strong and consistent performance is achieved by our method on two rearranged datasets, with a significant improvement in identifying relational triples, including those involving ``unseen'' named entities. For example, our model improves F1-score by 3.1%/20.5% over previous approaches on the NYT-R/WebNLG-R datasets in the Unseen metric. Code: https://github.com/xiaocen-luo/Interaction-Network.

AI.tldr: 提出多粒度交互网络，通过词-词、实体-关系、头-尾的交互与多次迭代，缓解关系三元组抽取中"未见实体"导致的性能退化。
AI.motivation: 传统关系三元组抽取不依赖实体类型信息，但面对"未见实体"（unseen entities）时无法建立相关的上下文依赖，性能严重下降。
AI.method: 提出多粒度交互网络，融合词-词、实体-关系、头-尾三个层次的交互以捕获深度语义依赖；并通过多次迭代精炼头尾实体表示，增强三元组的全局语义特征，从而补全早期步骤中被忽略或遗漏的三元组。
AI.result: 在两个重排数据集上取得稳定且强劲的表现；在Unseen指标上，NYT-R/WebNLG-R数据集F1分别提升3.1%和20.5%，尤其在含"未见"命名实体的三元组识别上有显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 多粒度交互与迭代机制能有效应对未见实体问题，提升关系三元组抽取的整体性能。

title: Subjective Valuations Make It Hard to be Fair: The Complexity of Resource Allocation to Groups of Agents
summary:
We study the parameterized complexity of finding an EF1 allocation of indivisible items in the group-sharing setting, which has received increasing attention in recent years. There, items are not allocated to individual agents but rather to one of two (or possibly more) groups, and agents within that group all share the assigned items. We consider both the "fixed" (EF1-Fix) and "variable" (EF1-Var) group cases, where in the former the assignments of agents to groups are prescribed. While both are NP-hard in the classical sense, we show that their algorithmic behavior differs significantly from the parameterized perspective. As our main results, we:
  (1) prove that both cases are NP-hard even when the number of agents is a small constant;
  (2) circumvent this hardness by establishing fixed-parameter tractability for EF1-Var w.r.t. the number of "subjective" items, that is, items which are viewed as chores or goods by different agents---but rule out an analogous result for EF1-Fix; and
  (3) establish fixed-parameter tractability for EF1-Fix w.r.t. the number of item types, but link the existence of an analogous fixed-parameter algorithm for EF1-Var to a fundamental open question in the setting of Integer Linear Programming.

AI.tldr: 研究群组共享场景下不可分物品EF1分配的参数化复杂性：证明两类情形即使代理数为常数仍NP难；EF1-Var对"主观物品"数FPT而EF1-Fix无此性质；EF1-Fix对物品类型数FPT，EF1-Var的对应结果则与ILP基本开放问题等价。
AI.motivation: 群组共享分配近年备受关注，但固定/可变群组两种EF1分配情形的参数化复杂性尚不清楚，且二者经典复杂性均NP难，需从参数化视角刻画其算法本质差异。
AI.method: 从参数化复杂性角度分析EF1-Fix与EF1-Var：通过归约证明常数代理数下仍NP难；选取"主观物品"数和"物品类型"数作为参数，分别建立或排除固定参数可处理（FPT）算法，并将EF1-Var的FPT性与整数线性规划中的基本开放问题相联系。
AI.result: (1) 两情形在代理数为小常数时仍NP难；(2) EF1-Var对主观物品数FPT，而EF1-Fix不存在类似结果；(3) EF1-Fix对物品类型数FPT，EF1-Var的类似FPT算法存在性等价于ILP中的基本开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 固定与可变群组EF1分配在参数化视角下行为显著不同：同一参数仅对其中一类给出FPT，另一类则被排除或与ILP开放问题挂钩，凸显两类问题的算法本质差异。

title: RELAY: Scaling Historical Build Restoration through Rule Reuse and Agentic Repair
summary: Vulnerability benchmarks and software engineering research depend on rebuilding historical software. Yet builds rely on external resources, such as base images and packages, that change independently of the source code. In this study, we examine this environment decay on 14,159 OSS-Fuzz cases. We find that 69.7% no longer complete reconstruction and verification, and that most failures share a small number of recurring failure symptoms. A recurring failure can therefore be diagnosed once and its repair reused. We present Relay, a hybrid framework that uses an LLM to derive and validate deterministic repair rules from representative failures, reuses them without model calls, and escalates cases unresolved by rules to a per-case agent. We evaluate Relay in human-guided and fully automated rule-derivation campaigns and compare it with a per-case agent approach. We find that rule derivation can be fully automated, and that reusable rules restore as many builds as per-case agents with fewer build executions. However, agents restore cases that the rules cannot. Our results show that a hybrid approach that applies rules first and escalates the remaining cases to an agent restores more builds than either approach alone and at a lower cost than using agents alone.

AI.tldr: 论文研究历史软件重建中的"环境腐化"问题（依赖的基础镜像、软件包等外部资源变化导致构建失败），在14,159个OSS-Fuzz案例上发现69.7%已无法完成重建与验证，且失败症状高度重复。提出混合框架Relay：用LLM从代表性失败中推导并验证确定性修复规则，规则可无模型调用复用，规则无法解决时升级到逐案例agent。
AI.motivation: 漏洞基准与软件工程研究依赖重建历史软件，但构建所依赖的外部资源（基础镜像、软件包）独立于源码而变化，导致历史构建失效（环境腐化）。逐案例使用LLM agent成本高，而失败症状的重复性暗示修复可被复用。
AI.method: 在14,159个OSS-Fuzz案例上量化环境腐化程度与失败症状分布；提出Relay混合框架：LLM从代表性失败中推导并验证确定性修复规则，规则复用时不调用模型，未解决案例升级至逐案例agent；在人工引导与全自动规则推导两种模式下评估，并与纯逐案例agent方法对比（构建执行次数、恢复数量、成本）。
AI.result: 69.7%的历史案例无法完成重建与验证，且大多数失败集中于少数反复出现的症状。规则推导可完全自动化；可复用规则恢复的构建数量与逐案例agent相当，且构建执行次数更少，但agent能恢复规则无法处理的案例。
AI.conclusion: "规则优先、剩余升级至agent"的混合方法恢复的构建数多于任一单独方法，且成本低于仅使用agent，是应对环境腐化的高效实用方案。

title: Rate as a Feature, Not a Nuisance: Curriculum FiLM Training for Event-Based Graph Neural Networks
summary: An event camera emits events at a rate given by the scene motion, object texture, illumination, its own contrast thresholds, and other settings. Across the N-Caltech101 dataset, recorded by a single event camera, the event rate varies by roughly 26x. Standard event-based Graph Neural Network GNN pipelines do not make use of the variable event rate. They either normalize each event's timestamp into a fixed window or train the network to be invariant to the event rate. We argue that both choices lose information that could instead be used to improve the performance of a pipeline. Per-recording normalization is non-invertible, incurring about 6pp (percentage points) of natural-rate accuracy loss in our setting. And invariance training trades accuracy for robustness to shifts in the event rate. We instead take a different path and condition on the event rate directly. We add a per-recording log-rate scalar that modulates every stage of a PointNet++ backbone through Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM), initialized to identity, so that training begins at the unmodified baseline. A two-stage curriculum (natural event rates first, then rate-augmented fine-tuning) reaches 67.2% on N-Caltech101 (+6.3pp) and 82.5% on DVS128 Gesture (+14.0pp) with an additional ~0.2M parameters. A matched-capacity control experiment shows that the gain is not from the increase in model capacity but from the rate conditioning. We will make the implementation publicly available upon acceptance of this work.

AI.tldr: 本文指出事件相机数据中事件率变化巨大（约26倍），而现有基于GNN的事件处理流程要么对时间戳做固定窗口归一化（不可逆、损失约6pp精度），要么训练事件率不变性（牺牲精度）。作者转而直接以事件率作为条件，通过FiLM将每条记录的log事件率标量注入PointNet++骨干网络的每一层，并以两阶段课程学习训练，在N-Caltech101和DVS128 Gesture上分别取得67.2%(+6.3pp)和82.5%(+14.0pp)的提升，仅增加约0.2M参数。
AI.motivation: 事件相机的事件产生速率受场景运动、物体纹理、光照、对比度阈值及设置等影响，N-Caltech101数据集中事件率变化约26倍。标准事件GNN流程忽略这一变量：固定窗口时间戳归一化不可逆、损失信息；事件率不变性训练以精度换鲁棒性。作者认为事件率本身是可用信息，应直接作为条件利用。
AI.method: 提出按记录的事件率条件化：将每条记录的log事件率作为标量，通过Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) 调制PointNet++骨干网络的每个阶段，FiLM初始化为恒等映射，使训练从原始基线开始。采用两阶段课程：先在自然事件率上训练，再进行事件率增强的微调。
AI.result: N-Caltech101达67.2%（+6.3pp），DVS128 Gesture达82.5%（+14.0pp），仅增加约0.2M参数。匹配容量对照实验表明增益来自事件率条件化而非模型容量增加。另测得按记录归一化约造成6pp自然事件率精度损失。
AI.conclusion: 事件率是被现有事件GNN流程丢弃的有用信息；以FiLM显式条件化事件率、并以课程训练，可低成本稳定提升性能，且增益并非来自容量增长。

title: When Planning Problems Become Hard for LLMs: Separating Structural Complexity from Semantic Interpretability
summary: Large language models (LLMs) struggle with classical planning, but benchmarks rarely distinguish structural difficulty from the difficulty of interpreting symbolic vocabulary. We examine seven STRIPS domains with BFS-optimal plan lengths. For predicting structural difficulty without solving an instance, the zero-training delete-relaxation heuristic $h_{\mathrm{add}}$ outperforms learned alternatives on held-out domains (mean Spearman $|ρ|=0.931$), including ridge regression ($0.707$), object count ($0.657$), and the episodic retrieval architecture ARC ($0.400$). ARC also fails to outperform a linear model using the same features. To isolate semantic effects, we progressively rename predicates while preserving states, transitions, and optimal plans. Valid LLM planning success drops from $67.5\%$ to $40.0\%$ between $0\%$ and $100\%$ renaming, while refusals remain at $0\%$. An LLM supplied with ARC's conditioning information predicts difficulty in context better than trained ARC (mean $|ρ|=0.826$). Hybrid routing between an LLM and a symbolic planner depends more on calibration to the target LLM's outcomes than on the structural score selected. Thus, established symbolic heuristics already estimate structural difficulty well; improving hybrid planning requires modeling LLM behavior sensitive to predicate semantics rather than developing more structural predictors.

AI.tldr: 论文区分了经典规划任务中的"结构难度"与"符号词汇理解难度"，发现经典符号启发式 $h_{\mathrm{add}}$ 在预测结构难度上优于学习型方法，而谓词重命名会显著降低 LLM 规划成功率，说明提升混合规划的关键在于建模 LLM 的语义敏感性而非更好的结构预测器。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 规划基准通常混淆了任务本身的结构性难度与 LLM 理解符号词汇的语义难度，导致难以判断 LLM 失败的真正原因，也让混合规划系统的路由设计缺乏清晰依据。
AI.method: 在 7 个 STRIPS 领域（以 BFS 最优规划长度衡量难度）上，比较零训练的 delete-relaxation 启发式 $h_{\mathrm{add}}$ 与学习方法（ridge 回归、object count、ARC 检索架构）对结构难度的预测能力；并通过逐步重命名谓词（保持状态、转移和最优规划不变）来隔离语义效应；另用 LLM 在上下文中预测难度并与训练后的 ARC 对比，分析混合路由的影响因素。
AI.result: $h_{\mathrm{add}}$ 跨领域平均 Spearman $|\rho|=0.931$，显著优于 ridge（0.707）、object count（0.657）和 ARC（0.400）；ARC 甚至不敌使用相同特征的线性模型。谓词从 0% 到 100% 重命名后，LLM 规划成功率由 67.5% 降至 40.0%，而拒答率保持 0%。给 LLM 提供 ARC 的条件信息后，其上下文难度预测（$|\rho|=0.826$）优于训练后的 ARC。LLM 与符号规划器之间的混合路由效果更多取决于对目标 LLM 行为的校准，而非所选结构分数。
AI.conclusion: 已有的符号启发式已能很好地估计结构难度，发展更复杂的结构预测器收益有限；改进混合规划应聚焦于对谓词语义敏感的 LLM 行为建模，以及针对具体 LLM 的路由校准。

title: AutoSim: A Self-Improving User Simulator for Conversational Search Evaluation
summary: User simulators promise to evaluate conversational search systems at a scale human studies cannot reach, but only if their behavior is realistic enough to trust. We study AutoSim, a conversational-search user simulator whose relevance judgments rank a controlled pool of retrieval systems in agreement with NIST across three TREC iKAT years (Kendall's $τ$ of $0.66$, $0.91$, and $0.91$; all $p{\le}0.002$), an agreement that survives removing its persona. AutoSim self-improves against a held-out signal from real users, and we find that fine-tuning its weights makes it behave like real users, which in turn gives a more accurate estimate of how well a system serves them. Reaching that behavior takes more than prompting: when discriminating between real and simulated user sessions, no prompt we tried lowers a held-out real-versus-simulated classifier below AUC $0.85$, whereas fine-tuning the weights drives it to $0.45$, where neither the classifier nor a human reading full dialogues can tell it from a real user. That added realism is what makes the evaluation more accurate: where real users retrieve little, a prompted simulator over-estimates retrieval effectiveness by $+0.136$ nDCG and returns a relevant passage on $57\%$ of the turns where real users find none, enough to change a deployment decision. Only the weight-level simulator escapes this bias. We release the framework and code.

AI.tldr: AutoSim是一个对话搜索用户模拟器，其细调权重版本在真实性上达到与真实用户难以区分的程度（分类器AUC低至0.45），从而能更准确地估计检索系统的实际效果。
AI.motivation: 用户模拟器有望以人类研究无法企及的规模评估对话搜索系统，但前提是其行为足够真实可信。本文探究模拟器需要达到何种真实性、以及如何达到，才能做出可信的评估。
AI.method: 1) 用三个TREC iKAT年份的数据，检验AutoSim的相关性判断对受控检索系统池的排序是否与NIST一致；2) 检验去掉persona后的一致性是否保持；3) 利用真实用户的留出信号进行自我改进，对权重进行微调；4) 用真假用户会话分类器及人类阅读完整对话来判断模拟真实性。
AI.result: AutoSim与NIST排序的一致Kendall's τ分别为0.66、0.91、0.91（均p≤0.002），去掉persona后仍成立。提示工程无法降低分类器判别度（AUC始终≥0.85），而微调权重可降至0.45，此时分类器与人类均无法区分真假。真实性带来更准确评估：在真实用户检索较少的场景，提示式模拟器将检索效果高估+0.136 nDCG，并在真实用户未找到相关段落的57%轮次上返回了相关段落，足以改变部署决策；仅权重级模拟器能规避此偏差。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠提示不足以获得可信的模拟真实度，需在权重层面微调才能让模拟器行为贴近真实用户，从而使评估更准确、避免系统性高估检索效果并影响部署决策。作者开源了框架与代码。

title: ORBIT: Autoregressive Time Series Generation via Next Frequency-Band Prediction
summary: Deep generative models provide an effective modern solution to alleviating the problem of data scarcity by synthesizing realistic time series. However, despite the considerable progress achieved by existing deep time series generators, two key challenges remain: (1) learning hierarchical representations for heterogeneous temporal patterns; and (2) coordinating the generation process of heterogeneous temporal dynamics. To address these key bottlenecks, in this work, we propose ORBIT, a unified deep generative framework for time series. Specifically, we develop two key components: the Frequency-Hierarchical VQ-VAE (FH-VQ-VAE) and the Frequency-Band Autoregressive Transformer (FBAR). The former learns hierarchical representations by decomposing latent temporal representations into different frequency bands and applying residual quantization with increasing token budgets. The latter establishes a novel low-to-high frequency autoregressive direction, yielding a time series generation process that first constructs global temporal structures and then incrementally incorporates fine-grained temporal details. These compact designs not only disentangle heterogeneous temporal patterns for more effective representation learning but also mitigate potential interference among different temporal dynamics during generation. Extensive experiments on multiple challenging real-world benchmarks demonstrate that ORBIT achieves state-of-the-art overall performance while exhibiting superior inference efficiency compared with advanced baselines.

AI.tldr: ORBIT：面向时间序列的统一深度生成框架，通过频带分层VQ-VAE与频带自回归Transformer，实现从低频到高频的层次化生成，达到SOTA性能并提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: 数据稀缺问题可用深度生成模型合成真实时间序列缓解，但现有生成器存在两大瓶颈：(1) 难以学习异质时间模式的层次化表示；(2) 难以协调异质时间动态的生成过程。
AI.method: 提出ORBIT框架，含两个核心组件：Frequency-Hierarchical VQ-VAE（FH-VQ-VAE）将潜在时间表示分解到不同频带，并用递增token预算的残差量化学习层次化表示；Frequency-Band Autoregressive Transformer（FBAR）建立从低频到高频的自回归方向，先生成全局时间结构，再逐步加入细粒度细节。
AI.result: 在多个具挑战性的真实基准上，ORBIT达到整体SOTA性能，且相比先进基线具有更优的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 频带分解+残差量化可解耦异质时间模式以改善表示学习；低频到高频的生成顺序可缓解不同时间动态间的干扰，验证了该统一框架的有效性与高效性。

title: LAMB: Latent Multi-Hypothesis Beliefs for Long-Horizon Large Language Agents
summary: Long-horizon language agents require compact memories that retain interaction evidence while preserving competing hypotheses about unobserved states. Although effective, many belief-state methods encode memory in discrete natural language, where repeated compression can omit evidence or prematurely discard plausible alternatives. We introduce LAMB, a recurrent framework for latent multi-hypothesis beliefs. A Common--Delta factorization combines a shared Common state for interaction evidence with weighted Delta components for competing hypotheses. Relative evidence from action-outcome predictions guides recurrent hypothesis updates without generating textual memory. A context-conditioned readout exposes hypotheses separately to the policy through a fixed-token belief prefix in the default configuration. The belief modules and policy are jointly trained using action imitation and auxiliary state, outcome, and observation-discrimination objectives. Across ALFWorld, BabyAI, ScienceWorld, and Crafter, LAMB matches or outperforms PABU, improving ALFWorld SR@30 and ScienceWorld success by 6.0 and 22.0 percentage points, respectively, and Crafter achievement progress by 26.37 points. On ALFWorld, it also reduces the redundant-action rate by 17.70 percentage points. These results support latent multi-hypothesis beliefs as compact memory for effective long-horizon decision making

AI.tldr: LAMB：用"公共-增量（Common-Delta）"分解的循环隐空间框架来维护多假设信念记忆，取代离散自然语言记忆，在长程任务上匹配或超越PABU。
AI.motivation: 长程语言智能体需要紧凑记忆，既要保留交互证据，又要保留对未观测状态的多种竞争假设。现有信念状态方法多以离散自然语言编码记忆，反复压缩会丢失证据或过早丢弃合理备选假设。
AI.method: 提出LAMB循环信念框架：Common-Delta分解，用一个共享Common状态承载交互证据，用加权Delta分量表示竞争假设；以动作-结果预测的相对证据驱动循环假设更新，不生成文本记忆；通过固定token的信念前缀（context-conditioned readout）分别向策略暴露各假设；信念模块与策略联合训练，损失含动作模仿及辅助的状态、结果、观测判别目标。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、BabyAI、ScienceWorld、Crafter上匹配或超过PABU：ALFWorld SR@30提升6.0个百分点，ScienceWorld成功率提升22.0个百分点，Crafter成就进度提升26.37点；ALFWorld冗余动作率下降17.70个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将隐空间多假设信念作为长程决策的有效紧凑记忆。

title: Exact Envy-Free Cake Cutting with Polynomial Expected Queries
summary: Envy-free cake cutting asks how to divide a resource so that no agent prefers another agent's share. Finding such a division with few queries about preferences has been a longstanding challenge. Aziz and Mackenzie gave the first query bound depending only on the number $n$ of agents: a tower of six $n$'s. Subsequent improvements culminated in Ye and Bai's single-exponential bound of $n^{O(1)}2^n$. A large gap remains between this deterministic upper bound and Procaccia's general lower bound of $Ω(n^2)$. Whether polynomially many queries suffice is a central open question in fair division. We show that a polynomial expected query bound is possible. Our randomised protocol uses only independent, uniformly sampled points from the cake as its source of randomness. For every profile of $n$ agents with nonnegative, additive, nonatomic valuations, the protocol has the following guarantees: (1) It terminates with probability one. (2) Every allocation it returns is complete and exactly envy-free. (3) Its expected number of Robertson-Webb queries is $\widetilde{O}(n^{30})$. The expectation is taken solely over the protocol's random choices, with no distributional assumptions on preferences.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了无嫉妒蛋糕切割存在多项式期望查询上界，给出一个随机协议，对任意非负可加非原子估值，期望 Robertson-Webb 查询数为 Õ(n^30)，且以概率一终止并返回完全且精确无嫉妒的分配。
AI.motivation: 无嫉妒蛋糕切割长期存在查询复杂度问题：确定性最好上界为 n^{O(1)}2^n（Ye 与 Bai），而一般下界仅 Ω(n^2)，差距巨大；多项式查询是否可行是公平分配的核心开放问题。
AI.method: 提出随机化协议，仅以从蛋糕上独立均匀采样的点作为随机性来源；对 n 个代理的非负、可加、非原子估值运行协议，终止后返回完整精确无嫉妒的分配。
AI.result: 协议以概率一终止；返回的每个分配均完整且精确无嫉妒；期望 Robertson-Webb 查询数为 Õ(n^30)，期望仅对协议随机选择取，无偏好分布假设。
AI.conclusion: 无嫉妒蛋糕切割存在多项式期望查询上界，回答了多项式查询是否可行这一核心开放问题，将上界从单指数显著降至多项式（随机化意义下）。

title: RAG-NIMBF: A Non-Invasive, Modular Benchmarking Framework for Automated RAG Configuration Analysis
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become the dominant paradigm for grounding the outputs of large language models (LLM) in external knowledge. However, practitioners are faced with a vast configuration space comprising chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, prompting and generation models, and there is limited guidance on how these components interact. We present RAG-NIMBF, a modular benchmarking framework that attaches to existing RAG pipelines as a non-invasive evaluation layer. It evaluates the configuration space through controlled ablation with end-to-end experiment tracking. The evaluation combines LLM-based answer quality scores, retrieval correctness measures, and runtime indicators. This study validates the framework across multiple generation models on the SQuAD dataset. This process reveals non-obvious interactions and demonstrates how the experiments are tracked. The findings indicate that the retrieval balance of relevance and diversity substantially enhances the relevance and coverage of retrieved context in comparison to a conventional similarity search, with MMR raising nDCG@5 by +4 to +11 percentage points across the swept models. More detailed prompt instructions meaningfully increase how faithfully generated answers stick to the retrieved evidence, especially for capable and reasoning models (+10 to +13pp on Qwen3.6-27B, GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3.5-think, but negligible on the 20B generator). Overall, RAG-NIMBF transforms the configuration space of RAG into reproducible, comparable experiments. By attaching to existing production pipelines in a non-invasive way, it enables practitioners to systematically evaluate and improve deployed systems without disrupting existing workflows. This replaces ad hoc choices with evidence-based decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出 RAG-NIMBF——一种非侵入式、模块化的 RAG 评测框架，通过受控消融与端到端实验追踪，将 RAG 配置空间转化为可复现、可比较的实验；在 SQuAD 上验证发现 MMR 检索使 nDCG@5 提升 4–11 个百分点，细致提示词显著提升答案忠实度（10–13pp）。
AI.motivation: RAG 已成 LLM 外部知识落地的主流范式，但分块、嵌入、检索、重排、提示与生成模型构成庞大配置空间，各组件如何交互缺乏指导，实践者多凭经验做临时选择，缺少系统、可复现的评测手段。
AI.method: 提出模块化基准框架 RAG-NIMBF，以非侵入方式挂接现有 RAG 流水线作为评测层；通过受控消融扫描配置空间，配合端到端实验追踪；评测指标综合 LLM 评判的答案质量分、检索正确性指标与运行时指标；在 SQuAD 数据集上对多个生成模型（如 Qwen3.6-27B、GPT-4o-mini、Qwen3.5-think、20B 模型等）进行验证。
AI.result: 发现非显而易见的组件交互：兼顾相关性与多样性的检索（MMR）相较传统相似度检索显著提升上下文相关性与覆盖率，nDCG@5 在被扫描模型上提升 +4 至 +11 个百分点；更细致的提示指令显著提升答案对检索证据的忠实度，在能力较强及推理型模型上提升 +10 至 +13pp，而在 20B 生成器上几乎无效果。
AI.conclusion: RAG-NIMBF 把 RAG 配置空间转变为可复现、可比较的实验，并以非侵入方式接入生产流水线，使实践者能在不干扰现有工作流的前提下系统评估并优化已部署系统，以证据驱动决策取代临时性选择。

title: Deep Auxiliary Learning via Bilevel Feature Optimization for Label-Efficient Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Auxiliary learning (AL), which can improve the performance of a primary task by leveraging related auxiliary tasks, is commonly regarded as a special case of multi-task learning. Existing AL approaches typically require manually annotated auxiliary labels, increasing annotation costs, particularly in medical imaging where expert labeling is expensive. In this work, we investigate whether segmentation performance can be improved using auxiliary tasks whose labels are automatically derived from existing segmentation annotations, requiring no additional manual labeling. To address this, we propose a novel auxiliary learning framework, formulated as a bilevel optimization problem. Our method enables effective knowledge transfer between tasks via a feature communication module, enhancing the primary segmentation task. We evaluate the method on three medical image segmentation benchmarks under limited-label settings. The results demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods, achieving superior label efficiency. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/FupingWu90/ALBO.

AI.tldr: 提出一种双层优化的辅助学习框架ALBO，用从已有分割标注自动派生的辅助任务提升主分割任务，无需额外人工标注。
AI.motivation: 现有辅助学习通常依赖人工标注的辅助标签，在医学影像中专家标注成本高昂，因此希望用无需额外人工标注的辅助任务来提升分割性能。
AI.method: 将辅助学习建模为双层优化（bilevel optimization）问题，并提出特征通信模块实现任务间有效知识迁移，以增强主分割任务。
AI.result: 在三个医学图像分割基准的少标注设置下进行评估，结果一致优于现有最先进方法，取得更好的标签效率。
AI.conclusion: 无需额外标注的自动派生辅助任务可有效提升医学图像分割性能，双层优化与特征通信模块是关键设计。

title: SPEM: Structure-Aware Procedural Memory for Efficient Skill Use in LLM Agents
summary: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on reusable skills. However, scaling skill libraries makes efficient and accurate skill use difficult. Full skill loading incurs high token and runtime overhead. In contrast, flat semantic retrieval treats skills as independent text entries, ignoring dependencies, execution order, state transitions, and data flow constraints. We propose SPEM, a lightweight structure-aware procedural memory framework for efficient skill use in LLM-based agents. SPEM maintains Atomic Skill Memory for individual skills and Skill-DAG Memory for reusable compositions derived from successful executions. For a new task, SPEM reuses high-confidence Skill-DAG templates when available. Otherwise, it retrieves atomic skills and invokes Skill-GNN for state- and structure-aware skill selection. Successful executions are written back as new Skill-DAGs, allowing procedural memory to accumulate over time. Experiments on ALFWorld and SkillsBench show that SPEM achieves the best overall effectiveness--efficiency trade-off, reaching 87.1% ALFWorld success and 38.38% SkillsBench reward while reducing token and runtime costs against strong baselines.

AI.tldr: SPEM：一种轻量级结构感知程序记忆框架，用原子技能记忆+技能DAG记忆替代扁平检索，结合Skill-GNN做状态/结构感知选择，并以成功执行回写实现记忆累积。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体日益依赖可复用技能，但技能库扩大后难以高效准确调用：全量加载带来高token与运行时开销；扁平语义检索把技能当独立文本条目，忽略依赖关系、执行顺序、状态转移和数据流约束。
AI.method: SPEM维护两类记忆：针对单个技能的Atomic Skill Memory，以及从成功执行中提炼的可复用组合Skill-DAG Memory。新任务优先复用高置信度Skill-DAG模板；否则检索原子技能并调用Skill-GNN进行状态与结构感知的技能选择；成功执行回写为新Skill-DAG，使程序记忆随时间累积。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与SkillsBench上取得最佳整体效果—效率权衡：ALFWorld成功率87.1%，SkillsBench奖励38.38%，相比强基线降低token与运行时开销。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知的程序记忆（模板复用+图神经网络选择+成功经验回写）能在不牺牲效果的前提下显著提升技能库规模下的调用效率，是技能扩展的一种可行方案。

title: Multimodal Reranking Is a System One Decision
comment: Position paper. 19 pages (9 main), 2 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/Ryenhails/rerank-as-decision
summary: Multimodal rerankers are usually dedicated models: a vision-language model (VLM) is trained on retrieval data to score the candidates of a query. Scoring options is not specific to reranking. System One decision models such as Jev map a state and a typed question to one probability per option without generating text, and general models can make such decisions with little or no training. Reranking is one such decision, with the query and its candidates as the state and the candidates as the options. We therefore argue that a general VLM can serve as a multimodal reranker through System One decisions, and that decision tuning can improve its reranking. We ask a VLM one choice question over the top 16 candidates of a first-stage retriever and rank the candidates by the probabilities of their labels, read from one forward pass. On MMEB-V2 image retrieval, this choice scores 5.4 to 7.3 hit@1 above a yes/no question per candidate, and the yes/no question falls below the first stage. With the choice, zero-shot Qwen3.8-27B beats the supervised Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B on all three benchmarks and comes within 1.6 points of Reranker-8B on each. It matches Reranker-8B on MMEB-V2 visual documents (84.79 vs. 84.78 nDCG@5), at 1.1 to 1.5 times its latency. JEV-27B-VL, the same backbone tuned on text decisions only, improves page reranking by 0.6 to 1.1 points, with gains on most tasks (sign test, p <= 0.017), and leaves natural images unchanged. The zero-shot model is larger than the supervised rerankers and of a newer generation, so these comparisons are confounded; we discuss this and other alternative views, and the experiments that would test the position.

AI.tldr: 论文主张通用VLM可通过"System One决策"（单次前向读出选项标签概率）充当多模态重排器，且决策调优可进一步提升重排效果。
AI.motivation: 现有工作通常训练专用的视觉语言模型做多模态重排，作者认为"对选项打分"并非重排独有，而是可视为一种System One决策（状态+类型化问题→各选项概率），因此无需专门重排模型。
AI.method: 对一阶段检索的top-16候选提出单个多项选择问题，用VLM一次前向传播读出各候选标签概率并据此排序；与逐候选yes/no打分对比；并在纯文本决策数据上调优backbone得到JEV-27B-VL。
AI.result: MMEB-V2图像检索上choice较yes/no提升5.4–7.3 hit@1（yes/no甚至低于一阶段）；零样本Qwen3.8-27B在三个基准上均超过有监督Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B，并在各基准距Reranker-8B不到1.6分，视觉文档任务持平（84.79 vs 84.78 nDCG@5），延迟为1.1–1.5倍；JEV-27B-VL页面重排提升0.6–1.1分（多项任务显著，符号检验p≤0.017），自然图像无变化。
AI.conclusion: 通用VLM可零样本胜任多模态重排，决策调优带来额外增益；但对比存在模型规模与代际混淆，作者讨论了替代解释及可验证该观点的后续实验。

title: HierDTA: Hierarchical Structure-Aware Representation Learning for Drug--Target Affinity Prediction
summary: Drug--target affinity (DTA) prediction plays an important role in computer-aided drug discovery, where reliable computational models can help prioritize compound--protein pairs before experimental validation. A key challenge in DTA prediction is to effectively mine multi-level molecular information from drug structures while accurately modeling the binding-site environment of target proteins. To address these issues, we introduce HierDTA, a hierarchical structure-aware framework for DTA prediction. \textcolor{black}{HierDTA represents each drug as an atom--motif heterogeneous graph and introduces an augmentation module that propagates functional-motif semantics to the corresponding atoms. For proteins, kinase-domain structures are converted into residue interaction graphs. The resulting atom and residue representations are integrated using cross-attention to capture pair-specific relationships, while molecule fingerprints and pretrained ESM-2 embeddings provide complementary global information. Compared with state-of-the-art methods, HierDTA achieves superior performance on the Davis dataset across all metrics and attains the highest \(r_m^2\) of 0.791 on KIBA. It also exhibits strong generalization under cold-start settings, particularly on KIBA, where MSE is reduced by 21.7\% in the unseen-protein scenario. Ablation study and interpretability analysis supported the contributions of the hierarchical augmentation and interaction components.} Case studies further showed that HierDTA provided early enrichment of candidate bioactive compounds. These results indicate that HierDTA is an effective framework for affinity prediction and target-specific virtual screening.

AI.tldr: HierDTA：分层结构感知的DTA预测框架，将药物表示为原子–基序异构图、蛋白激酶域转为残基交互图，并用交叉注意力和ESM-2/指纹互补信息融合，在Davis、KIBA及冷启动场景下取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: DTA预测的关键挑战在于：既要有效挖掘药物结构的多层级分子信息，又要准确建模靶蛋白结合位点的环境。现有方法在这两方面仍有不足。
AI.method: 药物表示为原子–基序异构图，并设计增强模块将功能基序语义传播至对应原子；蛋白的激酶域结构转换为残基交互图；原子与残基表示经交叉注意捕获配对特异性关系；分子指纹与预训练ESM-2嵌入提供全局互补信息。
AI.result: 在Davis数据集上所有指标均优于SOTA；KIBA上rm²达0.791；冷启动场景泛化强，KIBA未见蛋白场景MSE降低21.7%；消融与可解释性分析验证了分层增强和交互模块的贡献；案例研究显示可早期富集候选活性化合物。
AI.conclusion: HierDTA是面向亲和力预测与靶点特异性虚拟筛选的有效框架。

title: SZED at ArGuard Shared Tasks: Multi-Task Label-Attention and Cross-Modal Fusion for Arabic Hateful Meme Detection
summary: We present SZED's submission to ArGuard 2026 Track A: Arabic hateful meme detection. The task has two parts: binary classification (A1) and fine-grained multi-label tagging (A2). For A1, we fuse MARBERTv2 and CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings, comparing concatenation, self-attention, and ensemble heads. For A2, we use a multi-task label-attention architecture with per-class query vectors and an auxiliary head for cascade calibration. We reach macro-F1 = 0.7597 on A1 and 0.3142 on A2 (averaged over 10 active classes). We report reproducibility across runs, per-class error patterns, and the effect of cascade calibration on the long-tailed A2 label space.

AI.tldr: SZED 团队参加 ArGuard 2026 Track A 阿拉伯语仇恨模因检测：A1 二分类用 MARBERTv2+CLIP ViT-L/14 融合（拼接/自注意力/集成头三种方案对比），A2 细粒度多标签用多任务标签注意力架构（每类查询向量+级联校准辅助头）。A1 macro-F1=0.7597，A2 十类平均 macro-F1=0.3142。
AI.motivation: 针对阿拉伯语仇恨模因这一低资源、多模态且标签长尾的任务，需同时解决二分类判定与细粒度多标签标注，并考察不同模态融合方式与级联校准对长尾标签空间的作用。
AI.method: A1：融合 MARBERTv2 文本嵌入与 CLIP ViT-L/14 视觉嵌入，比较拼接、自注意力头、集成头三种融合策略。A2：多任务标签注意力架构，采用逐类查询向量建模标签，并增设辅助头进行级联校准。
AI.result: A1 macro-F1=0.7597；A2 在 10 个活跃类别上平均 macro-F1=0.3142。文中报告了多次运行的可复现性、逐类错误模式以及级联校准对长尾 A2 标签空间的影响。
AI.conclusion: 多模态融合在二分类上取得较强性能，而细粒度多标签仍是难点；级联校准与逐类分析为长尾标签建模提供了可复现的基线参考，但 A2 绝对性能仍有较大提升空间。

title: MIMOS-Tools: An Integrated Toolchain for Model-Based Design of Embedded Systems
summary:
Despite decades of progress in model-based methods and tools for embedded real-time systems, there is still no integrated environment that supports the entire development lifecycle.
