This paper presents MIMOS-Tools, a comprehensive toolchain spanning the key phases of development, including modeling, simulation, formal verification, real-time scheduling, schedulability and end-to-end latency analysis, and code generation for heterogeneous multicore platforms. All phases are grounded in a single, coherent, and deterministic model of computation, the MIMOS model, for which we present a formal operational semantics and establish both functional and timing determinism. This semantic foundation ensures that properties verified at the model level are preserved throughout the development process and in the generated implementation.
  A distinguishing feature of MIMOS-Tools is its support for not only deterministic but also modular, compositional design. Unlike synchronous design environments such as SCADE and Simulink, which rely on a global base clock and offline static scheduling, MIMOS-Tools supports time-triggered asynchronous communication together with flexible real-time scheduling of computation. This removes the tight global coupling of the synchronous paradigm: components can be added, modified, or updated without recomputing a system-wide schedule, enabling scalable and incremental design and dynamic updates throughout the system lifecycle. However, MIMOS-Tools also supports Simulink models when the deadlines of tasks are set to zero to emulate the zero-time semantics of synchronous design.
  The toolchain is available at uu-mimos.github.io.

AI.tldr: MIMOS-Tools 是一个基于统一 MIMOS 计算模型的嵌入式实时系统全生命周期工具链，支持建模、仿真、形式验证、实时调度与异构多核代码生成，并具有功能与时序确定性及模块化组合设计能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于模型的方法与工具发展数十年，嵌入式实时系统领域仍缺乏覆盖整个开发生命周期的集成环境；且现有同步设计环境（如 SCADE、Simulink）依赖全局基准时钟与离线静态调度，导致组件间强耦合，难以支持增量设计与动态更新。
AI.method: 提出 MIMOS-Tools 工具链，全部阶段建立在单一、连贯、确定性的 MIMOS 计算模型之上；为该模型给出形式化操作语义，并证明功能确定性与时序确定性；支持时间触发的异步通信与灵活实时调度；当任务截止期设为零时可兼容 Simulink 模型的零时间同步语义。
AI.result: 工具链涵盖建模、仿真、形式验证、实时调度、可调度性与端到端延迟分析，以及面向异构多核平台的代码生成；语义基础保证模型级验证的性质在开发全过程及生成实现中得以保持；模块化设计使组件增改无需重算全局调度，支持可扩展的增量设计与生命周期内动态更新。
AI.conclusion: MIMOS-Tools 提供了首个以确定性、模块化、可组合计算模型为统一语义基础的全生命周期集成环境，在保持同步设计可验证性的同时解除了全局时钟耦合；工具链已公开于 uu-mimos.github.io。

title: REST: Reliability-Guided Spatial Transcriptomics Supervision for Gene Expression Prediction from Histopathological HE-Stained Images
summary: Histopathology is central to cancer diagnosis, but morphology in Hematoxylin and Eosin (HE)-stained images does not directly reveal the molecular states that characterize disease heterogeneity and inform tumor characterization, prognostic assessment, and biomarker discovery. Spatial Transcriptomics (ST) measures spatially resolved gene expression, providing molecular information within tissue architecture, yet differences in assay coverage and spot informativeness make paired HE--ST observations unequally reliable for representation learning. We propose Reliability-Guided Spatial Transcriptomics (REST) supervision with Biological Program Bank (BPB), a program-structured and reliability-guided ST-supervised training framework for predicting molecular information from H\&E images. REST constructs BPB from curated signature, pathway, and cell-type gene sets to provide a shared structure for ST encoding, reliability estimation, and molecular reconstruction. Guided by BPB, Spot-Reliability Contrastive Alignment (SRCA) measures the reliability of each spot from assay-level program coverage and spot-level activity dispersion, and reweights HE--ST alignment accordingly. Biology-Informed Program Reconstruction (BIPR) further uses learnable program queries to reconstruct member-gene expression from histological morphology. REST's training corpus comprised 209 samples (407,475 spots across 16 organs); evaluation used 70 disjoint samples (230,056 spots across eight organs) for gene-expression, pathway-activity, and cell-signature prediction. REST achieved the highest Macro correlation among state-of-the-art ST-supervised training methods and outperformed existing pathology foundation models. Code is available at https://github.com/lanfz2000/REST.

AI.tldr: 提出REST框架，由生物程序库(BPB)引导，从HE图像预测空间转录组分子信息，通过斑点可靠性加权重对齐并重建基因表达，在16器官训练、8器官评估中Macro相关性最优。
AI.motivation: HE染色形态学无法直接反映疾病异质性的分子状态；空间转录组(ST)可提供空间分辨的基因表达，但不同检测覆盖度与斑点信息量差异导致配对HE-ST观测用于表征学习时可靠性不均。
AI.method: REST构建生物程序库(BPB)，整合特征基因集、通路与细胞类型基因集，为ST编码、可靠性估计与分子重建提供共享结构；斑点可靠性对比对齐(SRCA)基于检测级程序覆盖度和斑点级活性离散度评估可靠性并加权HE-ST对齐；生物信息引导程序重建(BIPR)用可学习程序查询从形态重建成员基因表达。
AI.result: 训练集209样本(16器官407,475斑点)，评估70个不相交样本(8器官230,056斑点)用于基因表达、通路活性与细胞特征预测；REST在先进ST监督方法中取得最高Macro相关性，并优于现有病理基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 程序结构化且可靠性引导的ST监督可有效从HE图像预测分子信息，缓解配对观测可靠性不均问题，代码已开源。

title: Does Multi-Agent Collaboration Reduce Hallucination in Clinical Tasks?
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems improve performance on clinical tasks, and that improvement is often read as evidence of a more trustworthy system. However, the two are not the same claim. A clinician acts on the stated reasoning and not only on the conclusion, so whether collaboration reduces hallucination, and what decides when it does, has to be measured in the reasoning too. Yet most evaluations score only the final answer. We evaluate four systems (a single-LLM baseline and three multi-agent topologies) across four models and three clinical tasks, scoring hallucination, under a factuality and faithfulness taxonomy, inside the rationale each system generates and reporting it alongside the task metric. We report that collaboration buys task performance but not lower hallucination as a rule, and no topology is reliably better than another. The effect differs by model: of the $36$ model--system--task comparisons, $12$ are large enough to resolve --- four decreases and eight increases, with no model on both sides. What sets the level, and the direction of any change, is the model rather than the topology or the number of agents. A self-correction experiment is consistent with this: shown its own flagged errors, every model except Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct reduces hallucination; the one model for which collaboration lowers hallucination gains the most, and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, the model whose hallucination it amplifies most, does not reduce its hallucination at all. We find that collaboration redistributes what its models can already do; it does not supply what they cannot.

AI.tldr: 多智能体协作提升临床任务表现，但并不必然降低推理中的幻觉；决定幻觉水平与变化方向的是底层模型本身，而非拓扑结构或智能体数量。
AI.motivation: 临床决策依赖推理过程而不仅是结论，但现有评估大多只打分最终答案，因此"性能提升=更可信"的推断缺乏依据。作者需要在推理文本内部测量幻觉，检验协作是否真正降低幻觉，以及是什么因素决定这一点。
AI.method: 构建包含1个单LLM基线加3种多智能体拓扑的4套系统，覆盖4个模型与3个临床任务；基于事实性与忠实性分类法，对每个系统生成的理由（rationale）内部打分幻觉，并与任务指标并列报告；另做自校正实验（向模型展示其被标记的错误）。
AI.result: 协作能买到任务性能，但不能普遍降低幻觉，且没有任何拓扑稳定占优。36个模型–系统–任务比较中仅12个可判别（4降8升），无模型同时出现在两侧。层级与变化方向由模型而非拓扑或智能体数量决定。自校正实验中除Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct外所有模型都能减少幻觉；协作降幻觉最多的模型收益最大，而Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct（协作放大其幻觉最多）完全无法自我减少幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 协作只是重新分配模型已有的能力，不能提供它本不具备的能力；评估多智能体临床系统时必须在推理层面度量幻觉，而不能以任务指标替代。

title: ECHO: Efficient Cascade with Homogeneous Operators for Distillation-Guided 100K-Sequence Modeling
summary: Modeling lifetime user behavior sequences is essential for capturing long-range preferences in industrial recommendation, yet 100K-length user sequences make target-aware ranking prohibitively expensive. Search-based methods that retrieve from raw sequences incur candidate-dependent costs that grow with sequence length, whereas latent compression methods reduce computation at the expense of item-level addressability. We propose ECHO (Efficient Cascade with Homogeneous Operators), a framework that balances efficiency and fine-grained retrieval by retaining a subset of original event records per user via a Distilled Selector (DS) and retrieving a smaller set of target-relevant records per candidate via a Target-aware Fine-grained Retriever (TFR). DS is supervised by a candidate-aware full-history teacher via per-target distillation, enabling target-aware user-level selection without incurring full-history computation for every candidate. The retriever and target-attention scorer share the teacher's learned relevance parameters, ensuring consistent relevance estimation across the cascade. At a sequence length of L = 100K, ECHO reduces online sequence-branch FLOPs by approximately 160x compared with a representative end-to-end model. Three deployment optimizations, including common user inputs, compact record encoding, and key-side projection absorption, further reduce memory, storage, and data-movement overhead. Experiments on KuaiRand-1K and an industrial-scale short-video platform demonstrate relative GAUC improvements of 0.113%-1.520% over state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines across multiple tasks. Furthermore, online A/B testing shows a 0.613% improvement in app usage time.

AI.tldr: ECHO 通过"蒸馏选择器+目标感知细粒度检索器"的级联框架，在 100K 长度用户行为序列上兼顾效率与item级可寻址性，在线FLOPs降低约160x，并取得GAUC与A/B正收益。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐需建模超长（100K）用户行为序列以捕捉长程偏好，但目标感知排序计算代价过高：基于检索的方法成本随序列长度与候选数增长；隐式压缩方法虽省算力却牺牲item级可寻址性。
AI.method: 提出 ECHO 级联框架：Distilled Selector（DS）为每个用户保留原始事件记录子集，并由候选感知的全历史教师模型通过逐目标蒸馏监督，实现无需对每个候选做全历史计算的目标感知用户级选择；Target-aware Fine-grained Retriever（TFR）为每个候选再检索更小的目标相关记录集。检索器与目标注意力打分层共享教师学到的相关性参数，保证级联中相关性估计一致。另有三项部署优化：公共用户输入、紧凑记录编码、key侧投影吸收，降低内存、存储与数据搬移开销。
AI.result: 在L=100K时在线序列分支FLOPs相比代表性端到端模型降低约160x；在KuaiRand-1K与工业级短视频平台上，多任务相对GAUC提升0.113%–1.520%；在线A/B测试应用使用时长提升0.613%。
AI.conclusion: 通过"候选无关的蒸馏用户级选择+候选相关的细粒度检索"两级级联并共享相关性参数，ECHO 在超长序列下实现了效率与细粒度检索的平衡，且具备实际工业部署价值。

title: Exploration via Activation-Space Steering for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model by sampling responses, scoring them with an automatic verifier, and updating the policy from the resulting rewards. The policy therefore receives direct learning signals only from trajectories that appear in its rollouts. Yet repeated sampling from the same policy can concentrate on similar reasoning paths, leaving useful alternatives unexplored under a fixed rollout budget. We introduce Activation-Space Exploration (ASE), an online method for diversifying training rollouts. By clustering activation differences between correct and incorrect responses to the same problem, ASE builds a structured bank of latent exploration vectors. Different vectors are then applied to subsequent rollouts to explore alternative reasoning paths. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base trained on DAPO-Math-17k, ASE improves average Mean@8 across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks over GRPO by 4.87 and 1.87 percentage points, respectively, under the same rollout budget.

AI.tldr: 提出 ASE（激活空间探索），通过对同一问题正确/错误回答的激活差异进行聚类，构建潜在探索向量库，并在后续 rollout 中施加不同向量以增加推理路径多样性，在同等 rollout 预算下提升 RLVR 数学推理性能。
AI.motivation: RLVR 仅从实际采样到的轨迹获得学习信号，而同一策略的重复采样易集中于相似推理路径，固定 rollout 预算下有用替代方案未被探索。
AI.method: 一种在线 rollout 多样化方法：对同一问题下正确与错误回答之间的激活差异进行聚类，构建结构化的潜在探索向量库；随后在后续 rollout 中施加不同向量，引导探索不同推理路径。
AI.result: 在 DAPO-Math-17k 上训练 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 与 Qwen3-8B-Base，同等 rollout 预算下，六个数学推理基准的平均 Mean@8 相比 GRPO 分别提升 4.87 和 1.87 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在激活空间中进行结构化探索可有效提升 rollout 多样性与 RLVR 训练效果，且无需额外采样预算。

title: Sharp Degree Bounds for Putinar Certificates in Terms of the Positivity Margin via Analytic Sums of Squares
summary: We establish sharp degree bounds for Putinar sum-of-squares (SOS) certificates in terms of the positivity margin $δ$. For any fixed Archimedean quadratic module with prescribed generators and any fixed bound on the degree of the objective, we prove a uniform certificate-degree upper bound of $O(δ^{-1/2}\log^2(2/δ))$ for normalized polynomial objectives. We show that this bound is sharp by constructing a matching lower-bound example in three variables, thereby establishing that the dependence on $δ$ is optimal. These matching bounds also yield sharp worst-case convergence rates for the Lasserre hierarchy.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了 Putinar SOS 证书度数关于正性裕度 δ 的尖锐上下界：上界 O(δ^{-1/2}log^2(2/δ))，并用三变量反例证明其最优，从而得到 Lasserre 层级的尖锐最坏收敛速率。
AI.motivation: Putinar 表示定理保证正多项式存在 SOS 证书，但证书度数如何依赖正性裕度 δ 此前缺乏刻划，尤其在固定 Archimedean 二次模与目标次数时是否可一致控制未知。
AI.method: 在固定 Archimedean 二次模（预设生成元）与固定目标次数的设定下，对归一化多项式目标建立一致的证书度数上界估计；并通过三变量构造匹配的下界反例。
AI.result: 证明上界为 O(δ^{-1/2}log^2(2/δ))；三变量实例给出与之匹配的下界，说明对 δ 的依赖是最优的；并由此导出 Lasserre 层级的最坏情形收敛速率。
AI.conclusion: Putinar SOS 证书对 δ 的依赖已完全刻划为 δ^{-1/2}（对数因子），上下界匹配且最优，同时给出 Lasserre 松弛收敛速率的尖锐保证。

title: Raise or Check? Predicting the Necessity of Additional Fuzzing for Continuous Fuzzing
summary: Continuous fuzzing is used for vulnerability detection in Open Source Software (OSS). Large-scale services such as Google's OSS-Fuzz fuzz over 1,300 projects and have revealed more than 10,000 vulnerabilities. Despite this, a considerable time lag often exists between when a vulnerability is introduced and when it is detected (i.e., the window of exposure). Given the computational cost of additional fuzzing, we aim to allocate fuzzing resources efficiently using vulnerability-risk estimates. We propose RAISE (Risk-Aware Intensive Supplemental Execution Framework), a Just-In-Time (JIT) framework that prioritizes additional fuzzing for high-risk project-days. RAISE performs binary classification at the project-day granularity to estimate whether a vulnerability is introduced on a given day. We construct a dataset combining vulnerability-introducing commits from the OSV database with daily coverage and change metrics from OSS-Fuzz, covering 15 C/C++ projects and 15,210 project-days, of which 347 (2.28%) are vulnerability-introducing. In a cross-project validation setting, our best model, a Random Forest combining VCCFinder-based static features with dynamic fuzzing features, achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.74, substantially outperforming a random baseline; coverage metrics, led by PatchCoverage, are the most important features. In a simulation over 968 vulnerabilities comparing five allocation strategies, Simple-Regression was significantly more cost-efficient than the prediction-agnostic heuristics, spending 91.60 additional fuzzing sessions per detected vulnerability, roughly half the cost of the Median heuristic (171.89). RAISE shows that JIT vulnerability prediction with coverage-aware fuzzing features can effectively guide risk-aware allocation of continuous fuzzing resources.

AI.tldr: RAISE是一个即时（JIT）框架，用项目-日粒度的二分类预测某天是否引入漏洞，从而把额外模糊测试资源优先分配给高风险项目-日，以降低单位漏洞检测成本。
AI.motivation: 大规模持续模糊测试（如OSS-Fuzz）虽已发现上万漏洞，但漏洞从引入到被检测存在较长暴露窗口；而追加模糊测试计算代价高昂，因此需要基于漏洞风险估计来高效分配测试资源。
AI.method: 构建数据集：将OSV数据库中引入漏洞的提交与OSS-Fuzz的每日覆盖率及变更指标结合，覆盖15个C/C++项目、15,210个项目-日（其中347个，2.28%为漏洞引入日）。在项目-日粒度做二分类，特征包括基于VCCFinder的静态特征与动态模糊测试特征；采用跨项目验证，并用968个漏洞的模拟比较五种资源分配策略。
AI.result: 跨项目验证中，结合静态与动态特征的最佳模型（随机森林）ROC-AUC达0.74，显著优于随机基线；覆盖率指标（尤以PatchCoverage为首）最重要。模拟中Simple-Regression策略显著更具成本效益，平均每个检出漏洞花费91.60次额外模糊测试会话，约为Median启发式（171.89）的一半。
AI.conclusion: 结合覆盖率感知模糊测试特征的JIT漏洞预测能有效指导持续模糊测试资源的风险感知分配。

title: Long-wave Infrared Polarimetric Remote Sensing Image Fusion for Vehicle Detection
summary: Blurred vehicle contours and low contrast limit detection performance in infrared remote sensing imagery, while existing fusion methods may introduce polarization noise and fail to integrate complementary information effectively. To address these limitations, we propose a Mamba-based infrared polarimetric remote sensing image fusion model. Infrared polarization information reflects surface material properties and geometry, providing complementary information to infrared intensity. The proposed method first combines long-wave infrared total intensity S0 and the degree of linear polarization (DoLP), using a physics-inspired polarization-response proxy and spatial structural continuity to extract guidance features. It then employs bidirectional state space scanning along horizontal, vertical, and both diagonal orientations to enable cross-modal feature fusion across the entire image. Prior-guided multi-window structural similarity, reconstruction constraints, and a relative lower-bound loss for polarization saliency are jointly introduced to suppress noise while preserving global background structures and target polarization features. In addition, we construct AIR-LWIR-Pol, a dataset of 1,901 accurately registered image pairs acquired using an airborne division-of-aperture long-wave infrared polarimetric imaging system, and evaluate downstream vehicle detection using YOLO11. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms the comparison methods on four fusion metrics, including entropy and structural similarity. Vehicle detection mAP50 and mAP50-95 reach 55.0% and 29.4%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining physical priors with state space modeling for long-wave infrared polarization image fusion and support its use for target detection in complex remote sensing scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Mamba的长波红外偏振遥感图像融合模型，结合物理先验与双向状态空间扫描融合强度S0与DoLP，并构建AIR-LWIR-Pol数据集，融合指标与车辆检测性能均优于对比方法。
AI.motivation: 红外遥感图像中车辆轮廓模糊、对比度低，限制检测性能；现有融合方法易引入偏振噪声且未能有效整合互补信息。
AI.method: 利用红外偏振信息反映材质与几何特性的互补性，先将S0与DoLP通过物理启发的偏振响应代理与空间结构连续性提取引导特征；采用水平、垂直及双向对角共四个方向的双向状态空间扫描实现全图跨模态融合；联合引入先验引导多窗口结构相似性、重建约束及偏振显著性相对下界损失以抑制噪声并保留背景结构与目标偏振特征；同时构建1,901对精确配准的机载分孔径长波红外偏振数据集AIR-LWIR-Pol，并用YOLO11评估下游车辆检测。
AI.result: 在熵、结构相似性等四项融合指标上均优于对比方法；车辆检测mAP50为55.0%，mAP50-95为29.4%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明物理先验与状态空间建模结合对长波红外偏振图像融合有效，支持其在复杂遥感场景中的目标检测应用。

title: Teaching AI Agent to Play Poker Strategically Through Preference Optimization
summary: A poker agent can make a legal move and still make a strategically poor one. We ask whether compact AI agents can exhibit strategic behavior under hidden information and whether preference optimization can improve beyond static and zero-shot policies. We first evaluate a static baseline and three frozen language models: SmallThinker, Qwen3, and Gemma-3 whose performance varies substantially between exact-game and six-player evaluation. We therefore propose Strategic Preference Optimization with KL-anchored Equilibrium (SPOKE), combining teacher-relative value penalties, policy anchoring, risk constraints, and structured rationale supervision, and compare it with SFT, DPO, GRPO, and GSPO. Across three runs of a SmallThinker-4B-A0.6B policy, SPOKE achieves the lowest mean exploitability in Kuhn (0.213) and Leduc (1.081) and the highest six-max top-1 agreement (0.775), while maintaining teacher KL comparable to SFT (0.522 vs 0.523). These results provide preliminary evidence that strategic preference optimization can improve strategic quality while preserving teacher-consistent behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SPOKE（带KL锚定均衡的策略偏好优化），在隐藏信息扑克环境中让紧凑语言模型智能体展现更优策略行为，在Kuhn/Leduc可利用度和六人桌一致率上优于SFT、DPO、GRPO、GSPO。
AI.motivation: 合法动作不等于策略上合理：现有紧凑AI智能体在隐藏信息博弈中缺乏策略性，静态与零样本策略表现有限，且不同模型在精确博弈与六人桌评测间波动大，需要能提升策略质量又能保持教师一致性的偏好优化方法。
AI.method: 先评测静态基线与三个冻结语言模型（SmallThinker、Qwen3、Gemma-3）；提出SPOKE，将教师相对价值惩罚、策略锚定、风险约束与结构化理由监督结合，并与SFT、DPO、GRPO、GSPO对比；用SmallThinker-4B-A0.6B策略运行三次。
AI.result: SPOKE取得最低平均可利用度：Kuhn 0.213、Leduc 1.081；六人桌top-1一致率最高0.775；教师KL与SFT相当（0.522 vs 0.523）。
AI.conclusion: 初步证据表明策略偏好优化可在保持教师一致行为的同时提升策略质量；但证据有限，仅限扑克小型博弈与单一策略模型。

title: EGiME: Entropy-Guided Model Evaluation in Few-Shot Learning
summary: The feature-extraction quality of pre-trained models sets the ceiling of downstream transfer learning, yet few-shot model selection remains difficult: supervised evaluation on scarce labels is unstable and yields fluctuating rankings. We propose Entropy-Guided Model Evaluation (EGiME), a semi-supervised criterion that assesses a candidate model from the clustering structure of its feature space without any classifier training. EGiME performs $K$-means clustering over all labeled and unlabeled samples, then combines two entropy terms: an inter-cluster entropy measuring global separability, and an intra-cluster entropy measuring the compactness of labeled anchors, fused through an inverse-frequency weight that emphasizes small clusters. On five few-shot benchmarks and nine pre-trained models, EGiME achieves a correlation score of 0.966 with the full-pool ground-truth accuracy obtained by averaging the accuracies of K-means, KNN, and SVM. At labeling ratios of 4\%--20\%, it produces markedly more stable model rankings than cross-validated supervised baselines, establishing it as a practical alternative to conventional supervised evaluation for pre-trained model selection under data scarcity.

AI.tldr: 提出无监督式半监督准则 EGiME，用特征空间聚类结构的两个熵项评估预训练模型，在少样本场景下与全量真值准确率相关系数达 0.966，排名比交叉验证基线更稳定。
AI.motivation: 预训练模型的特征提取质量决定下游迁移学习上限，但少样本下模型选择困难：监督评估在稀缺标签上不稳定，模型排名波动大。
AI.method: EGiME 对全部有标签和无标签样本做 K-means 聚类，无需训练分类器；结合两个熵项：衡量全局可分性的簇间熵和衡量有标签锚点紧凑度的簇内熵，并通过逆频率权重强调小簇进行融合。
AI.result: 在 5 个少样本基准、9 个预训练模型上，EGiME 与全池真值准确率（K-means、KNN、SVM 三者平均）的相关系数为 0.966；在 4%–20% 标注比例下，模型排名显著比交叉验证监督基线更稳定。
AI.conclusion: EGiME 可作为数据稀缺条件下预训练模型选择的实用替代方案，取代传统监督评估。

title: Think Before You Transcribe: Context-Steered Reasoning for Hotword-Aware Speech Recognition
summary: Contextual automatic speech recognition (ASR) improves rare-entity recognition by supplying candidate hotwords, but retrieved candidates may be incomplete or incorrect. A reliable system must therefore exploit a relevant candidate without allowing unsupported alternatives to override the acoustic evidence. We propose a context-steered reasoning framework that generates a short, audio-grounded caption before transcription. This task-specific representation lets the model assess candidate relevance before making a lexical decision. Supervised fine-tuning establishes the structured caption-to-transcription behavior, while targeted trajectory injection strengthens group relative policy optimization when difficult utterances yield only unsuccessful rollouts. Experiments across diverse context conditions show that the proposed method consistently improves both transcription quality and hotword recognition while remaining robust to irrelevant candidates.

AI.tldr: 提出"上下文引导推理"框架：先根据音频生成简短、有音频依据的描述（caption），再做转写，使模型在做出词级决策前先评估候选项相关性；用SFT建立caption→转写行为，并用定向轨迹注入强化GRPO。
AI.motivation: 上下文ASR通过提供热词候选项提升罕见实体识别，但检索到的候选项可能不完整或错误。系统需既能利用相关候选项，又不能让其覆盖声学证据。
AI.method: 先生成短的、audio-grounded caption再转写；监督微调建立结构化的caption-to-transcription行为；针对困难utterance仅有失败rollout时，用targeted trajectory injection增强group relative policy optimization（GRPO）。
AI.result: 在多种上下文条件下实验，转写质量与热词识别均一致提升，且对无关候选项保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 以音频依据的中间表示为桥梁可有效判别候选项相关性，结合SFT与改进的GRPO训练，实现更可靠的上下文ASR。

title: From Tokens to Files: Multi-Granularity Detection and Localization of AI-Involved Code
summary: The increasing use of large language models for code generation calls for methods that distinguish purely human-written code from AI-involved code: files in which any part, however small, was generated or substantially modified by a model. Beyond flagging such files, we aim to localize the lines or blocks attributable to AI. Existing approaches compress a file into a single score, from surface stylistic features or a global code representation, which averages away the evidence when only a few blocks are AI-involved. We propose a framework that models AI authorship at the token level and predicts at the line, block, and file levels. A frozen code language model is equipped with two low-rank adapters, trained separately on machine-written and human-written files; their per-token log-likelihood ratio provides local evidence of AI authorship. Lightweight heads aggregate this evidence within lines and blocks, using the surrounding code context, and their local predictions are aggregated into a file-level decision. We train on mixed-authorship files built from human originals and their AI-generated or AI-modified counterparts, including continuation and fill-in-the-middle scenarios. On an internal test set of 11,773 AI-involved files across six generation regimes against 2,541 human files, our method reaches 72.4 macro F1 at a 1% FPR operating point. With no adaptation, it reaches 62.5 line-level F1 on HybridCodeAuthorship, an external human-AI co-writing benchmark with no training split, above the 56 its own paper reports as the best line-level result. On 19,445 human-written files from repositories created before 2022, the false-positive rate stays between 0.55% and 0.81% under the transported 1% threshold, so the operating point holds on real human code.

AI.tldr: 提出token级AI代码溯源框架，用双LoRA适配器的似然比提供局部证据，聚合成行/块/文件级判定，混合作者数据训练，宏F1达72.4，外部基准行级F1 62.5超原论文。
AI.motivation: 大模型生成代码日益普遍，需要区分纯人类代码与含AI参与（哪怕极小部分）的文件，并进一步定位AI生成的代码行或块。现有方法将整文件压缩为单一分数（基于表层风格或全局代码表示），当仅少数块由AI参与时证据被平均稀释。
AI.method: token级建模AI作者性，并在行、块、文件三级预测。冻结代码语言模型上挂载两个低秩适配器，分别在人写与机器写文件上训练，其逐token对数似然比作为AI作者的局部证据；轻量预测头结合上下文在行/块内聚合证据，再将局部预测汇总为文件级决策。训练数据由人类原始文件与其AI生成/AI修改版本构成混合作者文件，涵盖续写与fill-in-the-middle场景。
AI.result: 内部测试集含6种生成机制下11,773个AI参与文件与2,541个人类文件，在1% FPR下宏F1达72.4。无适配时在HybridCodeAuthorship（无训练集的人机共写外部基准）上取得62.5行级F1，超过其论文报告的56最佳结果。在2022年前创建仓库的19,445个人写文件上，迁移1%阈值后假阳性率为0.55%–0.81%，说明操作点对真实人类代码稳健。
AI.conclusion: token级局部证据建模有效克服全局压缩的稀释问题，实现精确的文件判别与细粒度定位，且具备良好的跨数据集与真实代码泛化性。

title: Robustness of Internal Signals for Hallucination Detection in Vision-Language Models
summary: When given an image and a text prompt, vision-language models (VLMs) can produce seemingly sophisticated text responses. However, they are also prone to hallucinate objects in their output, which can have detrimental consequences in safety-critical applications. To detect these hallucinations, certain methods interestingly leverage internal signals from the VLM as it generates the text response; potentially, these methods use the same signals that led to a hallucination to detect it. We conduct an in-depth analysis to understand the robustness of these detection methods. First, we show that a naive baseline of a generated word's token position in the VLM text response achieves competitive performance. Further, we reveal how some detection methods rely on token position and use this heuristic as a shortcut. Second, we explore detection methods' sensitivity to language and vision modalities. Our experiments suggest that strong detection performance is often driven by detecting language-based hallucinations, and when methods rely on token position, they tend to be less visually grounded and exhibit reduced robustness when hallucinations occur earlier in a text response. Lastly, we demonstrate that different detection methods can carry complementary signals; when ensembling methods together, adding weaker methods to an ensemble of higher performing ones still offers performance improvements. Altogether, while there may be useful internal VLM signals to detect hallucinations, our investigation reveals important limitations of the current methods that try to leverage them.

AI.tldr: 本文深入分析了基于VLM内部信号检测幻觉方法的鲁棒性，发现这些方法严重依赖token位置这一捷径，主要检测语言层面的幻觉，并提出集成互补信号可提升性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在图像-文本任务中易产生物体幻觉，在安全关键场景中危害严重。现有利用VLM生成文本时内部信号来检测幻觉的方法，可能存在理论缺陷——即用导致幻觉的同一信号去检测幻觉。作者希望系统评估这些检测方法的鲁棒性，揭示其潜在局限。
AI.method: 作者进行了深入分析实验：1）构建"生成词的token位置"这一朴素基线，并与现有检测方法对比；2）分析各检测方法是否依赖token位置作为捷径；3）通过操控语言/视觉模态，考察方法对两种模态的敏感性；4）测试幻觉出现在文本较早位置时的鲁棒性；5）尝试将不同检测方法集成，验证信号互补性。
AI.result: 1）朴素token位置基线达到与现有方法相当的性能；2）部分检测方法确实依赖token位置，把其当作捷径；3）强检测性能多源于检测语言层面幻觉，而依赖token位置的方法视觉根基较弱、对早期幻觉鲁棒性下降；4）不同方法携带互补信号，即使把较弱方法加入高性能方法集成中，仍能带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: VLM内部信号虽可能有助于检测幻觉，但当前利用这些信号的方法存在重要局限：依赖token位置捷径、偏重语言模态、视觉根基不足。未来需要更真正视觉根基化、鲁棒性更强的幻觉检测方法，并可通过多方法集成利用互补信号。

title: M-Plan: Comprehensive Planning For LLM Agents with Memory Arrangement
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have recently demonstrated outstanding performance in single-turn tasks, yet they continue to struggle with long-horizon tasks, particularly in environments without prior training. A key limitation of single LLMs is their difficulty in processing long contexts, which stems from weaknesses in continuous decision-making and reasoning capabilities. Although existing multi-agent systems (MAS) equipped with long-term memory bases can partially address this gap, they mostly rely on knowledge reuse or summarization, an approach that is often constrained by directly retrieval without any adaptation for the current task, while the retrieved memory may contain much history noises waiting to be preprocessed. In contrast, MAS characterized by task-specific guidance often lack long-term memory specifically designed for the guidance. To address these challenges, we propose M-Plan, a closed-loop MAS framework that integrates long-term and short-term memory. By combining global-local and past-current guidance, M-Plan enhances agents' performance on multi-turn tasks while maintaining a plug-and-play design. During task execution, agents receive task-specific milestones and insights, and are provided with local hints only when confusion arises, which form global-local guidance together. These guidance generation and utilization construct the short-term memory as well. After task completion, relevant information about the current task is optimized or reorganized before being sent to the long-term memory storage for future retrieval. The designments mentioned above build a comprehensive framework different from other individual long-term or short-term memory works. Extensive experiments on multi-turn tasks including ALFWorld, Webshop, and PDDL across diverse models demonstrate that M-Plan outperforms multiple baseline methods in both accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出M-Plan，一种融合长期与短期记忆的闭环多智能体框架，通过全局-局部与过去-当前双重引导提升LLM智能体在多轮长程任务上的表现，且保持即插即用。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体在单轮任务上表现优异，但在长程任务尤其是无先验训练环境中表现不佳，根源是单LLM难以处理长上下文，缺乏持续的决策与推理能力。现有带长期记忆的多智能体系统多依赖知识复用或摘要，检索缺乏针对当前任务的自适应且含历史噪声；而任务特定引导的MAS又缺少专门设计的长期记忆。
AI.method: 设计闭环MAS框架M-Plan，整合长期与短期记忆。执行中智能体获得任务特定的里程碑与洞见，仅在困惑时提供局部提示，形成全局-局部引导；这些引导的生成与使用构成短期记忆。任务完成后，将当前任务相关信息优化或重组后存入长期记忆，供未来检索。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、Webshop、PDDL等多轮任务上，跨多种模型进行大量实验，M-Plan在准确率与效率上均优于多个基线方法。
AI.conclusion: M-Plan通过融合长期与短期记忆、结合全局-局部和过去-当前引导，构建了区别于单一长期或短期记忆工作的综合框架，有效提升多轮任务性能并保持即插即用。

title: Hilbert-Scale Stability of Posterior Diffusion Priors for Ill-Posed Signal Recovery
summary: Indirect and noisy observations are difficult to invert when the forward operator smooths out the unknown signal. In this case, the unstable modes are precisely the modes that the data reveals least, thus the success of any reconstruction method depends on how prior information interacts with the geometry of the operator across regularity scales. Diffusion priors have become ubiquitous for such problems; however, the current theory still does not determine when a learned score remains informative under ill-posed forward operators. In this paper, we study posterior diffusion for linear inverse problems on Hilbert scales and derive a stability theory under an explicit score-amplification condition. Under a smoothing condition on the forward map, a source condition on the truth, and weak-norm control of score error, we derive non-asymptotic recovery bounds in \(\Hs^s\) that separate observation noise, score approximation, and reverse-time discretization. These bounds give a recoverable regularity threshold determined jointly by operator smoothing, truth regularity, score regularity, and the posterior correction. The threshold specifies the Hilbert-scale norms \(\Hs^s\) in which weak-norm score error remains controlled after propagation through the posterior reverse dynamics. For larger regularity indices \(s\), the inverse geometry magnifies the same error, and the Hilbert-scale recovery estimate no longer gives uniform stability. We also prove that a posterior correction adapted to the forward operator improves stability relative to isotropic guidance in the regularity ranges where the smoothing action of the forward map matters most. The recovery estimates give a regularity-sensitive theory of posterior diffusion and show how learned score error, operator smoothing, and reconstruction norm jointly determine the stable range predicted by the analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文在Hilbert尺度上研究线性反问题的后验扩散（posterior diffusion），在显式的score放大条件下建立稳定性理论，给出分离观测噪声、score逼近误差与反时间离散误差的非渐近恢复界，并确定可恢复的正则性阈值。
AI.motivation: 当正向算子平滑未知信号时，最不稳定的模态恰是数据揭示最少的模态，重建成败取决于先验信息如何与算子在各正则性尺度上的几何结构相互作用。扩散先验虽已广泛使用，但现有理论尚不能判定学习到的score在病态正向算子下何时仍具信息量。
AI.method: 在Hilbert尺度上分析线性反问题的后验扩散；引入显式的score放大条件、正向映射的平滑条件、真值的源条件以及score误差的弱范数控制，据此推导Hs^s中的非渐近恢复界。
AI.result: 得到可恢复正则性阈值，它由算子平滑度、真值正则性、score正则性与后验校正共同决定，界分离了观测噪声、score逼近与反时间离散化三类误差；对更大的正则性指标s，反问题几何会放大同一误差，Hilbert尺度估计不再给出均匀稳定性；并证明与前向算子相适应的后验校正相比各向同性引导在平滑作用最显著的区间内提升稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了对正则性敏感的后验扩散理论，说明学习score误差、算子平滑与重建范数如何共同决定分析所预测的稳定范围。

title: TRACE: Training-aware Robustness and Challenge Evaluation for Text-Vision Embedding Models
summary: Existing benchmarks for text-vision embedding models report aggregate scores that obscure whether performance comes from general capabilities, task-specific adaptation, or robustness to challenging tasks. We introduce TRACE, a Training-aware Robustness and Challenge Evaluation framework that reorganizes 168 tasks from various sources of datasets into three categories: General, Adaptability, and Challenge. Through controlled experiments on two text-vision embedding models, we show that combining general and adaptation data improves Adaptability performance by 7.67 and 7.09 points, respectively, while largely preserving General performance. However, Challenge performance remains below 5.0, with limited improvements from additional training data. Further analysis identifies multilingual and visual-document tasks as major weaknesses. Our findings demonstrate that data adaptation alone is insufficient to address these challenges, highlighting the need for methodological advances beyond data-centric improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出 TRACE 评测框架，将168个任务分为通用、适应、挑战三类，揭示文本-视觉嵌入模型性能来源及瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有文本-视觉嵌入模型的基准只报告聚合分数，无法区分性能来自通用能力、任务特定适应还是对困难任务的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建 TRACE（训练感知的鲁棒性与挑战评测）框架，将168个任务重组为 General、Adaptability、Challenge 三类；在两个文本-视觉嵌入模型上做控制实验，比较通用数据、适应数据及其组合的训练效果。
AI.result: 通用+适应数据组合使 Adaptability 性能分别提升 7.67 和 7.09 分，且基本保持 General 性能；但 Challenge 性能始终低于 5.0，增加训练数据带来的提升有限。多语言和视觉文档任务为主要短板。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠数据适应不足以解决困难任务，需要超越以数据为中心的改进，推动方法学层面的创新。

title: Hallucinations of Large Language Models in Cross-Language Code Translation: Phenomena and Mitigation
summary: Code translation converts source code from one programming language to another while preserving its functionality. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have improved code translation, their outputs still contain hallucinations: generated code that conflicts with the source program, violates target-language facts, or introduces contextually inconsistent dependencies. These failures are especially harmful in translation because small semantic deviations can silently change program behavior. Existing hallucination studies mainly focus on natural-language generation or code generation, leaving the forms, distribution, and mitigation of hallucinations in cross-language code translation insufficiently characterized. This paper presents a systematic empirical study of LLM hallucinations in code translation. Across three benchmark datasets, six language pairs, and seven LLMs, we construct a taxonomy with three major categories: Semantic Consistency Conflicts, Factual Knowledge Conflicts, and Project Context Deviations. We manually annotate 13,919 hallucination cases and analyze how hallucination types vary across models, datasets, and language directions. Guided by the taxonomy, we further propose HaluCodeTran, a mitigation framework that combines BM25-based retrieval of relevant translation examples with taxonomy-aware reflective refinement. The study provides an execution-tested characterization of code-translation hallucinations and a practical baseline for building more reliable LLM-based code migration tools.

AI.tldr: 本文系统实证研究了LLM代码翻译中的幻觉问题，构建了包含语义一致性冲突、事实知识冲突、项目上下文偏离三大类的分类体系，人工标注13,919个案例，并提出BM25检索+分类感知反思精炼的缓解框架HaluCodeTran。
AI.motivation: LLM代码翻译虽进步明显，但输出仍含幻觉（与源程序冲突、违反目标语言事实、引入上下文不一致依赖），微小语义偏差会静默改变程序行为。现有幻觉研究集中于自然语言生成或代码生成，跨语言代码翻译中幻觉的形式、分布与缓解尚未被充分刻画。
AI.method: 跨3个基准数据集、6种语言对、7个LLM开展实证研究；构建三分类幻觉分类体系（语义一致性冲突、事实知识冲突、项目上下文偏离）；人工标注13,919个幻觉案例并分析其在模型、数据集、翻译方向间的分布差异；提出HaluCodeTran缓解框架，结合BM25检索相关翻译示例与分类感知的反思式精炼。
AI.result: 完成基于执行测试的代码翻译幻觉刻画，给出手工标注的13,919案例及跨模型/数据集/语言方向的幻觉类型分布分析，并以HaluCodeTran作为可实践基线验证缓解效果。
AI.conclusion: 研究为代码翻译幻觉提供了执行验证的系统性刻画与分类体系，并提供实用基线，助力构建更可靠的LLM代码迁移工具。

title: VitronEdit: Universal Visual Editing across Images, Videos, and 3D Scenes
summary: Recent advances in unified visual editing have begun to consolidate image and video editing within a single model, while 3D scene editing remains largely separate and constrained by scarce paired training data. Given the rich image and video editing supervision now available and the common editing semantics shared across modalities, a natural question is whether this knowledge can be transferred to data-scarce 3D editing. We present VitronEdit, a universal framework for image, video, and 3D scene editing. VitronEdit adopts a shared sequence representation and progressive multimodal training to transfer editing knowledge across modalities. We further introduce geometry-aware post-training, which leverages a pretrained geometry reconstruction model to provide depth and camera-pose supervision. Surprisingly, applying geometric supervision only to 3D samples yields the best overall performance, while image and video editing also improve despite receiving no direct geometric supervision, suggesting that geometric regularization transfers through the shared backbone. Our analysis further shows that image and video training mainly transfers editing semantics to 3D, whereas 3D supervision primarily improves multi-view consistency. The project page: https://vitron-llm.github.io/VitronEdit/.

AI.tldr: VitronEdit：统一图像、视频与3D场景编辑的通用框架，通过共享序列表示与渐进式多模态训练迁移编辑知识，并用几何感知后训练（深度与相机位姿监督）提升多视图一致性。
AI.motivation: 3D场景编辑仍与图像/视频编辑割裂，且面临配对训练数据稀缺的问题；而图像与视频编辑监督丰富、编辑语义与3D共通，因此值得探索如何将多模态编辑知识迁移到数据稀缺的3D场景编辑。
AI.method: 采用统一的共享序列表示与渐进式多模态训练实现跨模态编辑知识迁移；并引入几何感知后训练，借助预训练几何重建模型提供深度和相机位姿监督。
AI.result: 令人意外的是，仅对3D样本施加几何监督即可取得最佳整体性能；图像与视频编辑虽未获直接几何监督也同步提升，表明几何正则通过共享骨干网络实现了迁移。进一步分析显示：图像/视频训练主要向3D传递编辑语义，3D监督主要提升多视图一致性。
AI.conclusion: 共享骨干的多模态统一训练可有效缓解3D编辑数据稀缺；几何正则具有跨模态溢出效应，且不同模态监督在语义与一致性上分工明确，为统一视觉编辑提供了新思路。

title: Physical AI: Concepts, Techniques, and Challenges
summary: In recent years, physical artificial intelligence (physical AI) has experienced rapid development, capturing significant attention in academia and industry. However, the field has yet to reach consensus on its definition, technical landscape, and core challenges. To address this gap, this monograph seeks to define physical AI, present its technical landscape, and examine each key technical subfield in depth. In doing so, it establishes a unified framework for Physical AI: artificial systems that perceive, model, and act upon the physical world through continuous feedback under real-world constraints. Further, this monograph distinguishes physical AI from conventional digital AI, embodied AI, cyber-physical systems, and digital twins. It develops the foundations of physical AI across physics, control, cognition, learning, and reasoning. It reviews key methodologies, including multimodal perception, physical data and simulation, world models, embodied foundation models, motor-control systems, multi-agent coordination, and hardware-software co-design. Furthermore, it examines applications spanning robotics, manufacturing, infrastructure, scientific experimentation, and autonomous services. Particular attention is given to sim-to-real transfer, reliability, real-time execution, evaluation, safety, governance, and long-term deployment. By connecting perception, prediction, decision-making, action, and adaptation in a closed loop, this monograph identifies the technical challenges and research directions required to advance from narrow automation toward more generalizable physical AI and, ultimately, physical artificial general intelligence (Physical AGI).

AI.tldr: 该专著对物理人工智能（Physical AI）进行定义与系统梳理，提出统一框架，区分其与数字AI、具身AI、信息物理系统及数字孪生的差异，并综述基础理论、关键技术、应用场景与安全治理，指出迈向Physical AGI的研究方向。
AI.motivation: 物理AI近年发展迅速，但学界与业界对其定义、技术版图与核心挑战尚未形成共识，亟需一个统一的概念框架与技术路线梳理。
AI.method: 采用专著综述形式：给出Physical AI定义（在真实世界约束下通过持续反馈感知、建模并作用于物理世界的人工系统）；从物理、控制、认知、学习、推理五方面构建基础；梳理多模态感知、物理数据与仿真、世界模型、具身基础模型、运动控制系统、多智能体协同、软硬件协同设计等方法；并结合机器人、制造、基础设施、科学实验、自主服务等应用展开分析。
AI.result: 建立了统一的概念框架与分类对照（区别于数字AI、具身AI、CPS、数字孪生），形成覆盖基础理论—关键技术—应用—治理的系统性技术版图，并重点讨论仿真到现实迁移、可靠性、实时性、评测、安全与长期部署等问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过将感知、预测、决策、行动与自适应闭环连接，该专著明确了从窄域自动化走向可泛化物理AI、最终迈向物理通用人工智能（Physical AGI）所需的技术挑战与研究议程。

title: Joint Constraint Aggregation for Qualifier-Sensitive Retrieval-Augmented QA
summary: Retrieval-augmented QA can fail even when the correct answer is in the retrieved evidence. This can happen when a competing answer satisfies some, but not all, of the question's requirements and is mentioned frequently in the retrieved documents, which can make it appear to be the best-supported answer. To test whether this retrieval skew actually affects the decision, we manipulate it directly: increasing the prevalence of passages that favor the competing answer makes the model more likely to select it. This points to a decision problem that candidate-level support alone cannot resolve. We therefore introduce Joint Constraint Aggregation (JCA), which compares candidates against the same question-derived requirements using the retrieved evidence. Across three evaluation settings and three instruction-tuned backbones, JCA improves overall accuracy, and its advantage grows when retrieval favors a competing answer. Together, these results suggest that when partial matches and retrieval prominence pull models toward a competing answer, comparing candidates against the question's full requirements can make selection more reliable.

AI.tldr: 检索增强QA中，若某竞争答案仅满足部分问题条件却因在检索文档中高频出现而被误选；本文将此归因于"决策问题"，提出联合约束聚合（JCA），让候选答案对照同一套由问题导出的要求进行比较。实验表明JCA在三种评测设置和三种指令微调骨干上均提升整体准确率，且在检索偏向竞争答案时优势更明显。
AI.motivation: 检索增强QA常在正确答案已在证据中存在时仍出错：一个只满足部分问题要求的竞争答案因在检索文档中频繁出现而显得"支持度最高"。作者试图验证这种"检索偏斜"是否真正影响模型决策，而非仅是相关性噪声，从而指出单看候选级支持无法解决的决策问题。
AI.method: 采用干预式实验：直接提高支持竞争答案的段落占比（prevalence），观察模型选择是否随之偏移，以此确立因果性。随后提出Joint Constraint Aggregation (JCA)，将候选答案统一对照问题导出的同一组要求，借用检索证据进行聚合比较，而非孤立评估单个候选的支持度。
AI.result: 提高偏向竞争答案的段落占比会使模型更倾向选择该答案，证实检索偏斜影响决策。JCA在三种评测设置与三种指令微调骨干模型上均提升整体准确率，且当检索偏向竞争答案时增益扩大。
AI.conclusion: 当部分匹配与检索显著性共同把模型拉向竞争答案时，将候选答案对照问题的全部要求（而非仅看候选级支持）可使选择更可靠；JCA为此提供了有效且稳健的解决思路。

title: LEAF: LUT-aware Efficient Attention on FPGAs
comment: Accepted for the 9th Workshop on Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences (ML4PS 2026)
summary: We introduce Lookup-table (LUT)-aware Efficient Attention on FPGAs (LEAF). LEAF is the first nanosecond-scale LUT-aware transformer for FPGAs. Deploying transformers that are large enough to perform well, small enough to fit on an FPGA, and fast enough to meet the sub-microsecond timescales required by real-time systems such as those at CERN remains difficult, since the same attention mechanism that gives these models their high expressivity also makes them costly to implement in hardware. LEAF converts the query, key, and value projections and the final output feed-forward layer into FPGA-native layers with LUT-aware training, creating the first LUT-aware transformer and linformer layers built for ultra-low-latency inference. Attention resists LUT-aware training because it multiplies two activations where the method needs a constant weight to tabulate; LEAF tabulates the attention block's constant matrix-vector multiplications and leaves the rest in arithmetic form. On a standard jet tagging benchmark this improves accuracy by 1.8 percentage points while using 2.9 times fewer LUTs than the previous state-of-the-art sub-microsecond transformer at the same input size. Our most efficient LEAF-based linformer with 64 input particles reaches 80.4% classification accuracy at 28k LUTs and 35ns.

AI.tldr: LEAF 提出首个面向 FPGA 的纳秒级 LUT 感知 Transformer，将 attention 中常量矩阵-向量乘法查表化，在相同输入规模下精度提升 1.8 个百分点且 LUT 用量减少 2.9 倍，最简模型 35ns、28k LUT 达 80.4% 分类精度。
AI.motivation: 在 CERN 等实时系统中需要亚微秒级延迟，但 Transformer 的 attention 机制导致硬件实现代价高：模型既要足够大以保证性能，又要足够小以装进 FPGA，还要足够快以满足纳秒级需求，三者难以兼顾。
AI.method: 通过 LUT 感知训练，将 Q/K/V 投影和输出前馈层转换为 FPGA 原生层，构建首个 LUT 感知的 Transformer 与 linformer 层；针对 attention 因两个激活相乘而无法直接查表的问题，仅对 attention 块中的常量矩阵-向量乘法进行查表，其余保持算术形式。
AI.result: 在标准 jet tagging 基准上，精度提升 1.8 个百分点，同时 LUT 用量比此前最优的亚微秒 Transformer 少 2.9 倍（相同输入规模）；最高效的 64 输入粒子 LEAF-linformer 在 28k LUT 下达到 80.4% 精度、35ns 延迟。
AI.conclusion: LEAF 证明了 LUT 感知训练与选择性查表可有效化解 attention 硬件化的难题，实现纳秒级、低资源、高精度的 FPGA Transformer，适用于实时科学探测场景。

title: How to get the best and fairest performance out of your ASR system using activation steering
summary: Activation steering for ASR systems is an underexplored technique in improving both ASR performance and demographic fairness. We investigate two forms of activation steering: paired activation subtraction, and supervised optimization. We find the former to be ineffective at ameliorating ASR performance whatsoever, while the latter is quite effective at deriving steering vectors (SVs) that improve at once overall ASR performance and demographic fairness along such diverse axes as gender, age, and dialect. We also explore what types of data---from the most to the least personal---are necessary for calculating or training SVs. First, we show significant performance in performance from training SVs using an eclectic group of speakers from the same dataset. Furthermore, we find that vectors trained using acoustically similar speakers leads to ASR performances that are competitive or superior to vectors trained on the same speaker, or speakers from the same labeled demographic group. This finding shows that we can harness activation steering for few-shot adaptation given access to a speaker's demography, or zero-shot adaptation to unseen speakers without the need for any labels at all.

AI.tldr: 本文探索激活引导(activation steering)用于提升ASR性能与人口统计公平性，发现监督优化得到的引导向量有效，而配对激活相减无效；且用声学相似说话人训练的向量即可实现少样本/零样本自适应。
AI.motivation: 激活引导在ASR性能提升和人口统计公平性改善方面研究不足，作者希望系统评估不同引导方式的效果，并探究训练/计算引导向量所需的数据类型（从最私密到最不私密）。
AI.method: 比较两种激活引导形式：配对激活相减(paired activation subtraction)与监督优化(supervised optimization)。训练引导向量(SVs)时使用不同数据来源：同一数据集中的多元说话人、声学相似的说话人、同一说话人、以及同标签人口统计群体的说话人。
AI.result: 配对激活相减完全无法改善ASR性能；监督优化能有效导出引导向量，同时提升整体ASR性能以及性别、年龄、方言等多个维度的人口统计公平性。使用同数据集多元说话人训练的SV已有显著效果；用声学相似说话人训练的向量与用同一说话人或同人口统计群体说话人训练的向量相比具有竞争力甚至更优。
AI.conclusion: 激活引导可用于少样本自适应（已知说话人人口统计信息时）以及零样本自适应（对未见说话人且无需任何标签）。

title: A Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning Engine for Compilation-Free Patch Presence Testing
summary: Code reuse in modern software ecosystems facilitates the spread of 1-day vulnerabilities, posing significant security risks. Determining if patches are present is crucial, but traditional methods suffer from limited usability and accuracy, often depending on a fragile compilation process. In our prior work, we introduced Lares, the first compilation-free framework for patch presence testing that combines large language models (LLMs) with SMT solvers. However, Lares treats the LLM and the SMT solver as two separate, parallel decision channels: the symbolic channel (Z3) succeeded in only 20% of code cases, and the remaining cases fell back to the neural channel (the LLM) for the final decision. Letting the LLM act as the final arbiter turns verification into an informal, non-deterministic process that is prone to hallucination errors, while the two channels never reinforce each other. To overcome these limitations, we propose SyLares, which reformulates compilation-free patch presence testing as neuro-symbolic reasoning. Instead of letting the LLM emit a final verdict, SyLares uses the LLM as a neural feature extractor that perceives heterogeneous source code and decompiled pseudocode and produces specification-compliant SMT-LIB inputs, and delegates the final, deterministic judgment to the symbolic Z3 solver. This neural-perceives, symbolic-decides coupling is realized by a Code2SMT reasoning engine that combines deterministic syntactic parsing with LLM-driven code normalization and symbol alignment, so that every case is reduced to a formal equivalence query rather than an opaque LLM guess.

AI.tldr: SyLares将无编译补丁存在性检测重构为神经-符号推理：LLM仅作神经特征提取器，把异构源码/反编译伪代码规范化为SMT-LIB，最终由Z3确定性判定，实现"神经感知、符号决策"。
AI.motivation: 现代软件生态的代码复用使1-day漏洞扩散，传统补丁存在性检测依赖脆弱的编译过程，可用性与准确性受限。先前工作Lares虽免编译，但将LLM与SMT求解器视为两个并行决策通道：符号通道仅20%代码案例成功，其余退化为LLM最终裁决，导致验证非形式化、不确定性、易幻觉，且两通道无法互相增强。
AI.method: 提出SyLares，把无编译补丁检测形式化为神经-符号推理。LLM不再输出最终结论，而作为神经特征提取器，感知异构源码与反编译伪代码并生成符合规范的SMT-LIB；最终确定性判断交由符号Z3求解器。该"神经感知、符号决策"耦合通过Code2SMT推理引擎实现，结合确定性语法解析与LLM驱动的代码归一化和符号对齐，将每个案例归约为形式化等价性查询。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数值，仅指出设计上使每个案例转化为形式等价查询，而非LLM不透明猜测，从而规避上一版本中符号通道仅20%成功率、其余依赖LLM裁决的问题。
AI.conclusion: SyLares通过让LLM服务于符号求解而非充当裁决者，将补丁存在性检测转为形式化等价查询，提升了验证的确定性与准确性，克服了Lares双通道独立、易幻觉的缺陷。

title: BUMP: Body-driven Unified Multi-object Physics for HOI Synthesis
summary: Generating human-object interactions (HOIs) with multiple objects is challenging because the resulting motions arise from different underlying causes. Human motion reflects semantic intent, intentionally manipulated objects must remain coordinated with the human, while surrounding objects move primarily as physical consequences of contact and collision. We present BUMP, a text-driven framework for multi-object HOI generation based on a simple principle: learn intentional motion and simulate physical consequences. Our method first generates full-body human motion from text and scene context, then predicts trajectories for a small number of intentionally manipulated driver objects conditioned on the human motion. We then obtain responder object motions through physics simulation, allowing the framework to handle varying numbers and configurations of surrounding objects without expanding the learned trajectory output space. To address the scarcity of paired full-body multi-object HOI data, we combine heterogeneous supervision from human-only motion, full-body HOI, and hand-centric manipulation data augmented with plausible body motion. We further introduce outcome-conditioned interaction editing, which infers a local modification of the causal driver object trajectory from a desired responder object behavior without requiring an explicit target driver object trajectory. Experiments demonstrate strong performance on both single-object and multi-object HOI benchmarks. Qualitative results showcase diverse scenarios involving inter-object relationships and edits, highlighting the advantage of our unified model formulation.

AI.tldr: BUMP 提出"学习意图运动、仿真物理后果"的文本驱动多物体人-物交互生成框架：先由文本+场景生成全身人体运动，再预测少量被意图操纵的驱动物体轨迹，其余响应物体由物理仿真得到。
AI.motivation: 多物体 HOI 生成困难，因为运动来源不同：人体运动体现语义意图，被操纵物体需与人协调，而周围物体运动主要是接触/碰撞的物理结果；现有方法难以统一处理且缺少配对的全身体多物体 HOI 数据。
AI.method: 1) 由文本与场景上下文生成全身人体运动；2) 以人体运动为条件预测少量"驱动物体"（driver）轨迹；3) 通过物理仿真得到"响应物体"（responder）运动，避免扩大轨迹输出空间；4) 融合人体单独运动、全身 HOI、手部操作三类异构数据并用合理身体运动增强进行监督；5) 提出结果条件化的交互编辑，从期望的响应物体行为反推驱动轨迹的局部修改。
AI.result: 在单物体与多物体 HOI 基准上均表现良好；定性结果展示了多样化的物体间关系与编辑场景，体现统一建模范式的优势。
AI.conclusion: 将"意图运动生成"与"物理后果仿真"分离，可自然扩展到数量与配置可变的多物体场景，并借助异构监督与交互编辑提升数据效率与可控性。

title: ReuF2F: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Formalized Undergraduate Research Problems
summary: As AI systems begin to resolve open research problems, reliable verification becomes increasingly important. Formal mathematics provides a trusted framework for mathematical reasoning, enabling agents to produce machine-checkable proofs while conducting mathematical exploration. Existing formal mathematics benchmarks often focus on known results or a small set of prominent open problems, which can become difficult to evaluate reliably once solutions are discovered and widely disseminated. Existing evaluation protocols are also not always aligned with how modern coding agents operate. We therefore introduce ReuF2F, a Lean 4 benchmark of 244 formalized open problems drawn from Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), spanning entry-level open research problems across a broad range of mathematical subfields. We expect these less prominent open problems, which tend to attract less attention and may remain unsolved for longer, to be better suited for held-out evaluation of end-to-end open problem resolution in Lean. We adopt a standard coding-agent evaluation setting, placing each problem and its logical negation into a Lean project in a Docker container. We also build Leanimum-agent on mini-SWE-agent to provide a unified harness for fair comparisons across models. Our evaluation finds that even the best-performing model resolves only ~40% of the problems, leaving substantial room for improvement on formalized open research problems.

AI.tldr: ReuF2F 是一个包含 244 个来自 REU 的 Lean 4 开放问题基准，配合 Docker 环境与 Leanimum-agent 统一评测，最佳模型仅解决约 40%。
AI.motivation: AI 系统开始解决开放研究问题，可靠验证日益重要。现有形式数学基准多为已知结果或少数知名开放问题，一旦被解决并广泛传播便难以作为可靠评测；且现有评测协议与现代编码智能体的工作方式不完全一致。
AI.method: 构建 ReuF2F：244 个形式化的 REU 开放问题，覆盖多个数学子领域的入门级开放研究问题；采用标准编码智能体评测设置，将每个问题及其逻辑否定放入 Docker 容器中的 Lean 项目；并在 mini-SWE-agent 基础上构建 Leanimum-agent 作为统一 harness 以公平比较各模型。
AI.result: 即使表现最好的模型也仅解决约 40% 的问题，说明形式化开放研究问题上仍有很大提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 较少受关注、可能长期未解的 REU 开放问题更适合作为端到端开放问题求解的留出评测；ReuF2F 与 Leanimum-agent 为形式数学智能体提供了更可靠、公平的评测框架。

title: Factual Access States in Diffusion Language Models: From Mechanism to Knowledge Editing and Retrieval
summary: Factual recall is a lookup: some representation inside the network serves as the key, and what that key is made of decides which queries can retrieve the fact, what an edit must cover, and what a retriever can read. We call it the factual access state. In autoregressive (AR) models the subject position enriches attributes largely independently of the relation, and relation-specific selection happens later, at the readout position. In masked diffusion language models (DLMs) we find the state is assembled differently, and much earlier: in the first attention layer the wording of the relation is routed into the position of whichever entity is visible and the early feed-forward layers look the fact up on this fused representation. The state therefore varies with the relation's surface form and with the query direction, so the queries about one fact occupy a region of state space rather than a point, and an operation on the fact succeeds only for queries that enter it. We treat the state as an interface to a DLM's factual knowledge, and put it to two uses. Writing to the state gives a knowledge editor: from one declarative statement, Multi-View Edit fits one shared value per direction across that region and installs it in the early-MLP block, preserving source-prompt reliability while substantially improving paraphrase and reverse question answering, where AR editors gain near zero. Reading it suggests a complementary use: the state at each entity position can serve as a relation-specific retrieval vector with no training, returning both pieces of evidence for two-entity queries on which pooled, prompted and lexical retrievers almost never return both.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"事实访问状态"（factual access state）概念，发现掩码扩散语言模型（DLM）与自回归模型（AR）在事实存储与读取机制上存在本质差异：DLM 在首层注意力即将关系措辞路由到实体位置，并由早期 FFN 完成查找，导致事实状态随关系表层形式与查询方向而变，形成"状态区域"而非单点。基于此，作者提出两项应用：写作侧给出无需训练的知识编辑器 Multi-View Edit，读取侧将实体位置状态用作免训练的关系特定检索向量。
AI.motivation: 事实召回本质是"查表"：网络内部充当 key 的表示决定了哪些查询能取回事实、编辑需覆盖什么、检索器能读出什么。AR 模型中主体位置与关系解耦、关系选择发生在读出处，而 DLM 的并行去噪机制可能根本不同，现有知识编辑与检索方法（多为 AR 设计）在 DLM 上表现不佳（改写与反向问答近乎为零），因此需要先弄清 DLM 的事实访问状态结构，再据此设计方法。
AI.method: 通过机制分析定位 DLM 的事实访问状态：首层注意力将关系措辞写入可见实体位置，早期 FFN 在该融合表示上查表。据此（1）提出 Multi-View Edit：从单条陈述句中，针对每个方向在该状态区域内拟合一个共享值，并写入早期 MLP 块；（2）提出免训练检索：以各实体位置的状态作为关系特定的检索向量，用于两实体查询的证据召回。
AI.result: Multi-View Edit 在保持源提示可靠性的同时，显著提升改写与反向问题问答表现，而 AR 编辑器在这两类问题上收益近乎为零。免训练检索向量能在池化、提示式与词法检索器几乎无法同时返回两条证据的双实体查询上，成功返回两部分证据。
AI.conclusion: DLM 的事实知识以"关系与实体融合、多查询方向共享区域"的形式早期组装，可作为知识接口加以利用：写作即知识编辑，读取即关系特定检索，二者互为补充，且均受益于对访问状态结构的理解。

title: ClockMark: Adaptive and Host-Dependent Watermarking for Large Language Models
summary: Large language model (LLM) watermarking operates on the next-token distribution that evolves during generation. In streaming generation, each sampled token becomes part of the text and affects subsequent distributions. Embedding therefore proceeds with a changing host, unlike classical watermarking, which adapts embedding to an existing host signal. To accommodate this difference, we formulate a novel embedding framework for LLM watermarking based on two principles. We first argue that embedding should be adaptive, retaining the state of previous sampling decisions to better guide subsequent choices. We further argue that embedding should be host-dependent, using the current LLM distribution to constrain both token selection and state updates. Guided by these principles and the two requirements of distribution preservation and robustness to text editing, we propose ClockMark. It combines adaptive and host-dependent embedding with message spreading, embedding the full payload in each watermarked token. Theoretically, we prove that ClockMark preserves the original LLM sequence distribution, thereby maintaining generation quality. Empirically, extensive experiments against 12 baselines demonstrate improved robustness to text editing, with gains of up to 16.08 percentage points in bit accuracy over the strongest tested baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出面向大语言模型流式生成的嵌入框架，并据此设计 ClockMark 水印方法，在保持原始分布的同时提升抗文本编辑鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 经典水印针对已有固定宿主信号做嵌入，而 LLM 生成时每个采样 token 都会改变后续分布，宿主在不断演化，因此需要重新形式化嵌入框架。
AI.method: 提出两项原则：嵌入应自适应（保留先前采样决策状态以指导后续选择）、应依赖宿主（用当前 LLM 分布约束 token 选择与状态更新）；在保持分布与抗编辑鲁棒两项要求下提出 ClockMark，结合自适应与宿主依赖嵌入及消息扩散，在每个水印 token 中嵌入完整载荷。
AI.result: 理论上证明 ClockMark 保持原始 LLM 序列分布从而维持生成质量；实验上与 12 个基线对比，抗文本编辑鲁棒性提升，比特准确率最多高出最强基线 16.08 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ClockMark 为流式生成场景提供了兼顾分布保持与鲁棒性的 LLM 水印方案，验证了自适应、宿主依赖嵌入原则的有效性。

title: Evaluating Tibetan Speech Recognition Across Dialects and Adaptation Regimes: A Multi-Granularity Analysis
summary: Tibetan speech recognition is usually evaluated with character or syllable error rates because the writing system does not mark word boundaries. These metrics can rank systems differently and respond differently to adaptation failures. We combine character error rate, syllable error rate, and segmented word error rate in one evaluation framework. We use dictionary-based, neural, and language-model-based segmentation and compare their boundaries with expert annotations. We evaluate five ASR architectures on Lhasa Tibetan, then test zero-shot transfer and target-corpus adaptation on five additional corpus subsets. We also vary LoRA rank and training-data size to examine adaptation failure. The results show that a lower character error does not always lead to a lower syllable or segmented-word error. These ranking differences persist across corpora. Metric correlations also weaken in some unsuccessful adaptation settings. Higher LoRA ranks improve syllable and segmented-word scores but remain worse than full fine-tuning in the tested range. A standardized phonological representation provides another view of spelling errors. These findings support evaluation at several linguistic levels and motivate better segmentation and adaptation methods for low-resource ASR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将字符错误率、音节错误率与分词词错误率结合的统一评测框架，用藏语语音识别实验说明不同指标会给出不同的系统排序，并考察零样本迁移、LoRA 适配与数据规模的影响。
AI.motivation: 藏语书写系统不标注词边界，常规只用字符或音节错误率评测，导致系统排序不一致、对适配失效的敏感度不同，缺乏多语言层级的可靠评测。
AI.method: 构建融合 CER、SER 与分词词错误率（SWER）的评测框架；采用基于词典、神经网络和语言模型三种分词方法并与专家标注边界对比；在拉萨藏语上评测五种 ASR 架构，并在五个额外语料子集上测试零样本迁移与目标语料适配；变化 LoRA 秩与训练数据规模以分析适配失效；另引入标准化音系表示分析拼写错误。
AI.result: 较低字符错误率并不总对应较低音节或分词词错误率，这种排序差异跨语料持续存在；部分失败适配设置下指标间相关性减弱；更高 LoRA 秩改善音节与分词词得分，但在测试范围内仍不及全参数微调。
AI.conclusion: 藏语 ASR 应在多个语言层级上评测；研究结果呼吁改进低资源 ASR 的分词方法与适配方法。

title: How Developers Configure LLM Inference: A Large-Scale Study of Real-World Practices
summary: LLMs are increasingly integrated into software systems, making deployment and inference configuration a recurring software engineering task. Inference backends expose many options that affect model loading, generation, serving, and request processing. Yet little is known about which of these options developers explicitly configure in practice. In this paper, we present a large-scale empirical study of LLM inference configuration practices in open-source software using Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, and the OpenAI API. We analyze 5,398 GitHub repositories using at least one of these backends and identify 345,117 explicitly configured option occurrences. Our results show that developers use only a small part of the available configuration space regularly. Although 98.8% of the documented backend-specific options appear at least once, 78.9% are configured in at most 10% of repositories using the corresponding backend. Configurations are also small, with a median of 2 options for Transformers and 4 for vLLM and OpenAI, but the combinations of options vary widely: 56.8-61.6% of multi-option signatures appear in only one repository. We also observe recurring option values as well as substantial variation in how values are chosen. Finally, configuration practices differ across application contexts, with option-adoption differences reaching 30.7 percentage points. These findings characterize the configuration surface developers make explicit rather than the importance or optimality of individual options. They provide empirical evidence for prioritizing future studies of inference configuration and for improving backend documentation and configuration support.

AI.tldr: 对 5,398 个使用 Transformers、vLLM 和 OpenAI API 的 GitHub 仓库进行大规模实证研究，识别出 345,117 处显式配置选项，揭示开发者只常用配置空间的一小部分、配置组合高度分散。
AI.motivation: LLM 已被广泛集成进软件系统，部署与推理配置成为常见软件工程任务；推理后端暴露大量影响模型加载、生成、服务与请求处理的选项，但开发者实际显式配置了哪些选项尚不清楚。
AI.method: 基于 Hugging Face Transformers、vLLM 和 OpenAI API 三种后端，分析 5,398 个开源 GitHub 仓库，统计并归纳显式配置的选项（共 345,117 次出现），分析选项覆盖度、配置规模、选项组合签名、取值模式以及不同应用场景下的差异。
AI.result: 开发者常用选项仅占配置空间一小部分：98.8% 的文档化后端专属选项至少出现一次，但 78.9% 仅在不超过 10% 的对应后端仓库中被配置；配置规模小（Transformers 中位数 2 个，vLLM 与 OpenAI 为 4 个）；选项组合高度分散，56.8–61.6% 的多选项签名只出现在单一仓库；存在重复出现的取值模式但取值选择差异大；不同应用场景间选项采纳率差异最高达 30.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究刻画的是开发者显式暴露的配置表面，而非各选项的重要性或最优性；结果为后续推理配置研究提供实证依据，并有助于改进后端文档与配置支持。

title: SciFigBench: A Benchmark for Scientific Method Figure Understanding
comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. Code and benchmark resources: https://github.com/LeNcyer/SciFigBench
summary: Scientific method figures often provide researchers with a clear visual entry point into a paper's methodology and core contributions, yet their dense layouts and complex information flows are difficult for Vision Language Models (VLMs) to interpret. Existing benchmarks predominantly focus on coarse-grained tasks, such as context-based retrieval or holistic comprehension, overlooking the fine-grained content and inter-module relations within complex methodological diagrams. To address these overlooked aspects, we introduce Scientific Figure Benchmark (SciFigBench), a benchmark for evaluating core capabilities required for scientific method figure understanding. Specifically, it targets three capabilities: dense content perception, visual relation comprehension, and information-flow tracing. For this purpose, we curate 4,352 scientific method figures from real-world research papers and construct 40,670 QA pairs to operationalize these capabilities as measurable question-answering tasks. All annotations are generated by dedicated pipelines and then manually verified. We further propose SciFigCue, a training-free visual prompting module that externalizes arrow-induced dependencies as visual relational evidence for method-figure reasoning. Experiments across open-source and proprietary VLMs show that even strong models remain substantially limited in visual relation comprehension, while SciFigCue improves performance across several tasks without parameter updates. The code and related resources are available at https://github.com/LeNcyer/SciFigBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SciFigBench，一个用于评估 VLM 理解科学方法图的基准，涵盖密集内容感知、视觉关系理解与信息流追踪三种能力，并配套训练无关的视觉提示模块 SciFigCue。
AI.motivation: 科学方法图是论文方法论的直观入口，但布局密集、信息流复杂，VLM 难以解读；现有基准多聚焦粗粒度任务（检索、整体理解），忽视图中细粒度内容与模块间关系。
AI.method: 构建 SciFigBench：从真实论文收集 4,352 张方法图，通过专门流程生成并人工校验 40,670 条 QA 对，将三项能力操作化为问答任务；同时提出免训练视觉提示模块 SciFigCue，把箭头蕴含的依赖关系外化为视觉关系证据。
AI.result: 开源与闭源 VLM 实验显示，即便强模型在视觉关系理解上仍显著受限；SciFigCue 在无参数更新的情况下提升了多项任务表现。
AI.conclusion: SciFigBench 揭示了 VLM 在方法图细粒度理解上的短板，SciFigCue 提供了有效的免训练改进方案，代码与资源已公开。

title: A general-purpose System One decision model for clinical records
summary: Clinical care, health-system operations and biomedical discovery depend on extracting reliable answers from patient records, yet applying diverse clinical questions across entire populations remains computationally expensive. Here we present Clinical System One (CS1), a 4-billion-parameter decision model for fast, typed judgments from clinical records, along with two agentic harnesses in which CS1 works together with a generalist language model. CS1-4B is trained on 12.4 million questions and answers from 3.6 million patients across a multi-hospital health system, combining structured-data keys, observed outcomes and language-model supervision across clinical notes, diagnostic reports and patient timelines. It answers multiple typed questions in a single forward pass without task-specific retraining, and each answer carries a probability that can route uncertain cases to human review. On 963,408 held-out patients, CS1-4B outperformed open decision models up to 27 billion parameters on 13 of 14 tasks scored independently of its training teacher. Across 21 external data sets, its aggregate performance approached that of the strongest tested 27-billion-parameter model, with 6.4-fold faster inference in a matched workload. Integrating CS1-4B with a language model agent produced cited answers over complete multi-year patient histories and screened a patient population against the eligibility criteria of 17 registered clinical trials, placing four times as many judged-eligible patients among its top 20 candidates as keyword search while using 690-fold fewer language-model tokens than a language model reading every record. These findings support a division of labour in clinical AI, with small decision models performing repeated record reading and generative models formulating questions and synthesizing evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出4B参数的临床决策模型CS1-4B，用1240万问题、360万患者数据训练，单次前向即可回答多类问题并给出概率；在96万留出患者上13/14任务优于达27B的开放决策模型，并与语言模型智能体配合完成带引用答案与临床试验筛选。
AI.motivation: 临床护理、医院运营与生物医学发现依赖从病历中获取可靠答案，但把多样化临床问题规模化应用到整个人群计算成本高昂；大语言模型逐条读取病历代价更大。
AI.method: 构建CS1-4B决策模型：多医院健康系统1240万问答、360万患者训练，融合结构化字段键、真实结局与对临床笔记/诊断报告/患者时间线的语言模型监督；单次前向传播输出多类型答案及可路由人工复核的概率。另设两个智能体框架，让CS1与通用语言模型分工协作。
AI.result: 963,408留出患者上，CS1-4B在14项独立于教师模型评分的任务中13项优于至27B开放决策模型；21个外部数据集聚合性能接近最强27B模型，匹配负载下推理快6.4倍。与语言模型智能体结合可对多年完整病史给出带引用答案，并对17项注册临床试验做人群筛选，前20候选中的判定合格患者数为关键词检索的4倍，语言模型token消耗少690倍。
AI.conclusion: 支持临床AI的分工范式：小型决策模型承担重复性病历读取，生成式模型负责提出问题与综合证据。

title: GARRET: Generative Feedback for Region Retrieval in Visual Documents
summary: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation over visually rich documents requires evidence at a finer granularity than entire pages. Existing visual retrievers typically index or return full pages, whereas training region-level retrievers often requires costly query-to-region annotations or noisy model-generated labels. We introduce GARRET, a region-retrieval framework trained from (page, question, answer) triplets through differentiable generative feedback. A shared context-preserving retriever produces page and region multi-vector representations. During training, their retrieval scores define a soft routing distribution over candidate region crops. An auxiliary vision-language model attends to each crop separately, aggregates crop-specific contexts using the routing weights, and predicts the question followed by the answer under a next-token prediction objective. Gradients through the routing distribution assign query-conditioned credit to the indexed region representations, without requiring query-to-region annotations. At inference, the auxiliary model is removed. GARRET also reuses the contextualized region representations, together with page summary tokens, to construct a compact page representation. We introduce ViDoRe-V3-Region, a corpus-wide benchmark containing 200,682 fixed candidate regions across eight domains. GARRET achieves a macro nDCG@10 of 0.4126, outperforming the strongest visual baseline by 2.94 points. On page retrieval, it remains comparable to ColQwen2.5-v0.2 while indexing 47.8% fewer vectors per page.

AI.tldr: GARRET：用可微生成反馈从(page, question, answer)三元组训练区域级视觉检索器，无需区域标注；在ViDoRe-V3-Region上宏nDCG@10达0.4126，超最强视觉基线2.94点。
AI.motivation: 视觉富文档的多模态RAG需要比整页更细粒度的证据，但现有视觉检索器通常以整页索引/返回；而训练区域级检索器又依赖昂贵的query-to-region标注或含噪的模型生成标签。
AI.method: 共享的保上下文检索器产出页面与区域多向量表示；训练时用检索分数定义候选区域裁剪上的软路由分布，辅助VLM分别关注每个裁剪、按路由权重聚合上下文并以NTP目标预测问题+答案；梯度经路由分布为区域表示分配query条件化信用。推理时移除辅助模型；并复用上下文化区域表示与页面摘要token构建紧凑页面表示。
AI.result: 提出ViDoRe-V3-Region基准（8个领域、200,682个固定候选区域）；宏nDCG@10为0.4126，超最强视觉基线2.94点；页面检索与ColQwen2.5-v0.2相当，但每页索引向量少47.8%。
AI.conclusion: 生成式反馈可作为区域级检索的弱监督信号，实现无区域标注的细粒度检索，并兼顾页面级效率。

title: RGH-GNN : Risk-Gated Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network for Financial Fraud Detection
summary: Credit card fraud is a significant problem for financial institutions, resulting in substantial monetary loss each year. Fraud patterns and methods are continuously evolving, with fraudulent transactions often disguised to resemble legitimate activity. Real world transaction data for fraud detection is severely affected by class imbalance making it harder to detect these transactions. Fraudulent transactions are rarely isolated. Accounts, devices, and other common attributes are often shared across fraudulent activity, revealing relational patterns that individual transaction features alone cannot capture. Graph-based approaches model these relationships explicitly. However, standard graph neural networks aggregate neighbourhood information uniformly, which can dilute the already scarce signal carried by fraudulent transactions and limit detection of camouflaged fraud. This work presents RGH-GNN, a heterogeneous graph neural network that addresses this limitation by incorporating transaction-level risk scores, generated by a supervised LightGBM classifier as edge weights. It is used to guide message passing through a learnable risk-gated aggregation mechanism. It ensures that high-risk transactions contribute more strongly to learned representations rather than being diluted by uniform neighbourhood aggregation. RGH-GNN is evaluated on the IEEE-CIS fraud detection dataset against standard graph neural network models that are trained on the same heterogeneous graph. RGH-GNN outperforms all baselines across every evaluation metric, with an AUC-ROC score of 0.914. This demonstrates that incorporating engineered risk signals into graph-based message passing substantially improves fraud detection performance.

AI.tldr: RGH-GNN 用 LightGBM 风险分数作为异构图边权重，通过可学习风险门控聚合引导消息传递，在 IEEE-CIS 数据上 AUC-ROC 达 0.914，全面超越标准 GNN。
AI.motivation: 信用卡欺诈模式不断演变且伪装成正常交易，类别极度不平衡导致信号稀少；欺诈常共享账户、设备等关系属性，但标准 GNN 均匀聚合邻居信息会稀释本已稀缺的欺诈信号，难以识别伪装欺诈。
AI.method: 构建异构交易图，用监督式 LightGBM 分类器生成交易级风险分数作为边权重，并将其注入可学习的风险门控聚合机制中引导消息传递，使高风险交易对表示学习贡献更大。
AI.result: 在 IEEE-CIS 欺诈检测数据集上，与在同一异构图上训练的标准 GNN 模型对比，RGH-GNN 在所有评价指标上均优于基线，AUC-ROC 达到 0.914。
AI.conclusion: 将工程化风险信号融入图消息传递可显著提升欺诈检测性能，缓解均匀聚合对稀缺欺诈信号的稀释问题。

title: Decomposed Relation Extraction from Aviation Accident Narratives: Evaluating Transformer-Based Safety Knowledge Discovery under Relational Sparsity
summary: Relation extraction from aviation accident narratives is challenging because genuine safety relations are sparse among possible concept pairs. This study evaluates a decomposed framework separating relation classification from concept identification. A benchmark of 300 National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) narratives containing 2,524 unique concept-text nodes was expanded into 21,038 ordered candidate pairs, with only 248 (1.18%) representing RESULTS_IN or CONTRIBUTES_TO relations. A TF-IDF Linear Support Vector Machine (SVM) and weighted RoBERTa classifier were developed using an independent graph-annotated resource with hard-negative sampling and frozen before sealed evaluation. Development Macro-F1 scores of 0.4738 (SVM) and 0.4809 (RoBERTa) declined to 0.2741 and 0.2420 under exhaustive evaluation, with Matthews correlation coefficients of 0.0128 and 0.0197. False positives dominated: the SVM recovered 96 reference relations but generated 7,018 false positives, while RoBERTa recovered 125 but generated 9,824. Post-test diagnostics revealed overlapping RoBERTa confidence distributions and false positives even within valid relation-category directions. Complementary end-to-end SmolLM2 evaluation identified missed and unsupported relations alongside malformed outputs. These findings demonstrate that known concept endpoints do not guarantee reliable relation extraction and that sampled-negative development performance may poorly reflect exhaustive evaluation. Controlling false positives and managing candidate-space sparsity remain essential for aviation safety knowledge extraction.

AI.tldr: 本文评估一种将关系分类与概念识别解耦的航空事故叙事关系抽取框架，发现已知概念端点并不能保证可靠的关系抽取，采样负样本下的开发性能在穷举评估中大幅下降，假阳性控制与候选空间稀疏性管理是关键。
AI.motivation: 航空事故叙事中真实安全关系在可能的概念对中极为稀疏，直接端到端抽取困难。作者希望验证"先识别概念端点、再单独做关系分类"的解耦思路是否可靠。
AI.method: 构建300篇NTSB叙事基准（2,524个概念-文本节点，扩展为21,038个有序候选对，仅248个即1.18%为RESULTS_IN或CONTRIBUTES_TO）。用带硬负采样的独立图标注资源训练TF-IDF线性SVM与加权RoBERTa，冻结后做密封评估；另用SmolLM2做端到端互补评估。
AI.result: 开发集Macro-F1为0.4738（SVM）和0.4809（RoBERTa），穷举评估降至0.2741和0.2420，MCC仅0.0128与0.0197。假阳性占主导：SVM召回96个关系但产生7,018个假阳性，RoBERTa召回125个但产生9,824个。诊断显示RoBERTa置信度分布重叠，甚至在有效关系类别方向上仍出现假阳性；SmolLM2出现漏检、无支撑关系及格式错误输出。
AI.conclusion: 已知概念端点不保证可靠关系抽取；采样负样本的开发表现可能严重高估穷举场景性能。控制假阳性、管理候选空间稀疏性对航空安全知识抽取至关重要。

title: LiveUIBench: Evaluating Agent as App Workflows
summary: Applications provide convenient features for users to complete daily tasks. However, different users may have different or even conflicting requirements for the same application, while the requirements of the same user may change over time. Personalizing applications produced by agent-to-app or UI-to-code approaches can require changes to the generated implementation. We propose Agent as App, a task in which users express their requirements in natural language and an agent creates a personalized application while continuing to supply its behavior during use. We implement LiveUIAgent, which generates a task-specific orchestration connecting the user interface, saved information, and service actions. A shared agent runtime renders and updates the interface while carrying out the requested operations. Revising the orchestration and interface while reusing that runtime provides a lightweight basis for personalization as requirements evolve. We introduce LiveUIBench, a benchmark with diverse requirements and ordered interactions across personal services. The empirical findings show that the evaluated models struggle to complete these workflows reliably. Applications can satisfy many local checks while leaving the overall task unfinished, and greater partial coverage can coincide with fewer completed workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出"Agent as App"任务与LiveUIAgent实现：用户用自然语言表达需求，智能体生成个性化应用并在使用中持续提供其行为，并配套推出LiveUIBench基准。
AI.motivation: 不同用户对同一应用的需求不同甚至冲突，同一用户的需求也随时间变化；agent-to-app或UI-to-code生成的应用若要个性化，往往需要改动生成的具体实现，代价高且不灵活。
AI.method: 定义Agent as App任务；实现LiveUIAgent：生成任务特定的编排（orchestration），连接用户界面、已保存信息与服务动作；由共享的agent runtime负责渲染与更新界面并执行所需操作；需求演进时只需修改编排与界面并复用同一runtime。
AI.result: 构建LiveUIBench基准，包含跨个人服务服务的多样需求与有序交互。实验表明所评估模型难以可靠完成这些工作流：应用可满足许多局部检查而整体任务未完成，部分覆盖率更高时反而完成的工作流更少。
AI.conclusion: 以"编排+共享runtime"的方式将个性化轻量化，是可行方向；但现有模型在端到端、顺序性个人服务工作流上仍不可靠，需以整体任务完成度而非局部覆盖来评估。

title: LVMem: Image-Augmented Memory for Long-Horizon Question Answering
summary: Reliable language-guided perception is essential for embodied agents, where questions about objects, events, and their locations must be answered from long observation histories. Unlike conventional visual question answering, realistic robotic settings require reasoning over extended temporal horizons and persistent scene memory. We build upon the view-based memory paradigm and propose an efficient framework for long-horizon spatio-temporal question answering. While existing view-based systems typically store either text captions or visual embeddings, we extend the ReMEmbR-style memory with image paths that link each stored description to its original visual content. To make the stored annotations more informative, we replace uniform sampling during memory construction with an optical-flow-based frame selection strategy (PSFR) and store an object-centric descriptive scene representation instead of plain captions. We further equip a VLM-based agent with an adaptive retrieval tool that returns the image associated with the most relevant caption, allowing the agent to decide when visual inspection is needed. On the OC-NaVQA benchmark, LVMem outperforms ReMEmbR on binary and positional metrics with both backbones and matches or exceeds a 4D scene graph DAAAM baseline on binary accuracy, while operating on a lightweight view-based memory that requires no explicit graph construction.

AI.tldr: 提出LVMem，一种高效的长时程时空问答框架：在ReMEmbR式视图记忆中加入图像路径链接，用光流帧选择(PSFR)替代均匀采样，存储以对象为中心的描述性场景表示，并配备自适应检索工具让VLM代理自主决定何时查看图像。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需要从长观测历史中可靠地回答关于物体、事件及其位置的问题，现实机器人场景要求跨长时序推理和持久场景记忆，而现有基于视图的系统仅存文本描述或视觉嵌入，信息有限。
AI.method: 1) 在ReMEmbR式视图记忆中为每条描述附加原始图像路径，实现描述与视觉内容的关联；2) 用基于光流的帧选择策略(PSFR)替代记忆构建中的均匀采样；3) 存储以对象为中心的描述性场景表示而非普通caption；4) 为VLM代理配置自适应检索工具，返回最相关caption对应的图像，由代理自行决定是否需要视觉检查。
AI.result: 在OC-NaVQA基准上，两种骨干网络下LVMem在二值和位置指标上均优于ReMEmbR；在二值准确率上达到或超过4D场景图基线DAAAM，且仅使用轻量级视图记忆，无需显式构建图结构。
AI.conclusion: 将文本描述与视觉内容链接、改进帧采样与场景表示、并赋予代理自适应视觉检索能力，可在不构建显式图的情况下高效实现长时程时空问答，性能优于现有视图记忆方法和图方法基线。

title: DeclineCraft: A RAG Abstention Benchmark for Jointly Measuring Combined Retrieval and Parametric Knowledge
summary: Reliable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires recognizing when neither retrieved documents nor parametric knowledge supports an answer. We introduce DeclineCraft, a dynamic abstention benchmark whose unanswerable questions target Minecraft feature additions after a corpus cut-off, with audits of possible parametric exposure. Later cut-offs support evaluation of future models. Across 27 LLMs, we measure Correct Abstention Rate (CAR; how often models acknowledge insufficient knowledge on unanswerable questions), Answerable Attempt Rate and Answer Accuracy. We find that (1) single-shot retrieval significantly raises CAR in 38 of 40 configurations (model and thinking setting) versus no retrieval. (2) Iterative RAG, in which the model self-assesses its context and can request up to two further retrieval rounds, significantly lowers CAR versus single-shot RAG in 30 of 40 configurations (mean 46.4%), with little change in Answer Accuracy (68.5% to 69.3%). Adding query rewriting and reranking to hybrid (dense & sparse) retrieval lowers CAR for all 12 models tested. (3) Larger models answer more accurately (Spearman $ρ= +0.60$ with total parameters), but neither model size nor release date shows a significant association with CAR. (4) Without retrieval, enabling thinking on the same weights lowers CAR significantly for 8 of 13 models (by 14% points on average), and the responses shift from acknowledged uncertainty to premise denial.

AI.tldr: 提出 DeclineCraft 基准，用 Minecraft 语料截止后的新特性构造不可回答问题，审计参数知识暴露，并在 27 个模型上评测中途退让（abstention）行为：单次检索显著提升正确退让率，而迭代 RAG 反而降低。
AI.motivation: 可靠 RAG 需要模型在检索文档与参数知识都不支持作答时识别"无法回答"，但现有评测缺乏对不可回答问题的系统性考察，也难以区分参数知识是否真的缺失。
AI.method: 构建 DeclineCraft 动态基准：不可回答问题针对语料截止后的 Minecraft 特性更新，并审计模型可能的参数暴露，提供多个截止时间点以评估未来模型。在 27 个 LLM 上测量正确退让率（CAR）、可回答尝试率与答案准确率；对比无检索、单次检索、迭代式 RAG（最多两轮追加检索）以及混合检索加查询改写与重排；并分析模型规模、发布时间、thinking 设置的影响。
AI.result: (1) 单次检索在 40 个配置中的 38 个显著提高 CAR。(2) 迭代 RAG 在 30/40 配置中显著降低 CAR（均值 46.4%），答案准确率几乎不变（68.5%→69.3%）；混合检索加入查询改写与重排后 12 个模型 CAR 全部下降。(3) 更大模型准确率更高（与总参数 Spearman ρ=+0.60），但模型规模与发布时间对 CAR 均无显著关联。(4) 无检索时开启 thinking 使 13 个模型中 8 个 CAR 显著下降（平均 14 个百分点），回答从承认不确定性转向否认前提。
AI.conclusion: 更多检索与更强的推理/改写并非总是提升可靠性：迭代 RAG 与 thinking 可能诱发"虚假自信"，削弱退让能力。需要在 RAG 流程中显式设计与评测退让机制，并注意模型规模不能作为可靠退让的代理指标。
