title: Reconstruction-Optimized Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce computation through sparse expert activation, but deployment still requires storing a large number of expert parameters. We study post-training expert pruning using task-domain calibration data as a subset-selection problem: given a pretrained MoE layer, select a fixed number of experts that best reconstruct its original output. Exact subset search is combinatorial and becomes intractable for modern MoE models with many experts per layer. We develop OptEP, a scalable continuous relaxation that directly optimizes differentiable expert-selection variables, followed by a lightweight reconstruction-based update of the retained expert weights. Across multiple MoE architectures and tasks spanning mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approach improves over the strongest existing expert-pruning baselines, with absolute accuracy gains of up to 15.05% on Qwen3-30B-A3B, 14.55% on Qwen3-235B-A22B, 11.06% on GLM-4.5-Air, and 16.20% on Mixtral-8x7B. The improvements are particularly pronounced under aggressive pruning, demonstrating that reconstruction-driven expert selection and weight adaptation can preserve substantially more of the original model's performance while reducing the number of retained experts.

AI.tldr: 提出OptEP，用连续松弛优化MoE专家剪枝的子集选择问题，并做基于重构的权重微调，显著优于现有剪枝基线。
AI.motivation: MoE虽通过稀疏激活降低计算，但部署仍需存储大量专家参数；训练后专家剪枝面临精确子集搜索的组合爆炸问题，在大规模MoE中不可行。
AI.method: 将专家剪枝建模为子集选择问题：给定预训练MoE层和任务域校准数据，选择固定数量专家以最优重构原始输出。为此提出OptEP——可扩展的连续松弛方法，直接优化可微的专家选择变量，随后对保留专家权重进行轻量级重构更新。
AI.result: 在多种MoE架构及数学推理、代码生成任务上优于最强基线，Qwen3-30B-A3B上绝对精度提升15.05%，Qwen3-235B-A22B提升14.55%，GLM-4.5-Air提升11.06%，Mixtral-8x7B提升16.20%；激进剪枝下提升尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 基于重构驱动的专家选择与权重自适应能在减少保留专家数量的同时更好地保持原模型性能。

title: Fluent but Fallible: Benchmarking Hallucination and Factual Reliability in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced natural language processing and artificial intelligence applications through their capabilities in reasoning, text generation and knowledge retrieval. However, LLMs are still vulnerable to two important challenges: hallucination, generating factually incorrect or fabricated content, and response deviation, meaning systematic deviations from ground-truth responses. These limitations raise serious concerns regarding reliability and trustworthiness in academic and research environments. This study offers a thorough comparative analysis using a variety of metrics of ten advanced LLMs ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude~3.5~Sonnet, LLaMA~3, Mistral, Grok, Perplexity, DeepSeek~V3, Falcon, and Gemma based on a benchmark consisting of 70 carefully designed academic prompts across four complexity levels: Basic, Explanation, Advanced, and Tricky, evaluated in February 2025 on specific model versions. Each response was independently evaluated by three reviewers using five metrics: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, Response Deviation Index, and Hallucination Index. Perplexity and DeepSeek~V3 achieved the highest overall accuracy, while Gemini demonstrated strong recall and a well-balanced performance profile across all five metrics. LLaMA~3 showed strong resistance against hallucinations through a conservative method of generation. Advanced-level prompts proved most challenging across all models, while Tricky prompts were handled more reliably owing to their binary true/false structure. Falcon achieved perfect precision and zero hallucinations, but at the cost of the lowest recall and the highest response deviation. The results show a fundamental trade-off between response completeness and factual reliability, intensified by prompt complexity.

AI.tldr: 该研究用70个分四级复杂度的学术提示词，对10个主流LLM进行五指标对比评测，发现模型在回答完整性与事实可靠性之间存在根本性权衡，且随提示复杂度加剧。
AI.motivation: LLM虽在推理、文本生成与知识检索上表现突出，但仍存在幻觉（生成错误或虚构内容）与回答偏差（系统性偏离真实答案）两大问题，这严重威胁学术与研究场景下的可靠性与可信度，因此需要系统性的多模型对比评估。
AI.method: 构建含70个精心设计的学术提示词基准，分Basic、Explanation、Advanced、Tricky四个复杂度层级；于2025年2月对ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude 3.5 Sonnet、LLaMA 3、Mistral、Grok、Perplexity、DeepSeek V3、Falcon、Gemma十个模型特定版本测试；每条回答由三名评审独立按Accuracy、Precision、Recall、Response Deviation Index、Hallucination Index五项指标打分。
AI.result: Perplexity与DeepSeek V3总体准确率最高；Gemini召回强且五项指标表现均衡；LLaMA 3因保守生成策略抗幻觉能力较强；Advanced级提示对所有模型最具挑战，Tricky级因二值真/假结构反而更可靠；Falcon精确率完美、零幻觉，但召回最低、回答偏差最高。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了回答完整性与事实可靠性之间的根本权衡，且该权衡随提示复杂度上升而加剧；模型选择需依据任务对完整性与可靠性的侧重进行取舍。

title: Training the Whole Agent, Not Just the Model
summary: Training coding agents typically updates the policy while keeping the harness fixed. During training, trajectories reveal flawed repair strategies and interaction problems that vary across tasks and change as the policy learns. We introduce HarnessAdapt-RL, which trains the policy and adapts its harness during reinforcement learning. For flawed repair strategies, a frozen teacher generates task-specific mechanism-level skills. For interaction problems recurring across tasks, a separate teacher model evolves tools and hooks, keeping each change only if it improves the observed pass rate or the observed trainable rate without lowering either. The policy trains with the adapted harness, and its new trajectories guide further adaptation. With a 9B base model, HarnessAdapt-RL improves pass@1 over GRPO by 9.8, 12.6, and 6.4 percentage points on SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, and Pro, and outperforms GRPO with the human-designed OpenHands harness. Gains from mechanism-level skills persist after their removal at evaluation. Re-evolving tools and hooks as the policy changes outperforms freezing early versions. Removing them at deployment, in contrast, costs up to 7.7 percentage points. Training therefore produces a model-harness pair: the trained policy and the evolved tools and hooks, with skills removed at deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出 HarnessAdapt-RL，在强化学习过程中同时训练策略并自适应调整其执行框架（harness）：用冻结教师生成任务特定的机制级技能，用另一教师模型演化工具与钩子，二者与策略共同迭代进化。
AI.motivation: 以往训练编码智能体只更新策略、固定 harness，但训练轨迹中暴露的修复策略缺陷与交互问题会随任务和策略变化，固定 harness 无法应对。
AI.method: 针对有缺陷的修复策略，由冻结教师生成任务特定、机制级技能；针对跨任务重复出现的交互问题，由独立教师模型演化工具与 hooks，仅在提升通过率或可训练率且不降低另一指标时保留改动。策略在新 harness 下训练，新轨迹再反馈驱动后续适配。
AI.result: 基于 9B 基础模型，在 SWE-bench Verified、Multilingual、Pro 上 pass@1 相比 GRPO 分别提升 9.8、12.6、6.4 个百分点，并优于使用人工设计 OpenHands harness 的 GRPO。机制级技能的增益在其被移除后仍保留；随策略变化持续演化工具/hooks 优于冻结早期版本；部署时移除这些工具/hooks 最多损失 7.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 训练产出的是「模型-harness 配对」：训练后的策略加上演化出的工具与钩子（部署时移除技能）。harness 与策略协同演化是提升编码智能体性能的有效途径。

title: Counting Contributions, Not Views: Occlusion-Aware Densification for 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: Accepted at ACCV 2026 (Oral). Includes the supplementary material as appendix. Code: https://github.com/MarcelRogge/occlusion-aware-3dgs
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting grows a dense scene from a sparse initialization through adaptive density control (ADC), driven by per-Gaussian statistics gathered during rendering. These statistics pass a frustum-based visibility filter blind to occlusion: fully occluded Gaussians still count as observed, diluting the averaged gradient signal and suppressing densification precisely where geometry is occluded. We correct this with an occlusion-aware filter that restricts densification statistics to views in which a Gaussian actually contributes, and replace the criterion's raw view-count normalizer with an average-contribution one. Integrated into a StopThePop-based framework, the two together improve every image-quality metric over the occlusion-blind baseline on occlusion-heavy scenes (up to 6% lower LPIPS), at less than half the Gaussians a view-count normalizer requires. Under the longer schedules these large scenes require, the count stays bounded where most criteria diverge, and on smaller benchmarks our method stays competitive at a fraction of the competitors' count.

AI.tldr: 提出遮挡感知的致密化统计过滤与平均贡献归一化，改进3DGS的自适应密度控制，在遮挡密集场景中提升图像质量且大幅减少高斯数量。
AI.motivation: 3DGS的自适应密度控制依赖渲染中收集的逐高斯统计，但现有统计使用基于视锥的可见性过滤，无视遮挡：被完全遮挡的高斯仍被视为“被观测”，稀释平均梯度信号，恰在几何被遮挡处抑制了致密化。
AI.method: 引入遮挡感知过滤器，仅将高斯真正有贡献的视角纳入致密化统计；并用“平均贡献”归一化替换原始的视角计数归一化。两者集成到基于StopThePop的框架中。
AI.result: 在遮挡密集场景中所有图像质量指标均优于遮挡不敏感基线（LPIPS最高降低6%），所需高斯数不到视角计数归一化方案的一半；长调度下高斯数量保持有界（多数准则会发散）；在较小基准上以竞争者零头数量保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 遮挡感知的统计与归一化能有效修正3DGS致密化偏差，在质量与效率上同时获益，并在长训练调度下保持稳定。

title: PROVISO: Provenance-Informed Action Selection for Secure LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents act on the external world through tools and third-party skills, so a single executed action can cause irreversible harm. Existing defenses judge a proposed action without tracking whether its content comes from the user or from external sources such as tool outputs, and they judge it in isolation rather than against an available alternative, which forces a trade-off between security and utility. We present PROVISO, a controller that decides which action to commit after the agent proposes an action and before it is executed. PROVISO encodes trusted observations, external observations, the proposed action, and an alternative into provenance-typed memory, relates them through role-specific queries, and commits the action with the highest calibrated value learned from outcomes. On four agent security tasks spanning the agent lifecycle, no baseline exceeds PROVISO in both security and utility. PROVISO improves F1 over the strongest baseline by 13.84 points on SkillsBench and by 7.07 points on ToolSafe, and it reaches 88-99 F1 on three additional skill detection benchmarks.

AI.tldr: PROVISO：在动作执行前，将可信观测、外部观测、候选动作与替代方案编码进带来源类型标注的记忆，通过角色特定查询比较并提交校准价值最高的动作，从而缓解LLM智能体工具使用中的安全与效用权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体通过工具和第三方技能作用于外部世界，单次执行可能造成不可逆伤害。现有防御未追踪动作内容来自用户还是外部来源，且孤立判断动作而非与可用替代方案比较，导致安全性与效用之间被迫取舍。
AI.method: 提出PROVISO控制器，在智能体提出动作后、执行前决定是否提交。它将可信观测、外部观测、候选动作及一个替代动作编码为来源类型化（provenance-typed）记忆，用角色特定查询建立关联，并依据从结果中学习到的校准价值选择价值最高的动作提交。
AI.result: 在覆盖智能体生命周期的四个安全任务中，没有基线在安全性和效用上同时超过PROVISO。F1指标上，SkillsBench较最强基线提升13.84点，ToolSafe提升7.07点，另在三个技能检测基准上达到88–99 F1。
AI.conclusion: 通过来源追踪与替代方案对比的提交前决策，PROVISO在保持高安全性的同时维持效用，优于现有防御基线，并在多个技能检测基准上取得强性能。

title: Evolving Semantic Indexes for Generative Retrieval
summary: Generative retrieval (GR) casts search and recommendation as autoregressive generation of discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs). SID design largely determines GR quality, but its discrete, interdependent components (SID construction, collision handling, decoding, and training) cannot be optimized end-to-end with gradients and remain largely hand-designed. We introduce a framework that improves these components through LLM-driven evolutionary program search, to our knowledge the first application of this approach to GR. A locally served, open-weight 31B model mutates executable GR components, so no proprietary LLM API is used, and a 1M-parameter proxy decoder provides fast feedback in place of repeatedly training the 1B target generator. Across 21 SID programs on NQ320K, proxy and target Recall@100 show strong rank correlation (Spearman $ρ= 0.90$). Guided by this proxy, evolution improves the seed GR on NQ320K, MSMARCO300K, and a multilingual e-commerce dataset under a fixed training recipe. On NQ320K, jointly evolving SID construction and collision handling improves Recall@1 from 55.8% to 59.3% and Recall@100 from 85.8% to 90.6%. A component study shows that proxy reliability depends on what is evolved: improvements transfer reliably for the semantic index but not for the generator's training objective or the full pipeline. LLM-driven evolutionary search is thus a practical tool for GR design, provided proxy reliability is established for the chosen search space.

AI.tldr: 提出用本地开源31B大模型驱动进化式程序搜索，自动改进生成式检索(GR)中手工设计的SID构建、碰撞处理等组件；以1M参数代理解码器快速反馈，在三个数据集上提升召回。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索质量高度依赖离散语义标识符(SID)的设计，但SID构建、碰撞处理、解码与训练相互耦合且不可微，难以端到端梯度优化，目前主要靠人工设计。
AI.method: 用本地部署的开源31B模型对可执行的GR组件代码进行变异，形成LLM驱动的进化程序搜索；用1M参数代理解码器替代反复训练1B目标生成器以提供快速反馈，并在21个SID程序上验证代理与目标的排名相关性。
AI.result: 在NQ320K的21个SID程序上，代理与目标Recall@100的Spearman ρ=0.90；固定训练配方下，NQ320K的Recall@1由55.8%升至59.3%、Recall@100由85.8%升至90.6%，MSMARCO300K与多语言电商数据集同样有提升。组件研究表明：语义索引部分的改进可可靠迁移，而生成器训练目标与整条流水线则不能。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的进化搜索是GR设计的实用工具，但前提是需针对所选搜索空间先验证代理可靠性。

title: Glass-Box Deep Reinforcement Learning for High-Speed Flow Control
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is challenging long-held assumptions in active flow control. By learning directly from interaction with a flow, DRL agents can find actuation strategies for nonlinear, unsteady flows without explicit models, often exploiting mechanisms that classical control would not anticipate. High-speed flows are a demanding test of this promise: shocks, shock/boundary-layer interactions, transition, aerothermal loading and microsecond-scale dynamics strain both algorithms and hardware. Yet most demonstrations remain idealized, low-speed simulations with limited evidence of robustness, interpretability, transferability or experimental deployment. In this perspective, we examine what constrains DRL-based high-speed flow control, including compressible simulation cost and fidelity, data efficiency, sensing in extreme environments, reward design, explainability, and generalization across Mach and Reynolds number. We argue that these limits reflect a tension between data-driven optimization and the structured physics, constraints and uncertainties of real flows. We then highlight where DRL may go beyond conventional approaches: adaptive control of shock-induced separation and turbulent boundary layers, coordination of distributed actuators, and discovery of unconventional flow-manipulation mechanisms.The central challenge, however, is translating these capabilities into reliable technology, which will require validated compressible simulation environments, physics- and constraint-aware learning, robustness to off-design conditions and sensor degradation, real-time operation, hardware-in-the-loop and wind-tunnel validation, and credible pathways to safety and certification.

AI.tldr: 该透视文章系统审视了深度强化学习(DRL)用于高速流(激波、激波/边界层干扰、转捩、气动热载荷等)主动控制的瓶颈与前景。
AI.motivation: DRL能从与流动的交互中直接学习非线性非定常流动的驱动策略，无需显式模型，常能发现经典控制难以预见的机制。但现有演示多停留在理想化低速仿真，缺乏鲁棒性、可解释性、可迁移性和实验部署证据，高速流的苛刻条件更使算法与硬件面临双重压力。
AI.method: 采用观点/综述性(理论思辨与归纳)的方法，梳理制约DRL高速流控制的各环节，包括可压缩仿真成本与保真度、数据效率、极端环境传感、奖励设计、可解释性以及跨马赫数与雷诺数的泛化。
AI.result: 识别出核心矛盾：数据驱动优化与真实流动的结构化物理、约束及不确定性之间存在张力；同时指出DRL可能在激波诱导分离与湍流边界层自适应控制、分布式作动器协调、非常规流动操控机制发现等方面超越传统方法。
AI.conclusion: 关键挑战在于将上述能力转化为可靠技术，需要经过验证的可压缩仿真环境、物理与约束感知的学习、对非设计工况与传感器退化的鲁棒性、实时运行、硬件在环与风洞验证，以及可信的安全与认证路径。

title: Cross-Lingual Reusability of LLM Pipelines: Financial Extraction, Multilingual Reasoning, and Semantic Screening
comment: 15 pages Accepted into ICAIF 2026 AI4F Workshop
summary: Financial institutions increasingly deploy large language models (LLMs) in multilingual markets, raising a practical question: can pipelines developed and validated in English be reused across languages, or must they be rebuilt per locale? We test cross-lingual reusability along three dimensions--accuracy, reasoning-effort transfer, and behavioural stability--through three complementary tasks. Task 1 (cheque extraction) and Task 2 (Mintaka QA with pinned evidence across nine languages and nine model-effort configurations) test whether accuracy and effort settings transfer; Task 3 (FinanceBench pilot, 50 items over SEC 10-K filings in four languages) validates whether these patterns generalise to financial content. Accuracy reusability is broadly confirmed: Gemini 3.5 Flash achieves 95.2-97.6% extraction accuracy across prompt languages, and FinanceBench per-language means span 5.8pp (77.1-82.9%), though the language-difficulty ranking reverses between domains (Hindi is worst on Mintaka, best on FinanceBench at 82.9%). Effort reusability is domain-dependent: higher reasoning effort yields marginal gains on general-knowledge QA but up to 8pp on financial content, and effort configurations that help in English help proportionally in other languages. Behavioural reusability holds: citation-set overlap with English averages 77-79% Jaccard, with no single language consistently worse. Together, these results support qualified reuse of English-built pipelines, but per-domain, per-language validation remains necessary--neither semantic similarity nor self-reported confidence reliably predicts cross-lingual accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文检验金融LLM流水线的跨语言可复用性：在准确性、推理努力迁移、行为稳定性三维度上，通过支票抽取、Mintaka多语问答、FinanceBench试点三任务实验，得出"有条件复用"结论——英文构建的流水线可部分复用，但必须按领域、按语言逐一验证。
AI.motivation: 金融机构在多语言市场部署LLM，实践中面临核心问题：在英文环境下开发并验证的流水线，能否直接跨语言复用，还是必须为每个地区重建。现有研究缺乏对"准确性—推理努力—行为稳定性"这一多维可复用性的系统性检验。
AI.method: 设计三个互补任务：任务1为支票信息抽取（检验准确性迁移）；任务2为Mintaka问答并固定证据，覆盖9种语言×9种模型努力配置（检验准确性与努力设置迁移）；任务3为FinanceBench试点，50题、4语言、基于SEC 10-K文件（检验结论能否推广到金融内容）。以Gemini 3.5 Flash为主要被测模型，用与英文的引用集Jaccard重叠度衡量行为稳定性。
AI.result: 准确性可复用性基本成立：Gemini 3.5 Flash跨提示语言抽取准确率95.2–97.6%，FinanceBench各语言均值跨度仅5.8pp（77.1–82.9%）；但语言难度排序在领域间反转（印地语在Mintaka最差，在FinanceBench最好，达82.9%）。努力可复用性依赖领域：提高推理努力在通用知识问答上收益有限，在金融内容上可达8pp，且英文有效的配置在其他语言中按比例有效。行为可复用性成立：与英文的引用集Jaccard重叠平均77–79%，无某语言一贯更差。语义相似度与模型自报置信度均无法可靠预测跨语言准确率。
AI.conclusion: 支持对英文构建流水线进行"有条件复用"，但按领域、按语言的验证仍不可或缺；不能依赖语义相似度或自我置信度作为跨语言准确率的代理指标。

title: AgenTest: Mining Business Rules to Test LLM Agents for Business Logic Bugs
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute business operations through tools and interact directly with application data and services. Beyond completing user requests, these agents must obey domain-specific business rules that constrain when actions are permitted and what data or resources may be affected. Violating such rules can lead to business logic bugs, even when a task appears successful. Detecting these bugs is difficult because the rules are rarely available as explicit, testable specifications. They are distributed across system prompts and tool definitions, while others remain implicit in domain knowledge. Existing agent testing approaches typically evaluate task success, predefined policies, or known attack scenarios. This limits their ability to systematically uncover previously unspecified business-rule violations.
  We present AgenTest, which mines business rules from system prompts, tool definitions, and domain knowledge, refines them into Given-When-Then specifications, and systematically tests each specification. For each extracted specification, AgenTest instantiates its Given conditions by constructing a satisfying environment state and simulated user, exercises the agent through multi-turn interactions, and checks its Then conditions over messages, tool calls, and state changes using a hybrid oracle. On the airline, retail, and telecom agents of tau2-bench with two underlying models, AgenTest produces 551 refined specifications, and detects violations of 89 and 121 distinct specifications, respectively -- 3.4X and 2.5X as many as all baselines combined. Only AgenTest detects cases where an agent improperly accesses or modifies another user's data. Moreover, about 60% of bug-triggering runs cannot be detected from the final state alone, highlighting the need to check the full interaction against explicit business rules.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgenTest，从系统提示、工具定义与领域知识中挖掘业务规则，精炼为 Given-When-Then 规格并系统化测试 LLM agent，在 tau2-bench 三领域中检出 89/121 个规格违规，远超基线。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 执行业务操作时须遵守领域业务规则，但规则分散于系统提示、工具定义，或隐含于领域知识中，缺少显式可测规格；现有测试只评估任务成功率、预定义策略或已知攻击场景，难以发现未明确规定的业务规则违规。
AI.method: AgenTest 分三阶段：(1) 从系统提示、工具定义和领域知识中挖掘业务规则；(2) 将其精炼为 Given-When-Then 规格；(3) 对每条规格，构造满足 Given 的环境状态与模拟用户，通过多轮交互驱动 agent，并用混合 oracle 在消息、工具调用和状态变更上检验 Then 条件。
AI.result: 在 tau2-bench 的 airline、retail、telecom 三个 agent（两种底层模型）上生成 551 条精炼规格，分别检出 89 和 121 条不同规格的违规，为所有基线合计的 3.4 倍与 2.5 倍；仅 AgenTest 发现 agent 不当访问或修改他人数据的情况；约 60% 的触发缺陷的运行无法仅凭最终状态检测。
AI.conclusion: 基于显式业务规则规格的系统化测试能有效揭示现有方法遗漏的业务逻辑缺陷，且必须检查完整交互轨迹而非仅最终状态。

title: MatchCityLoc: Aerial Localization in LoD City Models via Surface Normal Matching
summary: Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) navigation in urban environments requires precise pose estimation. Because Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) signals are often unreliable in cities, visual localization serves as a crucial complement. Within this domain, textureless Level-of-Detail (LoD) city models provide a lightweight and privacy-preserving substitute for heavy 3D textured meshes. However, localizing against abstract geometry is challenging. Existing pipelines typically score 2D silhouette overlaps, which can suffer from severe geometric ambiguities. We present MatchCityLoc, a framework that shifts this paradigm to direct feature matching from a noisy 6-DoF pose prior. By extracting surface normals from the query image using a zero-shot foundation model and matching them against rendered LoD normals, we establish explicit 3D-to-2D correspondences. This enables a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) pose solve, which we iteratively refine through a render-and-match loop. Experiments demonstrate strong pose recall and accurate translation and rotation among the evaluated off-the-shelf LoD-based methods with very few renderings. By bridging the modality gap between aerial imagery and texture-free geometry, MatchCityLoc enables accurate localization using lightweight, privacy-preserving city models.

AI.tldr: MatchCityLoc：从6-DoF位姿先验出发，用零样本基础模型提取图像表面法向，与渲染的LoD法向直接做3D-2D匹配，经PnP求解并用render-and-match迭代精化，实现无纹理城市LoD模型下的无人机视觉定位。
AI.motivation: 城市中GNSS不可靠，视觉定位是关键补充；无纹理LoD城市模型轻量且保护隐私，可替代重型纹理网格。但现有方法依赖2D轮廓重叠打分，存在严重几何歧义，且难以在抽象几何上精确定位。
AI.method: 不再使用轮廓重叠评分，而是转向特征匹配：用零样本基础模型从查询图像提取表面法向，与渲染LoD模型得到的法向匹配，建立显式3D-2D对应；据此求解PnP得到位姿，再通过render-and-match循环迭代精化。整个流程从含噪6-DoF先验出发，所需渲染次数很少。
AI.result: 在评估的现成LoD方法中取得较强的位姿召回率，平移与旋转精度高，且仅需极少量渲染即可达到。
AI.conclusion: 通过弥合航空影像与无纹理几何之间的模态差异，MatchCityLoc证明仅用轻量、隐私友好的城市模型即可实现准确的无人机定位。

title: PORA: Learning When More Reasoning Pays Off for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents perform tasks over multiple steps and revise their actions based on feedback. As the total reasoning budget is often limited and must support future steps, the agent must choose between short and long reasoning before each action. Longer reasoning may improve the final task outcome by preventing later errors, but it also uses budget capacity that may be needed for future decisions. This creates two challenges: estimating the downstream value of long reasoning and deciding when that value is worth using the remaining budget. We propose Paired Outcome-guided Reasoning Allocation (PORA), which learns this decision by comparing short and long reasoning from the same interaction state. During training, \method{} completes the task twice from each selected state, once with a short reasoning allowance and once with a long allowance, and compares their final quality and total processing to estimate when longer reasoning is valuable. During inference, a controller weighs this estimate against learned prices on remaining-budget pressure and chooses either short or long reasoning without running both alternatives. We evaluate PORA across application, memory, code, retail, and mathematics tasks, achieving strong results across all settings. On BFCL memory, it exceeds the strongest existing method by 17.4--32.9 percentage points. Within the same agent, it matches or exceeds always using long reasoning on code and mathematics with 50.6% fewer actor tokens and 31.2% fewer model requests, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出PORA方法，通过学习“短推理vs长推理”的成对结果对比，让LLM智能体在有限推理预算下自适应决定每步用短还是长推理。
AI.motivation: 智能体多步任务中总推理预算有限且需支撑后续步骤，每步都要在短推理与长推理间权衡：长推理可减少后续错误但消耗未来所需预算。核心难点是估计长推理的下游价值并判断何时值得花费剩余预算。
AI.method: Paired Outcome-guided Reasoning Allocation：训练时从每个选定交互状态出发，以短、长两种推理额度各完成一次任务，比较最终质量与总处理开销以估计长推理价值；推理时用控制器将该估计与学习得到的剩余预算压力价格相权衡，直接选择短或长推理，无需同时运行两种方案。
AI.result: 在应用、记忆、代码、零售、数学任务上均取得强结果。BFCL memory任务超过最强基线17.4–32.9个百分点；在代码与数学任务中，同等智能体下达到或超过“始终长推理”，分别节省50.6%的actor token与31.2%的模型请求。
AI.conclusion: PORA通过成对结果对比与预算价格学习，实现了有效的推理预算自适应分配，在提升/匹配性能的同时显著降低推理开销。

title: Ontic state recovery through prediction
summary: We encounter a system through its responses, yet its state concerns how the system is. Predicting further responses promises knowledge beyond what is immediately observed. What that knowledge tells us about the system's state depends on what we mean by a state in the first place. We give this notion a model-relative meaning: a state is the complete response profile over a specified query universe, and configurations agreeing on every query are regarded as the same state. From this perspective, a learned state is understood through the distinctions between these profiles that it retains. Prediction concerns selected observations; recovery concerns the profile as a whole. We examine their relationship through query ambiguity, state-space geometry, and the choice of prediction targets. Synthetic systems with known response laws and neural recordings provide complementary settings for this investigation. The aim is to clarify how prediction can become a way of knowing a system, and what it would mean for a learned state to preserve the state being studied.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种"模型相对"的状态定义：状态即系统在指定查询全域上的完整响应剖面。学习到的状态应以它保留的剖面区分为衡量标准，并探讨预测与状态恢复的关系。
AI.motivation: 我们只能通过系统的响应来接触它，但状态关乎系统"本身如何"。预测未观测响应有望带来超出即时观测的知识，而这类知识对状态的解释取决于"状态"的定义本身。
AI.method: 给出模型相对的状态模型：状态=在指定查询全域上的完整响应剖面，任意在所有查询上一致的配置视为同一状态。从该视角出发，通过三个角度分析预测与恢复的关系：查询歧义性、状态空间几何、预测目标的选择。使用两类互补场景：具有已知响应规律的合成系统，以及神经记录数据。
AI.result: 从理论上刻画了预测仅关注选定观测、而恢复关注整个剖面两者之间的张力，并借助查询歧义、状态空间几何与目标选择三方面展开分析；在合成系统与神经记录中进行了互补性检验。
AI.conclusion: 有助于澄清预测如何成为认识系统的一种方式，以及"学习到的状态保留被研究对象状态"意味着什么。

title: Discrete Neural Interlingua for Ontology-Agnostic EHR Modeling
summary: EHR foundation models promise scalable clinical prediction across health systems, yet their deployment is constrained by a tokenization bottleneck. The same clinical concept can appear as different ontology codes, local identifiers, synonyms, or free-text descriptions, which standard EHR tokenizers treat as unrelated symbols. A model trained on MIMIC-III with a closed-vocabulary tokenizer can use only 13% of eICU events. We introduce MEDIATOR, a discrete ontology-agnostic tokenizer that maps any clinical concept expressed as text into a shared vector-quantized codebook, turning EHR harmonization into open-vocabulary tokenization without manual mappings or a fixed vocabulary. Trained with synonym supervision and guided by enriched concept descriptions, code co-occurrence, and relation graphs, MEDIATOR collapses equivalent expressions while organizing distinct concepts in a medically meaningful discrete space. Used as the token interface of an EHR Transformer, MEDIATOR improves mean AUPRC over the strongest prior tokenizer by 4.0 points (8% relative) on 20 MIMIC-III tasks and by 8.6 points (29% relative) in zero-shot transfer to 14 eICU tasks, where it uses all events. The transfer gain combines coverage and representation, as MEDIATOR remains the best tokenizer under identical inputs (+1.0 and +1.9 points on operational and subcohort-mortality tasks). Same-encoder controls show that the text encoder drives in-domain accuracy, while the learned objectives of MEDIATOR drive transfer robustness and entity-linking quality. MEDIATOR also enables transferable attribution across hospitals.

AI.tldr: MEDIATOR 是一个离散、与本体无关的 EHR 分词器，把任意以文本表达的临床概念映射到共享向量量化码本，实现开放式词汇的分词与跨医院迁移，在 MIMIC-III 上提升 4.0 个 AUPRC 点，零样本迁移 eICU 提升 8.6 个点。
AI.motivation: EHR 基础模型受分词瓶颈制约：同一临床概念可能以不同本体编码、本地标识符、同义词或自由文本出现，而标准分词器把它们当作无关符号，导致封闭词表模型在 MIMIC-III 训练后仅能利用 eICU 中 13% 的事件。
AI.method: 提出 MEDIATOR，无需人工映射或固定词表，将文本形式的临床概念编码到共享向量量化码本中；训练时使用同义词监督，并借助增强的概念描述、编码共现与关系图作为引导，使等价表达被合并、不同概念在离散空间中有医学意义地组织；作为 EHR Transformer 的分词接口使用。
AI.result: 相比最强先前分词器，20 个 MIMIC-III 任务平均 AUPRC 提高 4.0 点（相对 8%）；零样本迁移到 14 个 eICU 任务提高 8.6 点（相对 29%），且覆盖全部事件。同等输入条件下仍最优（operational 任务 +1.0、亚组死亡率 +1.9）。同编码器对照表明文本编码器决定域内准确率，MEDIATOR 的学习目标决定迁移鲁棒性与实体链接质量，并支持跨医院的可迁移归因。
AI.conclusion: 开放词汇、本体无关的离散分词是解决 EHR 跨系统统一与迁移的有效路径，兼具覆盖度与表示质量优势，并支持可解释的跨机构归因。

title: From Code Generator to Engineering Companion: A Plant-aware Agent for PLC Programming
summary: Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) coding remains a manual, IDE-centric task that demands constant context switching between documentation, project files, and code editors. Recent work has demonstrated that retrieval-augmented large language models can generate vendor-compliant Structured Text at high compilation rates \cite{pred}, yet these systems treat code generation as a one-shot pipeline: the engineer submits a query and receives code, with no persistent knowledge of the specific plant. We present a plant-aware conversational copilot that extends this paradigm in three directions: plant-specific context ingestion, a chat-first interaction model for explanation and debugging, and a graduated tool-access ladder from chat to deployment. The system is designed for real plant infrastructure and keeps the engineer in control of each step that produces real-world effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个"工厂感知"的对话式 PLC 编程助手，将一次性代码生成扩展为具备工厂专属上下文、聊天优先交互和分级工具权限的持续协作系统。
AI.motivation: 现有基于检索增强大模型的 PLC 代码生成（如 \cite{pred}）虽能生成合规的 Structured Text 且编译率高，但属于一次性流水线：工程师提交查询、获得代码，系统对具体工厂/装置没有持久知识，也缺乏解释、调试与实际部署的连贯支持。
AI.method: 在原有检索增强生成范式上做三方面扩展：(1) 工厂特定上下文摄取，让系统持久掌握特定装置信息；(2) 以聊天为先的交互模型，支持代码解释与调试；(3) 从对话到部署的分级工具访问阶梯。系统面向真实工厂基础设施设计，每一步产生现实影响的操作都保留工程师的人工控制权。
AI.result: 摘要为系统描述性表述，未给出量化实验结果；主要成果是一个面向真实工厂部署、兼具上下文持久化与权限渐进升级的对话式助手机制设计。
AI.conclusion: 将 PLC 编码助手从"一次性代码生成"转向"持续、工厂感知、对话驱动"的协作范式，并通过分级工具权限与人工把关，在提升可用性的同时保证工业现场的安全与可控性。

title: PRIMFLOW: Learning Trajectory Primitives for Few-Step Distillation
summary: Few-step trajectory distillation aims to learn accurate global updates from dense local supervision along a teacher's sampling trajectory. Existing approaches construct within-step dynamics using specific trajectory parameterizations or discrete interval predictions, tying the learned update to a prescribed temporal structure. We propose \method, which directly learns a continuous trajectory primitive representing cumulative displacement along the teacher trajectory. By supervising finite differences of the primitive with local teacher velocities, \method learns the accumulated motion directly, while obtaining global updates through endpoint differences. This formulation avoids prescribing a temporal basis or fixed query grid and instead learns the temporal evolution of cumulative displacement from local supervision. We further establish a local-to-global error bound to characterize how local regression errors affect full-interval displacement accuracy, and introduce endpoint absorption to eliminate the auxiliary primitive branch while preserving one-network-evaluation inference. Experiments on large-scale text-to-image generation show that \method achieves a T-FID of 20.92 and an HPSv2 score of 28.35 at one NFE, improving both metrics over a trajectory-distillation baseline. After endpoint absorption, it retains comparable performance, achieving a T-FID of 20.86 and an HPSv2 score of 28.33.

AI.tldr: 提出 \\method，直接用连续轨迹原语表示沿教师轨迹的累积位移，通过局部速度监督有限差分、端点差得到全局更新，并给出局部到全局误差界与端点吸收技术，实现单步高质量生成。
AI.motivation: 现有少步轨迹蒸馏方法依赖特定轨迹参数化或离散区间预测来构造步内动态，把学到的更新绑定在预设的时间结构上，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 学习一个连续轨迹原语，表示沿教师采样轨迹的累积位移；用局部教师速度监督该原语的有限差分，从而直接学得累积运动，并通过端点差获得全局更新；不预设时间基或固定查询网格。另建立局部到全局误差界刻画局部回归误差对全区间位移精度的影响，并引入端点吸收以去除辅助原语分支，同时保持单次网络评估推理。
AI.result: 大规模文生图实验中，1 NFE 下达到 T-FID 20.92、HPSv2 28.35，均优于轨迹蒸馏基线；端点吸收后性能相当，为 T-FID 20.86、HPSv2 28.33。
AI.conclusion: 以连续轨迹原语取代预设时间结构，可更灵活有效地学习累积位移，兼具理论误差保证与单步推理效率，蒸馏效果与部署成本均具优势。

title: EDMA: Entropy-Driven Multimodal Answering
summary: Multimodal question answering (MMQA) is based on integrating heterogeneous data sources, selectively leveraging relevant modalities, and ignoring distractors. Existing approaches based on Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) improve performance by splitting the task into intermediate steps, but do not quantify how each modality contributes to reaching the final answer. We argue that quantifying the effect that each modality has on the answering process improves process traceability and final performance. Thus, we propose Entropy-Driven Multimodal Answering (EDMA), which uses logical entropy to formalise multimodal QA as an iterative process of entropy reduction and to quantify the contribution of each modality in distinguishing correct from incorrect candidate answers. This enables the construction of quantifiable answering trajectories, where each step is associated with a measurable entropy reduction. EDMA introduces (i) modality-conditioned partitioning to estimate unimodal entropy reduction, (ii) entropy-driven multimodal fusion to capture complementary information across modalities, and (iii) entropy-based selection of the answering trajectory that minimises the most logical entropy. Evaluated across standard MMQA benchmarks, EDMA outperforms competitive prompting baselines, with average gains of 12.8 F1 and 4.6 LLM-J points over Planning Prompting and 18.6 F1 and 8.3 LLM-J points over Chain-of-Thought. Moreover, EDMA outperforms self-consistency baselines and is competitive with the multi-agent system baseline. Moreover, we show that higher entropy correlates with more false positives and, through controlled trajectory selection, demonstrate that logical entropy serves as an effective, monotonic selector for correct reasoning paths, validating entropy level as a reliable proxy for performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出EDMA框架，用逻辑熵把多模态问答形式化为迭代式的熵降低过程，量化每种模态对区分正确/错误候选答案的贡献，并据此选择最优答题轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MLLM的方法虽通过拆解中间步骤提升效果，但未量化各模态对最终答案的贡献，缺乏过程可追溯性。作者认为量化各模态影响可同时提升可追溯性与最终性能。
AI.method: EDMA包含三部分：(i) 模态条件划分，估计单模态的熵降低；(ii) 熵驱动的多模态融合，捕获模态间互补信息；(iii) 基于熵的轨迹选择，选取逻辑熵最小的答题轨迹，从而构建每步都有可测熵降的可量化答题轨迹。
AI.result: 在标准MMQA基准上，相比Planning Prompting平均提升12.8 F1、4.6 LLM-J，相比Chain-of-Thought提升18.6 F1、8.3 LLM-J；优于self-consistency基线，与多智能体系统基线具竞争力。此外发现熵越高假阳性越多，受控轨迹选择实验证明逻辑熵是正确推理路径的有效单调选择器。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑熵可作为性能的可靠代理指标（熵越低答案越可能正确），EDMA通过熵驱动的模态量化与轨迹选择实现了更可追溯且更优的多模态问答。

title: Representing short-term movement to reveal animal identity and learning progress
comment: The first three authors contribute equally to this work
summary: How learning progresses over time and varies across individuals is a longstanding question in cognitive and behavioral science. However, a major challenge is identifying observable behavioral measures that faithfully capture learning progression. Existing approaches commonly rely on predefined behavioral features or task-level performance, while fine-scale posture and movement in freely behaving animals remain less explored. In this paper, we ask: can short-term movement trajectories reveal learning progress and individual identity? We introduce a self-supervised representation learning framework built on a simple hypothesis: behavioral characteristics associated with identity and learning remain relatively stable over nearby time intervals. Using temporal proximity as supervision, our framework learns compact representations directly from movement trajectories without manually defining behavioral states or kinematic features. Using behavior data from freely behaving rats, we show that the learned representations not only improve prediction of identity and learning-related readouts over existing methods, but also provide a tool for investigating broader scientific questions about when and how these signals appear in behavior. Specifically, trajectories as short as one second contain informative learning and identity signals. Egocentric pose dynamics are more predictive of identity, whereas allocentric motion is more predictive of learning-related variation, and both signals are strongest at decision junctions in the alternation cohort. We further use a representation-conditioned diffusion model to inspect movement patterns associated with identity and learning progress. Our findings establish short-term movement as an informative behavioral "fingerprint" for studying learning and individual differences. Our code is available at https://github.com/pizhn/TRAIL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出自监督表征学习框架TRAIL，利用时间邻近性作为监督信号，从自由行为大鼠的短时运动轨迹中直接学习紧凑表征，证明短至1秒的轨迹即可同时包含学习进展与个体身份信息。
AI.motivation: 如何找到忠实反映学习进程的可观测行为指标是认知与行为科学的长期难题。现有方法多依赖预定义行为特征或任务级表现，缺乏对自由行为动物细粒度姿态与运动的探索。
AI.method: 基于"与身份和学习相关的行为特征在邻近时间区间内相对稳定"的假设，以时间邻近性为监督信号，构建自监督表征学习框架，无需人工定义行为状态或运动学特征即可从轨迹直接学习表征；并进一步用表征条件扩散模型检视与身份和学习相关的运动模式。
AI.result: 在大鼠自由行为数据上，所学表征对身份和学习相关读数的预测优于现有方法；1秒轨迹即含信息；自我中心姿态动力学更预测身份，非自我中心运动更预测学习相关变化；两类信号在交替队列的决策节点处最强。
AI.conclusion: 短时运动可作为研究学习与个体差异的信息化行为"指纹"，为探讨这些信号何时、如何出现提供工具。

title: Foreword: Pre-Generation Prediction and Characterisation of LLM Test Failures using the Jacobian Lens
summary: Testing LLM-based software is expensive: each input needs several sampled responses, each judged by a costly oracle. Further, every prompt or model change calls for re-testing. Pre-generation adequacy measures cut this cost by ranking inputs by failure risk based on the model's internal state. However, the state of the art, Clotho, models only passing reference inputs, and its hidden-state representation says nothing about why inputs fail. We present Foreword, a framework built on two ideas: learn from both passing and failing references, and represent inputs through the Jacobian lens (J-lens), an interpretability technique that reads intermediate activations out as scores over vocabulary tokens. Foreword pairs these representations with two estimators: a sparse logistic-regression probe or dual Gaussian Mixture Models (dual GMMs), which also yield a reference density (to flag inputs the references do not cover) and failing-class components (to group similar failures). On ten tasks and three open-weight LLMs, all four combinations of representations and estimators outperform Clotho on average, both for prediction of failure (ROC-AUC improves by 0.14 on average and by up to 0.31) and test prioritisation (15% more failures among the 100 top-ranked inputs on average, up to 33%). Prioritisation obtained using small models also transfers better to proprietary models (on average 22% and up to 41% more failures in the first quarter of prioritised inputs). Importantly, our qualitative case study shows that Foreword supports semantic characterisation of failures by pointing to ambiguities in labels or task specifications. Combined, Foreword can support testers for prioritising inputs, checking support for a prediction, and characterising specific failures, all without generating output.

AI.tldr: Foreword通过同时学习通过/失败参考样本，并用Jacobian lens表示输入，实现免生成的LLM软件测试充分性预测，在十个任务三个开源模型上全面超越Clotho。
AI.motivation: LLM测试成本高：每个输入需多次采样响应且由昂贵oracle判定，且每次提示或模型变更都要重测。现有预生成充分性方法Clotho仅建模通过的参考输入，且其隐状态表示无法解释失败原因。
AI.method: 提出Foreword框架，两大要点：(1)同时从通过和失败的参考样本中学习；(2)用J-lens（Jacobian lens）可解释性技术将中间激活读出为词表token上的分数来表示输入。搭配两种估计器：稀疏逻辑回归探针或双高斯混合模型（dual GMM，可给出参考密度以标记未被覆盖的输入，并用失败类分量聚类相似失败）。
AI.result: 在10个任务和3个开源权重LLM上，四种表示×估计器组合平均均优于Clotho：失败预测ROC-AUC平均提升0.14（最高0.31）；测试优先级排序中top-100输入内失败数平均多15%（最高33%）。小模型得到的排序迁移到专有模型效果更好（优先输入前四分之一中失败数平均多22%，最高41%）。定性案例显示Foreword可指向标签或任务规格的歧义，实现失败语义刻画。
AI.conclusion: Foreword无需生成输出即可支持测试者进行输入优先级排序、检验预测的支持度以及刻画具体失败，为LLM软件测试提供低成本、可解释的预生成充分性方案。

title: CARLAR Influence: A Structured Hallucination Risk in Multimodal Cheque Extraction and an Exploratory Compressed-Image Countermeasure
summary: Multimodal large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for structured extraction from financial documents, but their behavior under visual ambiguity is poorly understood. We study CARLAR (Courtesy Amount Recognition and Legal Amount Recognition) influence: a model returns the same amount for both cheque fields even though their annotations differ, including cases with a blank annotation encoded as zero. Across ten visual prompting conditions, we evaluate GPT-4.1 and Claude 4.5 Sonnet on 243 primary cheques (124 with two observed unequal amounts) and 598 strict mismatches from two additional datasets. Under courtesy redaction, GPT-4.1 CARLAR reaches 73.7 percent (95 percent bootstrap interval: 68.3 to 79.0; p below 0.001 versus baseline). Model-reported confidence can remain high when predictions agree; expected calibration error reaches 0.93 among CARLAR cases. We also test a compressed-image few-shot intervention that presents examples as one visual table without model fine-tuning. On the 243-case cohort, Claude's Control condition increases paired joint extraction accuracy by 11.5 percentage points (95 percent interval: 6.2 to 16.9; adjusted p = 0.00054), but its strict-124 gain is smaller and not significant after correction. The intervention's effect on predicted-field agreement is model-dependent: it decreases for Claude and increases for GPT-4.1. These results motivate validation methods that account for visual context and dependencies between extracted fields.

AI.tldr: 研究多模态大模型在金融票据视觉歧义下的CARLAR现象（模型对支票两个金额字段给出一致输出，即使标注不同），并提出压缩图像少样本干预。
AI.motivation: 多模态LLM被广泛用于金融文档结构化抽取，但其在视觉歧义下的行为了解不足；尤其两个相关金额字段间的依赖可能导致系统性错误。
AI.method: 在10种视觉提示条件下评测GPT-4.1与Claude 4.5 Sonnet：243张主支票（124张存在两个观测不等金额）及两个额外数据集的598个严格不匹配样本；统计CARLAR发生率、置信度校准（ECE）；再测试将示例压缩为单张视觉表格的免微调少样本干预。
AI.result: courtesy redaction下GPT-4.1的CARLAR率达73.7%（95%区间68.3–79.0，p<0.001）；CARLAR案例中ECE高达0.93但模型自报置信度仍高。Claude的Control条件使243例配对联合抽取准确率提升11.5个百分点（6.2–16.9，校正p=0.00054），但严格124例子集增益较小且校正后不显著；干预对字段一致性的影响依模型而异（Claude下降，GPT-4.1上升）。
AI.conclusion: 结果为负面/警示性：视觉歧义会引发字段间错误级联且置信度不可靠；需采用考虑视觉上下文与字段依赖的验证方法，干预效果有限且模型依赖。

title: MoSAIK: Motion Search with Artificial Intelligence in K-space
summary:
Object:
  Motion artefacts remain a major limitation of routine two-dimensional T2-weighted turbo spin-echo (TSE) brain MRI, reducing diagnostic confidence and often necessitating repeated acquisitions. MoSAIK (Motion Search with AI in K-space) retrospectively estimates in-plane rigid-body motion directly from standard multi-coil TSE k-space. Without a motion-free reference, external navigators, or additional acquisitions, MoSAIK infers motion from k-space self-consistency violations and incorporates predicted parameters into model-based, motion-aware reconstruction rather than synthesizing corrected images.
  Materials and Methods:
  Selected complex coil data were represented as log-magnitude and phase channels. A decoupled convolutional embedding and Transformer encoder estimated phase-encoding-line-indexed rotation and two-dimensional translations. Training used motion-free clinical acquisitions with simulated motion; four held-out subjects were evaluated. Component-wise errors assessed estimation; SSIM and PSNR in silico and entropy focus criterion (EFC) in vivo assessed reconstruction.
  Results:
  Motion estimation errors were low for both rotation (MSE $<$ 0.2 deg$^2$) and translation (MSE $<$ 0.2 pixels$^2$), with Pearson correlations of approximately 0.96 and 0.94, respectively. In every in-vivo acquisition, more than 75% of slices showed information gain relative to uncorrected reconstructions. MoSAIK reduced visible artefacts while preserving anatomical detail.
  Discussion:
  Transformer-based k-space motion-trajectory estimation enables fast retrospective correction of standard clinical TSE brain MRI.

AI.tldr: MoSAIK 从常规多线圈 T2 TSE 脑 MRI 的 k 空间自洽性中回顾性估计平面刚体运动参数，并将其用于运动感知重建，从而无需导航器或额外采集即可抑制运动伪影。
AI.motivation: 二维 T2 加权 TSE 脑 MRI 中运动伪影严重降低诊断信心并常导致重复扫描；现有方法依赖无运动参考、外部导航器或额外采集，难以用于常规临床数据。
AI.method: 将选定复数线圈数据表示为对数幅值与相位通道，用解耦卷积嵌入加 Transformer 编码器估计按相位编码行索引的旋转与二维平移；训练采用无运动临床数据加模拟运动，在四名留出受试者上评估。估计误差按分量评估，重建用体外 SSIM/PSNR 与体内熵聚焦准则（EFC）评估。
AI.result: 旋转与平移估计误差均很低（MSE 分别 <0.2 deg²、<0.2 pixels²），Pearson 相关约 0.96 与 0.94；所有体内采集中超过 75% 的层面相对未校正重建获得信息增益；伪影明显减少且解剖细节得以保留。
AI.conclusion: 基于 Transformer 的 k 空间运动轨迹估计可实现标准临床 TSE 脑 MRI 的快速回顾性运动校正，具有常规临床推广潜力。

title: A Hybrid TFT-NBEATS Framework for Robust Multi-Horizon Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
summary: Accurate multi-horizon photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting is essential for grid stability, energy scheduling, and the efficient operation of PVbatterygrid systems. However, existing models often fail to jointly capture short-term variability and long-term temporal patterns, while lacking unified multi-horizon capability and interpretability. To address these limitations, this study proposes a novel hybrid deep learning framework that integrates a Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and N-BEATS within an attention-based fusion architecture. The proposed model leverages TFT to learn short-term temporal dependencies and dynamic feature importance, while N-BEATS captures long-term trend and seasonal components through interpretable basis decomposition. An adaptive attention mechanism dynamically fuses both branches, enabling balanced multi-scale learning. The framework simultaneously generates forecasts for 30-minute, 2-hour, 6-hour, 12-hour, and 24-hour horizons within a single unified pipeline. The model is evaluated using multi-year real-world datasets from the Desert Knowledge Australia Solar Centre (DKASC). Experimental results demonstrate superior performance over statistical, machine learning, and deep learning baselines. The proposed model achieves RMSE values of 42.35, 46.27, 52.29, and 48.11 across the 20162017, 2023, 2024, and 20252026 datasets, respectively, corresponding to a 3540% reduction compared to the best baseline (TFT). Additionally, MAPE remains below 5% across all datasets, indicating high predictive accuracy and stability. The model also provides interpretability through attention visualization and trendseasonality decomposition, and is deployed on a cloud-based platform for real-time forecasting. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework is robust, interpretable, and suitable for practical renewable energy applications.

AI.tldr: 提出TFT与N-BEATS注意力融合的混合深度学习框架，实现单管线多尺度光伏功率预测（30分钟至24小时），在DKASC多年度真实数据集上RMSE较最佳基线TFT降低35–40%，MAPE低于5%，并支持可解释性与云端部署。
AI.motivation: 现有光伏功率预测模型难以同时刻画短期波动与长期时序模式，且缺乏统一的多预测时距能力与可解释性；而多时距准确预测对电网稳定性、能量调度和光伏-电池-电网系统高效运行至关重要。
AI.method: 构建基于注意力的双分支融合架构：TFT分支学习短期时序依赖与动态特征重要性，N-BEATS分支通过可解释基分解捕捉长期趋势与季节成分；自适应注意力机制动态加权融合两分支实现多尺度平衡学习，单管线同时输出30分钟、2小时、6小时、12小时、24小时五个时距预测。在DKASC多年真实数据（2016–2017、2023、2024、2025–2026）上评估。
AI.result: 在统计、机器学习和深度学习基线中表现最优；四个数据集RMSE分别为42.35、46.27、52.29、48.11，较最佳基线TFT降低35–40%；所有数据集MAPE均低于5%，精度与稳定性较高。
AI.conclusion: 该框架兼具鲁棒性与可解释性（注意力可视化、趋势-季节分解），并已部署于云平台实现实时预测，适用于实际可再生能源应用场景。

title: ICLHerd: Herding-Based Data Selection for LLMs with In-Context Learning as a Proxy
summary: Data selection plays a central role in modern large language model training, as the quality of training data strongly influences downstream performance. A common approach is to curate a development set that encodes the desired skills (e.g., reasoning or multilinguality) and select data that are similar to them. Existing methods compute similarity using cosine distance over either the model's hidden states or gradients. However, we observe that this max-similarity strategy induces a mode-seeking bias: the selected data clusters tightly around the development samples. To address this, we propose ICLHerd, a data selection framework that leverages the von Mises-Fisher kernel to balance mode-seeking with mode-averaging. We further introduce in-context learning as a validation proxy, enabling efficient hyperparameter search over the balance trade-off. Results show that ICLHerd outperforms existing LLM data selection algorithms, highlighting the importance of balancing mode-seeking and mode-averaging.

AI.tldr: 提出ICLHerd数据选择框架，用von Mises-Fisher核平衡“模式寻求”与“模式平均”，并以in-context learning作验证代理高效搜索权衡超参，性能优于现有LLM数据选择方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于余弦相似度（隐藏状态或梯度）的最大相似度选数据策略存在“模式寻求偏差”（mode-seeking bias）：选出的数据紧簇在开发集样本附近，覆盖不足，影响下游表现。
AI.method: 将数据选择建模为核密度/加权问题，采用von Mises-Fisher核在最大相似度（mode-seeking）与分布覆盖（mode-averaging）之间做平衡；并引入in-context learning作为验证代理指标，用于高效搜索平衡权衡的超参数。
AI.result: 实验表明ICLHerd优于现有LLM数据选择算法，说明平衡模式寻求与模式平均对数据选择至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 数据选择不应一味追求与开发集的最大相似，需在集中性与多样性覆盖间取得平衡；vMF核提供了可行机制，ICL代理可实现低成本调参。

title: ExeBench-FHD: Addressing Fidelity Issues in Decompiler Evaluation
summary: ExeBench is one of the most widely used benchmarks for evaluating LLM-based decompilers. We analyze ExeBench and identify nine issues that affect how faithfully a test measures a decompiler. Three of them prevent LLM decompilers from recovering C code from ExeBench's function. These are ambiguous parameter order when integer and floating-point types are mixed, unused parameters that optimized assembly may drop, and constants stored outside the function's assembly code. Six more affect test validity: non-void functions without a return, placeholder types, static or inline functions removed by the optimizer, functions named main, trivial bodies and truncated definitions. We present ExeBench-FHD, a backward-compatible revision of ExeBench that adds 16 new fields: call-site assembly, data sections, test wrappers, linked-binary disassembly and five warning flags. In ExeBench, 38.9% of functions have at least one of the five flags; dropping records with any of the four warning flags (all except unused_param, which marks functions that the new wrappers make evaluable) keeps 63.9% of the corpus. In an evaluation at -O2 on four architectures, the new fields raise GPT 6 Sol's re-execution rate by up to 26.5%, 19.1% and 21.0% on functions that read data sections, mix parameter types and have unused parameters, respectively.

AI.tldr: 作者分析 ExeBench 指其九个缺陷影响测试保真度，提出向后兼容修订版 ExeBench-FHD（新增 16 字段与 5 个警告标记）；移除四类警告后保留 63.9% 语料，且新字段在四架构 -O2 下使 GPT 6 Sol 重执行率最高提升 26.5%/19.1%/21.0%。
AI.motivation: ExeBench 是 LLM 反编译评测的主流基准，但其测试是否真实衡量反编译器能力缺乏审视；需要揭示其缺陷并给出可修正的基准。
AI.method: 系统分析 ExeBench，归纳九类问题：3 类使 LLM 无法恢复 C 代码（整数/浮点混合时的参数顺序歧义、优化汇编丢弃的未用参数、函数外存储的常量）；6 类损害测试有效性（无 return 的非 void 函数、占位类型、被优化器删除的 static/inline 函数、名为 main 的函数、平凡函数体、截断的定义）。随后构建 ExeBench-FHD，向后兼容地新增 16 个字段：调用点汇编、数据段、测试包装器、链接后二进制反汇编及 5 个警告标记。
AI.result: ExeBench 中 38.9% 函数至少带一个警告标记；剔除四类警告（除 unused_param）后保留 63.9% 语料。在 -O2、四种架构评测中，新字段使 GPT 6 Sol 在读取数据段、混合参数类型、含未用参数三类函数上的重执行率分别最高提升 26.5%、19.1%、21.0%。
AI.conclusion: 现有 ExeBench 存在系统性度量偏差，需修正而非直接弃用；ExeBench-FHD 通过补充上下文信息与警告标记，更忠实地衡量反编译能力，并可直接替代原基准。

title: Language Guidance for Supervised Vision Training: An Empirical Study of Generalization
summary: Deep neural networks have achieved remarkable success on vision benchmarks, yet they continue to struggle with many generalization challenges. Supervised vision training relies on one-hot labels, which provide limited information about semantic structure and shared attributes between classes. This limited supervision can leave visual representations vulnerable to distribution shifts, spurious correlations, texture bias, adversarial perturbations, and forgetting in sequential learning settings. We study whether pretrained language models can serve as lightweight auxiliary supervision for vision training without requiring paired image-text data, prompt engineering, or contrastive objectives. Specifically, we evaluate two forms of language guidance, Explicit Language Guidance (ExLG) and Implicit Language Guidance (ImLG). We conduct a comprehensive evaluation across six generalization regimes, including in-distribution, out-of-distribution generalization, shortcut and spurious correlation resistance, texture and shape bias, adversarial robustness, and continual learning. Our analyses show that the two mechanisms have complementary strengths, with explicit guidance consistently benefiting in-distribution, low-data performance, and continual learning retention, while implicit guidance is often more useful in shortcut-sensitive settings and under stronger adversarial perturbations. Importantly, both are lightweight and add minimal parameters and training overhead. The analyses characterize when language-derived structure helps supervised vision training and provides a practical roadmap for using off-the-shelf pretrained models from another modality as auxiliary supervision.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究能否用预训练语言模型作为视觉训练的轻量辅助监督，比较显式(ExLG)与隐式(ImLG)两种语言引导形式在六类泛化场景下的效果。
AI.motivation: 监督视觉训练依赖one-hot标签，语义结构信息有限，导致表示对分布偏移、虚假相关、纹理偏置、对抗扰动及顺序学习遗忘等问题较脆弱。
AI.method: 无需图文配对数据、提示工程或对比目标，直接利用现成预训练语言模型提供两种语言引导：显式语言引导(ExLG)与隐式语言引导(ImLG)，并以极少量额外参数与训练开销接入。
AI.result: 在六类泛化设定(同分布、OOD泛化、捷径/虚假相关抵抗、纹理与形状偏置、对抗鲁棒性、持续学习)上系统评测：ExLG在同分布、低数据及持续学习保持上稳定获益；ImLG在捷径敏感场景和更强对抗扰动下更有效，两者优势互补。
AI.conclusion: 语言衍生结构可作为有效辅助监督，论文刻画了其何时有用，并为跨模态现成预训练模型作为辅助监督提供了实用路线图。

title: Learned Control Variates for Rare Grid-Outage Estimation at Electric Vehicle Charging Stations
summary: Public charging of electric vehicles (EVs) adds a large and synchronized load to the distribution feeders. In most networks, it is rare to overload a feeder at the same time. When it does happen, the consequences can be severe: an overloaded feeder stresses its transformers and can trigger cascading outages across a city. Planners who design for high reliability therefore need to estimate very small outage probabilities. To that end, plain Monte Carlo estimation with an expensive grid simulator can require a prohibitively large number of runs for this task. To reduce the number of runs, we propose a control variate (CV) built from a learned classifier of the outage, trained on cheap observable features such as temperature and load forecasts. We show that for any binary learner, the variance reduction is an explicit function of its recall and false-positive rate. Furthermore, we show that control variate based on a Gaussian proxy of the load loses its effect as outages become rarer, while a learner with non-vanishing precision keeps removing a fixed fraction of the variance even in the extreme rare-event regime. We verify these results in numerical experiments using a feeder-overload simulator across three orders of magnitude of outage probability and obtain that even weak learner with a single feature can remove a quarter of the variance, while a boosted-tree learner is able to remove about 60%. We then apply the estimator to the feeder network of Surabaya, Indonesia, in which the Gaussian load model leaves every feeder three to seven times the one-day-in-ten-years blackout target. At the same simulation budget, planning the reserve with the learned CV and a 95% confidence limit reduces the city-wide blackout days by a third compared with Monte Carlo. These results show that learned control variates can help planners design distribution grids that stay reliable against rare outages.

AI.tldr: 用基于学习分类器（温度、负荷预测等廉价特征）的控制变量法替代昂贵电网仿真的大量蒙特卡洛运行，可高效估计极稀有馈线过载概率。
AI.motivation: 电动汽车公共充电给配电网带来大而同步的负荷，馈线过载虽罕见但后果严重（变压器应力、级联停电），规划者需估计极小停电概率；纯蒙特卡洛配合昂贵电网仿真所需运行次数难以承受。
AI.method: 构建由停电二分类器（在温度、负荷预测等廉价可观测特征上训练）导出的控制变量（CV）；理论推导任意二元学习器的方差缩减是其召回率与假阳性率的显式函数；对比高斯负荷代理CV与学习型CV在稀有事件区的表现。
AI.result: 在跨三个数量级停电概率的馈线过载仿真中，单特征弱学习器可消除约25%方差，提升树学习器约60%；高斯负荷模型的CV随事件变稀有而失效，而精度不消失的学习器在极端稀有区仍消除固定比例方差。应用于印尼泗水馈线网络：高斯负荷模型下每条馈线超出一日十年一遇目标3–7倍；同等仿真预算下用学习型CV加95%置信限规划储备，全市停电天数比蒙特卡洛减少三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 学习型控制变量可显著提升稀有停电事件的估计效率，帮助规划者设计在稀有故障下仍可靠的配电网络。

title: Understanding the Benefits of Scaffolds through Computational Separations
summary: Inference-time harnesses, i.e., external procedures that call a model many times and keep state across calls, can substantially improve model capabilities. In this paper, we investigate the benefits of using such harnesses and the extent to which these benefits can be internalized through training. More precisely, we conceptualize a harness $\mathcal{A}$ as an arbitrary wrapper around a base model $M$ and attempt to distill a student model from the harness's traces. Empirically we find that, even with simple scaffolds and small models, the inference-time harness significantly outperforms a distilled student. We then prove that such a gap is due to a fundamental representational limitation: inference-time harnesses can compute a closure of their per-call primitive that is $\NL$-complete even when the primitive is a trivial $\AC^0$ lookup, and that no fixed-depth forward pass can represent under the widely believed conjecture that $\NL\not\subseteq\TC^0$. Our theory suggests that expanding the representational capacity of the student relative to the task at hand, e.g., by enlarging the model, making the task easier, or lengthening its chain-of-thought, is necessary to close the gap, which we verify empirically. Finally, we scale to an agentic harness on competition math, where the same gap reappears. Overall, our results show that a harness confers on the base model a profound gain in representational power, one that training a same-class student on its traces cannot transfer back into the weights.

AI.tldr: 推理时"套壳"(harness)让模型多次调用并保持状态，能显著提升能力；本文发现这种提升难以通过蒸馏传递回固定的学生模型权重，并给出表示能力上的理论解释。
AI.motivation: 探究推理时harness带来的能力增益能否通过在其轨迹上训练被"内化"进模型权重。
AI.method: 将harness A视为对基座模型M的任意封装，从harness轨迹中蒸馏学生模型；并做表示能力理论分析（每次调用原语为AC^0查表时，harness的计算闭包可达NL-完全），结合实证验证扩大模型规模、简化任务、延长思维链可缩小差距。
AI.result: 即使简单脚手架和小模型，harness也显著优于蒸馏学生；在竞赛数学agentic harness上差距重现；扩大学生表示能力可验证性地缩小差距。
AI.conclusion: harness赋予基座模型深刻且本质的表示能力增益，仅靠在同分布轨迹上训练同类学生无法将其转移回权重。

title: GRID: Modeling Health Influencer Discourse as Argument Networks for Credibility Assessment
summary: Health-related discussions on social media are increasingly shaped by influencers who offer diverse, and often competing perspectives on the same issue. Yet, such content is typically evaluated in isolation, without considering the broader discourse in which it appears. We introduce GRID (Grounded Reasoning over Interconnected Discourse), a framework for evaluating influencer content through collective inference over the surrounding discourse. GRID represents each video as an argumentation graph connecting claims to its central message, or takeaway, links related claims and takeaways across videos, grounds claims in scientific evidence, and jointly infers credibility over the resulting network. We evaluate GRID on an end-to-end health-related content validation task using 569 influencer videos grounded in expert assessments. Our results show that accounting for the broader discourse improves influencer content validation. Finally, we use GRID-inferred credibility to demonstrate how argumentative strategies and moral framing differ between low- and high-credibility content.

AI.tldr: 提出GRID框架，将社交媒体网红健康内容置于周边话语网络中做集体推理，实现更可靠的可信度评估。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体健康讨论中，网红常就同一议题提供多样甚至相互冲突的观点，但现有评估多孤立地看待单条内容，忽略了其所处的话语语境。
AI.method: GRID将每个视频表示为论辩图（将论点连向核心主张/要点），跨视频链接相关论点与核心主张，用科学证据为论点提供依据，并在构建的网络上联合推断可信度。
AI.result: 在569个网红视频、以专家评估为依据的端到端健康内容验证任务上，考虑更广泛话语可提升验证效果；并揭示低可信度与高可信度内容在论证策略与道德框架上的差异。
AI.conclusion: 集体、语境化的论辩推理优于孤立评估，GRID可用于内容验证并刻画可信度相关的论证与道德特征。

title: InterWebCoder: Learning Interactive Webpage Generation from Executable Tests via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Interactive webpages underpin modern applications, but reproducing both their visual appearance and multi-step behavior remains challenging for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Scalable training data must capture user actions, state transitions, and expected outcomes, while real-world webpage code is often entangled with irrelevant scripts and external dependencies. Moreover, existing GUI-agent-based verification provides slow and potentially unstable functional feedback. To address these challenges, we propose InterWebCoder, an efficient framework for interactive webpage code generation. InterWebCoder introduces a Test-Specification-Guided and Execution-Verified Data Synthesis pipeline that records real-world interaction trajectories and synthesizes self-contained webpage code with executable test scripts. A failureattributed repair mechanism uses runtime evidence to locate and iteratively fix errors in either the webpage code or test script. We then combine test-ID-weighted supervised fine-tuning with group-relative policy optimization, directly optimizing functional correctness and visual fidelity using test pass rates and state-level visual similarity. This replaces costly GUI-agent verification with fast, reproducible executable feedback. Our pipeline produces 1,736 verified samples from 2,058 tasks, achieving an 84.35% synthesis success rate. On IWR-Bench and Vision2Web, InterWebCoder achieves final scores of 48.54 and 48.42 with a 9B backbone, outperforming 30B-level models and Gemini-3.7-Flash while remaining competitive with Claude-Sonnet-5. It reduces reward-computation latency by over 97%, eliminates external MLLM verification costs, and accelerates end-to-end training by up to 1.4x.

AI.tldr: InterWebCoder 提出一种交互式网页代码生成框架，通过"测试规范引导+执行验证"的数据合成流水线与加权SFT+GRPO训练，显著提升功能与视觉一致性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型难以同时复现网页的视觉外观与多步交互行为；真实网页代码混杂无关脚本与外部依赖，难以扩展训练数据；且现有基于GUI智能体的验证方式反馈慢且不稳定。
AI.method: 构建 Test-Specification-Guided and Execution-Verified 数据合成流水线，记录真实交互轨迹并合成带可执行测试脚本的自包含网页代码；引入失败归因修复机制，用运行时证据定位并迭代修复网页代码或测试脚本中的错误；训练上结合测试ID加权监督微调与群体相对策略优化（GRPO），以测试通过率和状态级视觉相似度直接优化功能正确性与视觉保真度。
AI.result: 从2058个任务中产出1736个已验证样本，合成成功率84.35%；在IWR-Bench与Vision2Web上以9B主干分别取得48.54和48.42，超过30B级模型与Gemini-3.7-Flash，并与Claude-Sonnet-5保持竞争力；奖励计算延迟降低超97%，消除外部MLLM验证成本，端到端训练加速最高1.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 以可执行测试反馈替代昂贵的GUI智能体验证，是实现快速、可复现且可扩展的交互式网页代码生成训练的有效途径，小模型也能达到甚至超越大模型的性能。

title: Generalizing Multimodal Foundational Models in Context-Driven Class Incremental Learning
comment: This work has been accepted in WACV 2027
summary: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to learn new classes continuously without forgetting the previously learned ones. Recent works in CIL have significantly advanced across various modalities; however, at the intersection of audio-visual modality, this problem remains underexplored. While representations from multimodal foundational models (MFMs) encapsulate rich static priors, our preliminary analysis shows that these representations struggle in incremental settings. Motivated by this, we propose a framework that generalizes frozen MFMs to audio-visual CIL. Specifically, we leverage their dense audio and visual representations and employ an attention-based contextual guidance module, in which the audio representations serve as task-stable contextual guidance for the visual representations, enabling effective class recognition in the incremental setting. To further mitigate catastrophic forgetting and preserve stability across tasks, we employ feature- and logit-level distillation, which are primarily responsible for the reduced forgetting. Extensive evaluations across various audio-visual CIL benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/avigupta2798/MFM-CIL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个将冻结的多模态基础模型（MFM）泛化到音视频类增量学习（CIL）的框架，利用音频表征作为任务稳定的上下文引导视觉表征，并结合特征级与logit级蒸馏，在多个音视频CIL基准上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 音视频CIL问题研究不足；多模态基础模型的表征虽含丰富静态先验，但在增量场景下表现不佳，因此需要将其适配到增量学习。
AI.method: 冻结MFM并利用其稠密音频与视觉表征；设计基于注意力的上下文引导模块，以音频表征作为任务稳定的上下文引导视觉表征进行类别识别；采用特征级与logit级蒸馏以缓解灾难性遗忘、保持跨任务稳定性。
AI.result: 在多个音视频CIL基准上的广泛评估表明，该方法一致优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 冻结MFM加音频引导视觉的上下文机制与双级蒸馏，是解决音视频类增量学习的有效方案，显著减少遗忘并提升识别性能。

title: LSA-PAST: Layer-Specific Adaptation and Prototype Transport for Compositional Incremental Learning
summary: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) enables models to recognize new classes over time while retaining prior knowledge, but many real-world problems are compositional, where visual concepts arise from combinations of primitives such as states (i.e., red, shiny) and objects (i.e., shoe, car). Standard CIL methods treat each composition as an independent class, ignoring shared primitives and providing no mechanism to stabilize their representations as new compositions arrive. This causes parameter updates to entangle primitives and induce drift that degrades performance on earlier compositions. Compositional Incremental Learning (composition-IL) formalizes this setting by introducing new state-object compositions across tasks. In this paper, we propose Layer-Specific Adaptation with Prototype-Anchored Adapter-Space Transport (LSA-PAST), a parameter-efficient method tailored to composition-IL. LSA integrates Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) into a frozen ViT with depth-specialized adapters for states, objects, and compositions. PAST then maps past, anchored prototypes into the current adapter space through a rehearsal-free affine transform fit on current-task data, enabling old prototypes to remain compatible with new adapters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LSA-PAST achieves state-of-the-art (SOA) accuracy-forgetting trade-off performance for composition-IL.

AI.tldr: 提出 LSA-PAST，一种面向组合增量学习（composition-IL）的参数高效方法：在冻结 ViT 上按深度为状态、物体、组合设置专用 LoRA 适配器，并用免回放的仿射变换把旧原型映射到当前适配器空间，实现更优准确率-遗忘权衡。
AI.motivation: 现实问题常具组合性，视觉概念由状态（如红色、闪亮）与物体（如鞋、车）等原语组合而成。标准 CIL 把每个组合当作独立类别，忽略共享原语，也没有机制在新组合到来时稳定原语表示，导致参数更新使原语纠缠并产生漂移，降低旧组合上的性能。
AI.method: （1）形式化 Compositional Incremental Learning 设定：跨任务引入新的状态-物体组合。（2）LSA：将 LoRA 融入冻结 ViT，并按深度设置分别针对状态、物体、组合的专用适配器。（3）PAST：无需回放，用当前任务数据拟合仿射变换，把带锚点的旧原型映射到当前适配器空间，使旧原型与新适配器兼容。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，LSA-PAST 在 composition-IL 上取得了当前最优（SOA）的准确率-遗忘权衡表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过深度专用 LoRA 适配器与原型锚定适配器空间传输，可在免回放条件下缓解原语表示漂移，是组合增量学习的一种有效且参数高效的方案。

title: Meta-iLaD: Identifiable Latent Dynamics via Meta-Learning of Dynamics Environments
summary: Learning latent dynamics is central to assessing the current states and forecasting the future trajectories of high-dimensional time series. For locally-stationary latent dynamics $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{z}_{<t}; \mathbf{c})$ with latent dynamics state $\mathbf{z}_t$ and environment variable $\mathbf{c}$, prior identifiability results have largely focused on $\mathbf{z}_t$ when conditioned on predefined label $u$ of dynamics environments. This leaves two limitations: reliance on predefined labels that hinder generalization to unseen environments, and a limited understanding of the identifiability of $\mathcal{F}$ and $\mathbf{c}$ which -- although offering important structural properties for the identifiability of $\mathbf{z}_t$ -- are learned jointly with $\mathbf{z}_t$. We address these limitations with Meta-iLaD, a novel identifiable latent dynamics framework attained by meta-learning across dynamics environments. Meta-iLaD introduces a novel conditional prior of $\mathbf{c}$, modeled as a feedforward meta-learner to rapidly extract $\mathbf{c}$ from few-shot examples. Meta-iLaD further establishes identifiability for $\mathbf{z}_t$, $\mathbf{c}$, and $\mathcal{F}$ simultaneously, for a general formulation of $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{z}_{< t};\mathbf{c})$ without restricting the dimension of $\mathbf{c}$ or how it modulates $\mathcal{F}$. On synthetic and real data, we provide strong empirical evidence that 1) conditioning on few-shot examples enables generalization to out-of-distribution environments, and 2) identifiability for $\mathbf{c}$ and $\mathcal{F}$ is critical for accurate forecasting beyond reconstructing observed trajectories. Code is available at https://github.com/GoForIt-YYB/Meta-iLaD.

AI.tldr: 提出Meta-iLaD框架，通过跨动力学环境元学习摆脱预定义环境标签依赖，并同时建立潜状态、环境变量和动力学函数的可辨识性。
AI.motivation: 现有局部平稳潜动力学（如F(z_{<t};c)）的可辨识性研究多聚焦于给定环境标签u下的z_t，存在两大局限：依赖预定义标签导致难以泛化到未见环境；对F和c的可辨识性理解不足，而二者与z_t联合学习，其结构性质对z_t可辨识性至关重要。
AI.method: 提出Meta-iLaD框架：为环境变量c引入新的条件先验，将其建模为前馈元学习器，从少量样本（few-shot）中快速提取c；在F(z_{<t};c)的一般形式下同时建立z_t、c与F的可辨识性，且不限制c的维度及其调制F的方式。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据上验证：1）基于few-shot样本的条件化可泛化到分布外环境；2）c与F的可辨识性对于超越轨迹重构的准确预测至关重要。
AI.conclusion: Meta-iLaD通过元学习实现无标签的环境推断与联合可辨识性，提升了对未见环境的泛化与预测精度，并为高维时序潜动力学学习提供了理论保障。

title: SITO: Sifting a Commercial Text-Safety API for Missed Harm and False Flags in English, Ukrainian and Surzhyk
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10883
summary: Platforms that host young users screen messages with commercial text-safety APIs, but independent evidence on how often such systems miss harm or flag harmless text is scarce, especially outside English, and the documentation of the one studied here leaves its false-positive rate unquantified. We evaluated one such API, Tuteliq Detect as deployed under the release identifier tuteliq-detect-v5.20261011 (not the separately published v6 model), on six harm categories: authorised push-payment fraud, money-mule recruitment, social engineering, romance scams, gambling harm and bullying. We built SITO (Synthetic Independent Text-safety benchmark with Overflagging tests; sito is Ukrainian for 'sieve'), 2,332 synthetic cases in English, Ukrainian and mixed Ukrainian, with each harmful case matched by hard harmless ones: same-topic messages, minimal-edit contrasts, warnings and retrospective accounts. On English text the system flagged 84.9-94.1% of harmful cases and 0-4.3% of harmless ones per category. It missed third-party reports of ongoing harm far more often than perpetrators' messages (63.6% against 95.1% recall, all languages), when sent without the settings the API offers for reports of harm. Ukrainian and mixed-language input was detected at least as often as English, recall was lower on text from a held-out generator family, so headline recall may be optimistic, and 3.2% of cases received a different decision in repeated runs. A platform should measure false positives on its own traffic and check how bystander reports are handled. The datasets, generation prompts and code are released.

AI.tldr: 本文构建SITO基准（2,332条英/乌/混合语合成文本，含同类无害难例），评估商业文本安全API Tuteliq Detect v5在六类危害上的检出与误报，并释放数据与代码。
AI.motivation: 平台用商业文本安全API筛查青少年用户消息，但独立评测证据稀缺，尤其非英语场景；该API文档未量化误报率。
AI.method: 构建SITO合成独立基准：每个有害案例配同主题、最小编辑对比、警告与事后叙述等困难无害样本；在英语、乌克兰语、混合语上评估六类危害（APP诈骗、钱骡招募、社工、恋爱诈骗、赌博伤害、欺凌），并做重复运行稳定性与留出生成器族泛化测试。
AI.result: 英语上各类别检出84.9–94.1%、误报0–4.3%；第三方报告持续危害的召回(63.6%)远低于施害者消息(95.1%，全语种，未启用报告专用设置时)；乌语及混合语检出不低于英语；留出生成器族召回下降，说明头条召回可能偏乐观；3.2%案例重复运行结果不一致。
AI.conclusion: 平台应基于自身流量测量误报率，并核查旁观者报告的处置路径；合成基准可作补充但头条数字需谨慎解读。

title: TraceLite: Efficient Trace Reduction for SWE Agents via Optical Compression and Redundancy Removal
summary: Software engineering agents solve repository-level tasks through iterative tool use, but their continuously growing interaction traces incur substantial token consumption and inference overhead. Existing compression approaches often require model training, auxiliary LLM calls, or assumptions about specific content such as source code. We present TraceLite, a simple yet effective, training-free framework for compressing heterogeneous SWE-agent observations. Our preliminary study shows that optical rendering preserves substantial textual and semantic information under moderate compression, while agent trajectories exhibit both cross-step and phase-level redundancy. Motivated by these findings, TraceLite preserves recent observations as high-fidelity text, renders historical observations as compact images, removes overlapping content, and discards phase-expired observation payloads after code editing. It requires neither offline training nor auxiliary LLM inference. We evaluate TraceLite on SWE-bench Verified and DeepSWE using GPT-5.6-Luna and Gemini-3.8Flash as backbone models. On SWE-bench Verified, TraceLite achieves 78.25% resolve rate, outperforming the evaluated compression baselines while reducing average input-token consumption and API cost by 33.05% and 21.30%, respectively. Moreover, it introduces only 0.438 seconds of compression latency per observation. These results demonstrate that TraceLite improves SWE-agent efficiency with low processing overhead and without compromising issue-resolution capability. Our code is available at https://github.com/xjywhu/TraceLite.

AI.tldr: TraceLite 是一个免训练框架，通过"近期观察保留文本 + 历史观察渲染为图像 + 去重 + 阶段过期丢弃"来压缩 SWE agent 的交互轨迹，在 SWE-bench Verified 上达 78.25% 解决率，同时降低输入 token 与 API 成本约 33% 和 21%。
AI.motivation: SWE agent 通过迭代工具调用解决仓库级任务，交互轨迹不断增长，带来大量 token 消耗和推理开销。现有压缩方法多需模型训练、额外 LLM 调用，或依赖源码等特定内容假设，泛化性受限。
AI.method: 初步研究发现：光学渲染在中等压缩率下仍保留大量文本与语义信息；轨迹存在跨步骤和阶段级冗余。据此，TraceLite 将最近观察保留为高保真文本，把历史观察渲染为紧凑图像，删除重叠内容，并在代码编辑后丢弃阶段过期的观察负载。全程无需离线训练或辅助 LLM 推理。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 与 DeepSWE 上，以 GPT-5.6-Luna 和 Gemini-3.8Flash 为骨干评估。SWE-bench Verified 解决率 78.25%，优于所评估的压缩基线；平均输入 token 与 API 成本分别降低 33.05% 和 21.30%；每次观察仅引入 0.438 秒压缩延迟。
AI.conclusion: TraceLite 以低处理开销提升 SWE agent 效率，在不损害问题解决能力的前提下显著降低 token 与成本，且实现简单、免训练、通用性强。

title: What Not to Erase: Saliency-Constrained Augmentation for Low-Resource Handwritten Character Recognition
summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and handwritten character recognition (HCR) in low-resource historical material collections often rely on data augmentation, yet augmentation strategies are typically evaluated almost exclusively through predictive accuracy. This leaves open whether a model's improved performance is accompanied by saliency stability. This question is important in low-resource historical HCR, where recognition is performed on variable and partially degraded letterforms and two models with similar predictive performance may differ in how consistently their saliency patterns respond to such variation. We therefore study saliency-guided augmentation as an explanation-aware strategy for low-resource HCR. Rather than treating saliency maps only as post-hoc interpretations, we use them to define augmentation variants that perturb, preserve, or constrain visually informative regions of character images. We compare classical document-style transformations, random lacunae, and several saliency-constrained lacuna variants. To evaluate the effect of augmentation beyond accuracy, we introduce the Explainability Consistency Index (ECI), a metric that quantifies the stability of saliency patterns under controlled perturbations. We find that saliency-constrained augmentation can improve recognition over classical augmentation, but no single saliency strategy is consistently best. The preferred form of the constraint varies with both architecture and corpus, indicating that saliency is better treated as a mechanism for controlling augmentation than as a fixed augmentation strategy. In some settings, saliency-constrained training improves explanation consistency even when predictive performance is similar. This shows that predictive metrics alone can obscure differences in model sensitivity under perturbation, motivating explanation consistency as a complementary evaluation dimension.

AI.tldr: 论文研究低资源历史手写字符识别中显著性引导的数据增强，提出可解释性一致性指数（ECI）衡量扰动下显著性图的稳定性，发现显著性约束增强可提升识别率但最优形式随架构与语料变化。
AI.motivation: 现有低资源OCR/HCR的数据增强策略几乎只以预测准确率评估，未考察模型性能提升是否伴随显著性稳定性；而历史手写字符形变与退化明显，预测性能相近的模型在显著性一致性上可能差别很大。
AI.method: 将显著性图从后验解释工具转为增强机制，定义扰动、保留或约束字符图像中视觉信息区域的增强变体；对比经典文档式变换、随机挖孔（lacunae）及多种显著性约束挖孔变体；提出解释一致性指数（ECI）量化受控扰动下显著性模式的稳定性。
AI.result: 显著性约束增强可在识别率上优于经典增强，但无单一显著性策略始终最优；偏好约束形式随架构与语料而变；在某些设置下，即使预测性能相近，显著性约束训练仍能提升解释一致性。
AI.conclusion: 显著性更适合作为控制增强的机制而非固定增强策略；仅凭预测指标会掩盖模型在扰动下的敏感性差异，解释一致性应作为补充评估维度。

title: Sparse RL Relaxation for LLM Reasoning
summary: Recent work has explored continuous representations in place of discrete tokens during Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, often referred to as soft CoT. This is motivated by the idea that a mixture of token embeddings can represent a superposition of multiple reasoning possibilities within a single step. However, it remains challenging to train large language models to realize this potential. Existing work has explored reinforcement learning (RL)-style training for soft CoT. However, these approaches treat soft tokens as actions in a Markov decision process rather than as differentiable intermediate computation steps. Thus, they do not propagate gradients across the soft tokens and miss out on the signal of how the choice of one soft token affects the next. In this paper, we propose a sparse relaxation method for RL (called SpaRLax), which leverages the differentiability of soft-CoT reasoning over time steps and makes training more stable and effective. We adopt an entmax sparsity method that adaptively determines the degree of softness, which truncates long-tail noise at confident steps while retaining multiple plausible candidates when uncertain. Across nine reasoning benchmarks, our method achieves the highest average performance compared with baseline methods. Further analyses validate the effective use of soft-token superposition in our approach, and also demonstrate the contribution of adaptive sparsity in our approach.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SpaRLax，一种将软 CoT 推理沿时间步可微化的稀疏松弛 RL 训练方法，用 entmax 自适应控制软度，在九个推理基准上取得最优平均性能。
AI.motivation: 软 CoT 通过 token 嵌入的混合可在单步内表示多种推理可能的叠加，但训练大模型实现这一潜力仍困难。现有 RL 式训练把软 token 当作马尔可夫决策过程中的动作，而非可微的中间计算步骤，因此梯度无法跨软 token 传播，丢失了"前一个软 token 的选择如何影响后一个"的信号。
AI.method: 提出 SpaRLax 稀疏松弛 RL 方法：利用软 CoT 推理在时间步上的可微性，使梯度跨越软 token 传播，提升训练稳定性与有效性；并引入 entmax 稀疏化，自适应决定"软度"，在置信步骤截断长尾噪声、在不确定时保留多个合理候选。
AI.result: 在九个推理基准上，相比基线方法取得最高平均性能；进一步分析验证了软 token 叠加的有效使用，以及自适应稀疏性的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 将软 CoT 视为可微的中间计算而非离散动作，并结合自适应稀疏化，是训练软 CoT 推理更稳定有效的可行方向。

title: You Are the Trigger: Speaker-Activated Backdoors
summary: Speech models are increasingly used as an interface to AI systems, from transcription tools to voice agents. Existing audio backdoors require an attacker to introduce triggers at inference time. We study a different threat model in which the attacker compromises the model during fine-tuning but has no access to the victim's inference-time inputs. We introduce the Speaker-Activated Backdoor (SAB) setting, in which a target speaker's natural voice serves as the trigger. We develop a two-phase fine-tuning method that first makes speaker identity more accessible and then binds the target speaker to an attacker-chosen payload. Compared with a one-phase baseline with the same training budget, the two-phase method substantially improves selectivity and clean performance, and is especially important for content-dependent attacks. SAB achieves 90.2% and 97.0% backdoor success on Whisper-medium and Parakeet, with false-positive rates of 1.7% and 0%, respectively using as little as two minutes of real audio from the target speaker. We further demonstrate content-dependent semantic rewriting and downstream tool-use attacks, where malicious instructions are inserted into 96.9% of target-speaker transcripts. When these transcripts are passed to frontier LLM agents, GPT-4o and Claude (Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku), the injected instruction drives the agent to carry out the harmful action in up to 87.5% of cases. The attack generalizes to held-out recordings, multiple target speakers, and common acoustic degradations. These results establish speaker identity as a practical backdoor trigger that requires no inference-time attacker access and is invisible at the transcript layer.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"说话人激活后门"(SAB)：攻击者仅在微调阶段投毒，无需接触推理输入，以目标说话人的自然声音作为触发器。采用两阶段微调（先增强说话人身份可及性，再绑定载荷），在Whisper-medium和Parakeet上分别达到90.2%和97.0%后门成功率，误报率1.7%和0%。
AI.motivation: 现有音频后门都假设攻击者能在推理时注入触发器，这与现实中攻击者无法控制受害者推理输入的威胁模型不符。论文探索一种更现实、更隐蔽的新型威胁模型：仅通过微调阶段投毒，并利用受害者自然会产生的语音特征作为触发条件。
AI.method: 提出Speaker-Activated Backdoor设定，以目标说话人自然声音为触发器。设计两阶段微调方法：第一阶段让模型更容易区分/表征说话人身份，第二阶段将目标说话人身份与攻击者选定的载荷绑定。与同等训练预算的单阶段基线对比。
AI.result: 两阶段方法相较单阶段基线显著提升选择性与干净性能，对内容相关攻击尤为关键。仅用目标说话人2分钟真实音频，Whisper-medium和Parakeet后门成功率90.2%/97.0%，误报1.7%/0%；内容相关语义改写使96.9%目标说话人转写被插入恶意指令，下游LLM代理（GPT-4o、Claude系列）执行有害动作达87.5%；攻击可泛化到留出录音、多目标说话人和常见声学退化。
AI.conclusion: 说话人身份可作为一种无需推理时攻击者介入、且在转写层不可见的高效后门触发器，揭示了语音模型微调供应链中的新型安全风险。

title: On the Fragility of Tasks under Composition: Implicit Budgeting in Language Models
summary: Modern language models are increasingly asked to handle several tasks within a single prompt. Doing so requires solving each task correctly while integrating the resulting answers into a coherent response. In this paper, we identify a fundamental limitation in this process, where models make substantially more errors when tasks are composed, even when they can solve every constituent task reliably in isolation. This degradation cannot be fully explained by the accumulation of independent errors. Across both open-weight models and the frontier model Claude Opus 5, our findings instead point to an implicit thinking budget underlying this effect. In particular, under composition, models use substantially fewer tokens per task than in isolation, even when the full sequence remains well within the context window. Tasks that require longer solution traces in isolation are consequently more $\textit{fragile}$ under composition, i.e., models make more errors on prompts containing these tasks. In isolation, non-fragile tasks receive more reasoning than they need and waste compute.
