However, by grouping tasks according to their fragility, the implicit budgeting can be manipulated to reduce token usage by $43$\% across a range of math and linguistic tasks while also preserving accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文发现语言模型在多任务组合提示下性能显著下降，根源是模型存在"隐式思考预算"：组合时每任务分配token减少，长解链任务更脆弱；按脆弱性分组任务可操控预算，在保持准确率的同时减少43% token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现代语言模型常需在单个提示中处理多个任务，需正确求解每个任务并整合为连贯回答。作者观察到：即使模型能可靠地单独解决每个子任务，组合后错误率明显上升，且这种退化无法用独立误差累积解释，因此需要探究其内在机制。
AI.method: 作者在开源权重模型与前沿模型Claude Opus 5上进行实验，比较任务孤立求解与组合求解时的准确率和token使用情况；分析每任务token分配、任务解链长度与错误率（脆弱性）的关系，并提出按脆弱性对任务进行分组的策略来操控隐式预算。
AI.result: 组合条件下模型每任务使用token显著少于孤立条件（即便总序列远未达上下文窗口上限）；孤立时需更长解链的任务在组合时更脆弱、错误更多；孤立时非脆弱任务获得超出所需的推理而浪费算力。按脆弱性分组后，在数学与语言任务上token用量降低43%且保持准确率。
AI.conclusion: 多任务组合退化源于模型的隐式思考预算分配机制而非独立误差累积；理解并利用该机制（如按脆弱性分组）可在不损害性能的前提下大幅节省计算。

title: Recoverability and Verifier Strength: Two Measured Preconditions for Unattended Agent Self-Improvement
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AgenticOS. 6 pages + appendix
summary:
Agent platforms are starting to improve their own agents: they read a deployed agent's execution traces, derive a change, have an automated verifier approve it, and release it with no human author. How much of this loop can safely run without a human? We propose two quantities a platform can measure. Verifier strength $σ$ is how well the available verifier -- often an LLM judge -- agrees with a trusted reference verifier; it limits how much a step can improve the agent. Recoverability is how cheaply a bad change can be undone: whether undoing it needs a new verifier approval, and how much of the old behavior a rollback restores. A step should run unattended only if both are adequate. On our platform this rule allows prompt, tool and skill edits to run unattended and keeps weight updates under human sign-off.
  Our main contribution is these two definitions and how to measure them. We built a platform that applies the rule and tested it in two ways: on the platform's own approval gate, and in controlled experiments on the $τ^2$-bench agent benchmark. On verifier strength, the platform's LLM judge sometimes gave the same score no matter what it was shown (9 of 37 settings) and reported no error, so a verifier can look healthy while approving anything; its strength must be measured, and two simple tests catch the failure. On recoverability, restoring a saved copy brought the agent back to its original behavior, but a regenerated undo did not, so only changes whose old version is kept can be reversed without a human; and while a change was deployed, it altered the outcome of 17 percent of tasks beyond normal run-to-run variation, which no undo repairs. Together these support the rule: a change can run unattended only when its old version is kept and its verifier's strength has been measured.

AI.tldr: 论文提出两个可由平台度量的量——验证器强度σ（验证器与可信参考验证器的一致程度）与可恢复性（撤销坏改动的成本），主张只有两者都充分时改动才可无人值守上线；实验支持：提示/工具/技能编辑可自动，权重更新需人工签核。
AI.motivation: Agent平台已开始自动改进自身agent（读执行轨迹、生成改动、自动验证、无人工发布），但尚不清楚这个闭环中有多少能安全地脱离人类运行，需要一个可操作的判据。
AI.method: 定义并度量两个量：验证器强度σ（验证器常为LLM裁判，其与可信参考验证器的一致性）限制单步改进幅度；可恢复性衡量撤销坏改动的代价（是否需新的验证器批准、回滚能恢复多少旧行为）。据此制定规则：两者均充分才允许无人值守。在平台自身审批门限及τ^2-bench基准上做受控实验验证。
AI.result: 验证器强度：平台LLM裁判在37个设置中有9个不论输入如何都给出相同分数且不报错，说明验证器可“看起来健康却批准一切”，需实测，两个简单测试即可捕获该失效。可恢复性：恢复保存副本能还原原始行为，而重新生成的撤销不能，故只有保留旧版本才能无需人工逆转；改动部署期间使17%任务结果超出正常运行波动，且无撤销可修复。
AI.conclusion: 支持该规则：改动仅当保留旧版本且已测量验证器强度时才可无人值守运行；据此提示、工具与技能编辑可自动上线，权重更新仍需人工签核。

title: Steering Vision-Language Models for Visual-Contextual Privacy in Location Disclosure
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can infer sensitive information such as geolocation from subtle visual cues, creating privacy risks when responses disclose more detail than the visual context warrants. We study visual-contextual privacy in geolocation disclosure, where a VLM should reveal location information only at the granularity appropriate to the visual context depicted in the image. We first show that this contextually appropriate granularity is recoverable from pre-generation hidden states, even when generated responses are misaligned, with disclosure levels exhibiting an ordered structure along a common hidden-state direction. Motivated by this, we propose an inference-time route-and-steer framework: an ordinal granularity router maps visual-contextual privacy representations to a disclosure route, and a disclosure-level-conditioned steering module applies route-specific hidden-state interventions during decoding. Across four VLM backbones, our method improves visual-context-aware disclosure alignment, better balances over- and under-disclosure, and incurs only modest changes on general capability benchmarks. It further transfers to another dataset with a distinct data distribution and privacy-risk taxonomy.

AI.tldr: 论文研究视觉-语境隐私问题：VLM 应仅按图像视觉语境所允许的粒度披露地理位置信息，提出可恢复披露粒度的推理时"路由-引导"框架。
AI.motivation: VLM 能从细微视觉线索推断地理位置等敏感信息，当回答披露的细节超出视觉语境所能支撑的程度时，会带来隐私风险。作者希望模型只在语境合适的粒度上披露位置信息。
AI.method: 首先发现语境合适的披露粒度可从生成前隐藏状态中恢复，即使生成的回答不对齐，且披露层级在隐藏状态空间中沿某一共同方向呈有序结构。据此提出推理时 route-and-steer 框架：序数式粒度路由器把视觉-语境隐私表征映射到披露路径，再由披露层级条件化的引导模块在解码中对隐藏状态施加路径特定的干预。
AI.result: 在四个 VLM 主干上，方法提升了视觉语境感知的披露对齐，更好地平衡过度披露与披露不足，并对通用能力基准仅造成适度变化；还可迁移到数据分布与隐私风险分类体系不同的另一数据集。
AI.conclusion: 视觉-语境隐私粒度具有可恢复的隐藏状态结构，据此设计的推理时路由与引导方法无需重训练即可改善地理披露的隐私对齐，并具备跨数据集泛化性。

title: Magnolia: A Persistent-Memory Agent Framework for Computational Chemistry
summary: Chemistry has recently entered a high-data regime as molecular databases from high-throughput platforms or computational studies have become available. Increasing automation within the chemical sciences leads to a more digital and precision chemistry. Dedicated scientific agents are becoming central to guiding the chemist through an ever-increasing amount of data and findings, including negative ones. Here, we introduce Magnolia, a persistent-memory artificial intelligence agent framework that integrates computational protocols, from docking to quantum chemistry, lab notebooks and chat logs relying on large language models (LLMs). It relies on a three-tier memory system: session-level observations are automatically captured and distilled into structured learnings, confirmed and elevated to project-tier entries and, when human-validated, promoted to cross-project rules that actively guide subsequent work and provide direct chemical feedback. We illustrate Magnolia on four case studies: quantum-chemical evaluation of aromatic systems (COMPAS database), molecular dynamics of butane and of modified DNA, and a protein-peptide docking campaign. Across these projects, Magnolia tracked 317 runs and accumulated 116 project-tier entries, from which four cross-project rules were promoted; in controlled replays of four tasks, runs with memory passed the checks that runs without it failed (for example, ten of ten docking-configuration checks, against one to four of ten). By combining automation, reproducibility, and human-in-the-loop control, our Magnolia framework streamlines docking, molecular dynamics and quantum chemistry calculations with direct analysis and LLM-augmented feedback, offering accelerated access to computational (bio)chemistry.

AI.tldr: Magnolia 是一个带持久记忆的 AI agent 框架，集成计算协议、实验室笔记与对话日志，并用三层记忆系统把运行经验蒸馏为可复用的跨项目规则。
AI.motivation: 化学科学进入高数据时代，自动化与数字化程度提升，科研人员面临海量数据与结论（包括阴性结果）难以跟踪和利用的问题，需要专门的科学 agent 辅助导航。
AI.method: 提出 Magnolia 框架，基于 LLM，整合从分子对接至量子化学的计算协议、实验记录和聊天日志；采用三层记忆系统：会话级观察自动捕获并蒸馏为结构化经验→经确认提升为项目级条目→经人工验证后晋升为跨项目规则，主动指导后续工作并提供化学反馈。
AI.result: 在四个案例（COMPAS 芳香体系量子化学评估、丁烷与修饰 DNA 的分子动力学、蛋白-多肽对接）中，追踪 317 次运行，积累 116 条项目级条目并提炼出 4 条跨项目规则；四项任务的受控重放显示，有记忆的运行通过了无记忆运行失败的检查（如对接配置检查 10/10 对 1–4/10）。
AI.conclusion: Magnolia 结合自动化、可复现性与人在回路控制，简化了对接、分子动力学和量子化学计算及其直接分析与 LLM 增强反馈，加速计算（生物）化学的获取。

title: A Theoretical Analysis of Environment-Aware Out-of-Distribution Detection for Vision-Language Models
summary:
Continual vision-language models (VLMs) encounter a stream of environments and must also reject inputs that do not belong to the environment at hand.
  Class information from earlier environments can aid out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, yet existing detectors score each environment in isolation, and when previous environments help or hurt is theoretically unclear. We develop a theory of environment-aware OOD detection built on contribution scores, pairwise cosine expectations measuring how the image and text features of one environment align with those of another. We propose a cross-environment maximum-concept-matching (MCM) score with two terms: a primary term matching the test image against the current class texts, and a secondary term matching it against the class texts of a previous environment, weighted by the intra-modal alignment between the two environments. We prove that, under a positive environment transition and a bounded class-matching margin for OOD inputs, this score attains a false-positive rate no larger than that of the standard MCM detector at an adjusted threshold. We then show that the score gap of an MCM detector between two environments equals the self-contribution of the in-distribution environment minus its cross-modal contribution into the OOD environment, which separates soft OOD environments, with explicit AUROC, true-positive, and false-positive guarantees, from hard ones, which no threshold that retains the in-distribution data can reliably reject. For cascaded detection, in which the text prototypes of all seen environments are pooled, the false-positive rate on every past environment is non-decreasing in time, and we characterize when detection provably fails. A contribution balance factor applied to the gradients of the classification loss and of a smoothed false-positive rate completes the framework.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于"贡献分数"的环境感知OOD检测理论，设计跨环境最大概念匹配（MCM）分数并给出理论保证。
AI.motivation: 持续学习视觉-语言模型需拒绝不属于当前环境的输入；已有OOD检测器孤立地为每个环境打分，且不清楚利用历史环境何时有益或有害。
AI.method: 以成对余弦期望定义贡献分数，提出跨环境MCM分数：主项匹配当前类文本、次项按环境间模态内对齐加权匹配上一环境类文本；并分析级联检测（池化所有已见环境文本原型）的误报率演化，引入贡献平衡因子作用于分类损失与平滑误报率梯度。
AI.result: 证明在正环境转移与OOD输入有界类匹配间隔假设下，该分数在调整阈值下误报率不高于标准MCM；MCM分数差等于ID环境自贡献减去其跨模态贡献，从而区分软OOD环境（给出AUROC、TP、FP保证）与硬OOD环境（无法可靠拒绝）；级联检测中各历史环境误报率随时间非递减，并刻画可证明失败的条件。
AI.conclusion: 为持续VLM中的环境感知OOD检测提供统一理论框架与可证明的检测准则，并给出训练层面的实现方案。

title: Preference-Aware Pareto Steering for Multi-Task Speech LLMs
summary: Speech large language models (LLMs) perform multiple tasks, including automatic speech recognition (ASR), timestamp prediction (TS), and speech translation (ST). Joint training of speech LLMs creates task trade-offs, yet standard training with fixed loss weights does not generally control the resulting trade-off according to deployment preferences. To address this, we propose Endpoint-Anchored Preference-Aware Sampling Uniformly along the Pareto Front (EA-SURF), an a priori method that adapts scalarization weights so that the resulting task trade-off reflects the desired preference. EA-SURF retains the standard weighted-loss training pipeline, tracking the current model's performance relative to each task-specific reference and adapting the scalarization weights as training proceeds. We theoretically show that EA-SURF can match a desired preference, with the update becoming stationary at the target under checkable regularity conditions. Across six three-objective speech LLM requests, EA-SURF empirically converges toward the requested targets and increases endpoint-inclusive normalized hypervolume by 17.8% over fixed loss weighting.

AI.tldr: 提出EA-SURF方法，在语音大模型多任务联合训练中自适应调整标量化权重，使任务权衡符合预设偏好。
AI.motivation: 语音LLM需同时做ASR、时间戳预测和翻译等任务，联合训练产生任务权衡；固定损失权重无法按部署偏好控制权衡结果。
AI.method: EA-SURF是一种先验式方法，保留标准加权损失训练流程，通过跟踪当前模型相对于各任务参考表现，随训练自适应调整标量化权重，使其反映期望偏好；并在可检验正则条件下理论证明更新在目标处收敛为稳定。
AI.result: 在六个三目标语音LLM请求上，EA-SURF实证收敛到请求目标，端点包含的归一化超体积较固定损失加权提升17.8%。
AI.conclusion: EA-SURF能按部署偏好实现可控的多任务权衡，且作为理论可保证的先验方法兼容标准训练流程。

title: Auditing the Product, Not the Recursion: The Evaluation Evidence Behind Recursive Self-Improvement Claims
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) promises AI systems, such as self-evolving LLM agents, that become better at producing further improvements. Evaluating this promise requires separating product claims about the final system from process claims about the improvement process itself. Existing surveys specify the evidence these claims require, but how often studies report that evidence remains unmeasured. We examine this question through full-text coding of 114 eligible studies in a reproducible arXiv search frame frozen in October 2026, including 90 that describe their own systems as RSI. The codebook links claims to evaluation designs. Independent human coding, third-reader adjudication, and a separate blind coding of improver comparisons assess coding reliability. Among the 90 RSI studies, 90% report product evaluation beyond development tasks under a broad criterion that includes partial or unstated separation, while 60% report evaluation on tasks unused for selection. Only 22% audit two or more reruns of the full loop. In a human-coded random sample, the RSI studies show the same contrast: 45% evaluate on tasks unused for selection and 14% audit two or more reruns. Of the 26 studies claiming a better improvement procedure, 23 report a related comparison, but only 4 compare earlier and later procedures from identical starting artifacts at a matched budget. Across these results and a comparison set of established works, evidence for repeatability and improved procedures remains less developed than product evaluation. Three propositions explain how selection effects, shared evaluator errors, and changes in system state limit what product evaluations can establish. Together, the findings support a claim-indexed reporting standard that connects each claim to the evaluation design needed to test it.

AI.tldr: 通过对114篇研究（含90篇自称RSI系统）的全文编码，测量"递归自我改进"主张与实际评估设计之间的差距，发现产品评估远多于过程/可重复性评估，并据此提出"按主张索引"的报告标准。
AI.motivation: RSI承诺系统能在改进过程上不断变强，但需区分针对最终系统的"产品主张"和针对改进过程本身的"过程主张"。既有综述虽已规定所需证据，但研究实际报告这些证据的频率从未被量化测量，亟需实证填补。
AI.method: 在冻结于2026年10月的可复现arXiv检索框架内，对114篇合格研究进行全文编码；建立将主张与评估设计相链接的编码手册；采用独立人工编码、第三读者裁定，以及对改进器比较的单独盲编码来评估编码信度；并设置既有的对照文献集。
AI.result: 90篇RSI研究中，90%在宽口径（含部分或未明确分离）下报告了超越开发任务的产品评估，60%在未用于选择的任务上评估，但仅22%审计了完整循环的两次及以上重跑；人工编码随机样本中对比更明显（45%与14%）。26篇声称改进流程更优的研究中23篇报告了相关比较，但仅4篇在相同起始产物与匹配预算下比较了前后两种流程。对照文献集显示可重复性与改进流程方面的证据弱于产品评估。
AI.conclusion: 选择效应、共享评估器误差和系统状态变化三条命题可解释产品评估的局限；结果支持建立一种"按主张索引"的报告标准，将每项主张与其所需的评估设计相连接。

title: Look Before You Reason: Implicit Visual Thinking for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly in multimodal reasoning, yet they remain limited on tasks requiring fine-grained understanding of small or easily overlooked image regions. Recent thinking with images approaches mitigate this limitation by allowing models to inspect images through operations such as zooming, cropping, or code execution. While effective, their multi-turn interactions with VLMs introduce redundant token computation and slow inference, and separate region inspection from the reasoning step that depends on it. To address these issues, we propose Look Before You Reason (LoRe), an implicit visual thinking framework for efficient visual reasoning within a single-turn VLM interaction. Given an image and a question, LoRe predicts the most relevant image region, aligns it with the corresponding image patch features, and strengthens the associated key-value (KV) cache entries, enabling subsequent decoding to directly exploit the selected visual cues without additional visual inputs or explicit tool calls. We further employ reinforcement learning to guide the VLM toward identifying informative image regions and leveraging them during reasoning. To support fine-grained evaluation of multimodal reasoning, we introduce COCO-ObjQA, a large-scale benchmark for object-centric multimodal reasoning. Experiments on three challenging multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that LoRe consistently improves VLM reasoning performance with low additional inference overhead.

AI.tldr: LoRe 提出一种单轮交互的隐式视觉思维框架，通过预测相关图像区域并强化对应 KV cache 实现高效细粒度视觉推理，并构建 COCO-ObjQA 基准。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 在需要细粒度理解小目标或被忽略区域的任Ó 上表现受限；"thinking with images" 方法虽有效，但多轮交互带来冗余 token 计算、推理慢，且区域检查与依赖它的推理步骤相分离。
AI.method: LoRe 在单轮 VLM 交互中：给定图像和问题，预测最相关图像区域，将其对齐到对应图像 patch 特征，并强化相关 KV cache 条目，使后续解码直接利用所选视觉线索，无需额外视觉输入或显式工具调用；并用强化学习引导模型识别信息量大的区域并在推理中使用。此外构建 COCO-ObjQA 以中心物体为核心的大规模多模态推理基准。
AI.result: 在三个具有挑战性的多模态基准上，LoRe 在低额外推理开销下持续提升 VLM 推理性能。
AI.conclusion: LoRe 通过隐式区域关注与 KV cache 强化，将区域检查融入推理本身，实现高效细粒度视觉推理，并提供新基准支持相关评测。

title: EGI-BENCH: An Enterprise General Intelligence Benchmark Suite
summary: Enterprise adoption of LLMs in agentic workflows is gated by evaluations that span a wide arc of abilities: CRM operations, heterogeneous-document retrieval, personal data understanding, multi-turn planning, tool use, function calling, long-horizon research, and long-context software engineering. These evaluations live today in separate repositories with divergent runners, dependencies, and scoring conventions, which makes cross-benchmark comparison difficult and obscures what a single aggregate number actually represents. We release EGI-BENCH, a unified LLM agent benchmark suite that consolidates eight enterprise facing agent benchmarks (CRMARENA, HERB, PERSONABENCH, USERBENCH, MCP-UNIVERSE, MCPEVAL, BENCHFORCE, LOCOBENCH) behind a single command-line interface with two runtime-budgeted execution modes. On top of the suite we define the Enterprise General Intelligence (EGI) Score, a six-dimensional framework (M1-M6) whose buckets are populated by fine-grained sub-metrics routed from each benchmark rather than by benchmark-level averages. We describe the suite, the sub-metric routing, and the quick/deep budgets, and report results for fourteen frontier and cost-efficient LLMs spanning the GPT, Claude, and Gemini families under quick mode. Top-line EGI ranges from 39.6 (GPT-4o mini) to 65.6 (gpt-5.5), and no single model dominates every capability axis: gpt-5.5 leads task outcome, planning, and retrieval grounding; Claude Sonnet 4.5 leads tool actioning and safety/abstention; and Claude Haiku 4.5 leads engineering quality. Code is available at https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/egi-bench.

AI.tldr: 发布 EGI-BENCH：整合八个企业级 Agent 基准为统一 CLI（quick/deep 两种预算），并提出六维 EGI Score 评分框架，报告 14 个前沿/低成本 LLM 的结果。
AI.motivation: 企业采用 LLM agent 需评估 CRM 操作、异构文档检索、多轮规划、工具调用、长程研究、长上下文软件工程等广泛能力，但现有基准散落于不同仓库，运行器、依赖与打分约定各异，难以跨基准比较，聚合分数的含义也不清晰。
AI.method: 将 CRMArena、HERB、PersonaBench、UserBench、MCP-Universe、MCPEval、BenchForce、LoCoBench 八个基准统一到单一命令行接口，提供两种带运行时预算的执行模式（quick/deep）；定义 Enterprise General Intelligence (EGI) Score 六维框架 M1–M6，各维度由从各基准路由而来的细粒度子指标填充，而非使用基准级平均。
AI.result: 在 quick 模式下评估 GPT、Claude、Gemini 系列共 14 个模型：EGI 总分区间为 39.6（GPT-4o mini）至 65.6（gpt-5.5）；无单一模型全面领先——gpt-5.5 在任务完成、规划与检索接地方面领先，Claude Sonnet 4.5 在工具执行与安全/弃答方面领先，Claude Haiku 4.5 在工程质量方面领先。
AI.conclusion: 统一基准套件与子指标路由式评分可提升企业场景下 Agent 评估的可比性与可解释性，且揭示了能力维度的互补性，但本文仅报告 quick 模式结果。

title: Deep catastrophic-risk-aware reinforcement learning
summary: Estimating extreme risk in reinforcement learning becomes increasingly difficult as the confidence level increases, since only a small number of observations contribute to empirical estimates of Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR). In this paper, we extend an Extreme Value Theory (EVT) approach for CVaR optimization to high-dimensional neural-network policies. Using a peaks-over-threshold representation and method-of-moments estimation, we obtain a differentiable tail-risk objective and show that, conditional on the selected threshold, its finite-sample gradient can be computed directly through automatic differentiation. We first validate the approach in a controlled experiment with a known optimal solution and then investigate its performance in a deep-hedging problem with rare extreme market movements. Our results show similar hedging behavior for EVT- and empirical-CVaR-trained policies under normal conditions, while EVT-trained policies exhibit lower hedging losses under the extreme-scenario evaluation across the training sample sizes considered. These results suggest that EVT can provide a practical alternative for training neural policies when the observations relevant to extreme risk are scarce.

AI.tldr: 将极值理论(EVT)的CVaR优化方法扩展到高维神经网络策略，利用超阈值峰值表示和矩估计得到可微尾部风险目标，并在深度对冲问题中验证其在极端情景下优于经验CVaR训练。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中置信水平越高，极端风险(CVaR)的经验估计越困难，因为仅有少量观测参与估计。需要一种在极端风险相关样本稀缺时仍能有效训练的实用替代方法。
AI.method: 将EVT方法扩展到高维神经网络策略：采用超阈值峰值(peaks-over-threshold)表示与矩估计(method-of-moments)，构造可微的尾部风险目标，并证明在给定阈值条件下其有限样本梯度可通过自动微分直接计算。先在已知最优解的受控实验中验证，再在含罕见极端市场波动的深度对冲问题中测试。
AI.result: 受控实验验证了方法的正确性；对冲问题中，正常条件下EVT与经验CVaR训练的策略对冲行为相似，而在极端情景评估下，EVT训练策略在所考虑的各个训练样本量上对冲损失更低。
AI.conclusion: 当与极端风险相关的观测稀缺时，EVT可为训练神经策略提供一种实用替代方案。

title: The Culture Within: Towards Mechanistic Understanding of Cultural Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly operate across culturally diverse settings, yet existing evaluations largely measure cultural behavior at the output level. We introduce CultureLens, a reference-grounded benchmark and mechanistic study of how LLMs use cultural information. CultureLens contains 9,261 scenarios across 75 countries and systematically varies country, value, true-norm, and contradictory-norm evidence. Across Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-3-12B, and Qwen-3.5-27B, stating a contradictory norm lowers aligned answers by 32-47 percentage points, even when the model answers correctly from the country alone. Mechanistically, models default to Anglophone norms when no country is given. The failure under a contradictory norm is not one of missing knowledge, as blocking the norm inside the model restores the correct answer in most cases. Models accept a stated norm according to how it is presented and not whether it is true, which leaves them most exposed to errors in retrieved content. Supervised fine-tuning with contradictory-norm examples raises aligned answers under a contradictory norm to 85-93%, including on unseen countries, at a small cost under a true norm.

AI.tldr: CultureLens基准揭示LLM存在"文化从众"捷径：当提供与真实文化规范相矛盾的外部信息时，模型会放弃原本正确的知识，对齐率下降32-47个百分点；但其知识并未缺失，通过干预可恢复正确答案。
AI.motivation: 现有文化评估多在输出层面衡量行为，缺乏对LLM如何"使用"文化信息的机制性理解，尤其是模型在遇到矛盾外部证据时的内部处理方式。
AI.method: 构建CultureLens基准，含75个国家、9261个场景，系统变化国家、价值观、真实规范与矛盾规范证据；在Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-3-12B、Qwen-3.5-27B上进行机制分析与监督微调实验。
AI.result: 矛盾规范使对齐答案下降32-47个百分点；无国家信息时模型默认盎格鲁规范；阻断模型内部规范表征可在多数情况下恢复正确答案；模型依据规范的呈现方式而非真实性来接受它；用矛盾规范样本微调可将矛盾条件下的对齐率提升至85-93%，包括未见国家，仅在真实规范下有小幅代价。
AI.conclusion: LLM的文化错误源于对呈现形式的过度遵循而非知识缺失，使其尤其易受检索内容错误影响；简单的针对性微调可显著缓解该问题。

title: Reusing Assurance Evidence in AI Pipelines: Validity Conditions, a Fail-Closed Release Gate, and a Replay of 714 Public Data Version Control Pipelines
summary: Rerunning every governance control after every change to an artificial intelligence (AI) pipeline is expensive, so teams reuse earlier results. Reuse is safe only if each control's declared dependencies cover everything that can change its outcome, and only if the release gate checks that reused evidence describes the candidate being released. This article makes both conditions explicit and measures how often the first fails in practice. It defines when a signed evidence record is valid for a candidate and gives sufficient conditions under which change-local re-execution reaches the same release decision as rerunning every control. A reference gate implementing these checks with Ed25519 digital signatures blocks eight of nine manipulation scenarios, against one for a gate that trusts the planner and three for a gate that only verifies signatures; a dependency the policy never declared passes every gate. A replay of 38,083 commits from 714 public Data Version Control (DVC) pipelines measures that failure mode. Reusing stage results according to declared dependencies avoids 83.4% of stage executions, but in 3.3% of commits it reuses a stage whose imported code or referenced configuration changed, and 31% of pipelines are affected. A manual audit confirms the undeclared dependency in 36 of 40 sampled events. Evaluation stages, whose outputs are the evidence, are the most exposed. Adding each stage's static import closure lowers stale reuse to 0.4% while still avoiding 81.6% of executions; sampled shadow re-execution removes far less, and rerunning everything after unexplained changes avoids only 45.3%.

AI.tldr: 论文将"基于声明依赖的证据复用"形式化，给出变更局部重执行与全量重跑发布决策等价的充分条件，并用签名门禁实验与大规�模DVC提交回放测量未声明依赖导致的过期复用问题。
AI.motivation: AI流水线每次变更后全量重跑治理控制代价高昂，团队倾向复用先前结果；但复用的安全性依赖两个前提：控制声明的依赖覆盖所有可能改变其结果的因素，且发布门禁能校验复用证据确实对应待发布候选。论文指出这两个条件在实践中被忽视，尤其是第一个条件失效的频率未被量化。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义签名证据记录对某候选"有效"的含义，并给出变更局部重执行与全量重跑得到相同发布决策的充分条件；2) 实现基于Ed25519数字签名的参考门禁，与"信任规划器"门禁和"仅验签"门禁在9类操纵场景下对比；3) 回放714个公开DVC流水线的38,083次提交，按声明依赖复用阶段结果并统计过期复用率，辅以40例人工审计；4) 对比引入阶段静态导入闭包、抽样影子重执行、以及"无法解释变更即全量重跑"等缓解策略。
AI.result: 参考门禁阻断9类操纵场景中的8类，信任规划器仅1类、仅验签3类；而策略中从未声明的依赖可通过任意门禁。按声明依赖复用可省去83.4%的阶段执行，但3.3%的提交会复用代码或配置已变更的阶段，影响31%的流水线；人工审计40例中36例确认存在未声明依赖；评估阶段（即证据产出阶段）风险最高。加入静态导入闭包后过期复用降至0.4%且仍省81.6%执行；抽样影子重执行收益远低，无解释变更全量重跑仅省45.3%。
AI.conclusion: 证据复用带来的收益真实存在，但其安全性取决于依赖声明的完备性与门禁对候选绑定的校验，二者缺一不可；尤其是声明之外的依赖无法被任何门禁发现。以静态导入闭包补全依赖声明可近乎消除过期复用且保留大部分节省，是比抽样重执行或保守全量重跑更优的折中。

title: On the Limits of Scale: Inverse Scaling in Vision-Language Models
summary: Scaling laws suggest that increasing model size, training data, and compute generally yields monotonic performance improvements. While this often holds at the aggregate level, we present systematic evidence that vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit inverse scaling at the subtask level: specific question categories on which larger models perform worse than smaller counterparts within the same model family. We evaluate 19 models from four distinct model families across eight multimodal benchmarks (nine evaluation splits), answering 29,386 questions per model, 558,334 model-question evaluations in total. Using per-question pairwise analysis across all model pairs in each family, we identify 375 subtask-model-pair combinations exhibiting inverse scaling, spanning 4,342 unique queries where a smaller model answers correctly but a larger model fails, and we find that these patterns replicate across independently developed architectures. We identify 13 subtask-dataset pairs that show inverse scaling across multiple families, consistent with the phenomenon being task-driven rather than model-specific. The most affected domains in our study include multi-image spatial reasoning, visual perception, and university-level STEM knowledge, with accuracy gaps exceeding 20 percentage points in several cases, while diagram understanding appears comparatively resistant. These findings challenge the assumption that increasing model size uniformly improves multimodal capabilities and suggest that model selection should be task-aware.

AI.tldr: 本文系统发现视觉语言模型（VLM）在子任务层面存在"逆缩放"现象：同一模型家族中更大的模型在某些特定问题类别上反而不如小模型，且该现象跨架构可复现、更多由任务驱动而非模型特定。
AI.motivation: 缩放定律通常认为模型规模越大性能越好，但这主要停留在聚合层面。作者希望检验在细粒度子任务层面，VLM是否也存在违背缩放定律的逆缩放现象，从而挑战"增大模型规模即可均匀提升多模态能力"的假设。
AI.method: 评估4个模型家族的19个模型，覆盖8个多模态基准（9个评估划分），每模型回答29,386个问题，共558,334次模型-问题评估。采用家族内所有模型对的逐问题成对分析，识别出子任务层面的逆缩放组合，并检验其跨独立架构的复现性。
AI.result: 发现375个子任务-模型对组合呈现逆缩放，涉及4,342个唯一查询（小模型答对而大模型答错）；识别出13个跨多个家族一致的子任务-数据集对，表明现象由任务驱动。受影响最大的领域包括多图空间推理、视觉感知和大学STEM知识，部分准确率差距超过20个百分点，而图表理解相对不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果挑战了增大模型规模能均匀提升多模态能力的假设，表明模型选择应具备任务意识（task-aware），而非单纯依赖规模。

title: TxnQA: Benchmarking Analytical Reasoning and Evidence Grounding over Transaction Event Sequences
summary: Analyzing merchant transaction histories requires dynamic temporal filtering, entity resolution, and aggregation over irregular event streams--operations poorly captured by static tabular or time-series forecasting benchmarks. We introduce TxnQA, an analytical QA benchmark comprising 27 task families (81 templates) alongside a 5-scenario fraud-risk reasoning suite that evaluates both verdicts and supporting evidence over synthetic, privacy-mitigated transaction data. Ground-truth answers are computed programmatically, and model performance is decomposed into format-following rate (FFR), conditional content accuracy (CA), and end-to-end correctness (E2E). Evaluating prompted proprietary baselines and six LoRA-adapted open-weight models shows that adaptation reliably enforces output schemas but leaves arithmetic bottlenecks: Gemma-4-31B-IT and Qwen3-8B attain E2E scores of 0.867 and 0.816, whereas evaluated MoE checkpoints reach only 0.632-0.713. Furthermore, on the 500-instance fraud suite, verdict accuracy frequently exceeds 80%, yet joint accuracy (requiring exact evidence attribution) collapses to at most ~23%. These findings identify schema compliance, semantic calculation, and evidence attribution as three distinct bottlenecks in transaction-sequence QA.

AI.tldr: 提出 TxnQA 基准，评估模型对商户交易流水这类不规则事件流的分析问答能力，揭示格式合规、语义计算与证据归因三类瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 商户交易历史分析需要动态时间过滤、实体解析与不规则事件流聚合，这些操作难以被静态表格或时间序列预测类基准覆盖，现有评测缺失。
AI.method: 构建 TxnQA 分析式问答基准：27 个任务族（81 个模板）加 5 场景欺诈风险推理套件，基于合成且隐私缓解的交易数据；答案由程序计算生成；指标分解为格式遵循率 FFR、条件内容准确率 CA 与端到端正确率 E2E；评测提示式专有基线及 6 个 LoRA 适配开源模型。
AI.result: 适配可靠地约束了输出 schema，但算术瓶颈仍在：Gemma-4-31B-IT 与 Qwen3-8B E2E 分别为 0.867、0.816，MoE 检查点仅 0.632–0.713；500 例欺诈套件上判决准确率常超 80%，但要求精确证据归因的联合准确率最高仅约 23%。
AI.conclusion: 交易序列问答存在三个彼此独立的瓶颈——schema 合规、语义计算与证据归因；仅靠微调可解决格式问题，却不足以解决计算与归因，需针对性方法改进。

title: Solving the Ho--Nguyen Conjecture for Gaussian Mixtures: Applications to Mixtures of Experts
summary: Over-fitted Gaussian mixtures can contain many parameter configurations with nearly the same density, making the order of density cancellation central to their parameter-learning rates. Ho and Nguyen encoded these cancellations in a polynomial system and conjectured its exact order as a function of cluster size. The key to resolving the conjecture is a common positive-variance shift that turns the coefficient equations into Gaussian moment matching. For every cluster size $\Mhn\ge2$, we prove that the real, nonzero-weight system has order $2\Mhn$: a sharp sign-change bound forces rigidity at that order, while positive Gauss--Hermite quadrature constructs a non-trivial solution through order $2\Mhn-1$. Population-density calculations at 110-digit working precision recover the predicted leading term for two to six components; finite multistart searches recover the same observed powers for two to five components, with smaller finite-scale constants for three to five components. For parameter learning, the exact order gives an explicit pointwise maximum-likelihood exponent and an exact local minimax order on specified shrinking neighbourhoods of a fixed known mixing measure. The same coefficient viewpoint separates high-order cancellation from exact parameter symmetries in mixtures of experts. Synchronized replication preserves the conditional density while keeping the corresponding parameter losses positive in two broad standard-softmax classes, showing why statistical rate arguments must account for exact parameter symmetries.

AI.tldr: 该论文解决了Ho与Nguyen关于过拟合高斯混合模型中密度抵消阶数的猜想，证明对任意簇大小Mhn≥2，实非零权系统的阶数恰为2Mhn，并由此给出极大似然学习速率的显式指数。
AI.motivation: 过拟合的高斯混合可存在大量密度几乎相同的参数配置，密度抵消的阶数直接决定参数学习速率。Ho和Nguyen用多项式系统编码这些抵消，并猜想其阶数是簇大小的函数，但该猜想此前未被证明。
AI.method: 关键手段是引入一个公共的正方差平移，使系数方程转化为高斯矩匹配。对每个簇大小Mhn≥2：用尖锐的符号变化界在该阶数上强制刚性；用正Gauss–Hermite求积构造出直到2Mhn−1阶的非平凡解。另以110位精度做总体密度计算（2–6分量）与有限多起点搜索（2–5分量）进行验证。并将同一系数视角用于分专家混合模型中区分高阶抵消与精确参数对称性（同步复制）。
AI.result: 证明实非零权系统阶数为2Mhn（对任意Mhn≥2）。数值实验恢复了预测的首项（2–6分量），多起点搜索得到相同观测幂次（2–5分量）。对参数学习，得到显式的逐点极大似然指数，以及在固定已知混合测度的特定收缩邻域上的精确局部极小极大阶。在两类标准softmax的分专家混合中，同步复制保持条件密度但参数损失为正，说明统计速率论证必须考虑精确参数对称性。
AI.conclusion: 密度抵消阶数猜想得到完全解决（2Mhn），并转化为参数学习速率与局部极小极大阶的显式结果；同时澄清了高阶抵消与精确参数对称性的区别，强调统计速率分析须处理精确对称性。

title: LoWAgent: A Low-Resource Multilingual Benchmark for Web Agents
summary: Web agents are typically evaluated on English-language interfaces, leaving their ability to operate across the world's multilingual websites largely unexplored. This gap is especially significant for low-resource languages, where standardized resources for evaluating web agents remain limited. To address this gap, we introduce Low-Resource Web Agent Benchmark (LoWAgent), a benchmark for evaluating web agents across different low-resource languages (LRLs) in comparison to the default, English. LoWAgent evaluates web agents across English and four LRLs: Hindi, Bengali, Urdu, and Amharic. The benchmark comprises of six fully localized websites, instantiated across five languages to yield 3,000 task instances. We evaluate three closed-source and five open-source models across all five languages on all six websites. Our findings show that both closed-source and open-source models experience performance degradation for LRLs compared to English, with substantially greater performance drops observed among the open-source model agents. We further evaluate the robustness of the models on realistic interface disruptions, such as cookie notices and advertisement pop-ups, and find that these further degrade agentic performance. Finally, we show that post-training on a small subset of LoWAgent traces can significantly improve low-resource language agentic task performance, demonstrating the usefulness of our benchmark.

AI.tldr: LoWAgent：首个跨低资源语言（印地语、孟加拉语、乌尔都语、阿姆哈拉语）评测网页智能体的基准，含6个全本地化网站×5种语言共3000个任务；闭源与开源模型在低资源语言上均显著退化，开源模型更严重，界面干扰进一步降低性能，少量轨迹微调可显著提升表现。
AI.motivation: 现有网页智能体评测几乎只针对英文界面，其在多语言尤其是低资源语言网站上的能力缺乏标准化资源与系统评测，存在明显空白。
AI.method: 构建LoWAgent基准：6个完整本地化网站、覆盖英语与4种低资源语言共5种语言，生成3000个任务实例；评测3个闭源与5个开源模型，并测试cookie提示、广告弹窗等真实界面干扰下的鲁棒性，另做小样本轨迹后训练实验。
AI.result: 所有模型在低资源语言上相较英语均出现性能下降，开源模型下降幅度明显更大；cookie通知、广告弹窗等界面干扰进一步削弱智能体表现；仅用少量LoWAgent轨迹进行后训练即可显著提升低资源语言任务性能。
AI.conclusion: LoWAgent填补了低资源语言网页智能体评测的空白，揭示了当前模型的跨语言性能鸿沟与鲁棒性不足，并证明该基准可用于有效改进模型，具备实用价值。

title: From RL Papers to Framework Code: Inclusion and Review in Seven Open-Source Training Frameworks
comment: 29 pages (13 pages main text), 5 figures, 12 tables. Data and code at https://github.com/pth2002/rl-method-tracker and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23495743
summary: Practitioners use reinforcement learning methods for language models through training frameworks, so a method that a framework includes is one configuration change away for its users. We measure how often this happens. We trace seven open-source frameworks for RL post-training through their commit histories and link them to 6,939 screened arXiv papers from January 2025 to June 2026. Of 1,598 papers that propose a general RL training method, 37 reached at least one framework. Across five quarterly cohorts of papers, the number included within 180 days stayed between 5 and 7 while the cohorts grew from 72 to 386 papers. Compared with papers from the same quarters, included papers more often trained policies of 30B parameters or more, at 41 against 10 percent, and more often changed a coefficient, clip, mask or weight in the existing loss, at 29 against 9 percent. Both gaps hold without papers from the companies that maintain the frameworks, while code release was equally common in both groups. The frameworks' issues and pull requests show that few methods are turned away in public. More than nine in ten of the general methods no framework included have no thread there that cites or names them, and many proposals that do appear stay open without a reply. Two further records, the frameworks' issues and the technical reports of 13 large open-weight models, show that users rarely report training failures in public and that the reports state 8 of the 13 widely included methods. We release the data as a tracker that links training failures to framework implementations and lists each framework's contribution rules and earlier proposals.

AI.tldr: 研究追踪7个开源RL后训练框架的提交历史，与2025年1月至2026年6月的6,939篇arXiv论文匹配，发现1,598篇通用RL训练方法中仅37篇被框架采纳，且采纳门槛偏向大模型规模与损失函数微调类方法。
AI.motivation: 从业者主要通过训练框架使用RL方法，框架内置的方法对用户而言只需改一次配置即可用，因此"方法是否被框架采纳"直接决定其实践影响力。但这一采纳过程的发生频率与规律此前缺乏测量。
AI.method: 将7个开源RL后训练框架的commit历史与6,939篇经筛选的arXiv论文（2025.01–2026.06）关联；按五个季度分组比较采纳率随时间变化；对比被采纳与未被采纳论文的特征（模型规模、是否改动损失函数中的系数/裁剪/掩码/权重、代码释放情况）；并分析框架的issue与PR记录、以及13个大型开放权重模型技术报告中的方法引用。
AI.result: 1,598篇通用RL方法论文中仅37篇进入至少一个框架；尽管论文队列从72篇增至386篇，180天内被采纳数始终维持在5–7篇。被采纳论文更多训练30B参数以上策略（41% vs 10%），更多是在既有loss上调整系数/裁剪/掩码/权重（29% vs 9%）；两项差异在剔除框架维护公司自家论文后依然成立，而代码释放率两组相同。公开渠道几乎不拒稿：超九成未被采纳的方法在框架issue/PR中无任何提及线程，出现者多处于无人回复的开放状态。用户也极少公开报告训练失败，13份报告中只记录了8个被广泛采纳的方法。
AI.conclusion: 方法能否被框架采纳是筛选RL方法的强瓶颈，且筛选偏向大规模策略与低改动、易集成的损失微调，公开反馈渠道几乎不发挥过滤作用。作者发布了一个tracker数据集，关联训练失败与框架实现，并列出各框架的贡献规则与既往提案。

title: PerQ: Inverse Generative Modeling for Neural Image Compression via Quantization Error Compensation
summary: Neural image codecs face a fundamental trade-off between pixel fidelity and perceptual quality. Distortion-optimized codecs preserve pixel-wise fidelity but produce blurred reconstructions at low bitrates, whereas generative codecs leverage learned priors to improve perceptual quality but tend to exhibit saturating PSNR at higher bitrates and require separate models for different bitrate targets. We propose PerQ, which reframes perceptual reconstruction as inverse generative modeling with bounded support. Specifically, we define the quantization cell as the set of latents that yield the same transmitted symbols and derive a transport bound showing that reconstructions from this cell remain within a rate-determined radius of the codec output. This motivates performing generative reconstruction within the codec-induced quantization cell, rather than sampling from an unconstrained image prior. PerQ implements this principle by attaching a rate-conditioned flow-matching compensator to a frozen, multi-rate distortion-optimized backbone, enabling perceptual enhancement while preserving the backbone's coding performance. Experiments on Kodak and CLIC2020 show that PerQ achieves perceptual performance comparable to generative codecs such as MS-ILLM in LPIPS and FID, while maintaining competitive PSNR relative to distortion-optimized codecs such as ELIC. A single model checkpoint supports a wide bitrate range with fast decoding, and the compensator provides consistent gains across three different backbones. The implementation is available at https://jasminepp.github.io/PerQ/.

AI.tldr: PerQ将感知重建重新表述为有界支撑的逆生成建模，在冻结的多码率失真优化主干上附加码率条件流匹配补偿器，在量化单元内进行生成式重建。
AI.motivation: 神经图像编解码器在像素保真度与感知质量之间存在根本权衡：失真优化编解码器低码率下重建模糊，而生成式编解码器虽提升感知质量，却在高码率下PSNR趋于饱和，且不同码率需分别训练模型。
AI.method: 将量化单元（产生相同传输符号的潜变量集合）定义为有界支撑，推导传输界证明该单元内的重建与编解码输出距离受限；据此在码率诱导的量化单元内进行生成式重建，而非从无约束图像先验采样。实现上在冻结的多码率失真优化主干上附加码率条件流匹配补偿器。
AI.result: 在Kodak与CLIC2020上，PerQ的LPIPS和FID感知性能可比MS-ILLM等生成式编解码器，同时相对ELIC等失真优化编解码器保持有竞争力的PSNR。单一检查点支持宽码率范围并快速解码，补偿器在三种主干上均带来一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过在码率诱导的量化单元内进行有界生成式重建，PerQ兼顾感知质量与像素保真度，实现单模型多码率、快速解码且可跨主干通用，为感知编解码提供了新范式。

title: A latent control model for realistic rodent motion
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages, 13 figures. Project page with supplementary videos: https://aidansirbu.com/SCAMPER-site/
summary: The development of embodied models of animal behavior is a major goal of the neuro-AI community. Embodied models will enhance our ability to make direct comparisons between biological and artificial agents. To make such comparisons effective, though, we need embodied models that actually move like animals. Previous work has developed virtual animal bodies and techniques for training realistic motion through imitation. However, to date, there is no system for embodied animal modeling that produces natural movements both during trained goal-directed behavior, and during exploration driven by random generation. Here, we introduce Simulated Control via Augmented Motor Priors for Embodied Reinforcement learning (SCAMPER), a system for training an embodied virtual rat model, enabling natural movements during both goal-directed behavior and random exploration. SCAMPER uses a variational architecture with two distinct priors, a motion prior for control and a behavior prior for exploration. We show that combining both of these priors allows SCAMPER to generate realistic behavior during exploration and exploit the task structure effectively. SCAMPER can also learn from sparse rewards as a result of the diverse movements induced by the behavior prior, allowing the system to model realistic sparse-reward tasks from experimental neuroscience. Altogether, SCAMPER provides the neuro-AI community with an effective new system for training embodied models of rodents on realistic tasks.

AI.tldr: SCAMPER是一个用于训练具身虚拟大鼠模型的系统，通过结合运动先验和行为先验的变分架构，使虚拟大鼠在目标导向行为和随机探索中都能产生自然的运动。
AI.motivation: 神经-AI社区需要能像动物一样运动的具身模型，以便直接比较生物与人工智能体。现有虚拟动物身体和模仿学习技术存在不足：尚缺乏能在训练过的目标导向行为和随机探索中都产生自然运动的系统。
AI.method: 提出SCAMPER（Simulated Control via Augmented Motor Priors for Embodied Reinforcement learning），采用含两个不同先验的变分架构：用于控制的运动先验（motion prior）和用于探索的行为先验（behavior prior），并在具身虚拟大鼠模型上进行强化学习训练。
AI.result: 结合两种先验使SCAMPER在探索时生成逼真行为，并有效利用任务结构；行为先验诱导的多样运动使其能从稀疏奖励中学习，从而可建模实验神经科学中的真实稀疏奖励任务。
AI.conclusion: SCAMPER为神经-AI社区提供了一个有效的新系统，可在真实任务上训练啮齿类具身模型。

title: VPFlow: Value-Predictive Planning with Imperfect World Models for Offline Goal Reaching
summary: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning enables skill acquisition by reaching any goal from any state without dense rewards. Model-based methods allow for planning by scaling test-time compute to solve complex tasks. Combining both holds appealing promise for pre-training on suboptimal demonstrations and zero-shot adaptation via goal specification and planning. Yet existing methods assume effective planning requires accurate next-state prediction in pixel or latent space. In this work, we show that value prediction is more useful for planning, whereas accurate state prediction is often unnecessary. Our key insight is that offline goal reaching naturally admits a closed-form Monte Carlo return, enabling value regression to replace temporal-difference bootstrapping. We use this return as the sole supervision for latent world models: imagined latents are trained to predict goal-reaching value rather than match future states, implicitly preventing representation collapse. These planning-oriented representations let imperfect world models imagine on the level sets of value field beyond dataset transitions. We then present VPFlow, a value-predictive planner that pairs the world models with a one-step flow policy and plans in its noise space via evolutionary search. It enables policy improvement with imagined generalized advantage and reduces out-of-distribution queries common in action-space planning. On 30 state and pixel OGBench datasets, VPFlow surpasses model-free baselines by at least 30.3 and 10.1 percentage points in success rate, respectively, and outperforms latent planners LeWorldModel, PLDM, and TD-MPC2. It achieves this despite a latent prediction error orders of magnitude larger than with state prediction, while minimizing this error lowers success rate. This demonstrates that value-predictive representations, not exact state prediction, are what offline planning requires.

AI.tldr: VPFlow提出用"价值预测"而非"状态预测"来监督离线目标条件RL中的世界模型：利用目标可达回报的闭式蒙特卡洛估计作为唯一监督，构建面向规划的价值预测表征，并结合一步流策略在噪声空间做进化搜索规划，在30个OGBench数据集上显著超越模型无关与潜在规划基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于模型的离线目标条件RL方法普遍假设"有效规划需要准确的下一状态预测（像素或潜空间）"，从而把世界模型的训练重心放在状态重建/预测上。作者认为这一假设值得质疑，并希望同时利用离线数据预训练（允许次优演示）与测试时扩展计算进行零样本目标规划。
AI.method: 关键观察：离线目标到达问题天然存在闭式的蒙特卡洛回报，因此可用价值回归替代时序差分自举。作者将这一回报作为潜世界模型的唯一监督信号——想象中的潜变量被训练去预测"目标到达价值"而非匹配未来状态，从而隐式避免表征坍缩。所得面向规划的表征使不完美的世界模型能够在价值场等值面上进行超出数据集转移的想象。基于此提出VPFlow：将世界模型与一步流策略配对，在流策略的噪声空间中用进化搜索进行规划，实现带想象广义优势的策略改进，并减少动作空间规划中常见的分布外查询。
AI.result: 在30个状态与像素OGBench数据集上，VPFlow在成功率上分别至少超过模型无关基线30.3和10.1个百分点，并优于潜在规划器LeWorldModel、PLDM和TD-MPC2。值得注意的是，其潜预测误差比状态预测方法大几个数量级，却仍取得上述优势；且刻意降低该误差反而会降低成功率。
AI.conclusion: 离线规划真正需要的是价值预测表征，而非精确的状态预测。以闭式蒙特卡洛回报监督的潜世界模型，即使状态/潜预测不准确，也能支撑有效的目标条件规划，这挑战了"模型必须准确预测状态"的传统共识。

title: Which Agent's Skill Should Change? Group-Relative Credit Assignment for Evolving Multi-Agent Teams
summary: Cooperative language-model agents can improve without weight updates by revising reusable skills, but only if a shared team reward is traced to the responsible agent and skill. Existing methods credit the skills present in each trajectory, yet presence is not responsibility: a harmful skill active in successful runs still earns positive credit. We present \textbf{GRSE}, \textbf{G}roup-\textbf{R}elative \textbf{S}kill \textbf{E}volution, which assigns behavioral credit by comparison: inspired by GRPO, it executes each question several times under the same skill libraries and contrasts the executions to credit agent--skill pairs, with structured diagnosis of failures. On HotpotQA and LoCoMo with two open-weight actors, GRSE outperforms MASkills, the closest prior method, on HotpotQA and every LoCoMo category except open-domain, with the largest gains on multi-hop questions ($+6.7$ and $+3.2$ F1). Its gains rest on better-grounded retrieval rather than answers given without evidence, and its learned skills transfer between the multi-hop tasks. GRSE is robust to corrupted libraries: starting from planted harmful skills, it credits every planted skill with the correct sign and recovers the score of a clean library ($+6.3$ points), whereas MASkills misattributes two and falls below its starting point.

AI.tldr: GRSE提出用组相对比较为合作语言模型智能体分配行为信用，解决"技能存在≠技能负责"的信用错配问题。
AI.motivation: 智能体可在不更新权重的情况下通过修订可复用技能来提升，但前提是团队奖励能追溯到负责的智能体和技能。现有方法只对轨迹中出现的技能给信用，而"出现"不等于"负责"：一个在成功运行中出现的有害技能仍会获得正向信用。
AI.method: 受GRPO启发，对每个问题在同一技能库下多次执行，通过对比执行结果来为智能体—技能对分配行为信用，并结合对失败的结构化诊断。
AI.result: 在两个开源权重actor上，HotpotQA和除open-domain外的所有LoCoMo类别均优于MASkills，多跳问题增益最大（+6.7和+3.2 F1）；增益来自更有依据的检索而非无证据作答，学习到的技能可跨多跳任务迁移。面对被植入有害技能的污染库，GRSE对每个植入技能给出正确符号的信用并恢复到干净库分数（+6.3分），而MASkills误判两个技能并低于起点。
AI.conclusion: 以组相对比较替代"存在即信用"是解决多智能体技能信用分配的有效途径，能提升性能、支持技能迁移并抵御被污染的技能库。

title: Object-Oriented Harness: Evolving Agent Harnesses through Object-Oriented Design
summary: Agent harnesses are executable code that specifies the prompts, tools, and control flow around a language model. A single global harness can struggle with heterogeneous tasks that require different execution strategies. In this work, we introduce Object-Oriented Harness (OO-Harness), a harness optimization framework that evolves a hierarchy of executable harness classes using object-oriented design. During training, an evolution agent uses execution records to create a family of specialized harnesses, each implemented as a subclass of the base or an existing specialized harness via inheritance. At test time, a harness router uses routing lessons accumulated during training to select a specific harness for each task. Across three long-horizon benchmarks spanning business workflows, workspace tasks, and tool use, OO-Harness achieves the best performance among the compared methods, with an absolute improvement of up to 15% over the base. Extensive ablation studies examine the contributions of its core components.

AI.tldr: 提出面向对象式 harness 优化框架 OO-Harness，通过演化可执行 harness 类层级并用路由器为任务选择专用 harness。
AI.motivation: 单一全局 harness 难以应对需要不同执行策略的异构任务。
AI.method: 训练期由演化代理利用执行记录构建专用 harness 族，每个 harness 以继承方式作为基类或已有专用 harness 的子类实现；测试期由 harness 路由器依据训练中积累的路由经验为每个任务选择对应 harness。
AI.result: 在覆盖业务流程、工作区任务与工具使用三个长时程基准上取得对比方法中最优表现，较基线最高绝对提升 15%；并通过消融实验分析核心组件贡献。
AI.conclusion: 对象化、层次化并可路由的 harness 设计能有效适配异构长时程任务，优于单一全局 harness。

title: Test-time Adaptation for Point Cloud Denoising under Unseen Noise
summary: Although deep learning-based point cloud denoising methods have demonstrated impressive results in recent years, their effectiveness usually degrades substantially in real-world scenarios where the noise distribution of test point clouds deviates from that of the training set. To address this challenge, we propose a test-time adaptive denoising (TTAD) framework that enables existing denoising approaches to adapt to unknown noise patterns at test time without relying on additional supervision or retraining from source data. Taking a pre-trained denoising model and a test noisy point cloud as input, TTAD first employs a residual-driven noise modeling (RDNM) module to estimate the sample-specific noise distribution through analyzing the deviation between the noisy input and its pseudo-clean version denoised by the initial model. Then, a noise-aware contrastive adaptation (NACA) module is designed to build sample-specific noisy-noisier test-time training pair from the denoised point cloud, and update the model parameters over a few adaptation steps per sample at test time through contrastive learning. Furthermore, TTAD naturally extends to a continual TTAD (CTTAD) setting, facilitating efficient progressive refinement across sequential test samples with consistent noise distributions, while reducing the computational cost per sample. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the generalization ability of existing denoising models under unseen noise, achieving superior performance across multiple evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出测试时自适应去噪框架TTAD，让预训练点云去噪模型在测试阶段无需额外监督即可适应未知噪声分布，并可扩展为连续版CTTAD。
AI.motivation: 现有基于深度学习的点云去噪方法在测试点云噪声分布偏离训练集时（真实场景中很常见）效果显著下降，需要一种无需重新训练或额外监督的适应手段。
AI.method: TTAD以预训练去噪模型和测试噪声点云为输入：先用残差驱动噪声建模（RDNM）模块，通过分析输入与初始去噪得到的伪干净点云之间的偏差，估计样本特定的噪声分布；再用噪声感知对比适应（NACA）模块，从去噪点云构建样本特定的"噪声-更噪声"测试时训练对，通过对比学习在测试时对每个样本进行几步参数更新。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在未见噪声下显著提升现有去噪模型的泛化能力，在多个评价指标上取得更优性能。
AI.conclusion: TTAD提供了即插即用的测试时自适应能力；并可自然扩展为CTTAD，在噪声分布一致的连续测试样本上实现渐进式精修并降低单样本计算开销。

title: TEX: Test-Time Scaling Testing Agents via Execution-based Cross-Validation
summary: Test-case generation is critical but remains challenging for language models. Existing test-time scaling methods either isolate candidates or aggregate traces, which do not scale to long-horizon tasks. We present TEX, a collaborative test-time scaling framework based on execution-driven cross-validation. TEX parallelizes agents to generate tests and patches, cross-executing each test against every patch to form a $K \times K$ feedback matrix. Agents use their matrix slices for refinement, enabling objective validation without verbose trace sharing. On SWT-Bench Verified, TEX achieves 86.4%, establishing a new state-of-the-art and improving +9.0% over single-agent baselines. Moreover, even random selection from TEX outputs (84.4%) surpasses the previous SOTA (84.0%), showing collaborative execution feedback improves solution quality, not just best-case samples. Our results highlight execution-grounded feedback as an effective scaling mechanism for long-horizon agentic tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TEX，一个基于执行驱动交叉验证的协作式测试时扩展框架，用于长程的测试用例生成任务。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法要么隔离候选、要么聚合轨迹，难以扩展到长程任务；且依赖冗长的轨迹共享，缺乏客观验证。
AI.method: 并行化多个智能体分别生成测试与补丁，将每个测试与每个补丁交叉执行，构成 K×K 反馈矩阵；各智能体仅凭自己对应的矩阵切片进行迭代精炼，以客观执行结果替代冗长轨迹共享。
AI.result: 在 SWT-Bench Verified 上达到 86.4%，刷新 SOTA，较单智能体基线提升 +9.0%；即使随机选取 TEX 输出也有 84.4%，超过此前 SOTA 的 84.0%。
AI.conclusion: 执行驱动反馈是长程智能体任务中有效的扩展机制，协作执行反馈能整体提升解的质量而非仅改善最优样本。

title: VampPrior Unleashed
summary: Deep latent variable models (DLVMs) underpin many modern analysis pipelines, for example in single-cell genomics, yet their prior distributions have received markedly little attention. The VampPrior approximates the optimal prior (the aggregate posterior) and often attains high model evidence. Here, we identify two key limitations of the VampPrior: it ties prior and posterior uncertainty to a single amortized covariance and clusters poorly due to its fixed uniform mixture weights. We unleash the VampPrior by decoupling its prior and posterior covariances, resolving the conflict of generating high prior and low posterior entropy with the same shared parameters and substantially improving model evidence. We then replace the uniform mixture with a Dirichlet process. When combined, our proposals provide higher model evidence than the VampPrior and robust non-parametric clustering. Augmenting single cell Variational Inference (scVI) with our prior improves single-cell integration and clustering across six atlases while significantly raising model evidence. Our approach changes only the prior and thus can be applied to any DLVM with a continuous latent space.

AI.tldr: 本文指出VampPrior的两个局限（先验与后验共享单一amortized协方差、固定均匀混合权重导致聚类差），通过解耦先验/后验协方差并用Dirichlet过程替换均匀混合，提出改进先验，在模型证据与无参数聚类上均优于VampPrior，并在scVI中提升单细胞整合与聚类。
AI.motivation: 深度潜变量模型（如单细胞基因组学中的scVI）广泛应用，但其先验分布研究甚少。VampPrior虽能近似最优先验（聚合后验）并获得较高模型证据，却存在两点缺陷：先验与后验不确定性绑定于同一amortized协方差；且固定均匀混合权重导致聚类效果差。
AI.method: 1) 解耦先验与后验协方差，消除用同一套共享参数同时追求"高先验熵、低后验熵"的冲突；2) 用Dirichlet过程替代均匀混合权重，实现非参数混合。两者组合使用，仅修改先验，可适用于任意连续潜空间的DLVM。
AI.result: 组合方案在模型证据上高于VampPrior，并实现稳健的非参数聚类；将新先验引入scVI后，在六个图谱上改善了单细胞整合与聚类，同时显著提升模型证据。
AI.conclusion: 先验设计是DLVM中被忽视但关键的一环；简单地对VampPrior做协方差解耦与Dirichlet过程混合改造即可显著提升证据与聚类，且因只改先验而具良好通用性。

title: MMedAgent-Plus: Scaling Multimodal Medical Agents across Modalities, Tasks and Workflows
summary: Medical workflows often require multiple interdependent analyses, but existing specialist and generalist AI models are not designed to coordinate them. We introduce MMedAgent-Plus, a multimodal medical tool-use agent that combines a vision-language planner with 18 leading specialist models spanning 12 tasks and 8 modalities. Through a unified tool interface, the planner selects specialists, executes them in sequence, and synthesizes responses grounded in their outputs. The planner is instruction-tuned on 208,928 samples from 32 public medical benchmarks, covering single- and multi-tool interactions across single and multiple rounds. We separately evaluate tool orchestration, response synthesis, and end-to-end execution on held-out samples. MMedAgent-Plus achieves tool-call accuracies of 91.0%, 98.1%, and 80.7% in single-tool multi-round, multi-tool multi-round, and multi-tool single-round settings, respectively. Given correct tool outputs, MMedAgent-Plus achieves scores of 14.4-14.8 out of 15 for faithfulness, completeness, and conciseness across 600 evaluation samples. In end-to-end execution without pre-supplied tool outputs, MMedAgent-Plus correctly invokes the required specialist in 90.6% of 350 evaluation cases spanning seven tasks. Its final-answer accuracy reaches 0.98, matching the dedicated leading specialist and exceeding the strongest baseline (0.28).

AI.tldr: MMedAgent-Plus 是一个多模态医疗工具调用智能体，用视觉语言规划器协调 18 个跨 12 任务、8 模态的专家模型，在工具编排与端到端任务上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 医疗工作流常需多个相互依赖的分析步骤，但现有专家模型和通用模型缺乏协调多种工具的能力，无法完成多工具、多轮次的复合医疗任务。
AI.method: 构建视觉语言规划器 + 统一工具接口，整合 18 个专家模型（12 任务、8 模态）；规划器按需选择并顺序执行专家、基于其输出合成答案；在 32 个公开医疗基准的 208,928 条样本上做指令微调，覆盖单/多工具、单/多轮交互；分别评估工具编排、回答合成与端到端执行。
AI.result: 工具调用准确率：单工具多轮 91.0%、多工具多轮 98.1%、多工具单轮 80.7%；在给定正确工具输出时，600 个样本的忠实性/完整性/简洁性得分 14.4–14.8（满分 15）；端到端无预给输出时，350 案例中 90.6% 正确调用所需专家，最终答案准确率 0.98，与最强专家持平，远超最强基线 0.28。
AI.conclusion: 统一的工具接口加指令微调的规划器可有效实现多专家医疗工具编排，达到专家级最终答案质量，为复合医疗 AI 工作流提供可行范式。

title: TokenFlow: Latent Token Rectified Flow Matching for 3D Point Cloud Generation
summary: 3D point clouds generation requires capturing both part-level layout and surface detail while preserving permutation equivariance. Existing latent generative models often encode an entire shape into a single vector, which limits their ability to retain part-level structure. We propose TokenFlow, a hierarchical flow matching framework that represents each shape as a set of latent tokens and couples a rectified flow over these tokens with a conditional flow over points. A bottleneck of $M \ll N$ learnable tokens aggregates global context through cross-attention at $O(NM)$ cost. On ShapeNet, TokenFlow achieves the best MMD and coverage across airplane, car, and chair, while obtaining 1-NNA comparable to the strongest baselines. On ModelNet, its learned latent set reaches the best reported linear-evaluation accuracy on ModelNet10. These results show that representing a shape as a set of latent tokens, aggregated at $O(NM)$ cost, provides an effective representation for 3D point cloud generation.

AI.tldr: TokenFlow: 一种分层流匹配框架，将形状表示为潜token集合，用token上的rectified flow耦合点上的条件flow，实现3D点云生成。
AI.motivation: 现有潜生成模型将整个形状编码为单一向量，难以保留部件级结构；同时需兼顾部件级布局、表面细节与置换等变性。
AI.method: 用M≪N个可学习token通过交叉注意力以O(NM)代价聚合全局上下文；在token集合上施加rectified flow，并与点上的条件flow耦合，形成分层流匹配。
AI.result: ShapeNet上在airplane、car、chair上取得最佳MMD与coverage，1-NNA与最强基线相当；ModelNet10上潜集合取得最佳线性评测准确率。
AI.conclusion: 以token集合表示形状并以O(NM)代价聚合，是3D点云生成的有效表示方式。

title: Vulnerability Analysis for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement
summary: Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (SMARL) aims to learn cooperative control policies under prescribed safety constraints. Al- though existing SMARL methods focus on enforcing safety during policy optimization, their vulnerability remains largely unexplored. This paper investigates inference-time observation attacks against SMARL, where an adversary perturbs the observations of a subset of agents, thereby altering the actions produced by their policies. We propose MinMax Attack, an attack framework that jointly selects adversarial target actions for compromised agents while accounting for the Cooperative Resistance of benign agents. We further derive a bound on the induced safety cost and characterize its relation- ship with the Compromised-Agent Budget and the Perturbation Budget. Experiments across multiple safety-critical multi-agent benchmarks and representative state-of-the-art SMARL algorithms show that MinMax Attack induces substantially higher safety costs than existing attack baselines while preserving task reward, thereby reducing its detectability and achieving both attack effectiveness and stealthiness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MinMax Attack，一种针对安全多智能体强化学习（SMARL）的推理时观测攻击框架，通过联合选择被妥协智能体的对抗目标动作并考虑良性智能体的协同抵抗，在保持任务奖励的同时显著提高安全代价。
AI.motivation: 现有 SMARL 方法主要关注策略优化阶段的安全约束，但其在推理阶段的脆弱性尚未被充分研究。对手可通过扰动部分智能体的观测来改变其策略输出动作，从而破坏安全性。
AI.method: 提出 MinMax Attack 攻击框架：在推理时扰动部分智能体的观测，联合优化被妥协智能体的对抗目标动作，同时显式建模良性智能体的协同抵抗（Cooperative Resistance）；并推导了诱导安全代价的上界，刻画其与妥协智能体预算及扰动预算的关系。
AI.result: 在多个安全关键的多智能体基准与代表性 SOTA SMARL 算法上，MinMax Attack 相比现有攻击基线产生显著更高的安全代价，同时保持任务奖励，从而降低可检测性，兼具攻击有效性与隐蔽性。
AI.conclusion: SMARL 策略在推理阶段存在被观测扰动攻击的安全隐患；MinMax Attack 能有效且隐蔽地破坏安全性，揭示了现有 SMARL 方法的脆弱性，强调了推理时鲁棒性的必要性。

title: Automated Brick Schema Knowledge Graph Completion Across Buildings
summary: The Brick schema represents building equipment, sensors, spaces, and the relationships between them as typed, multi-relational graphs, providing machine-readable metadata that supports generalizable control applications. Current methods for producing complete Brick models require extensive manual examination of building schematics and point lists. We observe that as Brick models are knowledge graphs, inferring missing relations is naturally posed as a knowledge graph completion problem. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of knowledge graph completion to Brick model generation. We compare three methods, gradient-boosted trees, Pairwise Brick Relation Ranking, and CompGCN, on the relations feeds, hasPart, and hasPoint, which account for the majority of the schematic-reading work in building a Brick model by hand. Models are evaluated on held-out MORTAR buildings and out-of-distribution Kaggle and Building Time Series data. Although CompGCN is the strongest performer on held-out buildings under metrics resistant to class imbalance, leading macro-F1 and AUPRC, no method generalizes uniformly across datasets or relations.

AI.tldr: 首次将Brick模型补全建模为知识图谱补全（KGC）问题，并比较梯度提升树、Pairwise Brick Relation Ranking与CompGCN在feeds、hasPart、hasPoint三类关系上的表现，发现CompGCN在留出建筑上宏观指标最优，但无方法能跨数据集、跨关系一致泛化。
AI.motivation: 构建完整Brick模型需大量人工查阅建筑图纸与点表，成本高昂；由于Brick模型本质是类型化、多关系知识图，缺失关系推断可自然转化为知识图谱补全任务，从而减少人工工作量。
AI.method: 将Brick建模中的缺失关系推断表述为KGC问题，选取feeds、hasPart、hasPoint三类占据主要人工读图工作的关系；对比三种方法：梯度提升树、Pairwise Brick Relation Ranking，以及图卷积模型CompGCN。
AI.result: 在留出的MORTAR建筑上，CompGCN在抗类别不平衡的指标（macro-F1、AUPRC）上表现最强；但在分布外数据（Kaggle、Building Time Series）上以及不同关系之间，没有任何方法能够一致地泛化。
AI.conclusion: KGC可作为Brick模型自动补全的可行方向，CompGCN在留出建筑宏观指标上占优，但跨数据集与跨关系的泛化仍不统一，说明单一方法难以普适，需针对数据集与关系特性选择或集成方法。

title: CEFR-oriented Russian Text Simplification Using Reinforcement Learning
summary: We present a study on controlled automatic simplification of Russian texts using preference-based optimization algorithms with a focus on adapting texts to the A1, A2 and B1 proficiency levels. We fine-tune YandexGPT using Rejection Sampling and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) methods to improve control over the complexity of the generated text. We compare several training configurations that differ in dataset composition, text type and the strategy used to construct preference pairs for DPO. For automatic evaluation we train a regression model based on ruRoBERTa-large to predict continuous complexity scores corresponding to CEFR levels. We also consider semantic similarity, lexical coverage and quantitative readability metrics. Human evaluation assesses simplicity, fluency and adequacy. Our best model achieves 87.15\% target level accuracy, an MAE of 0.35 CEFR levels and a target interval MAE of 0.11. Manual assessment shows that 75% of the evaluated simplifications match the target morphological and syntactic level, and fluency and adequacy scores are especially high for A2 and B1. Although A1 remains the most challenging level, the model significantly reduces the proportion of vocabulary and grammatical constructions beyond the target level while generally preserving meaning. Our model is freely available on $\href{https://huggingface.co/kmustakova/RuSimplifier_DPO}{HuggingFace}$.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究俄语文本的自动简化，采用偏好优化方法（Rejection Sampling 与 DPO）微调 YandexGPT，使生成文本可控地适配 A1、A2、B1 语言水平，并通过自动与人工评估验证效果，模型已开源。
AI.motivation: 俄语文本简化需要将内容适配到特定 CEFR 等级（A1/A2/B1），但现有方法对生成文本复杂度的控制能力不足，难以稳定落在目标水平区间。
AI.method: 以 YandexGPT 为基础模型，使用 Rejection Sampling 和 Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) 微调，比较不同数据集构成、文本类型与偏好对构建策略的训练配置。自动评估采用基于 ruRoBERTa-large 的回归模型预测连续 CEFR 复杂度分数，并结合语义相似度、词汇覆盖率与可读性指标；同时进行人工评估（简洁性、流畅性、充分性）。
AI.result: 最佳模型达到 87.15% 目标等级准确率，CEFR 等级 MAE 为 0.35，目标区间 MAE 为 0.11。人工评估显示 75% 简化结果匹配目标形态与句法水平，A2 和 B1 的流畅性与充分性得分尤其高；A1 仍最具挑战性，但模型显著减少了超纲词汇与语法结构，并基本保持语义。
AI.conclusion: 基于偏好优化的微调可有效提升俄语文本简化的等级可控性，在保持语义的同时显著降低超纲语言成分，模型已公开于 HuggingFace。

authors: Udaya Sampath K. Perera Miriya Thanthrige
title: LoRASpace: A Pool-Wide Shared Substrate for Static and Dynamic Multi-LoRA Composition
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 29 pages, 6 figures, 26 tables. Code: https://github.com/Thamirawaran/loraspace. Project page: https://thamirawaran.github.io/loraspace
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) attaches small low-rank matrices to a frozen backbone, and public repositories host many LoRAs per backbone, each for a different concept or task. Combining several LoRAs in one generation forces a trade-off. Merging their weights into one update needs a single forward pass, but LoRAs trained for different concepts interfere and quality drops. Running each LoRA in its own forward pass (composite) preserves quality, but inference time grows linearly with the number of active LoRAs. We study a property of LoRA pools overlooked by prior multi-LoRA work. In real LoRA pools, the stacked low-rank factors need far fewer directions than their summed ranks. Using singular value decomposition, we find the minimal subspace that keeps 99% of the factor energy. On three diffusion pools, only 46% to 57% of the summed LoRA ranks is needed, and the subspace grows sub-linearly with pool size. A 48-LoRA sub-pool of LoRA-Hub on FLAN-T5 tasks shows comparable overlap (62%), while the diversity-curated LoRA-Retriever benchmark sits near the no-overlap baseline (96%), so pool composition rather than modality predicts where compression is large. We build on this overlap with LoRASpace, a training-free method that computes the subspace once per pool and reuses it in two inference modes, a static mode at merge cost and a dynamic mode for input-dependent routing. On the diffusion pools, static LoRASpace matches composite quality at merge cost, and dynamic LoRASpace is more than 6x faster than composite with six active LoRAs on a 17-LoRA pool, mainly because it runs one backbone pass instead of six. In an ablation, static variants at the same rank match LoRASpace, so the quality gain does not depend on the pool-wide basis. On the near-orthogonal LoRA-Retriever benchmark, compression is small and gains come from coupling with external retrieval.

AI.tldr: LoRA池中堆叠低秩因子实际所需方向远少于秩之和，LoRASpace利用该重叠性一次性计算子空间并复用，实现接近composite的质量且推理更快。
AI.motivation: 多LoRA组合存在矛盾：权重合并只需一次前向但不同概念间相互干扰导致质量下降；逐个LoRA单独前向（composite）保持质量但推理时间随LoRA数线性增长。作者研究此前工作忽视的LoRA池本身特性以打破该权衡。
AI.method: 用SVD找出保留因子能量99%的最小低秩子空间，测量真实LoRA池的秩冗余程度；据此提出免训练的LoRASpace：每个池只计算一次子空间，并支持静态模式（合并成本）与动态模式（输入相关路由）两种推理方式。
AI.result: 三个扩散池仅需46%–57%的秩和；LoRA-Hub的48-LoRA子池重叠度62%，而多样性筛选的LoRA-Retriever接近无重叠基线96%，说明池组成而非模态决定压缩潜力。扩散池上静态LoRASpace以合并成本达到composite质量；动态版本在17-LoRA池、6个激活LoRA时比composite快6倍以上，主要因只需一次骨干前向。消融显示同秩静态变体与LoRASpace相当，质量增益不依赖池级基。近似正交的LoRA-Retriever上压缩小，增益来自与外部检索的耦合。
AI.conclusion: 真实LoRA池存在显著子空间重叠，可利用该性质做免训练压缩以兼顾质量与效率；收益大小取决于池的多样性/组成，而非模态，近正交池需借助外部检索。

title: Stronger artificial intelligence breakthroughs hasten their own exhaustion
summary: Progress in artificial intelligence is widely assumed to scale with effort: more researchers, papers and investment should accelerate discovery. Theories of technological growth instead locate the difficulty of discovery in the space of ideas. Here we show that neither scale nor space is enough: breakthroughs depend on diverse attention, which collective concentration can deplete. Across 36 years of computer science, we analyze 7.2 million papers, 73,089 peer reviews and 3.7 million researchers and their topic shifts. The field expanded while its attention narrowed sharply after the Transformer. Over half of topic-shifting researchers moved into AI, especially mid-career ones, and reviewer confidence fell by a full point on a 5-point scale. Each successive breakthrough, from AlexNet to large language models, raised the field's carrying capacity for ideas but was followed by steeper exhaustion of those ideas. Bigger breakthroughs capture attention more completely, depleting the diversity their successors may draw upon. Structural biology shows the same cycle after cryo-EM and AlphaFold. Simulations show how well-intentioned and widely used policies such as reciprocal reviewing empower prolific authors and further narrow what the field accepts. We call for institutions that protect diverse attention in artificial intelligence rather than reward concentration on the winning paradigm.

AI.tldr: 基于36年计算机科学数据（720万篇论文、7.3万条审稿意见、370万研究者），本文提出"注意力多样性"是突破的关键：集体注意力的集中会耗竭多样性，形成"突破—耗尽"循环。
AI.motivation: 主流假设认为AI进展随投入规模线性扩张，而技术增长理论则强调"想法空间"的难度。作者认为二者都不充分，需引入第三种机制：多样化的注意力，且集体集中会耗竭这种多样性。
AI.method: 大规模实证计量：分析36年CS领域的论文、同行评审与研究者主题迁移数据；对比结构生物学中cryo-EM与AlphaFold后的类似循环；并用模拟实验检验互惠审稿等政策的影响。
AI.result: Transformer后领域扩张但注意力显著收窄；过半主题迁移研究者（尤其职业中期）流入AI；审稿人信心下降整1分（5分制）；从AlexNet到大模型，每次突破提升"想法承载容量"却加速其耗尽；突破越大越完全捕获注意力，削弱后继者可汲取的多样性；互惠审稿等政策反而赋权高产作者、进一步收窄领域接受范围。
AI.conclusion: 机构设计应保护AI中的多样化注意力，而非奖励对"获胜范式"的集中投入。

title: LiBRA: Logit Fingerprints for Byzantine-Robust Client Selection in Federated Learning
summary: Byzantine-robust aggregation shields federated learning from malicious updates, but the rules that filter out suspect updates do so by comparing clients' parameter vectors. That comparison requires access to every client's update, which secure aggregation exists to withhold, costs $O(n^2 d)$ in the parameter dimension $d$, and is defined only between clients that share an architecture. We propose LiBRA, which compares clients on what their models compute rather than on the parameters that compute them, using a fingerprint of $C^2$ values for $C$ classes, the class-conditional logit response of each client's model to pseudo-patterns optimised against it. We instantiate LiBRA as variants of Krum, Multi-Krum and Bulyan that change only what the dissimilarity score is computed on. On Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10 with three architectures and four backdoor and label-manipulation attacks under i.i.d. partitions, each variant holds every attack its parent holds, and on identical client updates under a backdoor attack the fingerprint ranks malicious clients within 0.006 AUC of the full parameter vector. The variants thus match the robustness of the rules they extend, while their trust decision reads no client parameter, compares up to 49,090 times fewer values, and can by construction compare clients whose architectures differ, at the cost of one pattern optimisation per client per round.

AI.tldr: LiBRA用"模型输出"而非"参数"来比较客户端：为每个客户端用C²个值的指纹（对伪模式优化的类条件logit响应）计算差异度，并据此改造Krum/Multi-Krum/Bulyan。指纹排序恶意客户端与全参数向量的AUC差距仅0.006，比较值少至49090倍，且支持异构架构。
AI.motivation: 拜占庭鲁棒聚合依赖比较客户端参数向量来过滤可疑更新，但这需要访问每个客户端的更新（与安全聚合的目标冲突）、复杂度为O(n²d)、且只在架构相同的客户端之间定义。
AI.method: 提出LiBRA：比较客户端模型"计算什么"而非"用什么参数计算"。每个客户端的指纹为C²个值，即模型对针对其优化的伪模式的类条件logit响应。实例化为Krum、Multi-Krum、Bulyan的变体，仅替换差异度分数的计算对象。在Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10上，用三种架构、四种后门与标签操纵攻击、i.i.d.划分评估。
AI.result: 每个变体都保持了其母规则的防御能力；在相同客户端更新与后门攻击下，指纹对恶意客户端的排序与全参数向量相差在0.006 AUC以内；信任决策不读取任何客户端参数，比较值最多减少49090倍，并能天然比较不同架构的客户端。
AI.conclusion: LiBRA以每客户端每轮一次模式优化的代价，换取了与参数比较相当的鲁棒性、隐私友好性和跨架构可比性。

title: Predicting Linear Relational Decodability Without the Relation
summary: Linear relational embeddings (LREs) approximate a language model's subject-to-object mapping with an affine function. Their faithfulness varies enormously across relations, from near zero for person_father to the ceiling for country_capital_city. We investigate the factors that contribute to this variation and demonstrate that it can be significantly predicted from a readout that is not aware of the underlying relation. To do so, we propose a novel form of the Jacobian lens, the entity lens. Whereas the Jacobian lens is estimated across all tokens and concepts, the entity lens EL_t is trained to predict what the model will output for an entity of type t under the neutral prompt "{} is known for"; e.g., we train ELs for countries and persons. After estimating an entity lens, we measure how highly it ranks the model's answer for a relation without using any relation-specific information in estimation and prediction. Across 28 relations of the LRE dataset on Olmo-3-7B this relation-agnostic score correlates with LRE faithfulness at ρ= 0.7355 (p < .01). This suggests that linear decodability is largely a property of what a subject's representation already carries, rather than of the relation being decoded. Moving the unit of analysis from the relation to the individual fact, we conclude that new relation datasets and analysis methods are needed to address several problems in existing datasets, most prominently semantically weak first tokens (e.g., most predicted universities' first token is "University") and reference competition (e.g., the LLM confuses obscure actor names with competing non-actor entities that have the same last name). Our full pipeline is available at https://github.com/jonasrohw/entity-lens

AI.tldr: 论文发现线性关系嵌入(LRE)的忠实度可从与关系无关的"实体透镜"打分中预测(ρ=0.7355),表明线性可解码性主要取决于主语表示本身携带的信息,而非被解码的关系。
AI.motivation: LRE忠实度在不同关系间差异极大(从接近零到上限),作者要探究这种差异的来源,并检验是否与具体关系无关。
AI.method: 提出实体透镜(entity lens),一种新形式的Jacobian lens:针对实体类型t(如国家、人物),在固定中性提示"{} is known for"下训练EL_t预测模型输出。用EL对模型答案的排序打分构造关系无关评分,在Olmo-3-7B的LRE数据集28个关系上检验其与LRE忠实度的相关性。
AI.result: 关系无关评分与LRE忠实度相关ρ=0.7355(p<0.01)。说明线性可解码性大多是主语表示已有属性的产物,而非关系本身的属性。
AI.conclusion: 分析单元应从关系转向单个事实;现有数据集存在语义弱的首token(如预测大学多以"University"开头)和参考竞争(同名非演员实体干扰)等问题,需要新的关系数据集与分析方法。代码已开源。

title: FocusOVD: Geometric and Contextual Feature Refinement for Open-Vocabulary Small-Object Detection
comment: Accepted as a full paper at ChineseCSCW 2026
summary: Open-vocabulary object detection aims to detect both seen and unseen categories by leveraging the semantic knowledge of vision-language models. However, existing methods often struggle with small objects due to insufficient preservation of high-resolution details, ineffective information aggregation across feature levels, and limited region-level discriminability. To address these challenges, we propose FocusOVD, an open-vocabulary object detector that enhances small-object representations without modifying the frozen VLM backbone. FocusOVD introduces three complementary components: a Reweighted Cross-scale Feature Fusion module, which learns normalized level-wise weights to adaptively balance shallow appearance details and deep semantic cues during feature pyramid aggregation; a Residual Pinwheel-shaped Gated Convolution module, which strengthens local geometric responses in high-resolution features; and a Residual Convolutional Gated Linear Unit module, which suppresses background-dominated activations and enhances RoI discriminability before prediction. Extensive experiments on COCO-OVD and LVIS-OVD demonstrate the effectiveness of FocusOVD. On COCO-OVD, FocusOVD achieves a novel-category AP of 36.3%, outperforming CORA, UniDetector, and SAMP by 1.3%, 1.1%, and 1.5%, respectively; on LVIS-OVD, it achieves an overall AP of 33.7%, surpassing the strongest competing method by 0.6%. These results demonstrate the strong generalization ability of FocusOVD for open-vocabulary small-object detection.

AI.tldr: 提出FocusOVD开放词汇目标检测器，针对小目标通过三个模块增强高分辨率特征表示，在COCO-OVD和LVIS-OVD上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇目标检测方法在小目标上表现不佳，原因包括：高分辨率细节保留不足、跨特征层信息聚合不有效、区域级判别能力有限。
AI.method: 在不修改冻结VLM主干的前提下引入三个互补模块：1) Reweighted Cross-scale Feature Fusion，学习归一化的层级权重，在特征金字塔聚合中自适应平衡浅层外观细节与深层语义线索；2) Residual Pinwheel-shaped Gated Convolution，增强高分辨率特征的局部几何响应；3) Residual Convolutional Gated Linear Unit，抑制背景主导的激活并提升RoI判别能力。
AI.result: COCO-OVD上新类AP达36.3%，分别超过CORA、UniDetector、SAMP 1.3%、1.1%、1.5%；LVIS-OVD整体AP达33.7%，超过最强对比方法0.6%。
AI.conclusion: FocusOVD在开放词汇小目标检测上展现出较强泛化能力，验证了在不改动冻结VLM主干情况下增强特征表示的有效性。

title: When Does an Added Planning Capability Create Operational Value? An Observable Evidence Standard
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Accepted and presented at the 3rd IEOM World Congress on Industrial Engineering and Operations Management, Irvine, California, USA, October 13-15, 2026. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/yvonnexu442/planning-capability-evidence-standard/releases/tag/v1.0-camera-ready
summary: Industrial artificial intelligence (AI) planning systems combine predictive models, optimization logic, controls, and governance rules, but improvement in the complete policy does not show whether one addition made an independent contribution or whether that contribution justifies its burden. We address this attribution problem with an observable evidence standard that separates opportunity to act, executed-plan change, operational consequence, equivalence, uncertainty, and operating scope. Using forecast-to-plan replay on Favorita, M5, and Walmart data, we apply the standard to heterogeneous planning additions. Three limits of single-indicator evaluation emerge. First, a composite policy can conceal negligible component contribution: one control changed only 15 of 681 executed plans. Second, changing execution does not guarantee stable benefit: the evaluated multi-period capability helped in several long-lead settings but was 7.6% more costly under tight capacity. Third, indirect evidence can prioritize review but cannot complete attribution. Independent runs produced different paths in 19 of 599 cases that a rule-based check predicted would be unchanged. Although a lower-cost diagnostic matched the full-evaluation winner in only 55.0% of cases, it selected an option within the $10^{-6}$ cost-equivalence tolerance in 79.5%; the remaining cases prevented the proxy from authorizing acceptance. These experiments establish capability-level contribution evidence; the organization completes the value decision by weighing it against implementation and sustaining burden. The resulting capability evidence record links the observations to validation, deployment scope, fallback, monitoring, redesign, and retirement decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对工业AI规划系统中"某项能力是否独立贡献价值"的归因难题，提出可观测证据标准并在Favorita、M5、Walmart数据上实证，揭示单指标评估的三大局限。
AI.motivation: 工业AI规划系统整合预测、优化、控制与治理规则，但完整策略的整体提升无法说明某一新增组件是否做出独立贡献，或该贡献是否值得其负担。
AI.method: 提出将"行动机会、执行计划变更、运营后果、等价性、不确定性、适用范围"分离的可观测证据标准；在Favorita、M5、Walmart数据上用"预测到计划重放"（forecast-to-plan replay）对异质性规划组件进行检验。
AI.result: 发现单指标评估的三重局限：(1)复合策略掩盖微小贡献——某控制仅改变了681个执行计划中的15个；(2)改变执行不保证稳定收益——多期能力在长提前期有效，但在紧容量下成本高7.6%；(3)间接证据只能提示复核而非完成归因——规则预测"无变化"的599例中有19例独立运行路径不同。低成本诊断仅在55.0%案例中选对全评估赢家，但在79.5%案例中落在1e-6成本等价容差内，其余案例阻止代理授权接受。
AI.conclusion: 实验建立了"能力级贡献证据"；组织需结合实施与维护负担做价值决策。由此形成的能力证据记录将观测与验证、部署范围、回退、监控、重设计与退役决策相连接。

title: Predictive Closure: A Set-Level Characterization of JEPA's Feature Selection
summary: In joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA), an encoder and a predictor are trained together to produce a representation that minimizes the error in predicting the representation of the next observation. Because the representations of both the current and the next observation are learned, it is unclear which features they will include. Earlier characterizations describe the features JEPA selects in terms of their individual predictability, raising the concern that unpredictable features, like a traffic light, will not be encoded into the representation. However, the prediction error is also affected by the relationships between features, e.g., the light's color helps predict whether the traffic will stop. We propose the predictive closure characterization, which accounts for these relationships. Based on a reformulation of the JEPA training objective, we show that selection depends on properties of feature sets. This view agrees with earlier works when features evolve independently, but makes new predictions when they do not, for instance that a feature like the traffic light can still be retained. We test this characterization in controlled experiments, which show that unpredictable features can become better represented when they help predict other features, and that changing one feature's predictive relationships can affect how well others are represented. We also demonstrate implications for steering feature selection: targeting one feature with an auxiliary objective, or supplying it to the predictor as side information, can strengthen the representation of another feature whose future values it helps predict, so steering can be indirect.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"预测闭包"(predictive closure)刻画，解释JEPA类联合嵌入预测架构会选择哪些特征进入表征：特征是否被保留不仅取决于其自身可预测性，还取决于它与其他特征的关系。
AI.motivation: 早期刻画认为JEPA仅保留"个体可预测"的特征，由此担心红绿灯这类不可预测特征会被丢弃。但预测误差还受特征间关系影响（如灯的颜色帮助预测车是否停下），因此需要更完整的理论解释。
AI.method: 通过对JEPA训练目标重新形式化，将特征选择归结为特征集合的性质；并在受控实验中验证：不可预测特征在能帮助预测其他特征时可被更好表征，改变某特征的预测关系会影响其他特征的表征。
AI.result: 实验证实不可预测特征在具有预测价值时仍被保留；同时发现可通过辅助目标或向预测器提供侧信息进行间接"引导"(steering)，从而强化另一特征的表征。
AI.conclusion: JEPA的特征选择由特征集合的整体关系决定，而非仅个体可预测性；这为理解和引导表征提供了新视角，且引导可以是间接的。

title: Diagnostic Analysis for Large Language Model Reasoning
summary: Reasoning structures (e.g., chains and graphs) are increasingly used for probabilistic inference, factuality verification, and uncertainty estimation, but their structural reliability is rarely evaluated directly. We test whether this reliability holds through a proposed two-stage diagnostic evaluation in open-ended multi-hop QA. Stage 1 tests different capabilities required to construct reasoning graphs, showing that graph reliability varies with topology, prompt design, and model family. Stage 2 uses uncertainty estimation as a downstream test case. Generated-edge experiments show that graph-based computation is sensitive to upstream graph errors, with performance dropping relative to the gold-graph setting. Gold-graph experiments further show that graph structure provides little benefit when used only as prompt context, but improves the separation of correct from incorrect answers by confidence score and enables node-level diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出两阶段诊断式评估，检验开放域多跳QA中推理结构（链/图）的可靠性与实际效用。
AI.motivation: 推理结构被广泛用于概率推断、事实性验证与不确定性估计，但其结构可靠性本身很少被直接评估。
AI.method: Stage 1 检验构建推理图所需能力，考察拓扑、提示设计与模型族对图可靠性的影响；Stage 2 以不确定性估计为下游测试，分别做生成图与金标图实验。
AI.result: 生成图实验显示图计算对上游图错误敏感，性能低于金标图设置；金标图仅作提示上下文时收益有限，但能改善按置信度区分的正确/错误答案分离度，并支持节点级诊断。
AI.conclusion: 推理图的价值更多体现在不确定性与细粒度诊断层面，而非单纯的答案提升；其可靠性受结构与模型因素显著影响。

title: Cross-Visibility-Gap Identity Persistence for 4D Scene Graphs
summary:
