Across different benchmarks and backbones, Anti-Persistence achieves higher overall held-out success and the lowest average LLM-call cost among the evaluated memory designs. These results support separating experience accumulation from abstraction persistence in memorybased self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM智能体外部记忆的设计问题，指出存储抽象知识会导致"错误复现"反馈循环，提出Anti-Persistence记忆设计：只累积轨迹与结果，按需重建任务指导并在执行后丢弃，从而在多个基准上获得更高的成功率与最低的LLM调用成本。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体可通过外部记忆存储经验实现免参数更新的自我改进。关键争议在于记忆应只保留观察到的轨迹与结果，还是也保留从中推断的规则、摘要与技能。保留抽象可复用策略，但错误抽象会通过检索复用传播，并污染后续执行轨迹，再被重新抽象，形成错误的持续复制（error reproduction）。
AI.method: 提出Anti-Persistence记忆设计：持续累积轨迹与结果，而在需要时按需重建任务特定指导；由一个自适应选择器依据历史结果决定是否以及如何合成指导，该指导在执行后即被丢弃，不作为存储对象被直接复用（间接经由保留轨迹的反馈仍可能存在）。
AI.result: 在不同基准与不同骨干模型上，Anti-Persistence取得更高的留出集整体成功率，并在所评估的记忆设计中具有最低的平均LLM调用成本。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在基于记忆的自我改进中将"经验积累"与"抽象持久化"分离，即保留经验而不长期保存抽象可缓解错误复现问题。

title: Projected Distillation: On Learning to Solve Hard Problems from Close, Correct Targets
summary: On-policy learning is central to post-training: training on a model's own generations limits distribution shift and helps preserve existing capabilities. On hard problems, however, on-policy RL provides no reward-based learning signal when all attempts fail. On-policy distillation provides next-token supervision from a teacher, but on hard problems, if a rollout goes wrong early, subsequent supervision is conditioned on prefixes that already contain the mistake. Correct behavior can instead come from a gold or teacher solution, but such off-policy targets can differ substantially from the model's generations and, as we show, may erode existing capabilities. We therefore treat on-policyness as a continuum and propose projected distillation, which minimally edits the student's failed attempts into correct targets. The method uses contrastive updates to favor corrections over failed attempts and refreshes these corrections as the student evolves, enabling near-on-policy learning even when all student attempts fail. Theoretically, we prove that the student's learning regret grows with the edit size: it scales linearly with the horizon under minimal correction, as in DAgger, and quadratically under full-answer replacement, as in behavior cloning. Empirically, across two students (Qwen3-8B and OLMo-2-7B) and five domains spanning math, code, science, and tool use, projected distillation gives the highest area under the specialization-retention frontier (best on 8 of 9 cells against GRPO and OPD, and 7 of 9 against SPOT and SODA). Our ablations highlight the importance of online corrections, the contrastive loss, and on-policyness: moving targets farther off-policy steadily worsens the specialization-retention trade-off, with retention falling from 0.916 to 0.744 when minimal corrections are replaced by student-agnostic gold solutions.

AI.tldr: 提出 projected distillation：将学生失败尝试"最小编辑"为正确目标，实现近 on-policy 学习，兼顾专门化能力与原有能力保持。
AI.motivation: on-policy RL 在困难问题上全部失败时无奖励信号；on-policy 蒸馏在早期出错时后续监督基于含错前缀；而 off-policy 的 gold/教师答案偏离学生分布，可能损害已有能力。
AI.method: 将 on-policyness 视为连续谱，最小幅度编辑学生失败轨迹以生成正确目标；采用对比损失偏好正确修正而非失败尝试；并随学生演化在线刷新修正目标。
AI.result: 理论上证明学习 regret 随编辑幅度增长：最小修正下随 horizon 线性（同 DAgger），完整替换下二次（同行为克隆）。实验在 Qwen3-8B 与 OLMo-2-7B 及五个领域上，specialization-retention 前沿 AUC 最高（对 GRPO/OPD 9 格中 8 格最优，对 SPOT/SODA 9 格中 7 格最优）。消融显示在线修正、对比损失与 on-policyness 均关键，改用 gold 答案使 retention 从 0.916 降至 0.744。
AI.conclusion: 以"最小编辑"实现近 on-policy 蒸馏，在不牺牲已有能力的前提下高效提升困难任务表现。

title: SHAM-Bench: A Span-level Hallucination Benchmark Across Multiple Tasks
summary: Span-level hallucination detection pinpoints unsupported content in LLM outputs, enabling actionable feedback and targeted mitigation. Existing evaluations for span-level hallucination detection methods are fragmented across tasks, annotation formats, and metrics, and most span-level datasets cover only a single NLG domain, making it difficult to assess whether a detection method actually generalizes across tasks and domains. In this paper, we introduce SHAM-Bench (Span-level Hallucination Benchmark Across Multiple Tasks), a unified benchmark for span-level hallucination detection spanning six NLG tasks, aggregated from existing human-annotated datasets totaling 6,461 examples under a common schema and evaluation protocol. Using SHAM-Bench, we evaluate existing hallucination detection methods and find that fine-tuned detectors often perform well in-domain but degrade under distribution shift, whereas prompt-based methods with reasoning are more robust across tasks. Our analysis further shows that subtle unsupported content remains difficult to detect and span-level evaluation is still challenged by ambiguous span boundaries and noisy labels. We release the dataset, evaluation code, and a public leaderboard to support future research on broadly generalizable hallucination detection.

AI.tldr: 提出SHAM-Bench，一个跨六类NLG任务、共6,461例的统一span级幻觉检测基准，用于评估检测方法的跨任务泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有span级幻觉检测评测在任务、标注格式与指标上彼此割裂，且多数数据集只覆盖单一NLG领域，难以判断检测方法是否能真正跨任务跨领域泛化。
AI.method: 从已有的人工标注数据集聚合六个NLG任务的样本，统一为共同的数据schema与评测协议，构建SHAM-Bench基准，并在其上系统评测现有幻觉检测方法（微调式与提示式）。
AI.result: 微调检测器在域内表现良好，但在分布偏移下明显退化；带推理的提示式方法跨任务更稳健。分析还发现细微的无支撑内容仍难检测，span边界模糊与标注噪声仍是span级评测的主要挑战。
AI.conclusion: SHAM-Bench揭示了现有方法的泛化短板，公开数据集、评测代码与排行榜以推动更具泛化性的span级幻觉检测研究。

title: Real In, Real Out: What If We Only Use Real Data for Scene Text Editing?
comment: Accepted as a conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Aiming to modify textual content while preserving the original style, Scene Text Editing (STE) has significant practical value in many applications. STE typically requires paired images before and after editing for training. However, recent approaches rely heavily on synthetic paired data and complex disentanglement strategies. They struggle to faithfully capture the diversity and complexity of natural scenes, often producing artifacts or hallucinations. In this work, we challenge the common practice and investigate whether STE can be driven by turning each real sample into its own paired supervision. Concretely, we explore multiple ways to disrupt the original image (e.g., Crop, Shuffle, Mask) to construct self-paired training data, and build a strong baseline (TextRIRO}) upon a conditional diffusion architecture. Our experiments show that combining character-column shuffling with image cropping (Shuffle&Crop) effectively destroys text semantics while preserving key style cues, enabling the model to learn editing behaviors directly from the real text image. With this concise yet real-oriented design, TextRIRO achieves promising performance in both accuracy and visual realism across real-world benchmarks, substantially mitigating the synthetic-to-real domain gap. Furthermore, we leverage TextRIRO to build TextRIRO-3M, a large-scale realistic dataset for long-text recognition by concatenating edited and original images. Experimental results show that training recognition models with TextRIRO-3M significantly improves recognition accuracy, demonstrating that TextRIRO provides highly useful training resources for downstream tasks. Overall, TextRIRO lifts STE to realistic, reliable, and widely applicable new levels. Code is available at https://github.com/YesianRohn/TextRIRO.

AI.tldr: 提出TextRIRO，用自配对（Shuffle&Crop破坏语义保留风格）代替合成配对数据，基于条件扩散实现真实场景文本编辑，并构建TextRIRO-3M数据集提升下游识别。
AI.motivation: 现有STE方法依赖合成配对数据和复杂解耦策略，难以刻画自然场景的多样性与复杂性，常产生伪影或幻觉，存在合成到真实的域差距。
AI.method: 挑战常规做法，探索将每个真实样本自身转为配对监督：用Crop、Shuffle、Mask等方式破坏原图构建自配对训练数据，并基于条件扩散架构建立强基线TextRIRO。实验发现字符列打乱加图像裁剪（Shuffle&Crop）能破坏文本语义同时保留关键风格线索，使模型直接从真实文本图像学习编辑行为。
AI.result: 在真实世界基准上于准确性和视觉真实度均取得可观表现，显著缓解合成到真实的域差距；并拼接编辑与原图构建大规模真实长文本识别数据集TextRIRO-3M，训练识别模型可显著提升识别精度。
AI.conclusion: TextRIRO将STE推向真实、可靠、广泛应用的新水平，并为下游任务提供高质量训练资源；代码已开源。

title: KPHarness: Co-Evolving Knowledge and Probing for Long-Horizon Gaming Harnesses
summary: A failed gaming trajectory reveals that an agent needs intervention, but not necessarily how its execution harness should change. Effective harness adaptation therefore requires gathering diagnostic evidence, rather than merely proposing alternative recovery rules. We present KPHarness, a framework that adapts the external execution harness of a frozen vision-language-action model through knowledge-probing co-evolution. Recovery knowledge supplies context-specific intervention hypotheses that guide active probing; probe outcomes reveal when these hypotheses apply and provide evidence for refining both recovery knowledge and later probe selection. This reciprocal process allows the harness to improve not only which interventions it applies, but also how it investigates failures. KPHarness separates fast policy execution from a slow research loop that translates accumulated knowledge and probing evidence into bounded harness revisions. Each revision is compared with the incumbent under matched sandbox conditions and accepted only when the paired evaluation shows improvement. Recoveries supported by further validation are retained for cross-task reuse, while immediate interaction feedback and delayed episode-success credit update action- and knowledge-probing policies during adaptation. Experiments on Minecraft tasks spanning mining, combat, and crafting show improved task coverage over bare policy execution, a manually specified fixed harness, and knowledge-only harness evolution with non-adaptive probing. Evaluation on previously unseen tasks further shows improved task completion with the evolved harness, knowledge bank, and probing policies held fixed,

AI.tldr: 提出KPHarness框架，通过"知识探针协同进化"自适应调整冻结视觉-语言-动作模型的外部执行外壳（harness），将快速策略执行与慢速研究循环分离，实现可验证的外壳修订。
AI.motivation: 失败的游戏轨迹只能说明需要干预，但无法直接告诉执行外壳应如何改变。因此有效的外壳自适应需要主动收集诊断证据，而非仅提出替代恢复规则。
AI.method: 恢复知识提供情境化干预假设并引导主动探测；探测结果揭示假设适用条件并反馈用于精炼知识库与后续探测选择，形成双向协同进化。系统分为快速策略执行与慢速研究循环，将积累的知识与探测证据转化为有界的外壳修订；每项修订在匹配沙盒条件下与现有版本成对评估，仅在显示改进时接受。经进一步验证的恢复方案跨任务复用，即时交互反馈与延迟回合成功信用共同更新动作与知识探测策略。
AI.result: 在Minecraft的采矿、战斗、制作任务上，任务覆盖率优于裸策略执行、人工固定外壳及仅知识进化（非自适应探测）方法；在未见任务上，固定进化后的外壳、知识库与探测策略仍提升任务完成率。
AI.conclusion: 将外壳自适应重构为"知识引导探测—证据驱动修订"的协同进化过程，并结合沙盒成对验证，可在不微调基础策略的前提下有效提升冻结VLA智能体在复杂长程任务中的鲁棒性与泛化性。

title: Training-Free Continual Learning for Multimodal Forecasting via Prompt Evolution
summary: Adapting a forecasting system to a changing world classically means retraining. We ask whether the task of continually learning regimes for time series forecasting can be represented by a piece of text: a guidance block, evolved by outcome-driven reflection and used in a frozen LLM forecaster's prompt. On a refreshed multimodal benchmark (weekly search indices, daily currencies, daily commodities, each window paired with web-retrieved news), we run GEPA-style prompt evolution under strict contamination control to prevent the data leakage common in timeseries benchmarks: the forecaster's knowledge cutoff predates every evaluated window. A 900-word evolved guidance carried by Llama-3.3-70B beats TimeSeries Foundation Models (TSFMs) on held-out data (GM MASE 0.776 vs. 0.898 for TabPFN-TS-3), transfers to more recent models without measurable loss, and costs dollars rather than GPU-days to update. We characterize the loop: out-of-loop gains concentrate in the first reflection, in-loop improvements overstate out-of-loop gains 2-3x unless an untouched monitor arbitrates, and error-only objectives silently suppress the text modality. We provide two extensions. First, compiling the guidance into executable code with a TSFM as a callable tool recovers most of the gain deterministically. Second, ablations show the advantage widens at short horizons and that removing the news text does not hurt the guided forecaster, consistent with the text's value being distilled into policy during learning. We argue that continual prompt evolution is a practical, training-free alternative to retraining for multimodal forecasting.

AI.tldr: 用一个约900词的"指导文本"(guidance block)代替重训练,通过结果驱动的反思式提示演化,让冻结的LLM预测器持续适应变化的时间序列情景,并系统刻画该演化循环。
AI.motivation: 传统上让预测系统适应变化的世界需要重训练。作者提出:持续学习时间序列预测的"情景(regimes)"能否被表示为一段可演化的文本,嵌入冻结LLM的提示中,从而以低成本、无需训练的方式实现持续适应,并规避时间序列基准中常见的数据泄漏问题。
AI.method: 构建刷新的多模态基准(每周搜索指数、每日汇率、每日商品,每个窗口配网页检索新闻);在严格污染控制下运行GEPA风格的提示演化,保证预测器知识截止早于所有评估窗口;演化出的900词指导由Llama-3.3-70B承载,并与TSFM比较;进一步将指导编译为可执行代码(TSFM作为可调用工具);并做消融(短horizon、去除新闻文本)。
AI.result: 演化指导在留出数据上超过TSFM(GM MASE 0.776 vs TabPFN-TS-3的0.898);可无损迁移到更新模型;更新成本以美元计而非GPU天。发现:循环外增益集中在第一次反思;循环内改进会高估循环外增益2-3倍,除非用未参与优化的监控集仲裁;仅用误差目标会隐性压制文本模态。编译为代码可确定性恢复大部分增益;优势在短horizon更明显;去除新闻文本不损害引导预测器(说明文本价值在学习中被蒸馏为策略)。
AI.conclusion: 持续提示演化是面向多模态预测的一种实用、免训练的重训练替代方案。

title: DStill: Trajectory Consistency Distillation for Accelerated One-Step Drafting in Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
summary: Block-diffusion speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel. However, one-step drafting in discrete diffusion is limited by token factorization error: each token is predicted from the same masked block, without conditioning on the tokens selected at other positions in that step. This can produce inconsistent drafts and reduce acceptance length. Iterative refinement mitigates this limitation by conditioning later predictions on previously committed tokens, though additional passes increase drafting cost. To address this trade-off between draft fidelity and inference latency, we introduce DStill, a two-stage framework that distills a target-conditioned drafter's own multi-step refinement into one-step drafting. We first train the drafter to complete partially revealed blocks, then use its refinement trajectories to train a student to predict the final completion in one pass. Using a curriculum that gradually transitions from partial to fully masked inputs, we successfully transfer the multi-step refinement capabilities into one step. Across reasoning, math, code benchmarks on three model families DStill improves acceptance length by up to 28% and speedup by up to 25% over one-step DFlash, achieving up to 6.45x speedup over auto-regressive decoding.

AI.tldr: DStill通过两阶段蒸馏，将目标条件drafter的多步精炼能力压缩进一步起草，解决块扩散推测解码中token分解误差导致的接受长度下降问题，在多个基准上提升接受长度最多28%、加速最多25%，相对自回归解码最高6.45倍加速。
AI.motivation: 块扩散推测解码通过并行起草多个token来加速LLM推理，但离散扩散的一步起草受token分解误差限制：每个token都从同一掩码块预测，未条件化于该步其他位置已选token，导致草稿不一致、接受长度降低。迭代精炼可缓解但增加起草成本，需权衡草稿保真度与推理延迟。
AI.method: 提出DStill两阶段框架：先训练drafter补全部分揭示的块；再利用其精炼轨迹训练student一步预测最终补全；采用从部分掩码逐步过渡到全掩码输入的课程学习，将多步精炼能力迁移到一步。
AI.result: 在三个模型家族的推理、数学、代码基准上，相比一步DFlash，接受长度提升最多28%，加速最多25%，相对自回归解码最高达6.45倍加速。
AI.conclusion: DStill有效弥合了草稿保真度与推理延迟的权衡，在不增加起草成本的前提下显著提升块扩散推测解码的效率。

title: Causal Spatiotemporal State Evolution for Monocular 4D Reconstruction
summary: While feed-forward models excel in static 3D geometry estimation, extending them to dynamic 4D scenes requires modeling visual geometry as a causally evolving state. Current methods typically rely on unordered temporal aggregation, which lacks the directional structure of physical time. Furthermore, existing supervision often treats geometry and motion as disjoint objectives, failing to exploit their inherent physical coupling. Consequently, they lack a unified constraint to effectively supervise temporal state transitions, leading to inconsistent 4D scene representations. To address this, we propose a feed-forward framework for causal 4D visual geometry learning from monocular videos. At its core, Causal Spatiotemporal Mamba augments temporal aggregation with directional state propagation. Through complementary Temporal-Spatial and Spatial-Temporal Scans, CSM continuously propagates geometry-aware states across frames to model spatiotemporal evolution. To align this causal state evolution with observable dynamics, we introduce Unified Motion Supervision. Rather than treating motion as an independent objective, UMS leverages geometry-aware predictions from the camera and depth heads to construct a unified forward motion field that is consistent with the underlying 3D structure. This geometry-grounded supervision explicitly constrains inter-frame state transitions, enabling stable states propagation across frames. Extensive evaluations on dynamic benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across video depth, camera pose, and optical flow estimation. These results validate that the synergy between the directional state propagation of Causal Spatiotemporal Mamba and Unified Motion Supervision effectively captures continuous scene evolution, significantly reducing temporal drift and reinforcing spatial-temporal consistency in 4D representation learning.

AI.tldr: 提出前馈框架，用因果时空Mamba（CSM）结合统一运动监督（UMS），从单目视频学习因果4D几何，在视频深度、位姿、光流上达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 前馈模型擅长静态3D几何，但扩展到动态4D需将视觉几何建模为因果演化的状态。现有方法用无序时间聚合，缺乏物理时间的方向结构；监督上把几何与运动当作独立目标，未利用二者物理耦合，缺乏统一约束来监督时间状态转移，导致4D表示不一致。
AI.method: 核心为Causal Spatiotemporal Mamba（CSM）：通过互补的Temporal-Spatial与Spatial-Temporal扫描，在帧间持续传播几何感知状态，赋予时间聚合方向性。并引入Unified Motion Supervision（UMS）：利用相机与深度头部的几何感知预测构建与3D结构一致的前向运动场，显式约束帧间状态转移。
AI.result: 在动态基准上于视频深度、相机位姿、光流估计均取得SOTA，显著减少时间漂移，增强时空一致性。
AI.conclusion: CSM的方向性状态传播与UMS的协同，能有效捕捉连续场景演化，强化4D表示学习的时空一致性。

title: Harness Self-Evolution for Long-Horizon Terminal Agents
summary: Long-horizon terminal agents may solve a task in one run yet fail across repeated runs. Stochastic errors can propagate through actions and context, creating a gap between capability and reliable execution. We present RiseHarness, a framework for iteratively improving agent harnesses with model weights fixed. It focuses on flipping tasks with both successful and failed runs under the same configuration, using successful runs as references for failure analysis. RiseHarness combines agent trajectories with internal harness traces from a runtime monitor to examine how model actions interact with command execution, feedback, context management, and completion decisions. A Harness Handbook links this evidence to harness behaviors and source code, helping identify recurring problems in mechanisms shared across tasks. RiseHarness then searches other harness frameworks for relevant implementations and adapts them as design references to the current model and execution protocol. Candidate changes undergo behavioral checks and repeated task evaluation; versions with measured gains seed the next iteration. This loop integrates suitable mechanisms from different frameworks into a single harness and uses new execution evidence to guide further changes. We evaluate task success and reliability across models, ablate harness execution evidence and external research, and test transfer to unseen benchmarks with the same model. RiseHarness treats a specific model as the unit of harness adaptation, studying how changes to shared interaction mechanisms can make existing capabilities more reliable across tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 RiseHarness 框架，在固定模型权重的前提下迭代改进终端智能体的 harness，通过成功/失败运行对比分析与跨框架机制借鉴，把已有能力转化为更可靠执行。
AI.motivation: 长时程终端智能体单次可完成任务，但重复运行时常失败：随机错误沿动作与上下文传播，造成"能力"与"可靠执行"之间的落差。
AI.method: 聚焦同一配置下既有成功又有失败的任务，用成功轨迹作失败分析参照；结合智能体轨迹与运行时监控的 harness 内部 trace，考察模型动作与命令执行、反馈、上下文管理、完成决策的交互；用 Harness Handbook 将证据关联到 harness 行为与源码以定位共性机制问题；再从其他 harness 框架检索相关实现并适配当前模型与执行协议；候选改动经行为检查与重复任务评测，有增益版本进入下一轮迭代。
AI.result: 评估任务成功率与可靠性（跨模型）；消融 harness 执行证据与外部研究的作用；测试同模型下向未见基准的迁移。
AI.conclusion: 以特定模型作为 harness 适配单元，通过改进共享交互机制使现有能力在任务间更可靠，并将多框架的合适机制整合进单一 harness。

title: When Parameter Gradient Flows Close in Representation Space
comment: 34 pages, 2 figures; code and numerical data included as ancillary files
summary: The represented gradient flow of a parameterized model depends on a mobility that can retain hidden parameter information. We study when one entire represented mobility map works for every autonomous loss from one fixed initialization. For two-factor matrix representations wider than both output dimensions, with individually full-row-rank factors, we classify all admissible joint ranks: closure occurs precisely at effective scalar-balanced minimal joint rank or a two-value signed spectral family at full joint rank. All intermediate ranks are excluded; positive represented flows belong to known square-root families. For general representations with constant ambient representation and gradient-Lie ranks, ordinary closure is equivalent to a local invariant-level metric in the analytic case and specified smooth regimes. An endpoint section forces the initially unrestricted mobility map to admit a locally smooth representative on the represented image. We also separate testing families: linear losses locally admit closure at every submersion, whereas one fixed translated strongly convex quadratic family fails it on a delayed-bracket example. A fixed output readout gives an ordinary squared-loss witness. These supporting results do not characterize quadratic-only closure in general. We retain the unresolved smooth output-rank-two case with Lie rank at least four. A frozen deterministic experiment checks a separate engineered-loss construction; it is distinguished from the squared-loss proof, universal theorems and empirical learning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究表示梯度流中"表示移动度（mobility）"对整个损失函数族的普适闭包问题，对双因子矩阵表示在满行秩条件下分类了容许的联合秩，并给出若干等价性与分离性结果。
AI.motivation: 参数化模型的表示梯度流依赖于携带隐藏参数信息的移动度，作者希望刻画：在固定初始化下，单一表示移动度映射能否对所有自治损失同时成立（闭合性）。
AI.method: 对宽于输出维度的双因子矩阵表示（因子各自满行秩），对全部容许联合秩进行分类；对具有常环境表示与梯度-Lie 秩的一般表示，用局部不变层度量和端点截面刻画普通闭包；并用线性损失、平移强凸二次族、输出读出等测试族做分离性对比。
AI.result: 闭包仅发生在有效标量平衡的最小联合秩，或满联合秩下的二值带符号谱族；所有中间秩被排除，正表示流属于已知平方根族。一般情形下（解析及指定光滑区域）普通闭包等价于局部不变层度量；端点截面迫使受限移动度在表示像上有局部光滑代表。线性损失在每个浸没处局部可闭包，而固定平移强凸二次族在延迟括号例子上失败；固定输出读出给出普通平方损失见证。
AI.conclusion: 结果为表示梯度流的闭包现象提供了秩级分类与一般等价刻画，但未刻画一般的"仅二次"闭包，光滑输出秩二且 Lie 秩≥4 的情形仍未解决；文中冻结的确定性实验仅检验单独构造的工程损失，与平方损失证明、普适定理及经验学习性能相区分。

title: Looking Into The Past: The Impact of Context on Detecting Deceptive Statements
summary: Deception detection typically considers messages in isolation. Previous works in claim verification and role detection have displayed that additional information such as gameplay history is crucial to successful predictions. In this work, we demonstrate the value of preceding gameplay dialogue when applied to deceptive message detection within the hidden role game of Avalon. The findings show that LLMs can see improvement across a number of metrics, including accuracy by up to 31\% with the addition of gameplay context for the target message.

AI.tldr: 在《阿瓦隆》游戏中加入目标消息之前的对局对话作为上下文，可显著提升大模型对欺骗性消息的检测效果。
AI.motivation: 现有欺骗检测通常孤立地分析单条消息，而谎言验证和角色识别领域的研究表明，游戏历史等额外信息对预测至关重要。作者希望验证前置对局对话对欺骗检测的价值。
AI.method: 以隐藏角色游戏《阿瓦隆》为场景，将目标消息之前的对局对话作为额外上下文输入LLM，与仅使用单条消息的基线在多个指标上对比。
AI.result: 加入游戏上下文后，LLM在多项指标上均有提升，准确率最高提升31%。
AI.conclusion: 前置游戏对话上下文对欺骗消息检测有明显价值，说明孤立分析消息存在局限，上下文信息应被纳入欺骗检测框架。

title: HiQGS: Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Querying for Feed-Forward Gaussian Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction from sparse posed monocular frames requires reasoning over observations that vary jointly in viewpoint and time. Existing methods either predict Gaussian primitives from observation-aligned features or aggregate multi-frame information through compact latent queries. However, the former tightly couples Gaussian allocation to individual frames, while the latter does not explicitly structure observed evidence according to its temporal relation to the requested timestamp. Consequently, evidence across spatial scales, viewpoints, and timestamps can be difficult to align and integrate. We present \textbf{HiQGS}, a query-based hierarchical framework for feed-forward Gaussian scene reconstruction from sparse monocular frames. HiQGS introduces a \textbf{Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Encoder} that organizes multi-resolution geometry-appearance visual features according to image location, observation time, and camera pose, thereby preserving complementary appearance and structural cues. Our \textbf{Time-Adaptive Decoder} use target timestamp queries the resulting hierarchical representation to retrieve relevant spatiotemporal evidence and predicts the corresponding Gaussian scene state. Experiments on static and dynamic scene reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate strong rendering quality and geometric accuracy, validating the effectiveness of hierarchical visual encoding and target-time-aware Gaussian querying.

AI.tldr: HiQGS：一种基于查询的分层框架，从稀疏单目视角图像前馈重建高斯场景，通过分层时空编码器与时间自适应解码器提升渲染质量与几何精度。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏带位姿单目帧前馈重建高斯时，观测在视角与时间上同时变化。现有方法要么将高斯分配与单帧紧耦合，要么用紧凑潜查询聚合多帧但未按时间关系结构化证据，导致跨空间尺度、视角与时间戳的证据难以对齐整合。
AI.method: 提出HiQGS：1）分层时空编码器，按图像位置、观测时间与相机位姿组织多分辨率几何-外观视觉特征，保留互补的外观与结构线索；2）时间自适应解码器，以目标时间戳为查询从分层表示中检索相关时空证据，并预测对应的高斯场景状态。
AI.result: 在静态与动态场景重建基准上实验，表现出较强的渲染质量与几何精度，验证了分层视觉编码与目标时间感知高斯查询的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 按空间、时间与视角结构化组织观测证据，并以目标时间戳驱动查询，可有效解决稀疏单目帧前馈高斯重建中的证据对齐与整合难题。

title: Ask to Distill: Learning to Synthesize Data for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) can succeed with surprisingly few training questions, motivating a view of questions as carriers of distributional knowledge transfer. How can we assess whether a newly generated question is valuable for distillation, and learn to generate better questions---without access to its correct answer? We introduce Ask-to-Distill (\method), a framework that treats synthetic questions as distribution elicitors and optimizes the teacher supervision they expose along student-generated trajectories. A student-initialized synthesizer is optimized using a distributional surrogate for question value, computed from a frozen student--teacher pair without reference answers, correctness rewards, or per-candidate student updates. The reward combines teacher--student disagreement with teacher probability mass on the student's candidate support, together with length and diversity controls. The generated questions are filtered and deduplicated into a prompt-only bank for standard OPD. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and agentic tasks, our method improves average performance and teacher-gap recovery over unoptimized student-generated prompts and KL-filtered real questions, while matching or exceeding real-bank OPD in the evaluated settings. Signal analyses further show that optimized questions can elicit denser supervision and more total signal from shorter student responses, supporting elicited distributional supervision as an objective for synthetic distillation data. Our code, data and models are publicly available at https://github.com/GasolSun36/Ask_to_Distill.

AI.tldr: 提出 Ask-to-Distill (A2D) 框架，将合成问题视为"分布诱导器"，用无需参考答案的分布代理指标优化问题生成器，生成更高质量的 on-policy 蒸馏问题。
AI.motivation: On-policy 蒸馏用极少问题即可成功，说明问题的本质是分布知识载体；但如何在没有正确答案的情况下评估新生成问题的价值并据此生成更好的问题，尚缺方法。
AI.method: 以学生模型初始化的合成器被优化，奖励为冻结师生对的分布代理信号：教师-学生分歧 + 教师概率质量落在学生候选支持集上的程度，并加入长度与多样性控制；不使用参考答案、正确性奖励或逐候选学生更新。生成问题经过滤去重形成 prompt-only 题库用于标准 OPD。
AI.result: 在数学推理、代码生成、智能体任务上，平均性能与教师差距恢复优于未优化学生生成提示和 KL 过滤的真实问题，与真实题库 OPD 持平或更好。信号分析显示优化问题能在更短学生回答中诱导更密集的监督和更多总信号。
AI.conclusion: "诱导式分布监督"可作为合成蒸馏数据的目标函数；代码、数据与模型已开源。

title: Orthogonal Boundary Unlearning for Dual-Use Concepts in Large Language Models
comment: 19 pages (inclusive of bibliography and appendix), 2 figures, 3 tables
summary:
Mitigating catastrophic risks from large language models requires excising hazardous operational capabilities, such as cyberwarfare exploitation and pathogen enhancement, without degrading benign scientific utility. In these dual-use domains, legitimate defensive science and malicious attacks share vocabulary, syntax, and internal model representations, causing standard unlearning methods to induce severe collateral damage (concept bleeding).
  In this work, we present Orthogonal Boundary Unlearning (OBU), a mathematically grounded framework designed to eliminate collateral damage on benign dual-use capabilities. OBU extracts a domain-matched capability subspace from paired calibration queries via singular value decomposition on empirical activation covariances, and restricts parameter updates strictly to the orthogonal null space. This guarantees that benign representations experience zero parameter perturbation along the spanned calibration subspace.
  We present two complementary realizations of OBU: Projected LoRA, which applies the orthogonal constraint during iterative gradient-based fine-tuning, and Closed-Form Weight Surgery, which directly edits model weights in a single analytical step without training. Across four modern open-weight foundation models (Gemma-3-4B, Qwen3.5-4B, SmolLM3-3B, and Granite-4.2-3B), OBU achieves strong dual-use concept separation, substantially mitigates in-context priming attacks, and demonstrates durable resistance against adversarial relearning without degrading benign domain competence.

AI.tldr: 提出正交边界遗忘（OBU）框架，通过将参数更新严格限制在与良性能力子空间正交的零空间中，在去除危险双用途能力的同时避免对良性科学能力造成附带损害。
AI.motivation: LLM存在网络战、病原体增强等危险操作能力，需去除这些能力但不能损害良性科学用途。但在双用途领域，合法防御研究与恶意攻击共享词汇、语法和内部表征，标准遗忘方法会导致严重的附带损害（概念渗漏）。
AI.method: OBU基于数学框架：先从配对校准查询中通过对经验激活协方差做奇异值分解，提取与领域匹配的能力子空间；再将参数更新严格限制在其正交零空间中，保证良性表征在标定子空间上零扰动。实现两种形式：Projected LoRA（迭代梯度微调中加入正交约束）与闭环权重手术（单步解析直接编辑权重，无需训练）。
AI.result: 在Gemma-3-4B、Qwen3.5-4B、SmolLM3-3B、Granite-4.2-3B四个开源基座模型上，OBU实现强双用途概念分离，显著缓解上下文引导攻击，并对对抗性再学习具有持久抵抗力，同时不损害良性领域能力。
AI.conclusion: 将遗忘更新约束在正交零空间是消除双用途领域概念渗漏的有效途径，投影式训练与解析式权重手术两种实现均可兼顾安全性与良性效用。

title: The Router Already Knows
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models already make a sparse choice for every token: which experts should process it. We ask whether a sparse dictionary should reuse that choice. NR-SAE gives each routed expert a small dictionary and opens only those the frozen router selects. At block 15 of Gemma 4 26B-A4B, after ten million C4 training tokens and across three seeds, the expert-aligned autoencoder explains 0.518 of the variance in router-weighted expert outputs on a fixed evaluation capture. A rank-addressed control with the same parameters but sixteen times as many candidates reaches 0.481, a candidate-matched control 0.458, and an architecture-matched control with randomized expert identity 0.387. A transcoder variant also leads all three controls: 0.432, against 0.347, 0.371, and 0.118. Part of this advantage is architectural: each expert writes into a subspace of at most a quarter of the model width, so naming the expert names the subspace. How much it explains, we have not measured. At this layer and budget, the router already knows something a dictionary would otherwise have to learn. Our implementation did not train faster, and semantic interpretability, downstream loss, and causal faithfulness remain untested.

AI.tldr: 提出NR-SAE：复用MoE路由器选择，为每个专家配小型字典，仅打开路由器选中的专家字典，在Gemma 4 26B-A4B第15层上解释方差0.518，显著优于三类控制组。
AI.motivation: MoE模型本身对每个token做稀疏路由（选择专家）。作者想探究稀疏自编码器（SAE）是否可复用它这一路由选择，从而避免字典重新学习路由器已知的信息。
AI.method: NR-SAE为每个路由专家分配一个小型字典，只激活被冻结路由器选中的专家的字典。在Gemma 4 26B-A4B第15层训练（1000万C4 token，3个随机种子），并设三个对照：rank-addressed（同参数但16倍候选）、candidate-matched、architecture-matched（随机化专家身份）；另做transcoder变体。
AI.result: 主实验解释方差0.518，对照为0.481/0.458/0.387；transcoder变体0.432，对照为0.347/0.371/0.118。作者指出部分优势来自架构：每个专家只写入≤1/4模型宽度的子空间，命名专家即命名子空间，但该因素贡献未测量。
AI.conclusion: 在此层与预算下，路由器已掌握字典本需学习的信息；但实现未训练更快，语义可解释性、下游loss与因果忠实性仍未测试。

title: DART: Scaling a Shape Representation Across Anatomical Classes and Imaging Modalities
summary: Current state-of-the-art segmentation models still produce anatomically implausible shapes, such as broken vessels and fragmented glands, on the structures that are hardest to segment. Learned shape representations capture what structures look like and can help correct these errors, but most cover a fixed set of anatomical classes. Extending this coverage across classes and imaging modalities is costly because it often requires new voxel-level annotations. We propose Diffusion for Anatomical Reshaping with Text (DART), which learns a shared shape representation from segmentation probabilities. It uses anatomical descriptions to correct these probabilities without receiving medical images. Across 13 public benchmarks, absolute Dice gains reach 31% for individual gallbladder cases in CT and 10% for individual prostate cases in MRI. Using existing segmentation predictions, we scale a single shape representation from 50 to 377 anatomical classes without new voxel-level annotations for correction training. The shared representation also corrects four lesion classes absent from training and transfers from CT to MRI without retraining. Corrected labels also improve segmentation models, raising one model's Dice from 57.1% to 67.5%. The same pipeline supports annotations for 45,000 CT scans. These results suggest that sharing shape information within and across classes can reduce the need for new voxel-level annotations when extending segmentation to more anatomical classes and imaging modalities. The model is available at https://huggingface.co/Koushik45/DART-Seg

AI.tldr: DART 从分割概率中学习共享的形状表征，用解剖文本描述纠正分割结果，无需医学图像或新体素标注，可在 377 个解剖类别间共享并跨模态迁移。
AI.motivation: 当前 SOTA 分割模型在最难分割的结构上仍产生解剖学上不合理的形状（血管断裂、腺体碎片化）。已有形状表征能纠错，但大多只覆盖固定解剖类别；扩展到新类别或新模态通常需要昂贵的体素级标注。
AI.method: 提出 DART（Diffusion for Anatomical Reshaping with Text）：以分割概率图为输入学习共享形状表征，并借助解剖文本描述对概率进行纠正，纠正过程不接收医学图像，也无需新体素级标注。
AI.result: 在 13 个公开基准上，CT 胆囊个体病例 Dice 绝对提升达 31%，MRI 前列腺个体病例达 10%；单个形状表征从 50 类扩展至 377 类无需新标注；可纠正训练中未出现的 4 类病变，并从 CT 零重训迁移至 MRI；纠正后的标签还能反哺分割模型（Dice 57.1%→67.5%），并支持 45,000 例 CT 的标注流程。
AI.conclusion: 类别内部与跨类别的形状信息共享可降低扩展解剖类别与成像模态时对新体素级标注的依赖。

title: Self-Evolving Agents through Privileged Retrospective Distillation
summary: Self-evolving agents aim to improve from their own experience rather than remain fixed after deployment, but naturally collected trajectories often lack ground-truth solutions or verifier-derived rewards. We introduce Retrospective Self-Distillation (RSD), a multi-round framework that turns such experience into dense supervision using privileged retrospective context. For each on-policy trajectory, the same underlying model acts as both student and teacher: the teacher re-scores the student's realized actions while conditioning on cross-task precedents and lessons, together with turn-level reflection and future hindsight from the completed trajectory. The resulting teacher distribution is distilled back into the policy through on-policy self-distillation. Across rounds, the experience bank grows and the retrospective context is refreshed, allowing the model, its data, and its supervision to co-evolve. We further introduce frontier-guided context-policy evolution, where a stronger frontier model proposes constrained edits to how privileged context is constructed. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SearchQA with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B, RSD improves performance by up to 59.7% relative to the base model, while frontier-guided context-policy evolution adds up to a further 44.7% relative improvement over a fixed context policy. These results show that naturally accumulated experience can be converted into persistent model capability without ground-truth trajectories or verifier-derived rewards for the core policy update.

AI.tldr: RSD：用特权回顾上下文把无真值的自演化轨迹转成稠密监督，同一模型当学生和老师，多轮中经验库/上下文/监督共同演化，最高提升59.7%，上下文策略进化再+44.7%。
AI.motivation: 自演化智能体希望从自身经验中持续改进，但自然收集的轨迹往往缺少标准答案或验证器给出的奖励，导致无监督信号可用。
AI.method: 提出Retrospective Self-Distillation（RSD）多轮框架：对每条on-policy轨迹，同一底层模型兼作学生与教师，教师结合跨任务先例与教训、回合级反思以及完成轨迹的未来后见信息重新给学生的动作打分，再通过on-policy自蒸馏回灌策略；多轮中经验库增长、回顾上下文刷新，实现模型-数据-监督协同演化。此外引入frontier引导的上下文策略演化，由更强模型对特权上下文构建方式提出受约束的修改。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、SearchQA上，基于Qwen3-8B与Qwen3-14B，RSD相对基座模型提升高达59.7%；frontier引导的上下文策略演化在固定上下文策略基础上再带来最高44.7%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 自然积累的经验可在核心策略更新无需真值轨迹或验证器奖励的情况下转化为持久模型能力。

title: Detecting Errors in Large Language Model Responses: The Incremental Predictive Value of Hidden States
summary: Although large language models support a wide range of tasks, hallucinations remain a major obstacle to user trust. When a model generates an answer, both its internal processing and final output vary with the question. Internal states are often expected to offer richer signals for hallucination detection. However, studies using these states typically report their standalone discrimination performance, while output-side comparisons often use simple baselines with weaker modeling capacity. We integrate output-side information available at inference time into a combined baseline and compare detection performance before and after adding hidden states under identical data splits and evaluation rules. Experiments cover open-ended generation and constrained multiple-choice tasks across different models. Adding hidden states improves AUROC by approximately 0.004 and 0.039 on the two tasks, respectively. Hidden states thus provide additional predictive information, but strong standalone detection performance can still yield only limited additional gains.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统比较了在相同数据划分与评估规则下，将隐含状态(hidden states)信息加入一个整合了推理时可获得的输出侧信息的强基线后，幻觉检测性能的变化。结果显示隐含状态确实带来额外预测信息，但增益有限（开放生成约+0.004 AUROC，约束多选题约+0.039 AUROC）。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常只报告隐含状态单独用于幻觉检测的判别性能，而输出侧方法又多用建模能力较弱的简单基线，导致两类信号的可比性不足，难以判断隐含状态是否真的能带来额外价值。
AI.method: 构建一个整合推理时可得输出侧信息的组合基线，在相同数据划分和评估规则下，比较加入隐含状态前后的检测性能；实验覆盖开放生成与约束式多选题任务，并涉及不同模型。
AI.result: 加入隐含状态后，开放生成任务AUROC提升约0.004，约束多选题任务提升约0.039；说明隐含状态提供额外预测信息，但提升幅度相对有限。
AI.conclusion: 隐含状态具有补充价值，但即使单独检测性能很强，其边际增益仍可能有限；评估幻觉检测方法时应在强基线与统一评估条件下进行对比。

title: WaveSpec: Multi-Spectral Iris Presentation Attack Detection via Wavelength-Conditioned Spectral Coherence Adaptation
summary: Multispectral iris presentation attack detection benefits from observing the same iris across multiple near-infrared wavelengths, but existing methods often use wavelength information mainly for conditioning or fusion. This can limit their ability to explicitly model whether the spectral response of a sample is coherent across bands. In this paper, we propose \textbf{WaveSpec}, a multispectral iris PAD framework that performs feature-level spectral coherence adaptation. Each NIR band is first encoded with a DINOv2 backbone. The proposed Set Conditioned Spectral Coherence Adapter then updates each band feature using the consensus of the available spectral set, the band-specific deviation from that consensus, and wavelength identity. The adapted features are projected into structural, spectral, and anomaly representations, adaptively pooled, and classified as bona fide or attack. We evaluate WaveSpec on the MSIrPAD benchmark under a strict cross-artefact protocol, where the model is trained with one presentation attack instrument and tested on unseen attacks. WaveSpec reduces the average D-EER from 8.45\% for SpectraIrisPAD to 3.33\%, and reduces average BPCER@APCER=1\% from 43.16\% to 12.07\%. Ablation results show that the SCSA adapter and spectral residual are central to the improvement, while a band-subset analysis shows that WaveSpec remains effective under partial spectral observations and performs best when all five bands are available. The method adds only modest computational overhead, with 11.15 ms end-to-end latency per five-band sample on an NVIDIA L40S-48Q GPU.

AI.tldr: 提出 WaveSpec，一种在多光谱近红外虹膜呈现攻击检测中进行特征级光谱一致性自适应的框架，通过集合条件光谱一致性适配器（SCSA）显式建模跨波段光谱响应的一致性，在 MSIrPAD 跨攻击仪器协议下将平均 D-EER 从 8.45% 降至 3.33%。
AI.motivation: 现有多光谱虹膜 PAD 方法多将波长信息仅用于条件化或特征融合，难以显式建模样本的光谱响应在各波段间是否一致，从而限制了攻击检测能力。
AI.method: 每个 NIR 波段先用 DINOv2 编码；SCSA 适配器利用可用光谱集合的共识、各波段相对共识的偏差以及波长身份来更新各波段特征；随后将适配特征投影为结构、光谱与异常三种表示，经自适应池化后分类为真实或攻击。
AI.result: 在 MSIrPAD 基准的严格跨攻击仪器协议下，平均 D-EER 由 SpectraIrisPAD 的 8.45% 降至 3.33%，平均 BPCER@APCER=1% 由 43.16% 降至 12.07%。消融显示 SCSA 适配器与光谱残差贡献最大；波段子集分析表明部分光谱观测下仍有效，五波段时最佳；五波段样本端到端延迟 11.15 ms（NVIDIA L40S-48Q GPU），开销适中。
AI.conclusion: 显式的特征级光谱一致性建模是一种有效且轻量的多光谱虹膜 PAD 思路，在未见攻击上泛化良好并具备实用部署潜力。

title: Runtime Control for AI Agents: Closing the Evaluation--Execution Gap in Operational Workflows
summary: Language-model agents increasingly participate in operational workflows where approvals, binds, and payments create commitments. An approval valid when issued may no longer authorize execution after relevant facts, evidence, policy, or authority change. We call this the evaluation--execution gap. We specify a state-bound runtime assurance layer that separates probabilistic measurement from deterministic adjudication, binds an execution allowance to the decision-relevant basis of an approval, invalidates that allowance after relevant logged changes, and rechecks admissibility at dispatch. This distinguishes the continued validity of a prior approval from a current-state policy check. We describe eight failure modes, an assurance model, a reference architecture, and prospective interventions with retrospective remediation. In a scripted 42-case replay, the state-bound configuration identifies 15 later-invalidated approvals that a deliberately non-re-evaluating point-in-time comparator does not revisit; it holds 14 affected actions before dispatch and compensates one landed effect. These results illustrate behavior under the stipulated policies and event orders, not superiority over dispatch-time enforcement designs or production effectiveness. Under explicit interception, ingestion, dependency, and serialization assumptions, the model establishes dispatch-time validity within the registered execution surface.

AI.tldr: 提出"评估—执行间隙"问题，并设计状态绑定运行时保障层，将概率性测量与确定性裁决分离，绑定执行许可以审批的相关依据并在依据变化后失效、派发前重查。
AI.motivation: 语言模型代理参与审批、绑定、支付等产生承诺的运营流程；审批签发时有效，但事实、证据、政策或权限变化后可能不再授权执行，形成评估—执行间隙。
AI.method: 状态绑定运行时保障层：分离概率测量与确定性裁决；将执行许可绑定到审批的决策相关依据；相关日志变化后使许可失效；派发时重查可采纳性，区分"旧审批持续有效"与"当前状态策略检查"。给出八类失效模式、保障模型、参考架构，以及前瞻性干预与回溯性补救。
AI.result: 42 例脚本回放中，状态绑定配置识别出 15 个后来失效的审批（对照的点时非重评估比较器未复查），在派发前拦截 14 个受影响动作，并补偿 1 个已落地效应。作者声明这仅说明既定策略与事件顺序下的行为，不代表优于派发时强制设计或生产实效。
AI.conclusion: 在显式拦截、摄取、依赖与序列化假设下，该模型在注册执行面内确立了派发时有效性；但结论限于脚本回放与规定假设，需进一步验证实际部署效果。

title: BEACON: Bridging Multimodal Semantics and Asynchronous Propagation for Cloud System Anomaly Detection
summary: Modern large-scale cloud systems continuously generate massive and multimodal observability data, such as time-series metrics, log records, and system dependency graphs, which reflect the health state of the system. To ensure reliable cloud system operation, anomaly detection models identify abnormal states by analyzing these multimodal observations. However, existing approaches rely on simple fusion strategies and graph learning, ignoring the semantic gap among modalities and the asynchronous spatio-temporal dependencies across system instances over time. To this end, we propose BEACON, a framework to Bridge multimodal sEmantics and Asynchronous propagation for Cloud system anOmaly detectioN. Specifically, we introduce a Dynamic Interpretable Multimodal Aggregator (DIMA) that leverages an information-bottleneck mechanism to compress information from the semantics and temporal dynamics of metrics, and aligns them with logs in a shared prototype space. Furthermore, we propose an Asynchronous Spatio-Temporal Propagator (ASTP) that captures temporal dependencies with multi-scale temporal attention and models spatial relations with topology-aware aggregation. This enables asynchronous propagation of anomalies across system instances. Extensive experiments on three real-world cloud system datasets demonstrate that \textbf{BEACON} consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: 提出BEACON框架，通过桥接多模态语义与异步传播来提升云系统异常检测性能，在三个真实数据集上优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有云系统异常检测方法依赖简单融合策略与图学习，忽略了模态间语义鸿沟以及系统实例间随时间的异步时空依赖，导致检测效果受限。
AI.method: 包含两个核心模块：(1) 动态可解释多模态聚合器DIMA，利用信息瓶颈机制压缩指标语义与时序动态信息，并在共享原型空间中与日志对齐；(2) 异步时空传播器ASTP，用多尺度时间注意力捕捉时间依赖，用拓扑感知聚合建模空间关系，实现异常在实例间的异步传播。
AI.result: 在三个真实云系统数据集上的大量实验表明，BEACON在异常检测上持续优于最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: BEACON有效解决多模态语义鸿沟与异步时空依赖问题，是云系统异常检测的高效框架。

title: Judging the Justification: Decision Certificate Supervision for Generative Reward Models
summary: Generative reward models (GenRMs) generate natural language rationales to justify preference judgments, yet a correct verdict does not guarantee a sound justification. Existing approaches often rely on reference explanations to supervise rationales, but obtaining such references can be costly and does not necessarily establish whether generated rationales support the resulting verdict. To address these limitations, we propose DeCert, a framework that evaluates the validity and verdict consistency of generated rationales without requiring reference explanations. Crucially, DeCert translates these assessments into preference supervision that accounts for both verdict correctness and justification quality. In particular, when multiple sampled judgments share the same correct verdict, differences in certificate quality enable DeCert to construct rationale preference pairs that distinguish stronger from weaker justifications. Extensive empirical studies across two model families and multiple in- and out-of-distribution benchmarks demonstrate that DeCert consistently outperforms strong generative judge baselines while improving rationale quality. Moreover, DeCert effectively mitigates positional bias, improving position-consistent accuracy by up to 14.8 points. These results highlight the importance of supervising not only which verdict is correct, but also how that verdict is justified.

AI.tldr: 提出DeCert框架，无需参考解释即可评估生成式奖励模型（GenRM）解释的有效性与判决一致性，并将该评估转化为同时考虑判决正确性和解释质量的偏好监督信号。
AI.motivation: GenRM生成的正确判决并不保证其理由合理；现有方法依赖昂贵的参考解释进行监督，且无法确立生成解释是否真正支持判决结果。
AI.method: DeCert在无参考解释条件下评估生成解释的有效性与判决一致性，并将其转化为偏好监督；当多个采样判断共享同一正确判决时，依据证明质量差异构建解释偏好对，区分更强与更弱的理由。
AI.result: 在两个模型家族及多个分布内/分布外基准上，DeCert持续优于强生成式评判基线并提升解释质量；位置偏差缓解显著，位置一致准确率最高提升14.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 监督不仅应关注判决是否正确，还应关注判决如何被论证，DeCert证明了同时监督解释质量的价值。

title: Provisioning Robust and Efficient LiDAR Perception for Autonomous Driving
summary: LiDAR-based 3D object detection is a core perception service for autonomous driving, but deployment requires robustness to point-cloud corruption while meeting latency and memory requirements. Existing approaches address robustness and resource efficiency separately, resulting in compact detectors that are fragile under corruption or robust detectors that remain costly to deploy. We therefore formulate LiDAR perception provisioning as constructing a detector that remains accurate under point-cloud corruptions while meeting constraints on inference latency and peak GPU memory. To achieve robustness, we first craft corrupted samples that mimic extreme weather conditions. Then we train candidate detectors offline by ordering clean and corrupted samples by perturbation sensitivity, through which detectors learn more from hard corrupted samples. We estimate perturbation sensitivity using an ensemble of seven heterogeneous 3D detectors by tracking changes in confidence, BEV overlap, and unmatched detections. To improve efficiency, we narrow the network and use offline neighborhood-density measurements to determine how many points and neighbors each sampling stage processes. We evaluate our method using AP (Average Precision) under clean and corrupted conditions, inference latency, and peak allocated GPU memory. On KITTI for Car detection with PointRCNN, our method improves Moderate AP under corruption by 3.32 points over the original detector while reducing mean latency by 19.8% and peak allocated GPU memory by 53.9%. Across two datasets, two detector architectures, and three object classes, our method improves AP under corruption by 4.03 points on average over the corresponding original detectors, while reducing mean inference latency and peak allocated GPU memory by 14.4% and 38.0%, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/drunklibai/robust-efficient-lidar-perception.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在点云损坏下保持精度、同时满足推理延迟与GPU显存约束的LiDAR 3D检测器构建方法。
AI.motivation: 现有工作将鲁棒性与资源效率分开处理：紧凑检测器在损坏下脆弱，鲁棒检测器部署代价高，缺乏同时兼顾二者的方案。
AI.method: 先用模拟极端天气的方式构造损坏样本；用7个异构3D检测器集成，通过置信度变化、BEV重叠与未匹配检测来估计扰动敏感度，据此将干净与损坏样本按敏感度排序进行离线训练，使模型更多学习困难损坏样本；再通过收窄网络并结合离线邻域密度测量，确定各采样阶段的点数与邻居数。
AI.result: KITTI Car+PointRCNN上，损坏条件Moderate AP提升3.32点，平均延迟降低19.8%，峰值显存降低53.9%；跨2数据集、2种架构、3类目标，损坏下AP平均提升4.03点，延迟与显存分别降低14.4%与38.0%。
AI.conclusion: 在鲁棒性、延迟与显存三方面同时取得改进，验证了将鲁棒训练与结构/采样效率优化协同设计的有效性。

title: Securing Agentic Commerce Through Behavior-Aware Fraud Detection and Cybersecurity for Trusted AI-Agent Payment Authorization
summary: The growing use of autonomous artificial intelligence agents in digital commerce creates new security concerns involving agent impersonation, unauthorized payments, compromised agents, and misuse of delegated authority. This research introduces the Autonomous Commerce Agent Guard System (ACAGS), a cybersecurity framework combining supervised machine learning, behavioral analytics, agent-specific authorization controls, and explainable AI. The framework was evaluated using synthetic financial transaction data augmented with simulated agent characteristics and five adversarial scenarios. XGBoost was selected following comparisons with alternative classifiers. Across ten experimental runs, behavioral features improved mean F1-score from 52.12% to 67.49%, with agent-specific features increasing performance to 69.46%. The framework achieved detection rates of 99.77% for abnormal agent behavior, 99.73% for impersonation, and 100% for malicious delegation and authorization-scope violations. Compromised-agent detection reached 72.27%. ACAGS also supported APPROVE, REVIEW, and REJECT authorization outcomes, with SHAP explanations providing model interpretability. The results demonstrate the potential of combining behavioral intelligence and delegated authorization controls to strengthen simulated agentic-commerce payment security, while highlighting the need for validation using real-world transactions.

AI.tldr: 提出ACAGS框架，结合监督学习、行为分析、代理授权控制与可解释AI，用于检测自主AI代理在数字商务中的冒充、越权支付等安全风险。
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理在数字商务中日益普及，带来代理冒充、未授权支付、代理被攻陷及委托权限滥用等新型安全威胁。
AI.method: ACAGS框架：监督机器学习（经比较后选用XGBoost）+行为特征分析+代理专属授权控制+可解释AI（SHAP），基于合成金融交易数据并注入模拟代理特征与5类对抗场景进行十次实验评估。
AI.result: 行为特征将平均F1从52.12%提升至67.49%，加入代理专属特征后达69.46%；异常行为检测率99.77%、冒充99.73%、恶意委托与权限越界100%、被攻陷代理检测72.27%；支持APPROVE/REVIEW/REJECT授权决策并提供SHAP解释。
AI.conclusion: 行为智能与委托授权控制结合可增强代理式商务支付安全，但结果基于合成数据，需真实交易数据进一步验证。

title: Timing-Aware and Interpretable Self-Attention for Event-Based Wearable Task Transition Detection
comment: Submitted to IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (JBHI) on 26 February 2026; currently under review
summary: Task transition detection aims to identify when a person shifts from one task to another, providing a foundation for continuous health monitoring and timely context-aware interventions. While statistical and deep feature representations have demonstrated strong classification performance, they often rely on aggregated or latent features that are difficult to interpret in behavioural terms. Event-based features provide a compact and interpretable alternative by encoding behavioural and physiological patterns as discrete tokens with explicit semantic meaning, making them well suited for behavioural analysis in health informatics. Self-attention offers a mechanism for modelling interactions among such tokens; however, conventional self-attention classifiers primarily rely on token order and do not explicitly incorporate timing or duration information. As a result, informative temporal cues in event representations may not be fully exploited for task transition detection. This study proposes an event-based time-aware self-attention framework that represents behavioural signals as sequences of discrete events augmented with onset timestamps and durations. Event timing is encoded using a parameter-efficient kernel-based representation, while a novel type-aware duration embedding modulates information propagation according to event persistence. Experiments on a semi-naturalistic wearable dataset show that the proposed model outperforms existing event-based approaches, achieves performance beyond or comparable with statistical and deep-learning models with a more compact input representation, and provides improved interpretability through integrated-gradient-based analysis. These results indicate that explicit modelling of event timing and duration enhances both classification performance and interpretability, supporting reliable deployment in biomedical and health informatics applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于事件的时间感知自注意力框架，将行为信号编码为带起始时间戳和持续时间的事件序列，用核式时间编码和类型感知时长嵌入增强注意力，实现可解释的任务转换检测。
AI.motivation: 任务转换检测是连续健康监测与情境感知干预的基础。现有统计与深度特征方法分类性能好但可解释性差；事件式特征紧凑可解释，却常被传统自注意力按顺序建模，未显式利用时间与持续时间信息，导致时间线索未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: 将行为信号表示为离散事件序列，并附加起始时间戳与持续时间；采用参数高效的核函数表示编码事件时间；提出类型感知的时长嵌入，依据事件持续性调节注意力中的信息传播；以自注意力建模事件间交互进行任务转换检测。
AI.result: 在半自然可穿戴数据集上，模型优于现有事件式方法，以更紧凑的输入表示达到超越或媲美统计与深度学习模型的性能，并通过积分梯度分析提升可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模事件时间与持续时间可同时提升分类性能和可解释性，支持在生物医学与健康信息学中的可靠部署。

title: EviDial: When Correct Depression Predictions Lack Evidence
summary: Depression dialogue benchmarks commonly assess models by comparing predicted symptom labels with clinical scale scores. However, a prediction may agree with a benchmark label even when the dialogue lacks enough evidence to justify it. We introduce EviDial, a benchmark that distinguishes label agreement from evidence-grounded assessment. EviDial comprises 382 depression dialogues from three sources and 2,744 participant-symptom cells, each classified as having absent, partial, conflicting, or sufficient evidence. Because evidence sufficiency lacks a directly observable gold standard, we derive calibrated evidence references from multiple judgments using generalizability theory, many-facet Rasch measurement, and random-effects latent class analysis. Our audit reveals that 82.8% of participant-symptom cells lack sufficient textual evidence for the corresponding symptom assessment, with substantial variation across sources. Across model families and prompting strategies, 69.2%-96.9% of predictions judged correct by benchmark labels are nonetheless unsupported by sufficient dialogue evidence. Further analyses show that strong agreement among LLM evaluators need not reflect independent evidence judgments, underscoring the need to calibrate automated reference panels. These findings demonstrate that label-based evaluation can overestimate evidence-grounded performance by conflating agreement with clinical labels and support in the observed dialogue. EviDial provides a measurement layer for separating these constructs and auditing LLM-based depression assessment more faithfully.

AI.tldr: EviDial基准将"标签一致"与"证据支持"分离，审计发现82.8%的受试者-症状单元缺乏足够文本证据，且69.2%–96.9%被标签判为正确的预测实际缺乏对话证据支持。
AI.motivation: 现有抑郁对话基准仅比较预测症状标签与临床量表分数，预测可能因缺乏对话证据而与标签偶然一致，导致评估高估真实证据支撑下的性能。作者希望区分标签一致性与证据根基性评估。
AI.method: 构建EviDial：382段来自三个来源的抑郁对话、2744个受试者-症状单元，分别标注为无证据、部分、冲突或充分证据；由于证据充分性无直接可观测金标准，采用泛化理论、多面Rasch测量与随机效应潜在类别分析从多评判中推导校准证据参考。
AI.result: 审计显示82.8%的单元缺乏足够文本证据，且各来源差异显著；跨模型族与提示策略，69.2%–96.9%被基准标签判为正确的预测缺乏充分对话证据支持；LLM评估者间高一致性并不必然反映独立的证据判断。
AI.conclusion: 基于标签的评估混淆了与临床标签的一致性和对话中可观测证据的支持，从而高估证据根基性表现；EviDial提供测量层以分离两类构念，实现更忠实的LLM抑郁评估审计。

title: PACE-MoE: Adaptive Domain Sampling and Domain-Specific LoRA for Medical Visual Grounding
summary: Medical visual grounding requires models to align clinical descriptions with spatial evidence across heterogeneous imaging domains. However, existing multi-domain post-training strategies typically rely on fixed domain sampling and shared parameter updates, overlooking the need to adapt both which domains receive training and where their updates are applied. To address this issue, we propose PACE-MoE, a policy-guided framework that jointly performs adaptive domain sampling and domain-specific adaptation for medical visual grounding. PACE dynamically assesses the training value of each imaging domain from current-policy feedback and progressively adjusts domain coverage through domain admission, replay, and final all-domain balancing. Meanwhile, domain-specific LoRA adapters route updates to the corresponding imaging domains while preserving the pretrained backbone and visual encoder. This coordinated design aligns training-data allocation with parameter adaptation without modifying the original reward formulation or Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) objective. Experiments across seven medical imaging domains show that PACE-MoE consistently improves grounding performance over fixed-domain training, achieving a 3.64% relative improvement in mean box IoU over the Vanilla baseline. Under matched domain-specific adapter architectures, adaptive sampling alone further improves mean box IoU by 2.07%, demonstrating the benefit of policy-guided domain allocation. These results establish coordinated data-parameter routing as an effective strategy for multi-domain medical visual grounding.

AI.tldr: 提出PACE-MoE，通过策略引导的自适应域采样与域特定LoRA适配协同优化多域医学视觉定位。
AI.motivation: 现有多域后训练策略采用固定域采样和共享参数更新，忽视了"哪些域参与训练"和"更新施加于何处"两个需要自适应的问题。
AI.method: PACE依据当前策略反馈动态评估各成像域训练价值，通过域准入、回放与最终全域平衡逐步调整域覆盖；同时使用域特定LoRA适配器将更新路由到对应成像域，保持预训练主干与视觉编码器不变，且不修改原奖励与GRPO目标。
AI.result: 在七个医学影像域上，相比固定域训练的Vanilla基线，平均box IoU相对提升3.64%；在相同域特定适配器架构下，仅自适应采样即可提升平均box IoU 2.07%。
AI.conclusion: 数据与参数协同路由是多域医学视觉定位的有效策略。

title: The More the Better? A Comparison of Single- and Multi-Agent LLM Setups on a Financial Review Task
summary: Practitioner guidance holds that a large language model reviews a document better when the work is divided among agents. We test a narrow form of it in a controlled comparison of single-agent and multi-agent setups on a financial task, reviewing credit assessment memos against requirements. One agent checks six requirements in one call. A team of three on the same model checks the same memo, two requirements each, in the same words, with no roles or later stage. Labels are known for every requirement on 300 synthetic memos, so misses and false alarms are measured separately. Two primary predictions are tested on four models at a Bonferroni-corrected level. Under an instruction to decide each requirement once, the team catches 0.08 to 0.10 more of the defects that carry an explanation on the three models whose single agent misses some, at the corrected level on two. It raises more false alarms on all four, at the corrected level on three. Balanced accuracy, an exploratory measure, changes by 0.02 or less, and the team uses 2.2 to 2.4 times the tokens. Showing each agent the requirements it was not given reduces the added false alarms on the two Claude models, at the corrected level on one. In exploratory comparisons, sampling the single agent three times and flagging on any draw gives higher balanced accuracy than the team on those models, and the team's results depend on the instruction.

AI.tldr: 在金融信贷备忘录审查任务上，将同一任务分给三个agent（每个查两项要求）相比单agent，能多检出0.08–0.10的带解释缺陷，但同时增加误报，平衡准确率几乎不变，且token消耗为2.2–2.4倍。
AI.motivation: 业界实践指南宣称"分工给多个agent能让大模型更好地审阅文档"，但缺乏受控对比证据，因此本文检验这一说法的一个窄化形式。
AI.method: 受控对比单agent vs 多agent：单agent一次调用检查6项要求；三agent团队用同一模型、每个查2项、措辞相同、无角色分工和后续阶段。使用300份合成备忘录，每项要求均有已知标签，可分别度量漏检与误报。在四个模型上检验两个主要预测（Bonferroni校正）。
AI.result: "每项只决策一次"指令下，团队在三个单agent有漏检的模型上多检出0.08–0.10的带解释缺陷（两个模型达校正显著）；四个模型误报均上升（三个显著）。平衡准确率变化≤0.02，token用量为2.2–2.4倍。向agent展示其未分配的要求可降低两个Claude模型的新增误报（一个显著）。
AI.conclusion: 多agent分工能提高检出率但以误报为代价，整体平衡准确率无实质提升且成本更高；探索性分析显示对单agent多次采样取"任一命中"优于团队，且团队效果依赖指令措辞，因此实证上不支持"分工必然更好"的实践指南。

title: Lower Bounds for Smooth Nonconvex Zeroth-Order Optimization: The Price of Determinism under Low Curvature Trace
comment: 59 pages, 2 figures, 1 table; Lean 4 formalization of the deterministic bounds in the ancillary files
summary: Low curvature trace, an effective rank condition, is a common explanation for why randomized zeroth-order methods scale to high-dimensional tasks such as language model fine-tuning. Can deterministic methods achieve the same savings? We show that they cannot. We study finding $\varepsilon$-stationary points of $L$-smooth nonconvex functions on $\mathbb{R}^d$ from exact function values, assuming that below the starting value the Hessian is dominated by a fixed matrix with trace at most $LE$; this is the effective rank condition used to explain zeroth-order fine-tuning. When $ET\le d$, the Gaussian two-point method that such fine-tuning uses needs only $O(ET)$ calls if it rejects steps that raise $f$, where $T=LΔ/\varepsilon^2$ is the iteration count of gradient descent from initial gap $Δ$, and we prove that every randomized method needs $Ω(ET)$ calls, so this cost is optimal up to constants. In contrast, every deterministic method needs $\widetildeΩ(d\min\{T,\sqrt{ET}\})$ calls, and adaptive subspace search attains $O(d\min\{T,\sqrt{ET}\})$: a deterministic method pays about $d$ calls per discovered direction, and the trace budget allows about $\sqrt{ET}$ directions. Determinism thus multiplies the cost by a factor of order $d/(E+\sqrt{ET})$ up to logarithmic factors, which grows linearly with $d$ for fixed $E$ and $T$; once $E$ exceeds $T$ by a logarithmic factor, deterministic methods need $Ω(dT)$ calls, as without any trace budget. Our lower bounds hold for $C^\infty$ functions with the matrix bound on all of $\mathbb{R}^d$, even when each call also returns gradient projections priced by rank.

AI.tldr: 本文研究低曲率迹（有效秩）条件下确定性零阶方法能否像随机方法一样节省查询，结论是否定的：随机Gaussian两点法在拒绝上升步时达到最优 O(ET)，而任何确定性方法至少需要 Ω̃(d·min{T,√(ET)})，自适应子空间搜索可匹配该上界，确定性代价约为随机的 d/(E+√(ET)) 倍。
AI.motivation: 随机零阶方法（如语言模型微调中的ZO）在高维任务上高效，常用低曲率迹/有效秩条件来解释。作者追问：确定性方法能否获得同样的查询节省？此前缺乏对确定性零阶方法在有效秩条件下的下界分析。
AI.method: 在 R^d 上 L-光滑非凸函数、仅访问精确函数值，假设起始值以下 Hessian 被固定矩阵支配且迹 ≤ LE（E 为有效秩）。证明技术：(1) 上界——分析带拒绝步的 Gaussian 两点法只需 O(ET) 次调用；(2) 下界——分别构造随机与确定性方法的对抗性下界，并证明其适用于全空间矩阵约束的 C^∞ 函数，即使每次调用额外返回按秩计价的梯度投影。
AI.result: 当 ET≤d 时：Gaussian 两点法（拒绝上升步）需 O(ET) 次调用，且任意随机方法下界为 Ω(ET)，故最优；任意确定性方法需 Ω̃(d·min{T,√(ET)})，而自适应子空间搜索达到 O(d·min{T,√(ET)})，因此确定性代价被乘上约 d/(E+√(ET)) 的因子；当 E 超过 T 的对数倍时，确定性方法退化为 Ω(dT)，与无迹预算时相同。
AI.conclusion: 低曲率迹带来的查询节省本质上是随机化方法的专属优势：确定性方法每发现一个方向约需 d 次调用，迹预算只能支持约 √(ET) 个方向，因而在高维下无法复制随机方法的高效性。该结果揭示随机性在有效秩零阶优化中的根本作用。

title: Exploring Recurrent-Depth Language Models for Multitask Clinical Text Processing
summary: Clinical natural language processing includes diverse tasks such as information extraction, classification, and question answering. Developing one model for all tasks could simplify deployment and improve knowledge transfer. We evaluated whether small recurrent-depth language models can meet this need through joint fine-tuning and compared their performance with standard transformers. We fine-tuned Ouro1.4B-Thinking, Ouro-2.6B-Thinking, HRM-Text-1B, Qwen3-1.7B, and Qwen3-8B on 9 datasets covering information extraction, classification, inference, and question answering, and evaluated them on four additional datasets excluded from training. Across these 13 datasets, Ouro-1.4B-Thinking achieved higher performances than Qwen3-1.7B on 11 datasets; Ouro-2.6BThinking was competitive with Qwen3-8B on most tasks. Ouro models showed the largest gains on inference and question answering, whereas HRM-Text-1B showed mixed results. These findings support further study of recurrent-depth models for clinical tasks through controlled experiments to isolate architectural effects and investigate how recurrent computation influences reasoning, knowledge acquisition, and generalization.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估小型循环深度语言模型（Ouro、HRM-Text）通过联合微调完成多种临床NLP任务的可行性，并与标准Transformer（Qwen3）对比。
AI.motivation: 临床NLP任务多样（信息抽取、分类、问答），用一个模型统一处理可简化部署并促进知识迁移；作者想验证小型循环深度模型能否胜任。
AI.method: 在涵盖信息抽取、分类、推理、问答的9个数据集上联合微调Ouro-1.4B-Thinking、Ouro-2.6B-Thinking、HRM-Text-1B、Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-8B，并在4个未参与训练的数据集上测试，共13个数据集比较性能。
AI.result: Ouro-1.4B-Thinking在11/13个数据集上优于Qwen3-1.7B；Ouro-2.6B-Thinking在多数任务上与Qwen3-8B相当；Ouro模型在推理与问答任务上增益最大，HRM-Text-1B结果参差。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持进一步研究循环深度模型用于临床任务，需通过受控实验分离架构效应，并探究循环计算对推理、知识获取与泛化的影响。

title: Structured-Token Attention for Fine-Grained mmWave Liquid Identification
summary: Fine-grained liquid identification requires a classifier to distinguish similar substances from compact millimeter-wave measurements. We investigate structured-token attention, which represents a radar feature tensor through complementary antenna, feature, branch, and global views. The proposed StructAttn model embeds these views into eleven tokens and combines them with a three-layer transformer. Experiments on the public FG-LiquID data cover 30 liquids and 3,000 samples. Over five seeds on the released split, StructAttn achieves 96.70\% mean best-epoch accuracy, matching the original-recipe MMNet baseline and exceeding a scalar-token attention model by 1.50 percentage points. A five-seed probability ensemble reaches 97\%, corresponding to 18 errors among 600 test samples. Final-epoch and five-fold results complement the checkpoint-selected comparison, with StructAttn obtaining 95.30\% out-of-fold accuracy. Token and feature analyses show that structured views are useful for prediction, while residual confusions concentrate in water, soft-drink, and edible-oil classes. These results support structured tokenization as a practical design choice for attention-based liquid recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出StructAttn模型，用结构化token注意力将毫米波雷达特征表示为天线/特征/分支/全局四视图共11个token，结合三层Transformer实现细粒度液体识别，在FG-LiquID上5种子平均96.70%，集成达97%。
AI.motivation: 细粒度液体识别需从紧凑的毫米波测量中区分相似物质（如水、饮料、食用油），单一标量token注意力难以充分利用雷达特征的多维信息。
AI.method: 设计结构化token化：把雷达特征张量映射为互补的天线、特征、分支与全局四类视图，共编码为11个token，输入三层Transformer进行分类。
AI.result: 在公开FG-LiquID（30种液体、3000样本）上，5种子最佳epoch平均准确率96.70%，追平原配方MMNet，超标量token注意力1.50个百分点；5种子概率集成达97%（600测试样本仅18错），五折袋外准确率95.30%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化token化是注意力式液体识别的实用设计选择；残余混淆集中在水、软饮和食用油类别。

title: Can Native Safety Travel? Reusing Safety Pretraining Across Models via On-Policy Distillation
summary: Safety pretraining has emerged as a promising paradigm for embedding safety deeply into a model during pretraining, yielding robustness to subsequent fine-tuning that conventional safety post-training often lacks. We refer to this safety acquired during model pretraining as native safety. Yet native safety is expensive to acquire, confined to the model in which it was pretrained, and often accompanied by lower general utility. In this work, we rethink the practical value of safety-pretrained models and introduce, for the first time, the native safety reuse problem: Can native safety be transferred from a specialized, potentially smaller, safety-pretrained "teacher" to standard-pretrained "students," enabling them to inherit its robustness while preserving their general utility? We show that native safety can "travel" through on-policy distillation. A standard-pretrained student generates responses to safety-pretraining prompts, while a small safety-pretrained teacher supervises the student's token-level predictions along its own generated trajectories; cross-tokenizer alignment further enables transfer across model families. The resulting students exhibit substantially greater safety robustness than their safety-post-trained counterparts while retaining higher general utility than the teacher: subsequent fine-tuning raises the average attack success rate (ASR) of the 1.7B student by only 5.00%, compared with 11.58% for safety post-training, and its average utility of 48.20% far exceeds the aligned teacher's 27.42%. Unlike conventional large-to-small knowledge distillation, our framework enables selective, small-to-large safety transfer: it reuses the robust safety expertise of a smaller pretrained teacher without inheriting its utility limitations. These findings establish native safety as a reusable model property rather than one permanently tied to the originally pretrained model.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出"原生安全复用"问题，并证明原生安全可通过在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）从小的安全预训练教师迁移到标准预训练学生模型，实现小到大的选择性安全迁移。
AI.motivation: 安全预训练（native safety）虽能让模型获得深度内化的安全鲁棒性，但成本高、局限于被预训练的模型本身，且常伴随通用能力下降，因此需要探索原生安全能否被复用/迁移。
AI.method: 采用在线策略蒸馏：由标准预训练的学生模型针对安全预训练提示生成回答轨迹，小型安全预训练教师对学生自身轨迹上的逐token预测进行监督；并通过跨tokenizer对齐实现跨模型家族迁移。
AI.result: 学生模型的安全鲁棒性显著优于安全后训练版本，同时保留高于教师的通用能力：后续微调后1.7B学生平均攻击成功率(ASR)仅上升5.00%（安全后训练为11.58%），平均通用效用48.20%远超对齐教师的27.42%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了选择性的"小到大"安全迁移，仅复用较小教师的安全专长而不继承其效用缺陷；表明原生安全是可复用的模型属性，而非永久绑定于原预训练模型。

title: Learned Readout Tokens for Extracting Large Language Model Confidence
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used within everyday applications where their responses have significant downstream impacts. For responsible deployment of such systems, we desire insight into how much we can trust their individual outputs. A popular approach for estimating LLM confidence is to train probes on the hidden states of the LLM's tokens to predict the correctness of the model's output. These probes typically read hidden states from tokens that are already in the model's vocabulary. In this work, we introduce a new approach to confidence probes that learn a new readout token and utilize its hidden states to train the probe. We show that our learned readout approach ScratchProbe outperforms its existing-token counterpart on a variety of datasets and LLMs. We also extend our method to a multi-token approach which we show provides further performance improvements. Finally, since the learned readout changes only the position a probe reads from, any existing probe can adopt it. Applied to a state-of-the-art probe, it improves AUROC on every backbone, in domain and out of domain.

AI.tldr: 提出ScratchProbe：通过引入一个新学习的读出token（readout token），用其隐藏状态训练置信度探针，比读取现有token隐藏状态的探针更准，且可即插即用地提升现有探针。
AI.motivation: LLM在日常应用中影响重大，需要估计其单条输出的可信度。主流方法是基于隐藏状态训练探针预测输出是否正确，但这些探针通常只读取已在词表中的token的隐藏状态，可能不是最适合读出置信信息的表征位置。
AI.method: 在模型中引入一个新的可学习读出token，用其隐藏状态训练置信度探针（ScratchProbe）；并扩展为多token方法以进一步提升性能。由于只改变了探针读取的位置，任何现有探针都可直接采用该机制。
AI.result: 在多种数据集和LLM上，ScratchProbe优于基于现有token的对照方法；多token版本进一步提升性能；应用于一个SOTA探针后，在域内和域外的每个backbone上都提升了AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 用学习到的读出token替代现有token作为探针输入是一种简单有效、通用可插拔的LLM置信度估计改进方案。

title: NeoWorld-3: From Pixels to Code-Defined Physical Worlds
summary: Simulation-ready world reconstruction demands physical interactivity beyond visual realism, which existing black-box 3D generation fails to deliver. We present NeoWorld-3, a coding-agent framework that reconstructs interactive 3D worlds from visual observations via tunable, executable programs. At its core, NeoSDK provides the underlying computational engine for low-level geometries, part composition, differentiable parameter refinement, and physics validation. At the same time, NeoMCP exposes these capabilities as structured, tool-callable APIs for vision-language agents to visually inspect, edit code, and iteratively refine programs. Through a hierarchical coordinator-worker architecture, the framework scales seamlessly from standalone articulated objects to complex compositional scenes. Evaluations across object-level and scene-level reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate that NeoWorld-3 achieves state-of-the-art geometric fidelity and physical readiness. Crucially, manipulation trajectories planned within our reconstructed twins achieve successful zero-shot execution on a physical dual-arm robot, completing the Real-Sim-Real loop.

AI.tldr: NeoWorld-3 是一个基于编码智能体的框架，通过可调、可执行的程序从视觉观测重建可交互的 3D 世界，实现从物体到场景的多层级重建，并完成 Real-Sim-Real 闭环。
AI.motivation: 现有黑盒式 3D 生成只追求视觉真实感，无法提供仿真所需的物理可交互性；重建"可直接用于仿真"的世界需要几何、部件组合、参数精调与物理校验的统一支撑。
AI.method: 核心为 NeoSDK 计算引擎（底层几何、部件组合、可微参数精修、物理验证），并通过 NeoMCP 将这些能力封装为结构化、可调用的工具 API，供视觉语言智能体进行视觉检查、代码编辑与迭代精修；采用分层 coordinator-worker 架构，从单体铰接物体平滑扩展到复杂组合场景。
AI.result: 在物体级与场景级重建基准上达到 SOTA 的几何保真度与物理可用性；在重建数字孪生中规划的操控轨迹可在真实双臂机器人上零样本执行成功。
AI.conclusion: 以"程序化重建 + 智能体迭代精修"替代黑盒生成，可同时获得高保真几何与物理可交互性，并打通 Real-Sim-Real 迁移闭环。

title: When Health Assistants Agree Too Readily: A Benchmark of Time-Critical Self-Diagnosis
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: The Third Workshop on GenAI for Health: Agentic Systems, Clinical Trust, and Future Potential
summary: Every day, more than 40 million people ask ChatGPT a health question, such as whether laptop posture explains a stiff neck and days of pounding headache. Posture is plausible, but meningitis is a time-critical possibility. We introduce SelfDx, a paired benchmark for whether models have the appropriate response behavior, a form of epistemic independence, in health questions where misplaced agreement with the user's self-diagnosis could delay urgent or emergency care. Each of 100 pairs contrasts a caution case, where a serious alternative remains possible, with an agreement case, where the user supplies evidence that rules out the alternative and it is safe for the model to agree. We find across 27 frontier models that they tend to inappropriately agree with the user's self-diagnosis in cases that require caution. Even the best current-generation model reaches only a 77.0% appropriate caution rate on time-critical condition cases. To address this gap, we experiment with three prompt variants that increase appropriate caution but reduce appropriate agreement by 9-35%, indicating excessive caution. In contrast, supervised fine-tuning on 128 balanced examples improves both rates together across three runs. We recommend post-training to improve appropriate caution without making models cautious on every case, with paired evaluation to verify both response behaviors.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SelfDx配对基准，评估模型在健康自诊问题中是否具有"适当的谨慎/认同"行为（认知独立性），发现27个前沿模型普遍过度认同用户自诊，最佳模型关键病症谨慎率仅77.0%，并指出SFT可同时提升两种行为。
AI.motivation: 每天超4000万人向ChatGPT询问健康问题，模型若在存在紧急替代诊断（如脑膜炎）时仍迎合用户自诊（如姿势问题），可能延误救治；需要衡量模型是否具备"认知独立性"——该谨慎时谨慎、该认同时有证据才认同。
AI.method: 构建SelfDx配对基准：100对案例，每对含"谨慎案例"（严重替代诊断仍可能）与"认同案例"（用户提供证据排除替代诊断）；对27个前沿模型评测，并比较三种提示变体与128条平衡样本的有监督微调（SFT）效果。
AI.result: 模型普遍不当认同用户自诊；最优当代模型在时间关键病症上适当谨慎率仅77.0%；提示工程虽提升谨慎却使适当认同率下降9-35%（过度谨慎）；而SFT在三次运行中同时提升两项指标。
AI.conclusion: 建议通过后训练（而非单纯提示）提升适当谨慎，同时避免对所有案例一味谨慎；应使用配对评测同时验证谨慎与认同两种响应行为。

title: AnchorRM: Parallel Intra-Batch State Reconstruction with Anchor-Based Residual Memory for Temporal Graph Neural Networks
summary: Memory-based temporal graph neural networks (TGN) rely on recurrent node memories to capture evolving interaction histories. However, temporal mini-batching introduces a trade-off between computational efficiency and temporal fidelity: when a node appears multiple times within the same batch, later interactions are evaluated using stale pre-batch memory because the intermediate memory updates have not yet been committed. This problem becomes more severe as temporal batch size increases. To overcome this challenge, we propose AnchorRM, an anchor-based residual memory mechanism that reconstructs event-specific intra-batch node states without executing sequential recurrent updates. AnchorRM treats the last committed node memory at the beginning of each batch as a pre-batch fixed anchor and uses causally preceding same-batch interactions to infer the missing state evolution relative to that anchor. The learned residual then calibrates the anchor to reconstruct an event-specific node memory for each interaction. Because each event-specific residual is predicted directly from the fixed anchor and its causal history, reconstructed states do not depend on previously reconstructed states and can therefore be computed in parallel within the batch while preserving temporal causality. Experiments across four temporal graph datasets and three memory-based backbones demonstrate that AnchorRM achieves an average 6.16x training speedup (up to 10.05x) and 28.67x batch scaling (up to 40x). These results demonstrate that AnchorRM substantially improves the scalability and training efficiency of memory-based temporal graph learning while maintaining competitive predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 提出AnchorRM，一种基于锚点的残差记忆机制，在不做顺序循环更新的前提下重建批次内事件级节点状态，从而并行化计算并保持时间因果性。
AI.motivation: 基于记忆的时间图神经网络依赖循环节点记忆捕获演化交互历史，但时间小批量处理带来效率与时间保真度的权衡：同一节点在一个批次内多次出现时，后续交互使用的是批次前的陈旧记忆，因为中间更新尚未提交；批次越大问题越严重。
AI.method: 将每个批次开始时最后提交的节点记忆作为批次前固定锚点，利用批次内因果在先的同节点交互推断相对于该锚点的缺失状态演化；学习到的残差校准锚点，为每次交互重建事件级节点记忆。由于每个事件级残差直接由固定锚点及其因果历史预测，重建状态互不依赖，可在批次内并行计算且保持时间因果性。
AI.result: 在四个时间图数据集和三个基于记忆的骨干网络上，平均取得6.16倍训练加速（最高10.05倍）和28.67倍批次扩展（最高40倍），同时保持有竞争力的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: AnchorRM显著提升了基于记忆的时间图学习的可扩展性与训练效率，缓解了小批量陈旧记忆问题，且不牺牲预测性能。

title: AudiPsy: Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning over Spoken Counseling Conversations for Depression Assessment
summary: Depression assessment from counseling speech requires integrating textual and acoustic psychological evidence across turns, yet existing end-to-end classification approaches lack explicit multimodal evidence interpretation and context-aware reasoning. We propose AudiPsy, an evidence-grounded omni-LLM for depression assessment over spoken counseling conversations. AudiPsy employs an Observation-Assessment-Summary (OAS) paradigm to integrate dialogue transcripts, textual and acoustic emotions, and textual-acoustic emotion incongruence into structured reasoning. OAS incrementally organizes multimodal observations, performs contextualized assessment, and maintains an evolving dialogue summary for subsequent turns. To support this framework, we construct AudiPsy-Counsel, a synthetic spoken counseling conversation corpus with multimodal context augmentation, and develop a unified three-stage curriculum for depression-oriented reasoning. Experiments on DAIC-WOZ demonstrate superior depression assessment performance over specialized depression detection methods and general-purpose speech/omni-LLMs, along with improved reasoning quality, while supplementary evaluation on EATD-Corpus supports AudiPsy's applicability to naturalistic conversations.

AI.tldr: 提出AudiPsy，一个基于证据的全模态大模型，通过观察-评估-总结范式整合文本、声学情感及跨模态不一致证据，用于咨询语音的抑郁症评估。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端分类方法缺乏显式的多模态证据解释与上下文感知推理，难以在长对话中整合文本与声学的心理线索。
AI.method: 采用Observation-Assessment-Summary（OAS）范式：增量组织多模态观察、进行情境化评估并维护演化中的对话摘要；构建AudiPsy-Counsel合成语音咨询语料并设计三阶段课程学习。
AI.result: 在DAIC-WOZ上优于专用抑郁症检测方法和通用语音/全模态LLM，推理质量提升；EATD-Corpus上的补充评估支持其在自然对话中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 显式多模态证据与上下文推理能有效提升咨询语音抑郁症评估的性能与可解释性。

title: A Principled Optimal Transport Framework for Frame Selection in Long Video Understanding
summary: Long-video understanding with multimodal LLMs is fundamentally constrained by the mismatch between video length and the model's limited visual context budget, making frame selection essential for practical reasoning. Existing query-aware methods typically rely on heuristic pipelines: they assign one-dimensional query-conditioned scores to frames and then apply sampling, ranking, or extraction rules to form the final subset. While effective in practice, such methods are generally not derived from an explicit optimization objective and struggle to capture the heterogeneous evidence required for complex reasoning. In this paper, we revisit long-video frame selection from a principled optimization perspective. We formulate it as a structured evidence-allocation problem and propose OTFS, an optimal transport framework that maps multiple evidence sources onto video frames. To reflect the asymmetry of this problem---important evidence should be preserved, whereas redundant frames need not absorb mass---we instantiate this view with a semi-unbalanced entropic optimal transport objective and an efficient solver, OTFS-Sinkhorn. Combined with an exact dynamic program for coverage-aware subset extraction, OTFS yields a practical two-stage training-free pipeline. We further show that, in the single-source case, our formulation induces a Gibbs-type distribution over frames, making Q-Frame's temperature-scaled distribution a special case of our framework while also providing a broader perspective for understanding related prior methods. Experiments on three long-video understanding benchmarks show that OTFS consistently outperforms strong training-free baselines. Codes are available at https://github.com/barry664/OTFS.

AI.tldr: 该论文将长视频帧选择问题重新形式化为结构化证据分配问题，提出基于最优传输的无需训练框架OTFS，通过半不平衡熵最优传输目标与OTFS-Sinkhorn求解器，结合精确动态规划实现覆盖感知的子集抽取，在三个长视频理解基准上优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态LLM的视觉上下文预算有限，与长视频长度不匹配，帧选择至关重要。现有查询感知方法依赖启发式流程（一维查询条件打分+采样/排序/抽取规则），缺乏明确优化目标，难以捕捉复杂推理所需的异构证据。
AI.method: 将长视频帧选择建模为结构化证据分配问题，提出OTFS框架，用最优传输将多个证据源映射到视频帧。鉴于问题的不对称性（重要证据需保留，冗余帧无需吸收质量），采用半不平衡熵最优传输目标及高效求解器OTFS-Sinkhorn，并结合精确动态规划进行覆盖感知子集抽取，形成两阶段免训练流程。单源情形下该形式化可导出帧上的Gibbs型分布，Q-Frame的温度缩放分布成为其特例。
AI.result: 在三个长视频理解基准上，OTFS一致优于强免训练基线。
AI.conclusion: OTFS从优化视角为长视频帧选择提供了原则性框架，统一并推广了以往启发式方法，兼具理论解释性与实际有效性。代码已开源。

title: MemDev-Bench: Does Memory Help Code Agents?Benchmarking Memory Systems over Real Repository Histories
summary: Code agents increasingly work on evolving real repositories, and memory systems aim to help them reuse earlier experience.
