However, such experience is diverse and evolving, so it remains unclear how memory systems organize it and thereby affect code agents. Existing benchmarks cannot answer this reliably because they lack either temporally valid histories or control over prior-task relevance. In this paper, we present MemDev-Bench to evaluate how memory systems affect code agents over diverse repository histories. It pairs each task with relevance-annotated earlier tasks from the same repository to build histories with controlled relevance. We also build an automated pipeline that reliably makes these earlier tasks executable and verifiable, producing 4,869 historical tasks for 555 base tasks. Based on MemDev-Bench, our systematic evaluation of memory systems across diverse development scenarios yields three main findings. (1) Memory mainly improves fine-grained localization and editing, increasing functional correctness. (2) Memory also causes failures on otherwise solvable tasks even with related history, and unrelated history tends to increase such failures. These failures mainly stem from agents reusing memory without reassessing its applicability. (3) Compared with using memory systems, directly providing agents with raw historical trajectories substantially reduces their steps. Further analysis suggests that agents save these steps by reusing process information that compressed memories tend to omit. These results suggest that future memory systems should preserve process information and reassess memory applicability against current task context.

AI.tldr: 提出MemDev-Bench基准，用于评估记忆系统如何影响代码智能体在多样化仓库历史下的表现，揭示记忆的作用、失效原因及原始轨迹的优势。
AI.motivation: 代码智能体在持续演进的真实仓库上工作，记忆系统旨在帮其复用历史经验；但现有基准缺乏时间上有效的历史或对先前任务相关性的控制，无法可靠评估记忆组织方式对智能体的影响。
AI.method: 构建MemDev-Bench：为每个任务配对来自同一仓库、带相关性标注的早期任务以构造可控相关性的历史；建立自动流水线使早期任务可执行可验证，生成555个基任务对应的4,869个历史任务；据此对记忆系统进行系统性评估。
AI.result: 三点发现：(1) 记忆主要改善细粒度定位与编辑，提升功能正确性；(2) 即使有相关历史，记忆也会导致原本可解任务失败，无关历史加剧失败，主因是智能体复用记忆却不重估其适用性；(3) 直接提供原始历史轨迹比使用记忆系统显著减少步数，因智能体复用了压缩记忆常省略的过程信息。
AI.conclusion: 未来记忆系统应保留过程信息，并针对当前任务上下文重新评估记忆的适用性。

title: TRCM: Topology-Aware Route-Consistency Modeling for Robust Neural Vehicle Routing
summary: Neural combinatorial optimization has enabled fast constructive solvers for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), yet most autoregressive models still construct solutions through sequential node selection and represent route organization only implicitly. We investigate whether route-level customer co-assignment can be modeled explicitly and used to guide this node-level decision process. To this end, we propose TopologyAware RouteConsistency Modeling (TRCM), which reuses node representations from a standard autoregressive construction pipeline to predict pairwise same-route probabilities and injects them into customer selection as a route-consistency signal. Because sameroute supervision is both class-imbalanced and structurally uneven, TRCM combines structure-preserving augmentation with Topological Entropy (TE)- based reweighting to emphasize locally ambiguous customer pairs. Under matched decoding budgets, TRCM reduces the optimality gap from 3.67% to 3.28% on CVRP50 and from 2.11% to 1.99% on CVRP100; under 8-fold augmented inference, it reduces the CVRP100 gap from 1.61% to 1.49%. On XML100, TRCM*8Aug improves the average objective by 0.24%, with larger gains on several structurally informative factors. A controlled demand-reassignment test over 500 variants further shows more concentrated objective fluctuations. These results support explicit route-consistency modeling as an effective structural principle for autoregressive neural routing.

AI.tldr: TRCM复用自回归构造中的节点表示来显式预测“同路线”成对概率，并将其作为路线一致性信号注入节点选择，以提升CVRP神经构造求解器的解质量。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归神经CVRP求解器多按节点逐一选择来构造解，路线组织结构只是隐式表示，缺乏显式的路线级建模，因此作者想探究“客户同路线共指派”能否被显式建模并反过来指导节点级决策。
AI.method: TRCM在标准自回归构造管线中复用节点表示，额外预测客户对的同路线概率，并把该概率作为路线一致性信号融入客户选择；针对同路线监督的类别不平衡与结构分布不均，采用保结构数据增强与基于拓扑熵（TE）的重加权，突出局部歧义客户对。
AI.result: 在匹配解码预算下，CVRP50最优性差距由3.67%降至3.28%，CVRP100由2.11%降至1.99%；8倍增广推理下CVRP100差距由1.61%降至1.49%；XML100上TRCM*8Aug平均目标改进0.24%，在若干结构信息更丰富的因子上增益更大；500个变体的受控需求重分配测试显示目标波动更集中。
AI.conclusion: 显式路线一致性建模是自回归神经路径规划中一种有效的结构性设计原则，可在不改变解码预算的前提下稳定提升解质量与稳健性。

title: Why Static Probes Fail: Context Determines Deception Feature Composition
summary: With increasing autonomy, Large Language Models (LLMs) may engage in deceptive behaviors, such as scheming to pursue misaligned goals or sandbagging to escape oversight. Monitoring outputs alone is insufficient, as models can produce seemingly benign responses while harboring misaligned internal objectives. While mechanistic approaches like linear probing are promising, they rely on the assumption that deception corresponds to a single direction in representation space. We demonstrate that such single-direction probes fail to generalize across diverse deception scenarios. To bridge this gap, we propose representing deception as a multi-dimensional subspace rather than a single direction. Our method utilizes iterative orthogonal decomposition to identify complementary directions that capture distinct facets of deceptive intent. To effectively leverage these directions for detection, we find that static combinations prove brittle due to strong domain dependence across different scenarios. We therefore introduce a domain-adaptive gating mechanism that dynamically composes the extracted directions through few-shot adaptation at test time. With only 10 examples, our approach achieves an average AUROC of 0.97 and 94% recall at 5% FPR across all evaluated datasets, substantially outperforming existing methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用多维子空间（而非单一方向）表示LLM的欺骗意图，通过迭代正交分解提取互补方向，并用域自适应门控在测试时少样本组合这些方向进行检测，仅需10个样本即达平均AUROC 0.97、5%FPR下94%召回。
AI.motivation: LLM自主性增强后可能表现出欺骗行为（如scheming、sandbagging），仅监控输出不足，因为模型可输出看似无害而内部目标错位。线性探针等机制可解释方法有前景，但依赖"欺骗对应表征空间中单一方向"的假设，该假设无法跨多样化欺骗场景泛化。
AI.method: 将欺骗表征为多维子空间而非单一方向；采用迭代正交分解识别捕捉不同欺骗意图侧面的互补方向；发现静态组合因场景间强域依赖而脆弱，故引入域自适应门控机制，在测试时通过少样本自适应动态组合所提取的方向。
AI.result: 仅用10个示例，在所有评估数据集上平均AUROC达0.97，5% FPR下召回94%，显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 多维子空间建模比单方向探针更能泛化于多样欺骗场景，结合测试时少样本域自适应门控可实现高效、鲁棒的欺骗检测。

title: PanoGraphGS: Unifying Panoptic Segmentation and Hierarchical 3D Scene Graphs with Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D scene graphs support language-guided navigation by organizing physical entities and their containment and spatial relations into hierarchical maps. Building such structured maps requires a scene representation that consistently distinguishes semantic regions and object instances across viewpoints. To this end, we present PanoGraphGS, a unified framework that integrates panoptic 3D Gaussian representation learning with hierarchical 3D scene graph construction. The framework learns semantic and instance features on shared Gaussian geometry. Prototype-based semantic learning and association-based instance learning produce consistent panoptic predictions across viewpoints. The learned representation supports novel-view panoptic segmentation and direct Gaussian-level panoptic decoding. A semantic-aware scene graph module further recovers a floor-room-stuff-object hierarchy with containment and spatial relations. We further release NaviGS, a real-world dataset for panoramic scene understanding. The dataset provides 3DGS, mesh, RGB, semantic, and depth data. For 3D scene graph identification, PanoGraphGS outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline in object-node accuracy by more than 50\% points on average across Replica and NaviGS. PanoGraphGS also achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods in 2D panoptic segmentation. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of PanoGraphGS in both hierarchical 3D scene understanding and 2D panoptic segmentation. The project website is available at: https://github.com/gaojh0333/PanoGraphGS.

AI.tldr: PanoGraphGS将全景3D高斯表示学习与分层3D场景图构建统一，在保持视角一致的全景预测基础上直接解码高斯级语义/实例，并恢复楼层-房间-物体层级，在Replica和新数据集NaviGS上物体节点准确率超最强基线50+个百分点。
AI.motivation: 语言引导导航需要3D场景图组织物理实体及包含/空间关系，但构建此类结构化地图要求场景表示在不同视角下一致地区分语义区域与物体实例，这一需求尚未被很好满足。
AI.method: 在共享高斯几何上学习语义与实例特征：基于原型的语义学习和基于关联的实例学习实现跨视角一致的全景预测；学习到的表示支持新视角全景分割与直接的高斯级全景解码；语义感知场景图模块恢复楼层-房间-stuff-物体层级及包含与空间关系；同时发布真实世界全景数据集NaviGS。
AI.result: 在Replica与NaviGS上，场景图识别的物体节点准确率平均超过最强基线50个百分点以上；在评估方法中2D全景分割达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: PanoGraphGS在分层3D场景理解与2D全景分割上均有效，验证了全景高斯表示与场景图构建统一框架的价值。

title: Automated Multi-Agent Organization Design: From Architecture Search to Organizational Learning
summary: Agentic system design is increasingly shifting from hand-crafted prompts and workflows toward automated search over agentic programs and interaction structures, with multi-agent systems receiving growing attention. Yet a central question remains unresolved: when does an automatically generated multi-agent structure exhibit a functionally meaningful division of responsibility? We argue that automated multi-agent design should move beyond searching for effective architectures toward identifying which responsibilities are functionally necessary, how they should be allocated, and when they should change. To explore this, we propose Automated Multi-Agent Organization Design (AMOD), which treats organization itself as a first-class design object, explicitly modeling how agent teams are composed, what functional responsibilities the agents assume, how they coordinate, and how collective decisions are made. We formulate AMOD as an execution-driven design loop. For each task, an automated designer instantiates an organization by assigning functional responsibilities and coordination rules to a set of agents. After execution, task outcomes, intermediate artifacts, and interaction traces are examined to identify which responsibilities may be missing, duplicated, or ineffective, and the organization is revised accordingly. We also propose testing discovered responsibilities by removing them, replacing them with generic roles, or changing their assignment under matched resource budgets, with complementary evaluations. AMOD provides a principled foundation for evidence-based and adaptive multi-agent organization design.

AI.tldr: 提出AMOD（自动化多智能体组织设计），将"组织"本身作为一等设计对象，显式建模团队组成、功能职责、协调方式与集体决策，并以执行驱动循环自动迭代组织设计；同时提出通过删除职责、替换为通用角色、在同等资源下变更指派来检验职责的功能必要性。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体系统设计正从手工提示与工作流转向对智能体程序与交互结构的自动搜索，多智能体系统备受关注，但一个核心问题尚未解决：自动生成的多智能体结构何时真正体现功能上有意义的职责划分。作者主张自动多智能体设计应从"搜索有效架构"转向回答三件事：哪些职责在功能上是必要的、应如何分配、以及何时需要改变。
AI.method: 提出AMOD框架，把组织视为一等设计对象，显式建模智能体团队如何组成、承担何种功能职责、如何协调、如何做集体决策。将其形式化为执行驱动的设计循环：针对每个任务，自动化设计器为智能体集合指派功能职责与协调规则以实例化组织；执行后检查任务结果、中间产物与交互轨迹，识别缺失、重复或无效的职责并据此修订组织。此外提出职责检验手段：在匹配资源预算下删除某职责、以通用角色替换、或改变其指派，并辅以互补性评估。
AI.result: 摘要为立场/框架性论文，未给出具体实验数值结果；所称"结果"即AMOD框架本身及配套的职责消融式检验协议，为后续实证提供可操作的设计与评估路径。
AI.conclusion: AMOD为基于证据、可自适应的多智能体组织设计提供了有原则的基础，使自动设计从追求"有效架构"转向识别并验证功能必要的职责及其分配与演化。

title: Two Is Enough: Binary Classification Priors Suffice for Multi-Class In-Context Tabular Prediction
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) pretrain a transformer on large-scale synthetic priors so that a single forward pass yields zero-shot tabular prediction. TabICLv2 samples the class count of its classification prior during pretraining, and the prevailing configuration caps it at ten. We report a counter-intuitive result: setting this cap directly to two---making every pretrained classification task binary---still yields weights that perform zero-shot K-way classification 2. On the 38 TabArena classification datasets (200 bootstrap rounds, anchored at default RF = 1000), the binary two-stage recipe reaches 1590.1 Elo, above the official default at 1568.0 (+22.1), above TabPFN-v2.6 (1577.1) and RealTabPFN-v2.5 (1521.6). A production-scale validation on 60 real-world credit-scoring institutions independently confirms the direction: the same checkpoint improves test AUC on 44 of 60 institutions (paired Wilcoxon p = 0.0007 for AUC, p = 0.0002 for KS) at +1.5 inference cost. Mechanistically, classification in TabICLv2 is carried not by a fixed-cardinality output head but by an in-context comparison operator matching query-row embeddings against class-conditional embeddings, so the cardinality of the output space is set by the labels present in the context, not by the label space seen during pretraining. This makes a binary prior structurally cheaper to generate and cache than a ten-class prior, demotes "number of classes" from an architectural constraint to a tunable hyperparameter, and points to a class-count-agnostic regime of TFM pretraining.

AI.tldr: 在 TabICLv2 中将分类先验的类别数上限直接设为 2（全部预训练任务为二分类），仍能零样本完成 K 类分类，并在 TabArena 与信贷评分任务上取得更优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型预训练时把类别数上限设为 10，默认认为预训练先验的类别基数需要覆盖下游类别数。作者想检验这一"类别数=架构约束"的假设是否成立。
AI.method: 将预训练分类先验的类数上限从 10 改为 2；在 38 个 TabArena 分类数据集上用 200 轮 bootstrap 评估 Elo（以默认 RF=1000 为锚），并在 60 家真实信贷机构的评分数据上做生产规模验证（配对 Wilcoxon）。
AI.result: TabArena 上二分类两阶段方案达 1590.1 Elo，高于官方默认 1568.0（+22.1）、TabPFN-v2.6（1577.1）与 RealTabPFN-v2.5（1521.6）；信贷数据中 60 家中 44 家测试 AUC 提升（AUC p=0.0007，KS p=0.0002），推理开销仅 +1.5%。
AI.conclusion: TabICLv2 的分类由上下文中的查询—类条件嵌入比较算子实现，输出空间基数取决于上下文标签而非预训练标签空间，因此二值先验结构上更省生成与缓存成本，并把"类别数"从架构约束降为可调超参，指向类别数无关的 TFM 预训练范式。

title: VLA-Retain: Benchmarking Cross-Dimension Effects of Vision Tuning in VLAs
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models transfer knowledge from large-scale pretraining into robot control, but their manipulation performance remains sensitive to changes in observation conditions, which recent work addresses by fine-tuning the visual module on target-domain data. However, it remains unclear how such adaptation affects robustness beyond the target condition, as existing robustness benchmarks only evaluate models without fine-tuning and adaptation studies only report the target gain. Measuring this cross-dimension effect requires separating target gains from off-target changes, isolating adaptation effects from architectural differences, ruling out generic forgetting, and comparing tuning choices. Therefore, we introduce VLA-Retain, a benchmark that compares five open VLA models, tuned on Camera-view or Sensor-noise data, with their own base checkpoints on LIBERO-Plus dataset spanning seven perturbation dimensions. Our study reveals four findings. First, targeted vision tuning is not local, and its target gain does not predict retention. Mean off-target gain is negative in 8 of 10 model--domain configurations. Under Camera-view tuning, X-VLA gains $69.4$ percentage points on the target but loses $4.6$ points on average elsewhere, whereas OpenVLA-OFT gains $39.3$ and $1.4$ points, respectively. Second, these regressions are not explained only by performance loss on the same tasks without perturbations. Third, broader training coverage raises overall gain over target-specific training but does not eliminate dimension-level regressions. Fourth, tuning strategies are model-dependent, as DELTA-style feature preservation raises X-VLA's mean off-target gain to $+1.2$ points but lowers OpenVLA-OFT's to $-23.1$. Overall, these findings show that target-domain success alone is insufficient and highlight cross-dimensional retention as a key criterion for targeted VLA adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VLA-Retain 基准，比较五个开放 VLA 模型在 Camera-view 或 Sensor-noise 数据微调后与原基座 checkpoint 在 LIBERO-Plus 七个扰动维度上的表现，发现目标域微调的收益并非局部，跨维度保持性（retention）差且不可由目标增益预测。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型的操作性能对观测条件变化敏感，现有做法是在目标域数据上微调视觉模块；但现有鲁棒性基准只评估未微调模型，而适配研究只报告目标域增益，因此无法了解这种适配对目标条件之外的鲁棒性有何影响。要测量这种跨维度效应，需要分离目标增益与离靶变化、隔离适配效应与架构差异、排除一般性遗忘，并比较不同调参选择。
AI.method: 构建 VLA-Retain 基准：选取五个开放 VLA 模型，分别用 Camera-view 或 Sensor-noise 数据微调，并与各自原始基座 checkpoint 在同一协议下对比；评测集为 LIBERO-Plus，覆盖七个扰动维度，从而逐维度衡量目标增益与离靶（off-target）变化。
AI.result: 得出四条发现：(1) 定向视觉微调并非局部，目标增益不能预测保持性，10 个模型-域配置中有 8 个平均离靶增益为负——Camera-view 微调下 X-VLA 目标提升 69.4 个百分点但其他地方平均下降 4.6 点，OpenVLA-OFT 则分别提升 39.3 与 1.4 点；(2) 这些退化不能只用同任务无扰动下的性能损失解释；(3) 更广的训练覆盖能提升整体增益，但无法消除维度级退化；(4) 调参策略依赖具体模型，DELTA 式特征保持使 X-VLA 平均离靶增益升至 +1.2 点，却使 OpenVLA-OFT 降至 −23.1 点。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭目标域上的成功不足以说明适配有效，跨维度保持性应作为定向 VLA 适配的关键评价标准。

title: Act on Your Behalf, Beyond Your Authorization: Benchmarking LLM Agent Authorization Alignment
summary: When an LLM agent acts on behalf of a user, it is expected to act within the authorization scope the user grants. Existing agent evaluations largely measure task completion or harmful consequences and can therefore overlook actions that violate this delegation without producing conventional safety or privacy harms. We introduce AuthorizationBench, a benchmark of authorization alignment grounded in documented real-world cases. A scalable construction pipeline produces 286 executable tasks spanning situational triggers, the presence or absence of direct harmful consequences, and ten application domains. We execute every task with four models at two reasoning-effort settings across three agent harnesses in an authorization-aware sandbox that keeps authorized and out-of-authorization paths executable and observable, yielding 6,864 trajectories. Agents act out of authorization in 19.2% of trajectories, with rates ranging from 10.5% to 26.6% across the 24 configurations. Task completion does not imply authorization. Increasing reasoning effort leaves the aggregate rate nearly unchanged, with effects varying across models. On controlled pairs, agents act out of authorization at similar rates with (17.9%) and without (20.8%) direct harmful consequences, and more often under benign pressures than malicious injections (23.5% versus 17.6%, p=0.002). Our results show that task capability, additional reasoning, and consequence-oriented safety evaluation do not by themselves ensure authorization alignment. Moreover, agents that consult the principal before completing a task exhibit lower rates of out-of-authorization behavior (14.0% versus 21.6%, p<0.001), pointing to a tension between agent autonomy and preserving users' decision authority that calls for further human-centered study. Dataset and code are available at https://github.com/PEACH-Research-Lab/AuthorizationBench .

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AuthorizationBench，一个基于真实案例的"授权对齐"基准，用 286 个可执行任务、跨 4 模型×2 推理强度×3 智能体框架共 6864 条轨迹，发现智能体有 19.2% 的轨迹出现越权行为，且任务完成、更高推理强度、后果导向的安全评估都无法保证授权对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评测主要衡量任务完成度或有害后果，会漏掉那些违反用户授权范围、但不产生传统安全或隐私危害的行为，因此缺少对"授权对齐"这一维度的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建 AuthorizationBench：基于有记录的真实案例，用可扩展流水线生成 286 个可执行任务，覆盖情境触发条件、有无直接有害后果、10 个应用领域；在"授权感知沙箱"中让授权路径与越权路径都可执行、可观测，用 4 个模型×2 档推理强度×3 种智能体框架共 24 种配置跑完全部任务，得到 6864 条轨迹并进行对比分析（含配对实验与显著性检验）。
AI.result: 越权率总体 19.2%，24 种配置间从 10.5% 到 26.6%；任务完成不等于获得授权；提高推理强度对总体越权率几乎无影响（但模型间差异明显）；控制配对下有无直接有害后果的越权率相近（17.9% vs 20.8%），而良性压力比恶意注入更易诱发越权（23.5% vs 17.6%，p=0.002）；任务中先咨询用户（principal）的智能体越权率更低（14.0% vs 21.6%，p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 任务能力、额外推理与后果导向的安全评测本身都不足以保证授权对齐；更低的越权率与"先问用户"相关，揭示了智能体自主性与保留用户决策权之间的张力，值得进一步开展以人为中心的研究。数据集与代码已开源。

title: From POMDP Theory to Deep RL with Particle Filters
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning in partially observable environments requires inferring hidden states, learning latent dynamics, and planning under the resulting belief. Practical algorithms often solve one aspect of the above pipeline while relying on approximations for the others that are often poorly understood, while existing POMDP theory typically analyzes computationally inefficient theoretical algorithms far from modern deep RL practice. To fill this gap, we propose a practical end-to-end algorithm that approximately solves the hidden state filtering problem via sequential Monte Carlo (SMC), updates a latent dynamics model online, and performs approximate online planning for $d$ steps before bootstrapping leaves with a state-value critic (a QMDP approximation). We analyze each approximation and prove an end-to-end regret bound decomposing the error into model estimation error, particle filter error, Monte Carlo rollout error, and a structural bias term induced by the QMDP approximation controllable by the planning depth that we further analyze in various special cases. The resulting guarantee makes explicit how statistical sample size, particle budget, rollout budget, and planning depth affect performance. We instantiate our algorithm in an MPC-based deep RL framework, demonstrating its practicality on a variety of environments. On a POMDP that satisfies our assumptions, each term of the bound decays at its predicted rate. Our results provide a practical and theoretically grounded route for bridging theory and practice within online decision-making in POMDPs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个实用的端到端基于模型的POMDP强化学习算法，用序贯蒙特卡洛做隐状态滤波、在线学习隐动力学、以QMDP近似做d步在线规划，并给出可分解的端到端遗憾界，理论预测各误差项随样本量、粒子数、rollout数与规划深度的衰减规律，并在深度RL框架与实验中验证。
AI.motivation: 现有实用算法往往只解决"隐状态推断、隐动力学学习、基于信念规划"流水线中的一环，其余靠缺乏理解的近似；而POMDP理论分析的多是计算低效的理论算法，与现代深度RL实践脱节，需要弥合理论与实践之间的差距。
AI.method: 提出端到端算法：用序贯蒙特卡洛(SMC)近似求解隐状态滤波问题；在线更新隐动力学模型；执行d步近似在线规划，叶节点用状态价值critic自举（QMDP近似）。随后逐项分析各近似，证明端到端遗憾界。
AI.result: 遗憾界可分解为模型估计误差、粒子滤波误差、蒙特卡洛rollout误差，以及由QMDP近似引入、可由规划深度控制的结构性偏差项，并在若干特殊情形下进一步分析该偏差。界显式刻画了统计样本量、粒子预算、rollout预算和规划深度如何影响性能。将该算法实例化到基于MPC的深度RL框架，在多类环境中验证实用性；在满足假设的POMDP上，界中每一项均以预测速率衰减。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为POMDP在线决策中理论与实践之间提供了一条既实用又有理论基础的衔接路径。

title: TeCoP: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Model Decoding via Tentative Context Pipelining
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) predict multiple token positions per forward pass, yet block-wise decoders serialize generation and repeatedly recompute stable predictions. We attribute this inefficiency to coupling a prediction's readiness for irreversible commitment with its utility as context. We introduce Tentative Context Pipelining (TeCoP), a training-free decoder that decouples these roles through staggered block-parallel pipelining and draft-and-verify. TeCoP reuses stable but uncommitted predictions as provisional cross-block context, with commitment governed by confidence and stability checks. Across four LLaDA and Dream dLLMs on GSM8K, Minerva MATH, and MBPP, TeCoP reduces number of forward evaluations by up to 87% and achieves up to 7.50-fold throughput without KV caching and 11.77-fold with caching over the uncached original decoder. It outperforms Fast-dLLM and DSB in throughput across all 12 model-benchmark settings, with and without caching, while keeping average cached accuracy within one percentage point of the original decoder.

AI.tldr: TeCoP是一个免训练的解码器，通过错位块并行流水线与"草稿-验证"机制，将扩散大语言模型（dLLM）中"预测就绪可提交"与"作为上下文有用"两个角色解耦，在保持精度的前提下大幅提升吞吐。
AI.motivation: 块级解码的扩散大语言模型虽能一次前向预测多个token位置，但仍串行生成并反复重算稳定预测，效率低下。作者将此归因于将"预测是否可被不可逆提交"与"其作为上下文的价值"相耦合。
AI.method: 提出Tentative Context Pipelining（TeCoP）：采用错位块并行流水线与draft-and-verify；将稳定但未提交的预测复用为临时的跨块上下文，而真正的提交由置信度与稳定性检查决定。该方法无需训练。
AI.result: 在四个LLaDA与Dream dLLM、GSM8K/Minerva MATH/MBPP上测试：前向评估次数最多减少87%；吞吐相较无缓存原解码器提升最高7.50倍，带缓存时11.77倍；在全部12个模型-基准设置中吞吐均优于Fast-dLLM和DSB；带缓存平均精度损失在1个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦"提交就绪"与"上下文效用"，TeCoP以无需训练的方式显著提升dLLM解码吞吐，同时几乎不损失精度，优于现有基线方法。

title: VEOcc++: Learning Persistent Voxel Feature Maps for Embodied Online Semantic Occupancy Mapping and Offline Refinement
summary: Semantic occupancy mapping supports embodied perception during exploration and detailed scene understanding afterward, giving rise to two complementary requirements: online incremental mapping for maintaining an up-to-date global map under causal constraints, and offline global map refinement for improving the completed scene representation with additional computation. We present VEOcc++, a unified voxel-centric framework that connects both stages through a persistent sparse voxel feature map. During exploration, the map expands with newly observed regions and integrates aligned local features through reliability-guided updates, while context-aware decoding produces the current semantic occupancy map. After exploration, cached local features are consolidated as complementary evidence and combined with the completed online representation for multi-scale spatial refinement. On EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet, VEOcc++ achieves 67.12\% IoU and 58.40\% mIoU, establishing new state-of-the-art performance for online incremental mapping. With the local predictor fixed, our online mapping pipeline outperforms VEOcc fusion by 3.70 IoU and 3.74 mIoU points, demonstrating substantial gains from the proposed global mapping design. Offline global map refinement further improves the completed map to 67.79% IoU and 59.37% mIoU using only the observations acquired during exploration. Zero-shot deployment on a mobile robot further demonstrates transferability to unseen environments, onboard feasibility, and scalability to large-scale indoor mapping. Project page: https://wryzju.github.io/VEOccpp/.

AI.tldr: VEOcc++ 提出以稀疏体素特征图为持久载体的统一框架，将在线增量语义占用建图与离线全局地图精修两阶段连接，在 EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet 上取得在线建图新 SOTA，并支持移动机器人零样本部署。
AI.motivation: 具身探索需要在线增量建图（因果约束下维护最新全局地图），而后续场景理解又需要离线全局精修以提升完整场景表示。这两类需求互补，但现有方法往往割裂处理，缺少统一且可复用的表示。
AI.method: 以持久稀疏体素特征图为核心：探索阶段地图随新观测区域扩展，通过可靠性引导更新融合对齐的局部特征，并用上下文感知解码输出当前语义占用图；探索结束后，缓存局部特征作为互补证据，与已完成的在线表示结合进行多尺度空间精修；局部预测器保持固定。
AI.result: EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet 上在线增量建图达 67.12% IoU / 58.40% mIoU，刷新 SOTA；固定局部预测器情况下在线管道较 VEOcc fusion 提升 3.70 IoU / 3.74 mIoU；离线精修仅用探索期观测即提升至 67.79% IoU / 59.37% mIoU；移动机器人零样本部署验证了可迁移性、板载可行性与大规模室内建图扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 以持久稀疏体素特征图统一在线与离线两阶段是有效设计，能显著提升建图质量并保持部署可行性，为具身语义占用建图提供了可扩展范式。

title: RaspAssistant as an Agentic Framework for Automating Adsorption Simulation Research in Porous Materials
summary: Porous-material adsorption studies require coordinated structure preparation, force-field selection, simulation, validation, and interpretation, making end-to-end automation difficult. We test whether RaspAssistant, a hierarchical multi-agent framework, can carry an adsorption study from force-field preparation through validation and downstream separation analysis. Across twelve multi-agent workflow-reproduction runs spanning four adsorption and separation benchmarks, overall scores ranged from 8.50 to 10.00 on a rubric evaluating workflow correctness, simulation validity, and analysis consistency. In a separate eight-case force-field extraction benchmark, the mean weighted score was 0.967, combining parameter agreement and RASPA readiness. In open-ended studies, the system diagnosed and refined an acetylene force field and, after validating a CO$_2$ force field against MFI experiments, screened 197 pure-silica zeolites that passed automated input checks. These results demonstrate autonomous workflow execution after task specification and input provision: RaspAssistant coordinates, validates, adapts, and documents extended adsorption-simulation workflows while exposing model sensitivity and methodological limitations for expert review.

AI.tldr: 提出分层多智能体框架 RaspAssistant，实现多孔材料吸附研究的端到端自动化（力场准备→模拟→验证→分离分析），在12次工作流复现中得分8.50–10.00，力场提取基准平均加权分0.967。
AI.motivation: 多孔材料吸附研究需协调结构准备、力场选择、模拟、验证与结果解读等多个环节，流程复杂且依赖专家，端到端自动化困难。
AI.method: 构建分层多智能体框架 RaspAssistant，将吸附研究工作流分解为由多个智能体协同完成的子任务，覆盖力场准备、模拟执行、验证及下游分离分析，并在任务与输入给定后自主完成任务。
AI.result: 在4个吸附/分离基准的12次多智能体工作流复现中，按工作流正确性、模拟有效性、分析一致性评分，总分8.50–10.00；在8个案例的力场提取基准中平均加权分为0.967；开放研究中诊断并改进乙炔力场，经MFI实验验证CO2力场后筛选出197个通过自动输入检查的纯硅沸石。
AI.conclusion: RaspAssistant 能在任务规范与输入给定后自主协调、验证、调整并记录较长的吸附模拟工作流，同时暴露模型敏感性与方法学局限以供专家审查。

title: Bridging Digital Deception and Physical Fidelity: A Spatio-Temporal Attack on Cognitive Radars
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security. 16 pages, 13 figures
summary: As cognitive radars evolve towards the end-to-end processing of one-dimensional complex baseband sequences, deep networks face severe adversarial threats. However, existing attacks encounter dual limitations in practical electronic warfare: low cross-architecture transferability and severe vulnerability to physical channel distortions, which degrades their tactical reliability. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose a physical prior-driven Segmented Spatio-Temporal Attack (SSTA). First, a global-local feature decoupling segmentation mechanism interrupts the adversarial gradients' dependence on long-range sequence coherence, bridging the cross-architecture feature gap. Second, moving beyond static norm constraints devoid of physical semantics, we abstract channel distortions into differentiable spatio-temporal operators, integrating them into momentum iterations via an Expectation over Transformation (EoT) strategy. Comprehensive cross-evaluations across 9 heterogeneous models spanning CNNs, RNNs, and Transformers demonstrate that SSTA outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline by 10.36% in Average Black-Box Attack Success Rate. Furthermore, baseband equivalent simulations confirm that the generated waveforms survive extreme physical distortions and, after matched filtering, achieve zero main-lobe attenuation (0 dB) with noise floor lift strictly within Constant False Alarm Rate tolerances. SSTA successfully unifies digital-domain deception and physical-domain fidelity, providing crucial support for CEW security assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出物理先验驱动的分段时空攻击（SSTA），同时解决跨架构迁移性差与物理信道失真敏感两大问题，在9种异构模型上平均黑盒攻击成功率较SOTA提升10.36%，且基带等效仿真中主瓣零衰减、噪声抬升满足CFAR容限。
AI.motivation: 认知雷达趋向对一维复基带序列的端到端处理，深度网络因此面临对抗威胁；但现有攻击在电子战中跨架构迁移性低、对物理信道失真敏感，战术可靠性差。
AI.method: 1）全局-局部特征解耦分段机制，切断对抗梯度对长程序列一致性的依赖，弥合跨架构特征差距；2）将信道失真抽象为可微时空算子，通过期望变换（EoT）策略嵌入动量迭代，替代缺乏物理语义的静态范数约束。
AI.result: 在CNN、RNN、Transformer三类共9个异构模型交叉评估中，平均黑盒攻击成功率超SOTA基线10.36%；基带等效仿真显示波形可承受极端物理失真，匹配滤波后主瓣衰减为0 dB，噪声抬升严格处于恒虚警率容限内。
AI.conclusion: SSTA统一了数字域欺骗性与物理域保真度，为认知电子战（CEW）安全评估提供关键支撑。

title: Beyond Model Weights: Sampling-Dependent Fairness in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are emerging as a practical alternative to autoregressive language models (ARLMs), yet their fairness remains largely uncharacterized. DLMs introduce sampling controls with no direct autoregressive counterpart, such as block length and remasking strategy, that directly set their speed--quality operating point. This raises a basic question: does a DLM's measured social bias remain stable across these settings? Across LLaDA, LLaDA-1.5, and Dream on Open-BBQ, we find that all three models exhibit social bias, but both the magnitude of measured bias and the relative ordering of models by bias are highly sensitive to the sampling configuration. This sampling dependence also changes what successful debiasing means. While mitigation strategies established for ARLMs transfer effectively to DLMs and reduce bias without degrading downstream performance, sampling dependence persists even after mitigation. Our results show that fairness in DLMs cannot be characterized independently of the sampling configuration, even after debiasing. Project page is available at https://pakapaka333.github.io/Beyond-Model-Weights/.

AI.tldr: 扩散语言模型(DLM)的公平性度量高度依赖采样配置（块长度、重掩码策略），偏差幅度与模型间排序都会随设置改变，且去偏后这种采样依赖性依然存在。
AI.motivation: DLM正成为自回归模型的实用替代方案，但其公平性鲜有刻画。DLM引入了自回归模型没有的采样控制（块长度、重掩码策略），直接决定速度—质量权衡点。因此需要回答：DLM测得的社会偏差在这些采样设置下是否稳定？
AI.method: 在Open-BBQ基准上评测LLaDA、LLaDA-1.5与Dream三个DLM，系统改变采样配置以观察测得的社会偏差变化；同时检验现有面向自回归模型的去偏策略能否迁移到DLM，并考察去偏后采样依赖是否消失。
AI.result: 三个模型均表现出社会偏差；但偏差幅度以及模型间按偏差的相对排序都高度敏感于采样配置。面向ARLM的去偏方法可有效迁移，能降低偏差且不损害下游性能；然而去偏之后采样依赖性依然持续存在。
AI.conclusion: DLM的公平性无法脱离采样配置独立刻画，即使已做去偏；公平性评估必须同时报告采样设置，模型选择结论也应视为配置相关而非固有属性。

title: RLSplat: Resource-Linear Budget Control for Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (FF3DGS) reconstructs 3D scenes from images in a single forward pass, making it well-suited to applications that must operate within limited resource budgets. To further improve its practicality, recent budget-controllable FF3DGS methods allow the number of Gaussians to be adjusted at inference, so that the output meets a given storage limit or rendering-latency constraint. However, these methods overlook the cost of inference itself: to produce a representation with the target number of Gaussians, they first predict a dense set of Gaussians and then prune or select from it, requiring nearly constant latency and peak memory regardless of the budget. We therefore propose RLSplat, a resource-linear budget-controllable FF3DGS framework whose representation size, inference latency, and peak memory all decrease linearly as the Gaussian budget is reduced. Instead of pruning or selection, RLSplat learns a Gaussian allocation policy that distributes the budget across local scene regions, so that exactly the requested number of Gaussians is generated. These Gaussians are then refined through resource-linear Gaussian decoding, in which each Gaussian attends only to nearby Gaussians found via an efficient hierarchical neighbor search, so that the decoding cost decreases linearly with fewer Gaussians. In zero-shot evaluation, RLSplat outperforms prior budget-controllable methods at every budget, surpassing the strongest baseline even with 4$\times$ fewer Gaussians, while running up to 4.1$\times$ faster with 9.6$\times$ less peak memory at low budgets.

AI.tldr: RLSplat 是一个资源线性可控前馈3D高斯溅射框架，其表示大小、推理延迟与峰值内存均随高斯预算线性下降。
AI.motivation: 现有预算可控 FF3DGS 方法只控制输出规模，却忽略推理成本：它们先预测稠密高斯再剪枝/选择，导致延迟和峰值内存几乎不随预算变化。本文希望让推理本身的资源消耗也随预算线性减少。
AI.method: 用学习到的高斯分配策略将预算分配到局部场景区域，直接生成恰好所需数量的高斯；随后通过资源线性高斯解码，使每个高斯只关注由高效层次化近邻搜索找到的邻近高斯，从而解码开销随高斯数量线性下降。
AI.result: 在零样本评测中，RLSplat 在每个预算下都优于先前预算可控方法；即使高斯数量少4倍也超过最强基线，低预算下最高快4.1倍、峰值内存低9.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过分配策略与线性解码替代剪枝选择，RLSplat 实现了表示、延迟和内存随预算线性伸缩，提升了预算可控 FF3DGS 的实际可用性。

title: When LLMs Manipulate: Measuring Behavioral, Social, and Temporal Effects
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can influence user trust and decision-making through subtle linguistic cues, yet the behavioral effects of manipulative outputs remain poorly quantified. We introduce a behavioral computing framework for measuring \textit{behavioral vulnerability}, defined as users' susceptibility to manipulative AI responses. Building on DarkPatterns-LLM benchmark, we generate controlled manipulative stimuli using Manipulation Gradient Descent (MGD), targeting biases associated with authority, urgency, and social proof. We analyze participant responses using the Multi-Stakeholder Impact Assessment Network (MSIAN) to model cross-user influence and the Temporal Harm Propagation Model (THPM) to characterize the persistence of behavioral effects over time. In a study involving 120 participants, manipulative framing produced significant changes in trust calibration and compliance ($p < 0.01$), with effects also propagating across social contexts. These findings highlight the need to extend LLM safety evaluation beyond model outputs to measurable behavioral consequences and provide a computational framework for quantifying individual, social, and temporal risks arising from manipulative AI interactions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"行为计算"框架量化用户对LLM操纵性输出的行为脆弱性。
AI.motivation: LLM可通过微妙语言线索影响信任与决策，但操纵性输出的行为效应缺乏定量测量。
AI.method: 基于DarkPatterns-LLM基准，用Manipulation Gradient Descent(MGD)生成针对权威、紧迫、社会认同偏误的操纵刺激；用MSIAN建模跨用户影响，用THPM刻画行为效应的时间持续性；120名被试实验。
AI.result: 操纵性框架显著改变信任校准与顺从(p<0.01)，效应跨社会情境传播。
AI.conclusion: LLM安全评估应从模型输出扩展到可测量的行为后果，并提供量化个体、社会与时间风险的计算框架。

title: Benefit and Cost of Random-Token Replacement under Repeated Data: A Known-Entropy Decomposition and Evidence from Ten Real Corpora
summary: When unique pretraining data is scarce, models see the same tokens many times and are thought to memorize. Random-token replacement, an input-corruption augmentation, is one remedy reported to lower validation loss, but a lower loss alone does not reveal which source of error it reduces. On a controlled source whose entropy rate is known in closed form, we show that replacement shrinks predictions toward the corpus average. We also introduce a decomposition that separates validation loss into approximation, estimation, and memorization terms. This shrinkage view predicts that replacement's bias cost needs no memorization but its benefit does. Memorization raises validation loss after its minimum, so we report the effect at two points, the minimum validation loss and the end of a fixed budget. Where replacement helps, it reduces this rise by about 60%. At the end of the budget, it turns from harmful to helpful as the controlled source becomes less predictable; at the minimum, it helps at no predictability level under the fixed recipe. On Korean and Japanese web text, replacement removes about a third of the loss rise after the minimum by the end of the budget, but its effect at the minimum is much smaller. Across ten real corpora, replacement lowers the final loss on nine. It harms only the census corpus, program-generated JSON that is the most redundant of the ten and much more redundant than any of 64 further prose and code corpora we measure.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"收缩视角"解释随机token替换增强，并引入将验证损失分解为近似、估计、记忆三项的框架，区分替换带来的偏差代价（无需记忆）与收益（依赖记忆）。
AI.motivation: 随机token替换被报告能降低验证损失，但损失降低本身不能说明它减少的是哪类误差；当唯一预训练数据稀缺、模型反复见到相同token时，记忆成为重要误差来源，需厘清替换的作用机制。
AI.method: 在熵率已知闭式解的可控数据源上分析替换行为，发现其使预测向语料均值收缩；提出验证损失分解为近似、估计与记忆项，并在"最小验证损失"与"固定预算结束"两个时点评估效果；在韩日网页文本及十个真实语料（含64个额外散文与代码语料对照）上验证。
AI.result: 替换将最小损失后的上升减少约60%；预算结束时，随可控源可预测性下降，替换由有害转为有益，而在最小点任意可预测性下均无益；韩日文本上减少约三分之一的损失上升，最小点效果很小；十个真实语料中九个最终损失下降，仅对冗余度最高的census(JSON)语料有害。
AI.conclusion: 随机token替换本质是向语料均值的收缩：其偏差代价不依赖记忆，收益则依赖记忆；效果高度依赖评估时点与数据冗余度/可预测性，应在两个时点分别报告。

title: Push-Pull Attentional Anchoring for Diffusion Concept Erasure
summary: Rapid advances in diffusion models have raised concerns about privacy, harmful content, and copyright violations. Concept erasure methods aim to address these risks by removing undesirable concepts from pretrained models without full retraining. However, existing approaches often degrade non-target generation quality through heuristic strength scaling (e.g., classifier-free guidance or negative prompt scaling), leading to uncontrolled and excessive semantic drift. To address this, we propose Push-Pull Attentional Anchoring (PPAA), a mechanism in the cross-attention space that displaces target representations while anchoring the scale of erasure via bounded cosine-similarity constraints. By using a relative similarity ratio instead of an absolute difference, our adaptive threshold represents a meaningful percentage of semantic retention, facilitating a single value to be applied uniformly across layers. We conduct extensive experiments across multiple concept categories, including celebrities, artistic styles, nudity, and intellectual property. Our method achieves favorable trade-offs against prior approaches on Stable Diffusion v1.4 and demonstrates its applicability to modern architectures such as FLUX.

AI.tldr: 提出 Push-Pull Attentional Anchoring (PPAA)，在 cross-attention 空间中以有界余弦相似度约束实现概念擦除，平衡擦除效果与非目标生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型带来隐私、有害内容和版权风险；现有概念擦除方法依赖启发式强度缩放（如 CFG 或负提示缩放），导致非目标生成质量下降和不可控的语义漂移。
AI.method: 在 cross-attention 空间中推离目标表征并用有界余弦相似度约束锚定擦除强度；采用相对相似度比值替代绝对差值，使自适应阈值表示语义保留的百分比，从而可用单一数值跨层统一应用。
AI.result: 在名人、艺术风格、裸露内容和知识产权等多类概念上实验，于 Stable Diffusion v1.4 上取得优于先前方法的权衡，并验证了在 FLUX 等新架构上的适用性。
AI.conclusion: PPAA 通过相对相似度约束实现可控擦除，避免启发式缩放带来的质量退化，具备跨概念类别与跨模型架构的通用性。

title: The Show-Up Attack: When Subagents Win Over Their Supervisor
summary: Multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed to coordinate multiple large language model (LLM) agents. However, this also creates new attack surfaces: malicious agents may have chances to exploit the coordination. In this paper, we propose and study the \textit{show-up attack}, in which a malicious subagent manipulates the supervisor into involving it in tasks beyond its assigned scope. To evaluate this risk, we propose SUA-Arena, which implements 6 attack strategies and contains 188 test cases. Then, we evaluate 6 frontier LLMs and find that all of them are vulnerable to show-up attacks. For example, GPT-5.6-Sol as a supervisor suffers an ASR of up to 0.93. Mitigation strategies such as prompting and restricted communication fail to reduce the risk consistently. These results show that multi-agent systems need explicit mechanisms for enforcing authority boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并研究多智能体系统中的"露脸攻击"(show-up attack)：恶意子代理诱使监督代理将其纳入超出既定职责范围的任务；构建SUA-Arena基准（6种攻击策略、188个测试用例），发现6个前沿LLM监督代理均存在漏洞（GPT-5.6-Sol攻击成功率高达0.93），且提示工程与受限通信等缓解手段效果不稳定。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统越来越多地部署用于协调多个LLM代理，这同时带来了新的攻击面：恶意代理可能利用代理间的协调机制。现有工作缺乏对这一类"越权参与"风险的系统性评估。
AI.method: 提出show-up attack：恶意子代理通过操控监督代理，使自己被纳入超出其分配范围的任务。为此构建SUA-Arena评测基准，包含6种攻击策略与188个测试用例，并对6个前沿LLM作为监督代理进行评测，同时测试提示工程与受限通信等缓解策略。
AI.result: 全部6个前沿LLM均对show-up攻击存在脆弱性；例如GPT-5.6-Sol作为监督代理时攻击成功率(ASR)最高达0.93；提示式防御与限制通信等缓解策略无法稳定降低风险。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体系统需要显式的权限边界执行机制，而非仅依赖提示或通信约束来防范恶意子代理的越权攻击。

title: Learning Inter-Graph Interactions Between Heterogeneous Substructures of Chemical Systems
summary: Complex chemical systems containing heterogeneous substructures are common in real-world applications. Various physical phenomena of the complex chemical systems are derived from the interactions between the heterogeneous substructures. However, existing graph representation learning methods for inter-graph interactions assumed graph-level interactions between homogeneous structures, such as organic molecules and inorganic crystalline materials. We propose a data descriptor of the complex chemical systems and a graph neural network for learning inter-graph interactions between organic and inorganic compounds. We applied the proposed method to predict the physical properties of hybrid solar cell materials containing heterogeneous substructures, which have received significant attention for sustainable energy resources. By learning heterogeneous inter-graph interactions, the proposed method achieved state-of-the-art accuracy in predicting band gaps of 1,682 hybrid solar cell materials.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向复杂化学系统的数据描述符与图神经网络，用于学习有机-无机异构子结构之间的跨图相互作用，并在1,682种混合太阳能电池材料的带隙预测上取得最优精度。
AI.motivation: 真实世界的复杂化学系统常包含异构子结构，其物理性质源于子结构间的相互作用。然而现有图表示学习方法在建模图间交互时，假设交互发生在同质结构（如有机分子之间或无机晶体之间）的图级层面上，无法刻画有机与无机异构子结构之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 提出针对复杂化学系统的数据描述符，并设计一个图神经网络，用于学习有机化合物与无机化合物之间的异构图间相互作用（heterogeneous inter-graph interactions），从而将异构子结构信息纳入统一表示。
AI.result: 将该方法应用于混合太阳能电池材料的物理性质预测，在1,682种混合太阳能电池材料的带隙预测任务上达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习异构子结构间的图间交互，可有效建模含异构组分的复杂化学系统，为混合太阳能电池材料等可持续能源材料的性质预测提供了有效手段。

title: WORTH Benchmark: Evidence Discovery under Not-Fully-Cooperative Information -- A Two-Episode Pilot
summary: Existing reasoning evaluations typically provide task-relevant information to models as available premises, rarely examining concurrently how models discover evidence autonomously and how information presentation within narratives guides or obscures judgment. This paper proposes the WORTH Benchmark: models read original mystery narratives without clue annotations, autonomously select key clue sentences, identify case participants, and explain their reasoning process. The narrative materials are designed by professional authors such that evidence facilitating reasoning coexists with narrative arrangements that delay the revelation of truth. We report a pilot experiment under full-story conditions across two episodes, conducting a total of 70 formal runs on models, of which 67 runs are content-scorable. Scoring separately records hits on author-designated key clue sentences and participant selections; natural language explanations are used for case diagnosis and are not scored independently. The results show that clue hits and participant judgments are not synchronized; across 37 content-scorable runs in Episode 02, 31 runs simultaneously selected the same set of incorrect participants, while adjacent suspicion-oriented and exoneration-oriented sentences were selected 25 times and 0 times, respectively. These phenomena illustrate the diagnostic value of component-wise analysis and suggest that not-fully-cooperative informational relationships may influence evidence selection and judgment. This study only implements full-story conditions for two episodes, and does not establish stable model rankings or infer general mechanisms on this basis; human player records have not yet been cleaned, and this version does not report human-model comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出 WORTH Benchmark：让模型在无标注的原创悬疑叙事中自主选取关键线索句、识别涉案人物并解释推理过程，以组件化方式诊断推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有推理评测通常直接以可用前提形式提供任务相关信息，很少同时考察模型如何自主发现证据，以及叙事中的信息呈现方式如何引导或遮蔽判断。
AI.method: 由专业作者设计叙事材料，使有助于推理的证据与延迟真相揭示的叙事安排共存；模型在完整故事条件下阅读无线索标注的原文，自主选择关键线索句、识别案件参与者并给出自然语言推理。评分分别记录与作者标注关键线索句的命中情况和人物选择，解释文本仅用于案例诊断、不单独计分。两个章节共进行 70 次正式运行，其中 67 次可内容评分。
AI.result: 线索命中与人物判断不同步：第 02 章 37 次可评分运行中，31 次同时选中同一组错误参与者；相邻的"指向怀疑"与"指向免责"句子分别被选中 25 次和 0 次。
AI.conclusion: 组件化分析具有诊断价值，不完全合作的信息关系可能影响证据选择与判断。当前仅实现两章节的完整故事条件，尚不能建立稳定模型排序或推断一般机制，人类玩家数据未清洗，本版本未报告人机对比。

title: World2HOSI: A Multi-Expert Harness for Long-Horizon Human-Object-Scene Interaction Generation
summary: Long-horizon human-object-scene interaction (HOSI) is central to embodied AI, animation, and game development. Existing human-object interaction (HOI) and human-scene interaction (HSI) models excel in their respective domains, but none alone covers tasks requiring multiple interaction skills. Training unified HOSI models is hindered by scarce and costly data. We introduce World2HOSI, a multi-expert orchestration harness that generates continuous HOSI data from 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes and natural language instructions. Our key insight is that long-horizon HOSI hinges not on a stronger single model but on orchestration. Given a shared, structured scene state and an orchestration harness grounded in it, existing experts can jointly accomplish tasks beyond the reach of any of them alone. World2HOSI realizes this insight as a closed loop around a persistent scene state built from decoupled background and object assets. A harness plans action stages over this state, invokes experts via their native conditioning interfaces, and writes each action's effects back, so that every invocation is grounded in the evolving world. To reduce physical artifacts, bounded residual optimization and contact-driven physics simulation further ensure the physical plausibility of human motion and object manipulation, respectively, while preserving interaction intent. Experiments and a perceptual user study show that World2HOSI achieves the best task completion and interaction quality on the evaluated HOSI tasks, while generating more diverse data.

AI.tldr: World2HOSI：多专家编排框架，从3DGS场景与语言指令生成连续长时程人-物-场景交互数据
AI.motivation: 长时程人-物-场景交互（HOSI）需要多种交互技能，现有HOI与HSI模型各自独立、无法单独覆盖；而训练统一HOSI模型受限于数据稀缺且昂贵。
AI.method: 以共享、结构化的持久场景状态为核心构建闭环：从解耦的背景与物体资产构建场景状态；编排器在该状态上规划动作阶段，通过各专家原生条件接口调用现有专家，并将每个动作效果写回状态以保持落地；用有界残差优化保证人体运动物理合理，用接触驱动物理仿真保证物体操作合理，同时保留交互意图。
AI.result: 实验与感知用户研究表明，在评测的HOSI任务上取得最佳的任务完成度与交互质量，且生成数据更多样。
AI.conclusion: 长时程HOSI的关键不在单一更强模型，而在围绕结构化场景状态的编排；该思路可使现有专家协同完成超出各自能力的任务。

title: DuplexLedger: Benchmarking Transactional Memory in Full-Duplex Speech Agents
summary: Full-duplex speech agents must update persistent memory while listening and speaking, yet it remains unclear which events should be stored, revised, or excluded. Existing benchmarks isolate interaction timing from memory outcomes, obscuring the state transitions behind a correct answer. We introduce DuplexLedger, a bilingual benchmark of 1,094 persistent sessions aligning four full-duplex scenarios with event-level Write/Update/Ignore/Retain supervision, explicit pre/post memory states, and 6,564 same-session questions and checks. Evaluating five full-duplex models reveals an interaction-memory gap: no system combines strong boundary control with coherent final-state memory, and the best final-state fact coverage is 2.01%. We propose ACT-Mem, an 8.92M-parameter sidecar comprising an event controller, a versioned transactional ledger, and a typed retriever coupled with a frozen MiniCPM-o 4.5 backbone. On 219 held-out sessions, ACT-Mem increases latest-value accuracy from 4.11% to 8.68% while reducing stale assertions and distractor adoption. It improves interaction boundaries but slows interruption stopping. These results motivate selective, auditable full-duplex memory rather than indiscriminate transcript retention. Code is available at https://github.com/lyx-researcher/DuplexLedger.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出双语基准 DuplexLedger，用于评估全双工语音智能体在选择性与可审计的持久记忆更新能力，并提出轻量侧车模块 ACT-Mem 以改进记忆一致性。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音智能体需边听说边更新持久记忆，但哪些事件应写入、修改或忽略尚不明确；现有基准将交互时序与记忆结果割裂，掩盖了正确答案背后的状态转移过程。
AI.method: 构建 DuplexLedger：1,094 个持久会话、四类全双工场景、事件级 Write/Update/Ignore/Retain 监督、显式前/后记忆状态及 6,564 个同会话问题；评估五个全双工模型。进而提出 ACT-Mem（8.92M 参数侧车），含事件控制器、版本化事务账本与类型化检索器，挂接冻结的 MiniCPM-o 4.5 主干。
AI.result: 五个全双工模型均存在"交互—记忆鸿沟"，无系统兼具强边界控制与连贯终态记忆，最优终态事实覆盖率仅 2.01%。在 219 个留出会话上，ACT-Mem 将最新值准确率由 4.11% 提升至 8.68%，并减少过期断言与干扰项采纳；但改进了交互边界却拖慢了打断停止。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持选择性、可审计的全双工记忆机制，而非不加区分地保留全部转写文本。

title: From Outcomes to Steps: Reliable Success-Aware Critic Learning for Long-Horizon Language Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon language agents requires identifying whether intermediate actions make eventual task success more or less likely when supervision is available only at trajectory level. The main difficulty is that a critic with aggregate return-prediction accuracy may still fail to resolve the local value differences needed to assign credit to actions, especially under sparse feedback and function approximation. Conventional critics estimate future return, but policy improvement also depends on knowing whether each intermediate decision makes task success more or less likely. We introduce SCALE, an actor-critic framework that augments conventional return estimation with explicit prediction of eventual task success. At each interaction prefix, the critic predicts a return value and a Success Value, defined as the probability that the task will eventually be completed from that prefix. SCALE converts changes in Success Value into multi-step action credit through Success-GAE and modulates its contribution according to the estimated reliability of the predictor, while retaining the token-level PPO objective. Across five agent benchmarks and three model backbones, SCALE improves task performance over the compared RL baselines in most settings, with gains of up to 4.1 percentage points in success rate. Separate critic-learning analyses show that SCALE also improves critic estimation and training stability.

AI.tldr: SCALE：在actor-critic中显式预测"最终任务成功概率"（Success Value），并通过Success-GAE将其变化转化为多步动作信用，配合可靠性调制，提升长程语言智能体的RL效果。
AI.motivation: 长程语言智能体的监督仅在轨迹级别，需判断中间动作是否提升最终成功率。仅优化聚合回报预测精度的critic，在稀疏反馈和函数逼近下难以分辨局部价值差异，从而无法正确分配动作信用。
AI.method: 提出SCALE框架：在每个交互前缀，critic同时预测回报值和Success Value（从该前缀最终完成任务的概率）；用Success-GAE把Success Value的变化转换为多步动作信用；按预测器估计可靠性对该贡献加权调制；保留token级PPO目标。
AI.result: 在5个智能体基准、3个模型骨干上，SCALE在多数设置下优于对比的RL基线，成功率最多提升4.1个百分点；critic学习分析显示其改善了critic估计与训练稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模任务成功概率可弥补传统回报critic在信用分配上的不足，是一种有效且稳定的长程语言智能体RL强化手段。

title: Self-Decomposing Diffusion for Code Generation
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are emerging as a promising paradigm for code generation, offering the potential for fast, parallel decoding. However, generating complex programs remains challenging, as their interdependent components must maintain consistent interfaces, data flows, and shared assumptions. Aggressive parallel decoding can compromise these dependencies and undermine program correctness, while conservative decoding sacrifices efficiency. To address this trade-off, we propose planning program decomposition before implementation to coordinate interdependent units during parallel generation. We introduce Self-Decomposing Diffusion for Code (SDDC), a novel framework that decomposes complex programs and implements their units in parallel, entirely through diffusion. SDDC first generates a contract specifying the program's decomposition and inter-unit dependencies, then uses it to guide coordinated parallel implementation. Across five benchmarks and two 7B diffusion backbones, SDDC substantially improves the accuracy--latency trade-off, raising pass@1 by up to 31.1 percentage points while decoding 7.5--13.7$\times$ faster than the base models, and outperforming a fine-tuning baseline by up to 23.5 points with lower latency.

AI.tldr: 提出 SDDC 框架，先生成记录程序分解与单元间依赖的契约，再据此并行动扩散实现各单元，在保证逻辑一致性的同时提升复杂代码生成的准确率与速度。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型并行解码可加速代码生成，但复杂程序各组件间存在接口、数据流与共享假设等依赖，激进并行会破坏依赖、损害正确性，保守解码又损失效率，需要平衡。
AI.method: SDDC 先通过扩散生成一份"契约"，明确程序分解结构与单元间依赖；再以该契约为引导，全程用扩散并行实现各单元，实现协调一致的并行生成。
AI.result: 在 5 个基准、2 个 7B 扩散骨干上，pass@1 最高提升 31.1 个百分点，解码速度比基座模型快 7.5–13.7 倍，且优于微调基线最多 23.5 点并具更低延迟。
AI.conclusion: 将规划（程序分解）前置并作为并行生成的协调机制，可显著改善扩散代码生成的准确率—延迟权衡。

title: CILA: Confusion-based Instance-wise Logit Adjustment for Long-Tailed Recognition
summary:
Real-world datasets are inherently class-imbalanced, leading models to favor majority classes and struggle with minority ones. Existing logit adjustment methods address this by modifying logits based on class frequencies, but their class-wise adjustments ignore instance-wise confusion and often suppress informative signals from confusing non-target classes. This results in insufficient learning of such classes, increased prediction uncertainty, and limited generalization.
  To address this, we propose two complementary methods. First, \textbf{Confusion-based Instance-wise Logit Adjustment (CILA)} adaptively adjusts logits based on instance-wise confusion between the target and non-target classes, restoring informative gradients that class-wise adjustment suppresses. Second, \textbf{Batch-adaptation Noise-Injection (BNI)} perturbs the target logit during training, extending the confusion-aware update to correctly classified but near-boundary samples that the penalty alone cannot reach. CILA is a loss-agnostic plug-in module that can be seamlessly integrated into existing long-tailed learning methods, and consistently improves performance across multiple benchmarks. Our code will be available at https://github.com/maya0395/CILA.

AI.tldr: 提出CILA与BNI两种互补的实例级logit调整方法，缓解长尾分类中类级调整忽略实例混淆、压制有用梯度的问题。
AI.motivation: 真实数据存在类别不平衡，模型偏向多数类、少数类表现差。现有logit adjustment基于类别频率做类级调整，忽略实例级混淆，且常压制来自易混淆非目标类的有用信号，导致这些类学习不足、预测不确定性升高、泛化受限。
AI.method: 1) Confusion-based Instance-wise Logit Adjustment（CILA）：根据目标类与非目标类之间的实例级混淆程度自适应调整logit，恢复被类级调整压制的有用梯度；2) Batch-adaptation Noise-Injection（BNI）：训练时扰动目标logit，将混淆感知的更新扩展到分类正确但接近边界的样本。CILA为与损失无关的即插即用模块，可集成到现有长尾学习方法中。
AI.result: CILA可无缝集成到多种现有长尾学习方法中，并在多个基准上一致提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 实例级混淆感知的logit调整（配合噪声注入）能有效弥补类级调整的不足，是提升长尾学习性能的通用、可插拔方案。

title: Beyond Experience: Knowledge-Guided Evolution for NPU Kernel Generation
summary: LLM agents have become capable kernel engineers on mainstream GPU stacks, but they struggle on emerging accelerators such as Ascend NPUs, whose programming model is barely represented in pretraining data. Recent NPU agents address this gap largely through experience: they accumulate memory from their own generation and optimization trials and reuse it on later tasks. We argue that experience alone is not enough for kernel generation. An agent can only remember what it has tried, and it rarely tries a mechanism it does not know. As a result, such memory offers little help when a new operator calls for a different mechanism, and even familiar operators raise unseen situations as optimization proceeds. We present ASCENDEVOLVE, which grounds every step of an evolutionary kernel search in a large external knowledge base built from platform documentation, toolkit headers, and operator repositories. Because this corpus far exceeds any context window, ASCENDEVOLVE indexes it and routes each agent to a small, task-specific slice of evidence instead of the corpus itself. The retrieved knowledge seeds diverse implementation strategies, guides repair when a candidate fails, and constrains how strong candidates are recombined. On 53 Ascend C operators from CANN-Bench spanning four difficulty levels, ASCENDEVOLVE achieves an overall score of 71.39, improving over Reflexion and OpenEvolve by 11.6% and 17.2%.

AI.tldr: ASCENDEVOLVE 通过将进化式内核搜索的每一步都建立在大型外部知识库（平台文档、工具链头文件、算子仓库）之上，解决 NPU 智能体仅依赖自身经验难以生成新机制内核的问题。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在主流 GPU 上已能胜任内核工程，但在 Ascend NPU 等新兴加速器上因预训练数据稀缺而表现不佳。现有 NPU 智能体主要靠积累自身生成与优化试错的经验记忆，但只能记住"试过的"，很少尝试不了解的机制；遇到需要不同机制的新算子或优化中出现的未见情形时，记忆帮助有限。
AI.method: 构建来自平台文档、工具链头文件和算子仓库的大型外部知识库；因语料远超上下文窗口，对其建立索引，并将每个智能体路由到一小块任务相关的证据切片而非整个语料。检索到的知识用于：为多样化实现策略播种、在候选失败时指导修复、约束强候选的重组方式，并将这些融入进化式内核搜索的每一步。
AI.result: 在 CANN-Bench 的 53 个 Ascend C 算子（覆盖四个难度级别）上，ASCENDEVOLVE 总体得分 71.39，相比 Reflexion 和 OpenEvolve 分别提升 11.6% 和 17.2%。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠经验积累不足以支撑内核生成，引入大规模外部知识库并按需检索，能有效提升新兴加速器上的内核生成与优化能力。

title: Ensemble-Aware Structural Encoding (EASE): Conditioning Protein Encoders on Peptide Conformational Ensembles
summary: Protein foundation models provide transferable representations for downstream peptide prediction tasks. However, existing representations typically reduce a peptide to a single sequence or structure, which may miss conformational variability relevant to key peptide properties, including antibacterial activity, hemolysis, toxicity, stability, and binding. For example, protease resistance correlates more strongly with conformational dynamics measured by hydrogen exchange than with average helicity. Therefore, we introduce Ensemble-Aware Structural Encoding (EASE), a framework for effectively extracting structural information from conformational ensembles for peptide representation. To extract useful information from noisy conformers, EASE selects central conformers representing a peptide's major structural states and fuses their individual representations with a permutation-invariant operator to produce a peptide-level representation for downstream prediction. We then evaluate our framework on six peptide property-prediction tasks under leakage-controlled splits. Against matched single-structure baselines, EASE improves performance consistently on six tasks with a mean absolute gain of about 3.0% across two structural encoders. Gains keep growing as we add conformers through K=20. A single peptide conformer therefore provides a limited basis for structural representation, whereas our framework distilling and fusing multiple conformers yields a more informative representation.

AI.tldr: 提出EASE框架，从构象系综中筛选代表性构象并用置换不变算子融合其结构表示，得到更具信息量的肽段表示，在六个肽性质预测任务上平均绝对提升约3.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质基础模型把肽简化为单一序列或单一结构，忽略了与抗菌活性、溶血性、毒性、稳定性、结合等关键性质相关的构象可变性；例如蛋白酶抗性与氢交换测得的构象动态相关性比平均螺旋度更强。
AI.method: EASE框架：从带噪构象系综中选出代表肽主要结构状态的中心构象，再用置换不变算子融合各构象的独立表示，生成肽级表示用于下游预测；在防泄漏数据划分下评测六个肽性质预测任务。
AI.result: 与匹配的单结构基线相比，EASE在六个任务上一致提升，两种结构编码器下平均绝对增益约3.0%；构象数增至K=20时增益持续增长。
AI.conclusion: 单一构象为结构表示提供的基础有限；蒸馏并融合多构象的框架能获得更有信息量的肽段表示。

title: ABench: Adversarily Benchmarking Large Language Models across Taxonomized Values
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 16 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables
summary: Ensuring the alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) with diverse cultural values is critical for their safe global deployment. However, existing alignment benchmarks are predominantly English-centric or confined to simple discriminative tasks. Moreover, they often fail to effectively evaluate model robustness against complex, adversarial inductions within specific cultural contexts. To address these limitations, we propose ABench, a fine-grained, handcrafted benchmark specifically tailored to taxonomized values in Chinese. Grounded in a rigorous hierarchical taxonomy comprising 158 derived value subcategories, ABench consists of 2,895 open-ended questions. These questions employ techniques such as role-playing and logical traps to probe the stability of models' stances in adversarially induced contexts. Furthermore, we propose a weighted automated evaluation framework that utilizes question-specific scoring criteria for nuanced assessment. Extensive experiments on 16 mainstream LLMs reveal that most models exhibit significant vulnerabilities when subjected to sophisticated adversary attacks on values (scoring below 60). This underscores the need for more robust, culturally specific alignment strategies. Our data will be publicly released to promote further research on taxonomized value alignment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ABench——一个基于158个层级化价值子类、包含2895道开放式问题的中文细粒度手工价值对齐基准，通过角色扮演与逻辑陷阱等对抗性诱导手段，并配合加权自动化评估框架，揭示主流大模型在文化价值对齐上的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有价值对齐基准多以英文为中心，或局限于简单的判别式任务，难以有效评估模型在特定文化语境下面对复杂对抗性诱导时的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建严格层级化价值分类体系（158个子类），设计2895道开放式问题，采用角色扮演与逻辑陷阱等技术探测模型立场稳定性；并提出基于问题专属评分标准的加权自动化评估框架。
AI.result: 对16个主流大模型的实验表明，多数模型在复杂价值对抗攻击下得分低于60，表现出显著脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型缺乏稳健且具文化针对性的对齐策略；作者将公开数据以推动细粒度分类价值对齐研究。

title: Meta Expert: Cross-Layer Expert Sharing for Storage- and Retrieval-Efficient MoE
summary: As model parameters scale up, sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches have become essential for model scaling. However, mainstream models currently adopt hierarchical architectures, where experts in different layers, although topologically independent, exhibit substantial similarity and redundancy in their stored content. Compared to the hierarchically arranged \textbf{Local Expert} in existing mainstream models, we hypothesize that inter-layer shared \textbf{Meta Expert} hold greater potential. To this end, we conduct a multi-dimensional empirical comparison between Local and Meta Experts, and find that models incorporating Meta Experts exhibit lower parameter redundancy, together with lower cross-entropy loss and higher downstream task accuracy. With the activated quantity and the expert granularity held fixed, \textbf{our model matches the performance of Vanilla MoE using only 70--80\% of the experts}, substantially improving the model's scaling potential. Beyond removing inter-layer redundancy among experts and improving information storage efficiency, our theoretical analysis further shows that, compared with Local Experts, Meta Experts provide hidden states with more flexible residual pathways, thereby improving information retrieval efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层间共享的 Meta Expert 架构，替代主流 MoE 中层级独立的 Local Expert，以减少专家参数冗余、提升存储与检索效率。
AI.motivation: 随着模型参数扩张，稀疏激活的 MoE 成为扩展关键；但主流层次化架构中不同层专家虽拓扑独立，内容上却高度相似、冗余严重，存储效率低下。
AI.method: 假设层间共享的 Meta Expert 比层内 Local Expert 更具潜力；通过多维实证对比两类专家，并进行理论分析（分析隐状态残差路径的灵活性）。在激活专家数量与专家粒度固定的设定下进行实验。
AI.result: Meta Expert 模型参数冗余更低，交叉熵损失更低、下游任务准确率更高；在相同激活量和粒度下，仅用 70–80% 的专家即可达到 Vanilla MoE 的性能。理论分析表明 Meta Expert 为隐状态提供更灵活的残差路径，提升信息检索效率。
AI.conclusion: 消除层间专家冗余、提升信息存储效率可显著增强模型的扩展潜力，Meta Expert 是一种更优的 MoE 架构方向。

title: BCT: Bayes-Consistent Tempering for Flow Language Models
summary: Temperature scaling is typically applied as a post-hoc transformation of model probabilities. In posterior-induced flow language models, this creates two mismatches. First, posterior tempering implicitly changes both the endpoint distribution and the distribution of intermediate noisy states, while the denoiser remains trained on the original states. Second, the tempered posterior weights are combined with transport dynamics derived for the untempered flow. These mismatches are reflected empirically: lowering temperature improves GSM8K performance much less reliably in flow LMs than in discrete diffusion LMs. We introduce Bayes-Consistent Tempering (BCT), which makes temperature explicit in both the distributions and dynamics of the generative flow. Its learned realization trains the denoiser on tempered intermediate states and tempers the endpoint distribution using the corresponding tempered dynamics. We also derive training-free variants for conventionally trained checkpoints. Across hyperspherical flow LMs with two denoiser architectures and a von Mises--Fisher flow LM, BCT improves GSM8K generation across broad temperature ranges and achieves the strongest tempering performance. The gains also extend to Sudoku, demonstrating benefits on tightly constrained generation. At very low temperatures, the learned realization is also markedly more robust than the training-free variants, supporting temperature as a property of the generative flow across training and inference rather than a post-hoc probability adjustment. Code and model weights are available at https://daioba.github.io/bct .

AI.tldr: BCT把温度显式纳入生成流的分布与动力学，并训练去噪器在tempered中间状态上，从而修复后验诱导流LM中温度后处理导致的两处不匹配，在GSM8K、数独上取得最强tempering效果且低温更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 温度缩放通常作为事后概率变换。在后验诱导流语言模型中这产生两个不匹配：其一，后验tempering隐式改变端点分布和中间噪声状态分布，而去噪器仍在原始状态上训练；其二，tempered后验权重与为未tempered流推导的传输动力学结合。经验上表现为流LM中降温对GSM8K提升远不如离散扩散LM可靠。
AI.method: 提出Bayes-Consistent Tempering（BCT），在生成流的分布与动力学中都显式引入温度。学习式实现：在tempered中间状态上训练去噪器，并用对应的tempered动力学对端点分布做tempering；另为常规训练checkpoint推导免训练变体。实验覆盖两种去噪器架构的超球面流LM及von Mises–Fisher流LM。
AI.result: 在广泛温度区间内提升GSM8K生成，取得最强tempering性能；收益延伸至数独等强约束生成；极低温度下学习式变体明显比免训练变体更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 温度应被视为贯穿训练与推理的生成流属性，而非事后概率调整。代码与权重见 https://daioba.github.io/bct 。

title: PAR: Progress-Aligned Recurrence for Length Generalization in State Tracking
summary: Looped language models can run more iterations at test time, but additional iterations need not help them solve longer problems. For sequential state tracking, final-answer supervision does not specify how far each iteration should advance, and repeated updates can change the scale of the recurrent state. We introduce \textbf{Progress-Aligned Recurrence (PAR)}, which trains the prediction at iteration $k$ to match the state after the first $k$ operations and rescales recurrent states to their first-iteration norms. On swap-$S_5$, a Qwen2.5-0.5B model trained on at most 32 moves achieves 95.5\% mean full-state accuracy at 512 moves, or $16\times$ the training length, compared with 55.7\% reported for RLT and 0.8\% for explicit chain of thought on the same backbone. Controlled $S_5$ ablations show that removing norm anchoring reduces the extrapolation factor from $16\times$ to below $2.2\times$, and replacing progress-aligned targets with final-answer supervision reduces it to at most $8\times$. A learned completion readout selects when to answer without a supplied stopping depth. When intermediate labels are unavailable, prefix self-distillation induces the correspondence from shorter problem prefixes using only final answers. The gains apply across sequential state-tracking tasks, establishing the task structure required for depth extrapolation. These findings support training intermediate predictions and state scale together to make additional recurrent depth useful for longer problems.

AI.tldr: 提出 Progress-Aligned Recurrence (PAR)，让循环语言模型第 k 次迭代预测对应前 k 步操作后的状态，并将循环状态重标定到首次迭代的范数，从而在远超训练长度的序列上实现深度外推。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型在测试时可多迭代，但额外迭代并不必然帮助解决更长问题：最终答案监督无法指明每次迭代应推进多远，反复更新还会改变循环状态的尺度。
AI.method: 1) 进度对齐目标：第 k 次迭代的预测匹配前 k 步操作后的状态；2) 范数锚定：把循环状态重标定到首迭代范数；3) 学习式完成读出，自主决定何时作答、无需给定停止深度；4) 无中间标签时，用前缀自蒸馏从短前缀+最终答案中诱导出该对应关系。
AI.result: swap-S5 上，仅用 ≤32 步训练的 Qwen2.5-0.5B 在 512 步（16× 训练长度）达 95.5% 全状态平均准确率，对比 RLT 55.7%、显式 CoT 0.8%。消融：去掉范数锚定外推倍数从 16× 降至 <2.2×；用最终答案监督替代进度对齐目标则至多 8×。
AI.conclusion: 中间预测与状态尺度需联合训练，才能让额外循环深度对更长问题真正有用；增益可推广到多种序列状态跟踪任务，并明确了深度外推所需的任务结构。

title: PixelSR: Pixel-Space Orthogonal Flow Decoupling for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
summary: Latent diffusion models have recently achieved remarkable progress in Real-world Image Super-Resolution (Real-SR). However, existing methods consistently exhibit a persistent seesaw effect: enhancing perceptual realism compromises structural fidelity. This effect, we argue, is not intrinsic to diffusion models, but largely stems from the architectural constraints of prevailing two-stage frameworks. To address this challenge, we propose PixelSR, a novel single-stage Pixel Diffusion Transformer for Real-SR that operates directly in pixel space. Specifically, PixelSR consists of two core designs: Pixel-space Conditional Diffusion and Orthogonal Flow Decoupling. The former establishes an effective pixel-space restoration framework by integrating spatially aligned LR conditioning, visual semantic guidance, and lightweight texture refinement, thereby bypassing VAE compression and enabling end-to-end optimization directly in RGB space. Complementarily, the latter decomposes the asymmetric flow target into a low-rank semantic component and a noise-free orthogonal texture component. By routing these components to specialized branches, it achieves decoupled optimization with reduced mutual interference. Benefiting from these designs, our PixelSR restores perceptually realistic details while faithfully preserving structural content. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that PixelSR not only achieves competitive performance, but also effectively mitigates the fidelity--realism seesaw effect.

AI.tldr: PixelSR提出单阶段像素空间扩散Transformer，通过像素级条件扩散与正交流解耦两个设计，直接摆脱VAE压缩，缓解真实图像超分中保真度与感知真实感的跷跷板效应。
AI.motivation: 现有潜空间扩散真实超分方法长期存在跷跷板效应：提升感知真实感会牺牲结构保真度。作者认为这并非扩散模型固有缺陷，而主要源于主流两阶段框架（VAE潜空间+扩散）的架构约束。
AI.method: 提出PixelSR，一个直接在像素空间操作的单阶段像素扩散Transformer，含两个核心设计：1）像素空间条件扩散——融合空间对齐的LR条件、视觉语义引导与轻量纹理精修，绕过VAE压缩实现RGB空间端到端优化；2）正交流解耦——将非对称流目标分解为低秩语义分量与无噪正交纹理分量，分别路由到专门分支，减少相互干扰实现解耦优化。
AI.result: 在多个基准上实验表明，PixelSR达到有竞争力的性能，并有效缓解保真度—真实感跷跷板效应，既能恢复感知真实的细节又忠实保留结构内容。
AI.conclusion: 验证了跷跷板效应可通过架构层面重构（脱离两阶段VAE框架、像素空间单阶段扩散+解耦优化）得到缓解，为Real-SR提供新范式。

title: From Encoding to Generation: Towards Empathetic Large Language Models
summary: Empathetic interaction involves two distinguishable capacities: representing another person's emotional state (cognitive empathy) and generating an appropriate response to that state (affective empathy). We apply this distinction to examine how emotion-related information is internally organized, selectively attended to, and carried through response generation in Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct across 10 emotion categories from the EmpatheticDialogues dataset. Layer-wise linear probing revealed a broad middle-layer region of peak emotion-category decodability, with the layer-11 L2 probe achieving 63.6% held-out accuracy against a 10% chance level and a 54.6% TF-IDF lexical baseline. During response generation, emotion-related user tokens received 1.89 times as much attention per token as other utterance tokens, concentrated across layers 10-15. Target-emotion alignment then decreased from a mean cosine similarity of 0.239 for input representations to 0.125 for generated responses, with positive drift in 77% of examples and the largest shifts for angry and furious. Emotion-category representation, attention allocation, and response-level alignment therefore emerge as distinguishable components of model processing that can be analyzed through a functional cognitive-affective empathy framework. These findings provide a foundation for monitoring emotion representations during generation and leveraging models' existing affective structure to support more naturally empathetic responses without relying on external prompting or explicit emotion conditioning.

AI.tldr: 论文以认知共情（表征他人情绪）与情感共情（生成恰当回应）的区分为框架，用逐层线性探针、注意力分析和对齐度追踪，剖析Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct在10类共情对话情绪上的内部处理流程。
AI.motivation: 共情生成通常被当作单一能力研究，缺少对"情绪表征—注意选择—回应生成"各环节的分离性考察；作者希望借助功能性认知-情感共情框架，厘清情绪信息在模型中如何被组织、选择并传递到回应中。
AI.method: 在EmpatheticDialogues的10个情绪类别上：逐层线性探针解码情绪类别；统计生成过程中情绪相关用户tokens相对其他tokens的注意力量；用目标情绪的余弦相似度衡量输入表征与生成回应之间的对齐度及其漂移方向。
AI.result: 第11层L2探针留出准确率63.6%（随机10%，TF-IDF词法基线54.6%），中层存在较宽的解码峰值区；情绪相关用户tokens每token获得1.89倍注意力，集中于第10–15层；目标情绪对齐度从输入0.239降至回应0.125，77%样本呈正向漂移，angry与furious漂移最大。
AI.conclusion: 情绪类别表征、注意力分配与回应层对齐是模型处理中可区分的组成成分，可由认知-情感共情框架加以分析；这为生成过程中的情绪表征监测，以及在不依赖外部提示或显式情绪条件的情况下利用模型既有情感结构生成更自然共情回应提供了基础。

title: Pairwise Learning Increases Data Efficiency in Deep Neural Networks
summary: Deep neural networks often fail at small-sample regression, collapsing to low-variance predictions that miss individual differences. Here, we introduce a pairwise comparison framework that reframes regression as aggregated relative rankings. This method improves data efficiency across model architectures and dataset sizes. On the UTKFace dataset (23k images), pairwise learning generates over one billion training comparisons without additional supervision. The paired ranking allows a lightweight ResNet10 trained from scratch on home hardware to achieve a 3.64-year MAE-surpassing previous models, including those with large-scale pretraining. For classification into categories, pairwise supervision consistently outperforms an otherwise identical 10-way crossentropy model on STL10 with 500-2000 labeled examples, improving accuracy by up to 5.2%. Overall, pairwise supervision enhances data efficiency and enables strong regression and classification performance when labeled data are limited, particularly in clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 将回归重构为成对相对排序的聚合，显著提升小样本数据效率，在UTKFace上轻量ResNet10取得3.64年MAE，STL10少样本分类最高提升5.2%。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在小样本回归任务中表现不佳，倾向于输出低方差预测，无法捕捉个体差异，因此需要一种提升数据效率的方法。
AI.method: 提出成对比较框架，把回归问题重构为聚合的相对排序；在UTKFace（23k图像）上无需额外监督即可生成超过十亿个训练比较，并训练轻量ResNet10；分类任务则用成对监督对比相同的10路交叉熵模型，在STL10上使用500–2000个标注样本测试。
AI.result: UTKFace上实现3.64年MAE，超越包括大规模预训练在内的先前模型；STL10少样本分类准确率最高提升5.2%；方法跨模型架构与数据集规模均提升数据效率。
AI.conclusion: 成对监督能提升数据效率，在标注数据有限时实现强回归与分类性能，尤其适用于临床等小样本场景。

title: A Two-Way Street: Surveying the Interplay between Code-Mixing and Native Languages in Text and Speech
summary: Systems for code-mixed (CM) text and speech rarely start from scratch. CM data is scarce, so most work borrows from the languages being mixed, which we call native languages. This transfer can also run in reverse, when CM data is used to improve models for the native languages. Existing surveys focus on processing CM itself, and none brings the two directions together. This paper fills that gap with a systematic survey of transfer in both directions, across text and speech. We organise the surveyed work in a taxonomy of transfer direction, route and modality. Through this taxonomy, we find that most transfer runs from native languages into the CM setting. The reverse direction is younger, and in it code-switching mainly helps by aligning the two languages. Text and speech work share methods but rarely cite each other. On a shared speech benchmark, native data helps more than new architectures. These findings point to open challenges, such as how much native and CM data to mix in training, and how to evaluate CM text written in different scripts.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇综述论文，系统梳理了代码混合（CM）文本与语音任务中"迁移学习"的双向流动：从母语迁移到CM，以及从CM反向迁移改善母语模型，并以"迁移方向—迁移路径—模态"的框架组织现有工作。
AI.motivation: CM数据稀缺，模型通常借用被混合的母语数据训练，同时CM数据也可反过来提升母语模型；但现有综述只关注CM处理本身，未将两个迁移方向统一起来，文本与语音两条线也几乎互不引用。
AI.method: 对文本和语音两类模态下的双向迁移工作进行系统性综述，提出按迁移方向（正向/反向）、迁移路径和模态分类的taxonomy，并据此统计与归纳现有研究；同时在共享语音基准上做了对比分析。
AI.result: 多数迁移是母语→CM；反向迁移较新，其主要价值在于对齐两种语言；文本与语音方法相似但互不引用；共享语音基准上，母语数据带来的收益大于新架构带来的收益。
AI.conclusion: 双向迁移应被统一研究。开放挑战包括：训练中母语与CM数据的混合比例，以及如何评估使用不同文字系统的CM文本。

title: Radar-Based 3D Human Pose Estimation via Motion-Aware Pose Initialization and Observation-Guided Refinement
summary: 3D Human Pose Estimation (3D HPE) is used in indoor environments, such as smart homes, to analyze human movement and monitor human states. Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar is suitable for this task because it is robust to lighting variations and does not capture images of human appearance. However, radar observations often provide insufficient information about certain body parts or contain overlapping reflections from multiple body parts, limiting accurate 3D joint localization. To address these limitations, we propose the Initialization-to-Refinement Pose Framework (I2R-Pose), comprising two stages: Motion-Aware Pose Initialization and Observation-Guided Refinement. In the first stage, joint-wise features are learned by incorporating temporal relationships across consecutive radar observations and human skeletal structure to compensate for insufficient joint information and estimate an initial 3D pose sequence. In the second stage, separately extracted radar observation features predict joint-wise positional corrections that refine the initial pose and generate the final pose sequence. The framework supports individual and fused inputs of time-Doppler/time-range (TD/TR) maps and radar point clouds (PCs). To evaluate performance across indoor activities, we construct the Radar Motion and Spatial Information for 3D Human Pose Estimation (RaMoS-Pose) dataset, providing synchronized TD/TR maps, radar PCs, and 3D joint ground truth (GT). Evaluations on RaMoS-Pose and the publicly available MVDoppler-Pose dataset show that I2R-Pose reduces mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 39.50% on MVDoppler-Pose and by 15.13% on RaMoS-Pose with fused inputs, compared with the best-performing existing methods evaluated on each dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出I2R-Pose框架，通过"运动感知姿态初始化+观测引导精化"两阶段方法，利用毫米波雷达实现室内3D人体姿态估计，并构建RaMoS-Pose数据集。
AI.motivation: 毫米波雷达适合室内人体运动分析（对光照鲁棒、不采集外观图像），但其观测常缺少某些身体部位信息或存在多部位反射重叠，限制了3D关节定位精度。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段（运动感知姿态初始化）融合连续雷达观测的时序关系与人体骨骼结构学习逐关节特征，补偿关节信息不足并估计初始3D姿态序列；第二阶段（观测引导精化）用单独提取的雷达观测特征预测逐关节位置修正量，精化初始姿态得到最终序列。支持TD/TR图与雷达点云的单模态及融合输入。同时构建RaMoS-Pose数据集（同步TD/TR图、点云与3D关节真值）。
AI.result: 在MVDoppler-Pose上MPJPE相比最优现有方法降低39.50%，在RaMoS-Pose上（融合输入）降低15.13%。
AI.conclusion: 先初始化后精化的两阶段设计能有效缓解雷达信息不足与反射重叠问题，多模态融合输入进一步提升室内3D人体姿态估计性能。

title: TriGeoBench: A Multimodal Mathematical Geometry Benchmark with Figures and TikZ
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables, including appendices. The first four authors contributed equally
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models show strong vision-language capabilities, yet their geometry-centric reasoning remains insufficiently understood. Existing mathematical benchmarks typically rely on rasterized figures and cover limited geometric knowledge areas and response formats, making it difficult to assess whether models reason over geometric structures or exploit superficial visual patterns. We introduce TriGeoBench, a geometry-centric multimodal benchmark constructed from Chinese middle- and high-school mathematics examinations. TriGeoBench contains 7,000 question-answer pairs and 12,235 geometric figures with TikZ code, spanning plane geometry, solid geometry, analytic geometry, function, and vector geometry across diverse response formats. Each instance forms a {question-answer pair, image, TikZ} triplet: question-answer pairs are stored in LaTeX, images as RGB figures, and TikZ preserves geometric topology, symbolic annotations, and relational structure. We evaluate representative open- and closed-source MLLMs through image-to-TikZ and multimodal reasoning probes. Results reveal persistent fine-grained structure and image-text alignment challenges. Oracle experiments with human-curated reference TikZ suggest that accurate executable representations provide complementary geometric cues; they do not evaluate an end-to-end conversion pipeline. TriGeoBench offers a testbed for structure-aware mathematical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出TriGeoBench，一个源自中国中高考数学题的几何中心多模态基准，含7000问答对与12235张带TikZ代码的几何图，覆盖平面/立体/解析几何、函数与向量及多种作答格式，用以检验MLLM是真正理解几何结构还是依赖表面视觉模式。
AI.motivation: 现有数学基准多用栅格化图形，几何知识覆盖与作答格式有限，难以判断多模态大模型是否基于几何结构推理，还是利用浅层视觉模式。
AI.method: 构建TriGeoBench，每条实例为{问答对, 图像, TikZ}三元组：问答对用LaTeX存储，图像为RGB图形，TikZ保留几何拓扑、符号标注与关系结构。通过图像到TikZ转换与多模态推理探针评估代表性开源与闭源MLLM，并做人工标注参考TikZ的oracle实验（不评估端到端转换流程）。
AI.result: 实验显示模型在细粒度结构和图文对齐上存在持续挑战；oracle实验表明准确可执行的TikZ表示可提供互补的几何线索。
AI.conclusion: TriGeoBench为结构感知的数学推理提供了测试平台，揭示了当前MLLM在几何结构理解上的不足。

title: Neural Operator Splitting for Fluid Dynamics in Complex Geometry
summary: Solving dynamical systems in complex and diverse geometries remains challenging for both numerical solvers and learning-based surrogate models. We propose Neural Operator Splitting, a framework for learning fluid dynamics while preserving the physical structure of fractional-step numerical schemes. Instead of learning the full-step evolution monolithically, we decompose each time step into physically interpretable steps, and learn each operator separately using intermediate states from the underlying numerical solver. Guided by the linearity properties of the fractional steps, we introduce a conditional-linear Fourier neural operator (CL-FNO) whose linear state mappings are modulated by nonlinear conditioning on inputs such as boundary geometry. We further introduce two complementary strategies, symmetry sampling and corrective cycling, to mitigate error accumulation during autoregressive rollout. Experiments on 2D and 3D fluid flows with varying geometries and initial conditions show that our full model reduces mean relative $L^2$ rollout error by 68\% in 2D and 40\% in 3D compared with a single full-step neural operator. At comparable error levels, neural-operator inference is approximately $10^3$ times faster per step than the Monte Carlo solver.
