Fortunately, many functions of practical interest are compositionally sparse, meaning they admit a composition of local functions, each depending on only a few variables, allowing sample complexity to depend on local arity rather than ambient dimension. Yet realizing this benefit requires exploiting hidden compositional structure, which theory does not establish for practical gradient-based training. We study this gap with CSFRBench, a controlled benchmark that hides the target's compositional computation during training but retains it for diagnosis, and find that dense networks and sparsity-based baselines leave much of that benefit unrealized. Inspired by the spatial organization of biological neural circuits, we introduce Learned Wiring (LeWi): each neuron has a learned low-dimensional embedding, only nearby neurons connect, and embeddings and weights are trained jointly. LeWi improves sample efficiency on targets with hierarchical structure, intermediate reuse, or independent modules. Across 32 additional targets generated by independently sampled computation graphs, LeWi is the most sample-efficient method not given the target graph, with 27% lower mean learning-curve area than dense networks. Dense networks perform better on targets with a single high-arity function. LeWi's representations and connectivity align with the target computation. On 17 world-model prediction tasks spanning control, navigation, and manipulation, LeWi beats the dense baseline on 16 and wins 99/119 baseline comparisons. These results show that jointly learning connectivity and weights can exploit computational structure to improve sample efficiency.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Learned Wiring (LeWi)：每个神经元学习低维嵌入，只有邻近神经元相连，嵌入与权重联合训练，从而在梯度训练中利用组合稀疏结构，显著提升样本效率。
AI.motivation: 高维统计学习受维度灾难困扰；许多函数具有组合稀疏性（由少数变量的局部函数复合而成），但需要显式利用隐藏的组合结构，而现有理论并不保证基于梯度的实用训练能获得该收益。
AI.method: 构建 CSFRBench 受控基准：训练时隐藏目标的组合计算，测试时保留用于诊断。提出 LeWi：神经元具有可学习的低维嵌入，仅附近神经元连接，连接与权重联合优化，灵感来自生物神经回路的空间组织。
AI.result: 在具有层次结构、中间复用或独立模块的目标上提升样本效率；在 32 个独立生成计算图的目标上，LeWi 在未给定目标图的方法中最样本高效，学习曲线面积比稠密网络低 27%。稠密网络在单一高元函数目标上更优。LeWi 的表征与连接与目标计算对齐。在 17 个世界模型预测任务上，LeWi 在 16 个上优于稠密基线，赢得 119 次比较中的 99 次。
AI.conclusion: 联合学习连接与权重可有效利用计算结构以提升样本效率；LeWi 为实用梯度训练中获取组合稀疏收益提供了可行路径。

title: StreamEval: Evaluating Interactive Streaming Video Generation Models
summary: As streaming video generation advances, enabling real-time interaction with generated video is becoming increasingly important. We introduce StreamEval, a unified benchmark for interactive streaming video generation spanning five tasks: avatar dialogue, avatar performance, world generation, instruction editing, and reference editing. StreamEval comprises 300 scripted test cases lasting 15-300s, each specifying initial assets, incrementally arriving multimodal requests, and explicit requirements for state changes and content preservation. Performance is assessed along four evaluation dimensions: task execution, state consistency, visual fidelity, and audiovisual coordination, instantiated through ten task-specific metrics on a 0-100 scale. Evaluating 37 distinct models across 300 test cases, we find that high visual quality and identity retention do not necessarily coincide with reliable request execution or sustained state consistency. In particular, request execution remains challenging: the highest task-specific scores are 36.90 for Following among seven avatar-performance models, 25.93 for Following in text-conditioned world generation, and 15.00 for Edit Success among three reported reference-editing models. These findings identify reliable request execution under timing and preservation constraints as a central challenge for advancing omni-modal real-time interactive systems. The leaderboard is available at https://streameval.ai

AI.tldr: 提出 StreamEval，一个覆盖五类任务的交互式流式视频生成统一基准，含300个15-300秒脚本化测试用例与四维度十指标评测体系；评测37个模型发现高视觉质量与可靠请求执行并不一致，请求执行仍是核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 流式视频生成进步使"实时交互式生成视频"日益重要，但缺乏统一评测手段来衡量模型在增量多模态请求、时序与内容保持约束下的实际表现。
AI.method: 构建 StreamEval 基准：覆盖人像对话、人像表演、世界生成、指令编辑、参考编辑五类任务；300个15-300秒脚本化用例，每个用例规定初始素材、逐步到达的多模态请求、以及状态变化与内容保持的明确要求；按任务执行、状态一致性、视觉保真度、音视频协同四个维度、十项任务特定指标（0-100分）评测37个模型。
AI.result: 高视觉质量与身份保持并不必然伴随可靠的请求执行或持续状态一致性。请求执行尤其困难：七个人像表演模型中 Following 最高仅36.90；文本条件世界生成 Following 最高25.93；三个参考编辑模型 Edit Success 最高15.00。
AI.conclusion: 在时序与内容保持约束下实现可靠请求执行，是推进全模态实时交互系统发展的核心挑战；排行榜见 streameval.ai。

title: OptScientist: Automated Discovery of Optimization Laws
summary: Many scientific phenomena are best understood as outcomes of underlying optimization problems, yet automated scientific discovery has largely focused on recovering equations that describe observed input-output patterns. We introduce OptScientist, a novel automated framework for discovering compact symbolic optimization laws directly from data. OptScientist comprises (i) a model that infers symbolic optimization problems by first learning to represent data as an optimization problem and then extracting its symbolic form, and (ii) an LLM agentic system embedding the model in a discovery process that integrates theoretical priors from scientific literature, discovers candidate laws, abstracts their underlying mechanisms, and suggests new data to collect. We first evaluate OptScientist on OptFeynman, a novel benchmark of 99 physics-derived optimization problems, where OptScientist recovers ground-truth laws for over 80% of the problems and remains robust to noisy contextual information, while substantially outperforming machine-learning, symbolic, and LLM-based model-discovery baselines. On human risky choice and central-bank monetary policy, OptScientist discovers compact symbolic optimization laws that achieve held-out predictive performance competitive with leading baselines, while using few parameters and substantially fewer tokens than LLM baselines. Overall, OptScientist extends automated scientific discovery to uncovering optimization laws that generate observed phenomena, enabling automated theory building across the physical, biological, behavioral, and social sciences.

AI.tldr: OptScientist：从数据中直接发现紧凑的符号化优化定律（而非仅拟合输入-输出方程），在自建 OptFeynman 基准上恢复超 80% 的物理衍生优化问题真值定律，并在人类风险选择与央行货币政策任务上以少参数、省 token 的方式取得有竞争力的预测表现。
AI.motivation: 许多科学现象本质上是某个潜在优化问题的结果，但自动化科学发现目前主要关注恢复描述观测输入-输出模式的方程，忽略了"生成观测现象背后的优化定律"这一更具解释力的目标。
AI.method: 框架包含两部分：(i) 一个模型，先把数据表示为优化问题再抽取其符号形式，从而推断符号优化问题；(ii) 一个 LLM 智能体系统，将模型嵌入发现流程，融合科学文献中的理论先验、发现候选定律、抽象其内在机制并建议新采集的数据。作者还构建了 OptFeynman 基准（99 个源自物理的优化问题）。
AI.result: 在 OptFeynman 上对超过 80% 的问题恢复出真值定律，对噪声上下文信息稳健，显著优于机器学习、符号回归与基于 LLM 的模型发现基线；在人类风险选择与央行货币政策数据上发现紧凑符号优化定律，留出集预测性能与领先基线相当，但参数极少、token 消耗远低于 LLM 基线。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将自动化科学发现从"拟合观测方程"拓展到"揭示生成现象的优化定律"，支持物理、生物、行为与社会科学中的自动化理论构建。

title: When Do LLMs Help with Feature Selection? A Systematic Empirical Study
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can leverage semantic feature names alongside summary statistics for tabular feature selection, yet it remains unclear when such information improves subset selection relative to established statistical methods. We investigate this question within an 18-dataset framework comprising 10 datasets for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) training, 2 for checkpoint validation, and 6 held-out evaluation datasets. We compare five classical baselines, frozen Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.3-70B selectors, and two GRPO-adapted Qwen2.5-7B models, reporting classification ROC-AUC and regression R^2 separately and using dataset-wise ranks for cross-task comparison. Across five seeded evaluation partitions, classical selectors generally achieve higher predictive performance than the tested 7B LLM/RL selectors, including under a pre-specified ~33% feature budget with strict train-only classical fitting, while the 7B selectors retain compact subsets. A cardinality-matched semantic sensitivity experiment shows that, for Zero-shot Qwen-7B, informative feature names improve regression performance over anonymized and shuffled alternatives (+0.1964 and +0.1606 mean R^2), whereas aggregate classification differences are smaller (+0.0159 and +0.0084 ROC-AUC) and dataset-dependent. These results characterize when semantic information benefits LLM-based feature selection and show that classical selectors remain strong baselines for predictive tabular feature selection.

AI.tldr: 研究系统比较经典统计特征选择与LLM/RL选择器在表格特征选择上的表现，并分析语义特征名何时有用。
AI.motivation: LLM可结合语义特征名与摘要统计做表格特征选择，但这种语义信息相对于成熟统计方法何时带来收益尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建18数据集框架（10个用于GRPO训练、2个用于checkpoint验证、6个留出评估）；对比5个经典基线、冻结的Qwen2.5-7B与Llama-3.3-70B选择器、两个GRPO适配的Qwen2.5-7B模型；分别报告分类ROC-AUC与回归R²，并用数据组内排名做跨任务比较；五个种子评估划分；在~33%特征预算、仅训练集严格拟合条件下评估；另做基数匹配的语义敏感性实验（信息性特征名 vs 匿名/打乱）。
AI.result: 经典选择器普遍获得更高的预测性能，优于所测试的7B LLM/RL选择器，而7B选择器子集更紧凑。Zero-shot Qwen-7B下，信息性特征名相比匿名与打乱使回归R²提升+0.1964与+0.1606，分类提升较小（+0.0159、+0.0084 ROC-AUC）且依赖数据集。
AI.conclusion: 界定了语义信息对LLM特征选择有益的条件，并表明经典选择器仍是预测性表格特征选择的强基线。

title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Machine Learning with Evidence-based Planning for Medical Image Analysis
summary: Deep learning has become the default tool for medical image analysis, driven by the open-source movement. However, achieving the best performance on a given task remains difficult, with architecture selection and hyperparameter optimization (HPO) still considered "more of an art than a science". Automated machine learning (AutoML) automates parts of model training, yet helps little in medical imaging: general-purpose approaches lack medical architectures and preprocessing, and medical-focused ones demand engineering expertise and remain confined to narrow tasks such as 3D segmentation. We introduce MedicalMLOmni, a multi-agent AutoML framework that automates model training for diverse single- and multi-modal medical tasks through a natural language interface. Specifically, MedicalMLOmni performs evidence-based planning by retrieving published results to guide model selection and configuration, and employs parallel HPO where multiple agents explore adjustment strategies concurrently. MedicalMLOmni achieves the best score on 19 of 20 benchmarks; PMC-VQA is the exception, where a vision-language model with broader pre-training leads. Backbone-matched controls attribute the gains to the framework, not the backbone. By removing coding requirements, MedicalMLOmni lowers the barrier for domain experts with rich datasets but limited engineering expertise.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体AutoML框架MedicalMLOmni，通过自然语言接口自动化多样单/多模态医学影像任务的建模流程，在20个基准中19个取得最优成绩。
AI.motivation: 医学影像深度学习虽有开源生态支持，但架构选择与超参优化仍像"艺术而非科学"；通用AutoML缺乏医学专用架构与预处理，医学专用方案又依赖工程能力且局限于3D分割等狭窄任务。
AI.method: 多智能体AutoML框架：自然语言交互界面；基于证据的规划（检索已发表结果指导模型选择与配置）；并行HPO，多个智能体同时探索不同调参策略；覆盖单模态与多模态多种医学任务。
AI.result: 20个基准中19个取得最佳分数，唯一例外PMC-VQA由预训练更广泛的视觉语言模型领先；主干网络匹配的对照实验证明增益来自框架而非骨干网络本身。
AI.conclusion: MedicalMLOmni消除编程门槛，降低拥有丰富数据但工程能力有限领域专家的使用壁垒，将AutoML真正适配医学影像多任务场景。

title: Convergence of stochastic gradient descent for learning linear neural networks
summary: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is the cornerstone of modern deep learning, yet its theoretical convergence properties remain poorly understood in non-convex settings. To address this gap, we study SGD dynamics in deep linear neural networks - simplified models that retain key non-convex characteristics while remaining analytically tractable. Building on recent results for gradient descent, we extend convergence guarantees to SGD under regularized squared loss. We establish almost sure boundedness of SGD iterates. Using the framework of asymptotic pseudotrajectories from stochastic approximation theory, our analysis establishes then, for both deterministic and adaptive step-size choices, convergence of SGD to the set of critical points under mild conditions (without relying on Lipschitz properties or whitened data). To our knowledge, this is the first work providing almost sure convergence guarantees for SGD in deep linear networks, bridging the gap between theoretical optimization and practical stochastic training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究深度线性网络在正则化平方损失下SGD的收敛性，证明迭代有界并几乎必然收敛到临界点集合。
AI.motivation: SGD是深度学习基石，但其在非凸场景下的理论收敛性质仍不清楚；深度线性网络保留非凸特性又可解析处理，近期GD结果尚需推广到SGD。
AI.method: 以深度线性神经网络为模型、正则化平方损失为目标，先用随机逼近理论中的渐近伪轨迹框架证明迭代几乎必然有界，再分别对确定性和自适应步长证明收敛到临界点集合，不依赖Lipschitz性质或白化数据。
AI.result: 建立了SGD迭代的几乎必然有界性；在温和条件下，确定性与自适应步长均几乎必然收敛到临界点集合。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个给出深度线性网络SGD几乎必然收敛保证的工作，弥合了理论优化与实际随机训练之间的差距。

title: Brain2Vec: A Self-Supervised 3D Foundation Model for Structural Brain MRI
summary: Deep learning models have become essential tools in medical imaging, yet training them end-to-end for diverse tasks remains challenging due to limited labeled data and computational constraints. To address this, we introduce Brain2Vec, a foundation model pre-trained on 74,425 T1-weighted Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans pooled from multiple studies. Brain2Vec can serve both as a weight initialization backbone for fine-tuning downstream tasks and as a standalone feature extractor. We evaluated Brain2Vec in three tasks: downstream predictive performance, convergence speed, and embedding quality. Using Brain2Vec's pretrained weights as initialization and fine-tuning on labeled data for a brain age prediction task, results demonstrate improved final accuracy and faster convergence compared to random initialization. Additionally, its frozen embeddings outperform anatomically defined volumetric features on four of five downstream classification tasks and perform competitively with a state-of-the-art foundation model pre-trained on substantially more data. Lastly, we show that Brain2Vec encodes information primarily from a spatially localized and neuroanatomically meaningful set of brain regions, and that manipulating a subset of latent features produces monotonic, region-specific effects on the reconstructed anatomy. Brain2Vec code and trained models are available as an open-source package on https://github.com/CBICA/Brain2Vec. Users can apply Brain2Vec locally by installing the package, or directly through the NiChart cloud platform https://cloud.neuroimagingchart.com, where Brain2Vec features can be derived without requiring local installation or specialized infrastructure.

AI.tldr: Brain2Vec：基于74,425例T1 MRI预训练的脑影像基础模型，可作微调骨干或特征提取器，在年龄预测与分类任务中优于随机初始化与体积特征，并具备可解释的局部化表征，已开源并提供云端服务。
AI.motivation: 医学影像深度学习受限于标注数据稀缺与算力约束，端到端训练多样任务困难；需要可复用、可迁移的预训练基础模型来降低下游任务成本。
AI.method: 在多个研究汇总的74,425例T1加权MRI上预训练Brain2Vec基础模型；支持两种使用方式：作为权重初始化骨干进行下游微调，或冻结后作为独立特征提取器；在三方面评估：下游预测性能、收敛速度、嵌入质量（与解剖学体积特征和更大数据预训练的SOTA基础模型对比），并通过隐特征操控与重建分析表征的空间定位与神经解剖意义。
AI.result: 脑龄预测中，预训练初始化相比随机初始化取得更高最终精度与更快收敛；冻结嵌入在5个下游分类任务中的4个上优于解剖学体积特征，并与数据量更大的SOTA基础模型表现相当；模型主要编码空间局部化且具神经解剖意义的脑区信息，操控部分隐特征可对重建解剖产生单调、区域特异的影响。
AI.conclusion: Brain2Vec验证了大规模MRI预训练基础模型在医学影像中的有效性、效率与可解释性；代码与模型开源，并可通过NiChart云平台免本地部署直接提取特征，便于推广使用。

title: Sage-A1.5: From Long-Horizon Execution to Scientific Exploration with Capability Composition
summary: In this report, we introduce Sage-A1.5, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model that builds on A1 to advance long-horizon problem solving through adaptive capability composition. Compared with A1, Sage-A1.5 learns not only to solve individual tasks, but also to organize work and revise its approach during execution. Sage-A1.5 highlights three improvements: agentic orchestration, verification, and open scientific discovery. First, agentic orchestration extends single-agent execution through task delegation and parallel collaboration among subagents with isolated contexts, enabling complex tasks to be decomposed and addressed concurrently and supporting efficient execution while reducing interference across concurrent subagents. Second, agentic verification strengthens long-horizon reliability through progress checking, evidence validation, and reflective strategy revision, allowing the agent to recognize unproductive search paths and pursue alternative approaches. Third, open scientific discovery extends agentic capabilities beyond answering predefined questions to conducting exploratory research, connecting scientific inquiry with interactive analysis and inspectable research artifacts. We showcase these capabilities through complicated agentic tasks and multidisciplinary scientific applications. Besides, we hope Sage-A1.5 provides the community with an accessible foundation for open scientific discovery, offering a practical path from long-horizon task execution to collaborative, verifiable, and inspectable scientific exploration.

AI.tldr: Sage-A1.5 是一个 35B 的 MoE 智能体模型，在 A1 基础上通过"自适应能力组合"提升长程问题求解，核心是智能体编排、验证与开放式科学发现三项改进。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体模型多聚焦于单个任务的求解，缺乏在执行过程中组织工作、调整策略的能力；长程任务中并发子体相互干扰、搜索路径低效，且能力局限于回答预设问题，难以支撑探索性科学研究。
AI.method: 采用 35B Mixture-of-Experts 架构并在 A1 基础上迭代；引入三项机制：(1) 智能体编排——通过任务委派与上下文隔离的子智能体并行协作，实现任务分解与并发处理；(2) 智能体验证——通过进度检查、证据校验与反思式策略修正提升长程可靠性；(3) 开放式科学发现——将能力从预设问答扩展到探索性研究，配合交互分析与可检查的研究产物。
AI.result: 在复杂智能体任务与多学科科学应用中展示了上述三方面能力，证明模型可完成长程任务执行、识别低效路径并切换策略，并产出可检查的研究产物。
AI.conclusion: Sage-A1.5 旨在为社区提供一个可及的开放式科学发现基座，打通从长程任务执行到协作式、可验证、可检查的科学探索的实践路径。

title: Asymmetric Bidirectional Predictive Dynamics in Google Search and COVID-19 Time Series: A Multi-Horizon Forecast-Error Analysis
summary: Online search activity is widely used as a digital trace of information seeking during epidemics, but its predictive value is often reduced to correlation, a selected lag, or a single forecast-error score. We examine eight pre-specified Google Trends-COVID-19 pairs in both directions using matched LightGBM forecasts over rolling 400-day windows and horizons of 1-14 days. Log-RMSE gain is combined with forecast-error distribution entropy (FEDE), which captures horizon-dependent changes in the signed error distribution. The resulting directional predictive signature comprises response class, RMSE effect, FEDE endpoint and early-slope responses, persistence across rolling regimes, and horizon profile. For screening candidate directions, we also introduce a relative persistence-weighted directional predictive response strength (DPRS) on a within-study 0-100 scale; 100 denotes the strongest observed response in the comparison set, not an absolute coupling maximum. The pairs show concordant, RMSE-only, FEDE-only, and mixed responses. "loss of smell" -> reported cases is accuracy-dominant, with mean log-RMSE gain 0.104 (about 9.9% equivalent RMSE reduction) and DPRS 100, whereas the reverse direction is FEDE-dominant (D_FEDE=0.048; DPRS=42). "covid test" -> positive rate is FEDE-dominant (D_FEDE=0.039; positive in 72% of windows; DPRS=98) despite negative RMSE gain, while "lockdown" -> stringency is the clearest concordant case (DPRS=78). World-level symptom/case pairs are less persistent. Thus, forecast accuracy and error-distribution dynamics are complementary, predictive effects can be direction- and metric-dependent, and forecast horizon is part of the relationship. Aggregated regime-level patterns should not be extrapolated to individual time points or interpreted as evidence of causality.

AI.tldr: 该文在8对Google Trends与COVID-19指标的双向关系上，用滚动400天窗口、1–14天预测期的LightGBM匹配预测，结合log-RMSE增益与预测误差分布熵(FEDE)构建"方向性预测特征"，并提出相对持续性加权指标DPRS用于方向筛选。
AI.motivation: 网络搜索数据常被当作疫情信息寻求的数字痕迹，但其预测价值通常被简化为相关性、单一滞后或单一预测误差分数，忽略了方向性、误差分布动态以及预测期的影响。
AI.method: 对8组预先设定的Google Trends–COVID-19配对做双向分析；采用滚动400天窗口、1–14天预测期的匹配LightGBM预测；以log-RMSE增益和预测误差分布熵(FEDE)刻画随预测期变化的带符号误差分布；据此构建包含响应类别、RMSE效应、FEDE端点与早段斜率、跨滚动区制持续性、预测期轮廓的方向性预测特征，并提出0–100相对持续性加权方向性预测响应强度(DPRS)。
AI.result: 配对呈现一致型、仅RMSE型、仅FEDE型与混合型响应。"loss of smell"→报告病例为精度主导（平均log-RMSE增益0.104，约等价9.9% RMSE下降，DPRS=100），反向为FEDE主导（D_FEDE=0.048，DPRS=42）；"covid test"→阳性率为FEDE主导（D_FEDE=0.039，72%窗口为正，DPRS=98）但RMSE增益为负；"lockdown"→严格度为最清晰的一致型案例（DPRS=78）；世界级症状/病例配对持续性较低。
AI.conclusion: 预测精度与误差分布动态具有互补性，预测效应依赖方向与指标，预测期本身也是关系的一部分；区制层面的聚合模式不应外推到单个时间点，也不能作为因果证据。

title: Code2Video-Compass: A Comprehensive Benchmark for General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation across T2V, I2V, and V2V
summary: Code-based video generation offers fine-grained control, targeted editing, and component reuse compared with direct video generation. This approach requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to translate visual and temporal requirements into executable programs that produce complete videos. However, existing code-based benchmarks primarily target specialized tasks, leaving complete video creation across diverse creative categories and input modalities insufficiently evaluated. We introduce Code2Video-Compass, a general-purpose benchmark for code-based video generation across text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and video-to-video (V2V) settings. Code2Video-Compass comprises 2,104 tasks spanning 10 categories, 24 subtypes, and three complexity dimensions covering construction, dynamic animation, and state dependency. It combines tasks curated from textual instructions and visual references with corresponding T2V, I2V, and V2V tasks derived from complete professional and user-created videos. We propose a dual-level evaluation framework combining 12 objective metrics and five subjective metrics. Objective evaluation covers operational performance, video quality, text-video alignment, and reference fidelity, while subjective evaluation uses an MLLM judge to evaluate instruction following and holistic video quality. Extensive evaluation of 15 recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs from nine families reveals that even leading models face challenges in reliably generating high-quality complete videos aligned with textual and visual requirements, with performance generally declining as construction, dynamic animation, and state-dependency complexity increases. We anticipate that Code2Video-Compass will advance reliable, coherent, and controllable code-based video generation and inspire broader progress in programmatic visual creation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Code2Video-Compass，一个面向代码化视频生成的通用基准，覆盖T2V/I2V/V2V三种设定，含2,104个任务、10大类24子类及三个复杂度维度，并提出12项客观+5项主观的双层评测框架，评测9个家族15个MLLM。
AI.motivation: 代码化视频生成相比直接生成具备细粒度控制、定向编辑和组件复用优势，但需MLLM将视觉与时序需求转译为可执行程序生成完整视频。现有代码化基准多面向专门任务，缺乏跨多创作类别与多输入模态的完整视频创建评测。
AI.method: 构建Code2Video-Compass基准：2,104个任务，涵盖10类、24子类，以及构造、动态动画、状态依赖三个复杂度维度；任务既含文本指令与视觉参考策划的任务，也含由专业及用户创作视频衍生的T2V/I2V/V2V任务。设计双层评测框架：12项客观指标（操作性能、视频质量、文本-视频对齐、参考保真度）与5项主观指标（MLLM裁判评估指令遵循与整体视频质量）。
AI.result: 评测9个家族15个近期闭源与开源MLLM，发现即便领先模型也难以稳定生成符合文本与视觉需求的高质量完整视频，且性能随构造、动态动画、状态依赖复杂度提升而普遍下降。
AI.conclusion: Code2Video-Compass有望推动可靠、连贯、可控的代码化视频生成研究，并促进程序化视觉创作的更广泛进展。

title: Beyond the Sequentiality Bottleneck: A Hybrid Diffusion-Autoregressive Framework for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Autoregressive models (ARMs) face a "Sequentiality Bottleneck" in reasoning, while diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallelism but lack semantic coherence. To addresses both limitations, we propose Collaborative Reasoning Asymmetric Learning (CoRAL), a hybrid framework via an Asymmetric Planner-Executor (APE) architecture: a DLM Planner generates K diverse reasoning trajectories in parallel, while a large ARM Executor selects the optimal plan and synthesizes the final answer. To train the Planner effectively, we introduce Reward-Guided Denoising for CoT (RDC), which integrates outcome-based rewards into the diffusion process to steer it toward goal-directed reasoning. Experiments on vision-language benchmarks show that CoRAL significantly outperforms prior diffusion-based methods and achieves competitive performance against strong ARMs, achieving both superior efficiency and quality.

AI.tldr: CoRAL提出非对称规划器-执行器架构：扩散语言模型并行生成K条推理轨迹，再由大规模自回归模型选择最优规划并综合答案，并以结果奖励引导去噪训练规划器。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型存在"顺序性瓶颈"（逐token生成导致推理慢），而扩散语言模型虽可并行但缺乏语义连贯性，需兼顾效率与质量的混合方案。
AI.method: 提出CoRAL混合框架，采用非对称规划器-执行器（APE）：DLM规划器并行产出K条多样化推理轨迹，大型ARM执行器筛选最佳规划并生成最终答案；同时设计奖励引导的去噪（RDC），将基于结果的奖励融入扩散过程，引导其朝目标导向推理。
AI.result: 在视觉-语言基准上显著优于既有扩散类方法，并与强自回归模型相当，同时在效率与质量上均有优势。
AI.conclusion: 将扩散模型用于并行规划、自回归模型用于执行与综合，是缓解顺序性瓶颈且保持语义连贯的有效途径。

title: The Dynamics of Collapse and Recovery in Clustered Federated Learning
summary: Clustered federated learning (CFL) can suffer from cluster collapse. In particular, under unfavorable initialization, early client assignments concentrate heterogeneous groups on one cluster model, which is then trained toward a pooled compromise, while another model receives no updates. Since the current models determine client routing and routing determines subsequent model updates, we formulate clustered federated learning as control of an unknown dynamical system, with cluster models as the evolving state, client routing patterns as the control input, and routing interventions as state dependent controllers. In a two group linear model, we identify an initialization region in which greedy routing makes collapse self reinforcing. We then derive finite horizon error dynamics showing how routing interventions can reverse collapse by repeatedly training the starved model, primarily with updates from its compatible group. Motivated by this condition, each client uses blocked EXP3 to choose between greedy routing and interventions that redirect updates toward unused models. Experiments show that with simpler predictors and faster specialist formation, autonomous controller selection recovers usable specialists from unfavorable starts that trap standard CFL baselines. In transformed FEMNIST, the synchronized-entry configuration with persistent commitment recovers usable specialists in settings where the autonomous controller configuration often does not. Code and scripts for reproducing the experiments and figures are available at https://github.com/prsinha1/FedRecover.

AI.tldr: 该文将聚类联邦学习(CFL)中的"聚类坍缩"问题建模为对未知动力系统的控制问题，提出用阻截式EXP3让客户端自主选择"贪心路由"或"干预路由"以恢复专用模型。
AI.motivation: CFL在不利初始化下会发生聚类坍缩：早期客户端分配把异质组集中到同一模型，使其训练成折中解，另一模型得不到更新；由于模型决定路由、路由又决定后续更新，形成自强化坍缩，需要从控制视角加以纠正。
AI.method: 把CFL视为未知动力系统控制问题（聚类模型为状态、路由模式为控制输入、路由干预为状态相关控制器）；在两群体线性模型中刻画使贪心路由自强化坍缩的初始化区域，并推导有限时域误差动态说明干预可通过反复用其匹配群体训练"饥饿"模型来逆转坍缩；据此设计每个客户端用blocked EXP3在贪心路由与将更新重定向至未使用模型的干预之间选择。
AI.result: 实验显示，自主控制器选择配合更简单预测器和更快专家形成，能从标准CFL基线陷入的劣势初始点恢复可用的专用模型；在变换后的FEMNIST上，带持续承诺的同步进入配置可恢复专用模型，而自主控制器配置常无法做到。
AI.conclusion: 将聚类坍缩视为可控的动力学过程为修复CFL提供了原理性依据，路由干预配合EXP3式在线选择能有效缓解坍缩，但"同步进入+持续承诺"机制在某些设置下优于纯自主控制。

title: DISTRACT: Degradation-Indexed Study of Textual Reference Across Competing Targets
summary: Vision-language trackers (VLTs) accept descriptions intended to assist tracking, but accepting text does not establish that its content changes tracking decisions, particularly as visual evidence deteriorates. We introduce DISTRACT, a matched-intervention benchmark that holds video, target, and distractor fixed while crossing four text priors with four image degradations along a controlled severity axis. We evaluate five VLTs on four datasets using behavioral contrasts, layerwise representation probes, and activation patching. Molmo2 and JointNLT exhibit directed text use. Some effects contract under degradation, whereas others show no significant endpoint change after multiplicity correction. UVLTrack, MMTrack, and DUTrack respond only weakly to changes in text semantics, with no directed behavioral effect surviving FDR correction in the tested settings. Model-internal analyses reveal that at decision-near states, correct-versus-conflicting text is decodable in Molmo2 and JointNLT but not in the other three systems. In the responsive models, decodability peaks at late states where replacement produces little behavioral change, whereas replacing selected earlier states redirects conflict-associated trajectories toward the target. Because matched-correct donors do not significantly outperform unrelated donors, these interventions identify earlier intervention-sensitive states without establishing target-specific semantic rescue. DISTRACT thus exposes when and where text affects tracking under degraded visual evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DISTRACT 基准，用"匹配干预"固定视频、目标与干扰物，交叉四种文本先验与四种图像退化，检验视觉-语言跟踪器（VLT）是否真正使用文本语义。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLT 虽接受文本描述，但"接受文本"不等于"文本内容改变跟踪决策"，尤其在视觉证据退化时，文本是否被真正利用尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建匹配干预基准：交叉 4 种文本先验 × 4 种图像退化（受控严重度轴），在 5 个 VLT、4 个数据集上使用行为对比、逐层表征探针与激活修补（activation patching）分析。
AI.result: Molmo2 与 JointNLT 表现出有方向的文本利用，部分效应在退化下收缩，部分经多重校正后端点无显著变化；UVLTrack、MMTrack、DUTrack 对文本语义仅弱响应，FDR 校正后无有向行为效应。决策邻域状态中，正确 vs. 冲突文本仅在前两者可解码。可解码峰值出现在替换几乎不改变行为的晚期状态，而替换较早的选定状态可将冲突轨迹引回目标；但匹配正确文本供体并不显著优于无关供体。
AI.conclusion: DISTRACT 揭示了文本在视觉证据退化时于何时、何处影响跟踪，并表明干预定位到的是早期"干预敏感"状态，而非目标特定的语义救援。

title: What Do RTL Repair Benchmarks Actually Measure?
summary: RTL repair benchmarks should measure whether a model can fix broken RTL given a specification. To this end, we construct and hash-bind RTLRepairDataset, 5,784 (broken, fixed) training pairs; RTLRepairBench, 459 held-out cases with 374 syntactic and 85 behavioral mutations; and an evaluation harness supporting simulation and formal equivalence. We then use this infrastructure to identify two measurement confounds. First, simulation and formal scoring give opposite signs for the apparent effect of providing a specification in one evaluated cohort; reset-aware rescoring attributes almost all of the simulation-formal disagreement to reset and first-cycle comparison semantics. Second, on 274 mined model failures, the specification-only minus specification-conditioned recovery point estimate ranges from -8.5 to +18.3 percentage points across six models. Thus, a conventional repair score need not isolate whether the model used the faulty RTL. We translate these findings into evaluation controls: report initialization, reset, first-cycle, and unknown-value semantics; disclose oracle coverage and undecided cases; and include a specification-only baseline. Together, the resources and audit provide both a benchmark for behavioral repair and a protocol for diagnosing what contributes to its measured score. We release the benchmark, the training set, construction code, sanitized aggregate evidence, and reproduction materials at https://github.com/Evaaaz/RTLRepairBench.

AI.tldr: 论文构建RTL修复基准（数据集、测试集与评估框架），并审计出两类测量混淆，提出评估控制协议。
AI.motivation: RTL修复基准应衡量模型能否在给定规格下修复损坏的RTL，但现有评分可能无法区分模型是否真正使用了故障RTL或规格，存在测量效度问题。
AI.method: 构建并哈希绑定RTLRepairDataset（5,784个(损坏,修复)训练对）、RTLRepairBench（459个留出案例，含374个语法变异与85个行为变异）及支持仿真与形式等价的评估框架；用该设施识别两类混淆：仿真与形式评分给出相反符号、重置感知重打分；在274个挖掘的模型失败上跨六个模型比较"仅规格"与"规格条件"的恢复点估计；据此制定评估控制。
AI.result: 仿真-形式分歧几乎全部归因于重置和首周期比较语义；"仅规格减规格条件"的恢复点估计跨六模型为-8.5至+18.3个百分点，说明常规修复分数未必能隔离模型是否使用故障RTL。
AI.conclusion: 提出评估控制建议：报告初始化、重置、首周期与未知值语义；披露oracle覆盖率与未决案例；纳入仅规格基线。资源与审计共同提供行为修复基准及诊断评分来源的协议，并已开源。

title: The Token-Energy Law of LLM Decode: Active Bytes and Realized Time Account for Joules per Token
summary: Energy-efficient deployment of large language models requires understanding how model architecture, hardware, and serving settings shape energy per generated token. We introduce the Token-Energy Law, a compact, interpretable model of GPU-board energy per output token for dense, full-history decoding. It relates token energy to two core dimensions: active bytes and realized decode time. Active bytes describe logical byte demand per output, separating dense weights shared within a decode iteration from private key--value (KV) histories read and updated for each request. Realized decode time is the elapsed decode duration divided by the number of output tokens produced. We combine the two byte coordinates and time in a common affine form, with coefficients calibrated for each model and hardware/runtime configuration. This formulation explains how batching amortizes shared-weight work, longer attended histories increase private KV demand, and throughput determines the time-associated cost per output. Our experiments cover three models under BF16 decoding on NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPUs, including two-GPU tensor parallelism on Hopper. Using fixed coefficients and observed decode time, held-out condition-mean energy estimates differ from measurements by at most 3.73%.

AI.tldr: 提出 Token-Energy Law：用"活跃字节"与"实际解码时间"两个维度，以仿射形式建模稠密全历史解码下每输出 token 的 GPU 板级能耗，在 Hopper/Blackwell 上预测误差 ≤3.73%。
AI.motivation: 大模型能效部署需要理解模型架构、硬件与服务配置如何共同决定每生成 token 的能耗，现有工作缺乏简洁、可解释的预测模型。
AI.method: 构建紧凑可解释模型：活跃字节区分每次解码迭代共享的稠密权重与每请求私有读写的 KV 历史；用实际解码时间(总解码时长/输出 token 数)刻画时间成本；两者以共同仿射形式结合，系数按模型与硬件/运行时配置校准。
AI.result: 实验覆盖 BF16 解码下三个模型、NVIDIA Hopper 与 Blackwell GPU，含 Hopper 双卡张量并行；在固定系数与实测解码时间下，留出条件平均能耗估计与实测偏差最大 3.73%。
AI.conclusion: 该定律可解释批处理对共享权重开销的摊薄、长历史导致的私有 KV 需求上升、以及吞吐决定的时间相关成本，可作为能耗预测与部署调优的实用工具。

title: WorldSR: Harnessing World Knowledge Search for Grounded Image Super-Resolution
summary: Generative-prior-based super-resolution (SR) methods leverage implicit knowledge learned from large-scale models to enhance low-resolution inputs. However, such priors are inherently stochastic and optimized for diverse generation, conflicting with the deterministic, high-fidelity reconstruction required for SR. It is also tied to the base model, costly to update, and prone to hallucinations as real-world data evolves. To address these limitations, we introduce WorldSR, a novel framework that augments SR with explicit, entity-aligned visual world knowledge. WorldSR automatically decomposes the input into semantic entities and performs entity-wise retrieval of structurally and semantically aligned images from a large-scale external corpus. For efficiency and reliability, we incorporate a memory mechanism to reuse previously retrieved results and a multi-step filtering process to refine candidate references. The selected references as world knowledge are then integrated through a novel multi-reference super-resolution model, which provides fine-grained constraints for detail synthesis and structural recovery. Experiments on real-world SR benchmarks show that WorldSR consistently improves structural fidelity and visual quality, outperforming existing generative super-resolution methods. Our results suggest that entity-level grounding in external visual world knowledge provides a simple and effective complement to model-bound generative priors.

AI.tldr: 提出WorldSR框架，用实体对齐的外部视觉世界知识来增强超分辨，替代/补充模型内生生成先验。
AI.motivation: 生成先验本身随机、面向多样化生成，与SR所需的确定性高保真重建冲突；且绑定基模型、难更新、随真实数据演化易产生幻觉。
AI.method: 自动将输入分解为语义实体，从大规模外部语料中做实体级检索结构/语义对齐图像；用记忆机制复用已检索结果，并用多步过滤精炼候选；再通过新型多参考超分模型将所选参考作为世界知识融合，提供细节合成与结构恢复的细粒度约束。
AI.result: 在真实世界SR基准上持续提升结构保真度与视觉质量，优于现有生成式超分方法。
AI.conclusion: 实体级的外部视觉世界知识锚定，是模型内生生成先验的简单有效补充。

title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
summary: Computer-use agents are limited by the interfaces humans give them. An agent may type a spreadsheet cell by cell when a single line of code would do, or print all two thousand lines of a file through a shell to find one function. Both the interfaces and the knowledge of when to use each are built by hand, which cannot keep pace with new applications, workflows, and models. We argue that interface design should itself be an agent capability. We introduce Agent S4, an autonomous computer-use scientist that builds Evolving Agent Interfaces from task experience. A meta-agent examines task agents' trajectories on synthetic training tasks, without success labels, and constructs and revises interfaces and usage knowledge in a repository. Population-based evolution then selects which repositories to develop further by their performance on validation tasks the meta-agent never sees, favoring changes that generalize beyond the seen tasks. On OSWorld V2, Agent S4, with Qwen3.8-27B and the evolved repository of interfaces, sets a new state of the art in open-source computer-use agents, reaching 21.3% binary score, 3.8 times the same model with fixed interfaces. This is above both GPT-5.5 (13.0%) and Claude Opus 4.8 (20.6%), at about 4.3% and 1.5% of their respective costs. On ScienceBoard, the evolved interfaces improve the success rate from 41.4% to 58.6% with the same model. These results suggest that useful interfaces can be evolved from experience, making autonomous interface design a source of improvement complementary to advances in models and harnesses. We open-source our code at https://github.com/simular-ai/agent-s.

AI.tldr: Agent S4 提出"接口设计本身应成为智能体能力"，用元智能体从任务经验中自主构建并演化"进化型智能体接口"(Evolving Agent Interfaces)，在 OSWorld V2 和 ScienceBoard 上显著超越固定接口与商业模型。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体受限于人类手工给定的接口：可能逐格填写电子表格（本一行代码即可）、或用 shell 打印两千行文件只为找一个函数。接口及其"何时使用"的知识都由人工构建，无法跟上新应用、新工作流与新模型的节奏。
AI.method: 提出 Agent S4——自主的"计算机使用科学家"。元智能体在无成功标签的合成训练任务上分析任务智能体的轨迹，在仓库中构建与修订接口及使用知识；随后用基于种群（population-based）的进化，依据元智能体从未见过的验证任务表现来选择继续发展的仓库，偏好可泛化的改动。
AI.result: OSWorld V2 上，Agent S4（Qwen3.8-27B + 进化接口仓库）取得 21.3% 二值得分，为同模型固定接口的 3.8 倍，超过 GPT-5.5（13.0%）与 Claude Opus 4.8（20.6%），成本仅约其 4.3% 和 1.5%。ScienceBoard 上，同模型成功率从 41.4% 提升至 58.6%。
AI.conclusion: 有用接口可从经验中演化而来，自主接口设计是独立于模型与 harness 进步的互补改进来源；代码已开源。

title: Continuous-Time Policy Gradient from Discrete Data: Convergence Analysis and Model-Free Algorithms
summary: Continuous-time reinforcement learning seeks an optimal policy under unknown dynamics driven by stochastic differential equations using observations collected at discrete times. We develop a policy gradient framework that combines rigorous convergence analysis with learning from discrete data. We first establish a performance difference lemma and derive policy gradient formulas for randomized and parametrized policies. We then prove exponential convergence of an entropy-regularized policy flow to the regularized optimum. For discrete parametrized updates, we derive a convergence bound that explicitly separates the contributions of critic error, policy-regression error, and the learning step size. To enable learning under unknown dynamics, we integrate this framework with PhiBE, which constructs a continuous-time surrogate generator from discrete transition data. The resulting on-policy and off-policy model-free actor-critic algorithms preserve the continuous-time structure of the control problem. Numerical experiments on an entropy-regularized linear-quadratic regulator and a nonlinear wheeled robot demonstrate the performance and stability of the proposed methods with both known and data-driven dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出连续时间强化学习的策略梯度框架，结合离散数据学习与严格收敛分析，并借助 PhiBE 实现无模型 actor-critic 算法。
AI.motivation: 连续时间强化学习需在未知 SDE 动力学下、仅用离散时刻观测求最优策略，缺乏兼具严谨收敛分析与离散数据学习的策略梯度框架。
AI.method: 建立性能差引理，推导随机化与参数化策略的策略梯度公式；证明熵正则化策略流指数收敛到正则化最优；对离散参数化更新给出显式分离 critic 误差、策略回归误差与步长的收敛界；并结合 PhiBE 从离散转移数据构建连续时间代理生成器，得到 on-policy 与 off-policy 无模型 actor-critic 算法。
AI.result: 收敛性方面：熵正则策略流指数收敛，离散更新有显式误差分解的收敛界。实验方面：在熵正则化 LQR 与非线性轮式机器人上，已知与数据驱动动力学均展现良好性能与稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将严格收敛分析与离散数据学习统一，保持控制问题的连续时间结构，验证了连续时间无模型 actor-critic 方法的有效性与稳定性。

title: EvaOmni: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Audio-Visual Reasoning
summary: Omni LLMs can naturally locate key audio and visual evidence and integrate information across modalities for audiovisual reasoning. Existing audio-visual reasoning benchmarks that mainly rely on multiple-choice questions usually score models solely based on answer correctness, making it difficult to assess whether a model truly forms a reasoning chain from evidence to the correct answer. In addition, textual or unimodal shortcuts may allow models to answer correctly without analyzing the necessary audio-visual evidence, further weakening the reliability of evaluation benchmarks. To address these issues, we introduce EvaOmni, an evidence-grounded benchmark containing 392 videos and 1,027 purely human-annotated question-answer pairs, covering 15 capabilities and three levels: retrieval and localization, basic understanding, and complex reasoning. We design a series of rigorous annotation procedures in which experts annotate audio and visual evidence and construct video-based distractors; humans review whether questions meet strict inspection criteria, and finally models filter textual and unimodal shortcuts. Beyond high-quality question-answer pairs, we require models to simultaneously return the answer and supporting evidence intervals in order to evaluate the complete reasoning chain. We propose the Coverage Grounded Score (C.G.) to measure how much annotated evidence a model identifies, and the Bottleneck Grounded Score (B.G.) to penalize poor temporal localization in either modality; both are incorporated into answer correctness. Across 7 open-weight and 17 proprietary Omni LLMs, Gemini3.7-Flash achieved the highest overall accuracy (79.4%), C.G. (70.8%), and B.G. (35.1%). At Level 3, it reached 79.1% accuracy, but its B.G. was only 12.3%. These results show that even the most advanced models still have room for development in grounded audio-visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出EvaOmni——一个基于证据的视听推理基准（392视频、1027人工标注QA、15能力/3层次），要求模型同时给出答案与音视频证据时间区间，并提出C.G.与B.G.两项定位指标，评估24个Omni大模型的完整推理链。
AI.motivation: 现有多选题视听推理基准仅按答案正确性评分，无法判断模型是否真从证据推出答案；且文本或单模态捷径可能让模型"蒙对"，降低评测可靠性。
AI.method: 构建EvaOmni基准，覆盖检索定位、基础理解、复杂推理三层次共15项能力；采用严格标注流程：专家标注音频与视觉证据、构造视频内干扰项、人工审核题目标准、再用模型过滤文本与单模态捷径。评测时要求模型同时输出答案和支撑证据时间区间，并设计Coverage Grounded Score (C.G.)衡量证据覆盖率、Bottleneck Grounded Score (B.G.)惩罚任一模态的时间定位缺陷，二者与答案正确性结合。
AI.result: 在7个开源与17个专有Omni大模型上评测，Gemini3.7-Flash综合最优：准确率79.4%、C.G. 70.8%、B.G. 35.1%；Level 3上准确率79.1%但B.G.仅12.3%。
AI.conclusion: 即使最先进的Omni模型在基于证据的视听推理（尤其细粒度时间定位）上仍有较大提升空间，说明答案正确性不等于真实推理链。

title: Value-Rich, Differently Organized: Measuring Value Expression and Organization in AI-Generated Debates
summary: Current evaluation of LLM-generated debate largely focuses on argumentative quality, leaving the value structure of generated arguments underexamined. We introduce a diagnostic metric framework for comparing how values are expressed and organized in human-reference and AI-generated debates. The framework separates value expression, the range of recognizable values a debate invokes, from value organization, how those values are distributed and sustained across turns. Grounded in Schwartz's Basic-10 value theory, it represents debates as multi-level value distributions over argumentative units, utterances, stances, and full debates, enabling metrics for value coverage, alignment, diffusion, and cross-turn dynamics. Across multiple generation systems, AI-generated debates are broadly value-expressive, often activating as many or more value dimensions than matched human references, but they organize these values differently. Their utterances are more locally value-diffuse, and source-blind judges distinguish value clarity from value focus. These findings show that debate evaluation should consider not only value presence, but also value organization. Code and supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/Maoyuan-li/Value-Expression-and-Organization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个基于Schwartz基本价值理论的诊断性指标框架，用于比较人类与AI生成辩论中价值的表达与组织，发现AI辩论价值表达丰富但组织方式不同。
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM生成辩论的评估主要关注论证质量，而忽视生成论点的价值结构，缺少对价值观如何表达与组织的系统比较方法。
AI.method: 构建诊断性指标框架，区分"价值表达"（可识别价值的范围）与"价值组织"（价值在各轮次间的分布与维持）。基于Schwartz Basic-10价值理论，将辩论表示为论点、话语、立场与整场辩论的多层次价值分布，进而定义价值覆盖度、对齐度、扩散度与跨轮次动态等指标。
AI.result: 在多个生成系统中，AI生成辩论整体上具有价值表达性，激活的价值维度常不少于匹配的人类参考文本，但组织方式不同：其话语层面价值更为局部扩散；盲测评审能区分价值清晰度与价值聚焦度。
AI.conclusion: 辩论评估不仅应关注价值是否存在，还应关注价值的组织方式；代码与补充材料已公开。

title: PaPi: Parallel Picard-Duhamel Integration for Fast Neuro-Spectral Architectures
summary: Neuro-spectral architectures (NeuSA) are a class of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that have proven effective for solving time-dependent PDEs in the frequency domain. However, training and inference often rely on costly numerical integration of the learned vector field, typically using sequential Runge-Kutta time stepping, which limits temporal parallelism. We introduce PaPi, an integration scheme inspired by weakly nonlinear flows that enables time-Parallel inference through exponential integration and a Duhamel-Picard scheme. We show that the Duhamel-Picard iteration converges exponentially for all flows, and provide explicit error bounds that depend on how close the flow is to linear. Experiments show that PaPi accelerates training and inference by up to two orders of magnitude, achieving training times of under one second for low-dimensional PDE learning problems, while maintaining competitive predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出PaPi方法，用指数积分与Duhamel-Picard迭代实现时间并行推理，加速NeuSA训练与推理最高达两个数量级。
AI.motivation: NeuSA类物理信息神经网络在频域求解时间相关PDE效果良好，但训练与推理依赖昂贵的数值积分（如顺序Runge-Kutta时间步进），限制了时间上的并行性。
AI.method: 受弱非线性流启发，提出PaPi积分方案：结合指数积分与Duhamel-Picard迭代，实现时间并行推理；并给出该迭代对所有流均指数收敛的证明及显式误差界（依赖流与线性的接近程度）。
AI.result: 实验显示PaPi将训练与推理加速最高两个数量级，低维PDE学习问题训练时间低于1秒，同时保持有竞争力的预测精度。
AI.conclusion: PaPi为NeuSA提供高效时间并行积分方案，在显著提速的同时保持精度，适用于低维PDE学习任务。

title: Answering in the User's Variety: Calibrated Accommodation Pairs for Post-Training
summary: People adapt how they talk to the person in front of them. However, chat models tend to respond in Standard English regardless of the dialect used by the user. A uniform answer can hide whether training treats these users alike, and output audits cannot tell as well. We trace how each post-training stage, from supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to preference optimization (DPO) and reinforcement learning, changes a model's tendency to match the user, and read what each update prefers from two content-matched replies, one matching the user and one not. Across 10 open model lineages, post-training standardizes replies to every informal cue, yet after adjusting for how likely each reply already was, the DPO update still favours matching British and Australian spelling over AAE and Singlish on 10 lineages, and models still produce AAE features when asked. We then introduce calibrated accommodation pairs (CAP), preference data that reward matching users' dialect density while preserving Standard English for Standard-English users. On a fully open model, CAP raises convergence on features it was not trained on without a detectable increase in dialect for Standard-English users or a cost in instruction following. In contrast, one-sided pairs reach a similar gain only by overshooting the user and imposing dialect. Our findings show that uniform replies can hide selective updates and audits should read the update as well as the output. Code: https://github.com/kouzhizhuo/cap-accommodation.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示后训练各阶段会将回复标准化，但DPO更新在控制基础上仍偏向匹配英/澳拼写而非AAE和Singlish；提出校准适配配对(CAP)偏好数据，可在不损害标准英语用户和指令遵循的前提下提升方言匹配。
AI.motivation: 聊天模型无论用户使用何种方言都倾向用标准英语回复。统一输出会掩盖训练是否公平对待不同方言用户，仅靠输出审计无法判断，因此需要从"更新偏好"层面审视后训练。
AI.method: 追踪SFT→DPO→RL各后训练阶段对"用户匹配"倾向的影响；用内容匹配的成对回复（一个匹配用户、一个不匹配）读取每次更新偏好；在10个开源模型谱系上测试。并提出校准适配配对(CAP)：奖励匹配用户方言密度，同时为标准英语用户保留标准英语。
AI.result: 后训练对所有非正式线索都趋于标准化；但在校正回复本身先验概率后，DPO更新在10个谱系上仍更偏好匹配英式/澳式拼写，而非AAE和Singlish，尽管模型被要求时仍能产出AAE特征。在完全开源模型上，CAP提升了对未训练特征的收敛，且未增加标准英语用户的方言或损害指令遵循；单边配对只能通过过度强加方言达到类似增益。
AI.conclusion: 统一回复会掩盖选择性更新，审计应同时读取"更新"与"输出"。CAP提供了一种兼顾方言适配与标准英语用户的偏好数据方案。

title: Semantic Observability for Autonomous Systems Diagnostics
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Foundational architecture paper; companion evaluation paper forthcoming
summary: Modern distributed microservice deployments generate massive volumes of heterogeneous, multi-format observability logs across physically and logically partitioned infrastructure. Isolating root causes during cascading failures remains an arduous task for Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), bottlenecked by manual keyword filtering and disjointed temporal correlation across monitoring dashboards. We introduce Semantic Observability, an autonomous multi-agent framework that unifies disparate log streams into a dynamic, queryable Property Graph Database. By modeling physical infrastructure topologies, logical software dependencies, and chronological event sequences as attributed nodes and directed relations, it bridges the semantic gap inherent in flat, unstructured log repositories. Building on this unified substrate, we deploy a stateful multi-agent system orchestrated through Directed Cyclic Graphs (DCGs). The system autonomously navigates the topology, applying causal graph algorithms and temporal back-traversal to isolate the precise blast radius of anomalies. The pruned subgraph is then interpreted by a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning engine to generate contextualized, code-level Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and actionable remediations. This paper establishes the foundational system architecture, formal relational ontology, and multi-agent control loops of Semantic Observability. We show conceptually how the framework eliminates ambient telemetry noise, reduces Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR), compresses LLM token consumption, and prevents structural hallucinations. We also specify an open-source validation framework on standard benchmarks (LogHub and Train-Ticket), laying the groundwork for a forthcoming companion paper on exhaustive quantitative evaluation and production benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 提出"Semantic Observability"自主多智能体框架，将异构微服务日志统一为可查询的属性图数据库，并用有状态多智能体系统与LLM推理实现根因分析。
AI.motivation: 分布式微服务产生海量异构多格式可观测性日志，级联故障下SRE依赖人工关键词过滤与分散仪表盘的时间关联，根因定位困难且MTTR高。
AI.method: 将物理拓扑、逻辑依赖与时间事件序列建模为带属性的节点和有向边，构建动态属性图；在图上部署由有向循环图（DCG）编排的有状态多智能体系统，结合因果图算法与时间回溯剪枝定位故障爆炸半径；再由LLM对剪枝子图进行推理，生成代码级RCA与修复建议。
AI.result: 本文为系统架构、形式化关系本体与多智能体控制环的基础性论述；概念上论证可消除遥测噪声、降低MTTR、压缩LLM token消耗并防止结构性幻觉，并给出基于LogHub与Train-Ticket的开放验证框架设计，尚无定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作奠定了语义可观测性的系统基础，定量评估与生产基准留待后续姊妹论文。

title: Turning TS2Vec into a Foundation Model for Time Series Classification
summary: TS2Vec is one of the strongest self-supervised methods for time series classification, introduced in 2022. It is designed to be trained anew on every dataset: self-supervised pre-training followed by linear probing. Since then, the field has shifted towards foundation models that reuse one encoder across datasets. Yet TS2Vec offers a compact convolutional architecture that operates directly on temporal samples and accepts variable-length inputs without resampling. We ask whether these properties can be retained when the encoder is pre-trained only once, and show that they can: TS2Vec can essentially be turned into a foundation model. Three changes suffice: pre-train on a synthetic corpus, feed the encoder a raw amplitude view and an instance-normalized shape view of the input through two small stems, and distill one specialist encoder per view into a single encoder. The result, TS2Vec-FM, is a 1.6M-parameter dilated convolutional network that, kept frozen, reaches 83.3% on UCR-128 and 75.3% on UEA-27 under linear probing, within 0.3 pp of MantisV2, the current state of the art, and above TS2Vec trained separately on each target dataset. What we find most interesting is how different TS2Vec-FM is from other foundation models in design: near-parity is reached without attention, without a patch tokenizer, and without intermediate-layer extraction, using an "old-school" convolutional encoder and a two-layer MLP stem.

AI.tldr: TS2Vec-FM 仅需三项改动（合成语料预训练、原始振幅与归一化形状双视图、双专家蒸馏为单一编码器），即可将原本逐数据集训练的 TS2Vec 转为一次预训练、跨数据集复用的基础模型，1.6M 参数冻结后在 UCR-128 达 83.3%、UEA-27 达 75.3%，与 SOTA MantisV2 仅差 0.3 pp。
AI.motivation: TS2Vec 是强自监督时序分类方法，但需在每个数据集上重新预训练+线性探测；当前领域已转向跨数据集复用的基础模型。作者希望保留 TS2Vec 的紧凑卷积架构、直接处理时序样本、支持变长输入免重采样等优点，同时实现"一次预训练"。
AI.method: 三处改动：(1) 在合成语料上预训练而非逐数据集；(2) 用两个小型 stem 分别向编码器输入原始振幅视图与实例归一化的形状视图；(3) 将每个视图的专家编码器蒸馏进单一编码器。最终为 1.6M 参数的膨胀卷积网络，冻结后做线性探测。
AI.result: UCR-128 上 83.3%、UEA-27 上 75.3%，与当前 SOTA MantisV2 相差 0.3 pp 以内，且优于逐数据集单独训练的 TS2Vec。
AI.conclusion: TS2Vec-FM 表明接近 SOTA 的性能无需注意力、无需 patch tokenizer、无需中间层特征提取，仅靠"老派"卷积编码器加两层 MLP stem 即可达成，与其他基础模型设计差异显著。

title: CLOSER: Evidence-Aware Active Visual Verification for Embodied Object-Goal Navigation
summary: Object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) requires an embodied agent to find an instance of a specified category in an unseen environment and stop near it. The agent typically relies on an object detector but must judge online from a limited egocentric video stream, sometimes a single frame, whether a detected candidate is the target. Detectors often confidently mistake similar objects, such as a sofa for a bed, and stopping at a false positive fails the episode. Prevailing systems also approach candidates greedily, leaving them occluded or partially observed. We present CLOSER, an evidence-aware active verification framework that treats stopping as closed-loop evidence acquisition, coupling vision-language model (VLM) verification with active perception. CLOSER fine-tunes an open-source VLM to label each view of a candidate tracked across frames as target, non-target, or uncertain, selects complementary views with an embedding-based diversity gate, and fuses their per-view probabilities with a lightweight network. If the fused judgment remains uncertain, a diffusion policy drives the agent toward the candidate using only the tracked mask and depth until the decision becomes decisive. CLOSER runs locally and plugs into existing ObjectNav systems without retraining them. On Gibson and Habitat-Matterport 3D, it raises average success rate by 3.6 points and success weighted by path length by 2.0 points, showing that verifying evidence before committing improves embodied navigation.

AI.tldr: CLOSER 是一个证据感知的主动验证框架，将"停止"视为闭环证据采集过程，用 VLM 逐视角判定目标/非目标/不确定，配合多样性选帧与扩散策略主动接近，在 Gibson 与 HM3D 上提升成功率 3.6 点。
AI.motivation: ObjectNav 中智能体仅凭有限的第一视角视频（甚至单帧）判断检测候选是否为目标，检测器常把相似物体（如沙发误判为床）高置信度误判，停在假阳上即导致回合失败；现有系统还倾向于贪心接近候选，造成遮挡或观测不完整。
AI.method: 微调开源 VLM，对跨帧跟踪的候选逐视角标注为目标/非目标/不确定；用基于嵌入的多样性门控挑选互补视角；用轻量网络融合各视角概率；若融合结果仍不确定，则由扩散策略仅依据跟踪掩码与深度驱动智能体靠近候选，直至判定明确。可本地运行并可直接接入现有 ObjectNav 系统而无需重训练。
AI.result: 在 Gibson 和 Habitat-Matterport 3D 上，平均成功率提升 3.6 个点，SPL 提升 2.0 个点。
AI.conclusion: 在做出停止决策前先主动采集并验证证据，能有效改善具身导航性能，说明主动感知与 VLM 验证的闭环结合是有价值的方案。

title: Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction: How far should we go?
summary: Multi-token prediction (MTP) can accelerate language-model decoding by drafting several tokens and verifying them in a single target-model pass. However, the best speculation horizon changes with context: longer drafts offer greater amortization when reliable, but can waste compute on suffixes discarded after a rejection. Unlike autoregressive drafting, where a stopping rule can decide token by token, MTP must fix the horizon before drafting, as all heads fire in the same forward pass. We therefore formulate horizon selection as an online control problem, using verification feedback to learn how far the draft can be trusted in each context, and introduce Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction (AMTP): a lightweight controller that requires no retraining and leaves the exact verifier unchanged. To guide horizon selection, we characterize the expected number of tokens committed at each horizon via acceptance survival, the probability that a draft prefix is fully accepted. Before each round, AMTP predicts how far the draft is likely to survive and picks the horizon with the highest expected tokens per second, learning freely from every verification pass. Theoretically, we show that any online learner's prediction error translates into throughput regret against the best horizon for each context, and in turn into a bound on wall-clock completion time. With online gradient descent, this regret is sublinear. Across five draft-target pairings built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with Medusa heads, Meta's MTP models, and Qwen3-4B-Inst-2507-MTP, evaluated on AIME 2025 and GSM8K, AMTP decodes up to 4.1x faster than standard decoding and matches or outperforms the fixed window in 8 of 10 settings, with throughput gains of up to 10%.

AI.tldr: AMTP将多令牌预测的推测视野选择建模为在线控制问题，用轻量控制器依据验证反馈预测接受存活概率并选择期望吞吐最优的视野，无需重训练即可加速解码最多4.1倍。
AI.motivation: MTP需在起草前固定推测视野（horizon），但最优视野随上下文变化：长草稿可靠时可更好摊薄开销，被拒绝后则浪费计算。自回归起草可逐令牌决定停止，MTP因所有头同一次前向同时输出而无法这样做。
AI.method: 提出AMTP：将视野选择形式化为在线控制问题，引入"接受存活"（草稿前缀被完全接受的概率）刻画各视野下期望提交令牌数；轻量控制器在每轮前预测草稿可存活长度，选择期望令牌/秒最高的视野，并从每次验证过程持续学习；不重训练、不改动精确验证器。
AI.result: 理论上证明在线学习器的预测误差可转化为相对各上下文最优视野的吞吐遗憾，并给出墙钟完成时间界，在线梯度下降下遗憾为次线性。实验在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct配Medusa头、Meta MTP模型及Qwen3-4B-Inst-2507-MTP共5组草稿-目标配对，AIME 2025与GSM8K上：解码最高快4.1倍，10个设置中8个持平或优于固定窗口，吞吐提升最高10%。
AI.conclusion: 上下文自适应的推测视野选择可有效提升MTP解码吞吐，且以在线学习理论提供遗憾与延迟保证，方法轻量、即插即用、兼容现有精确验证与多种MTP架构。

title: Efficient Edge-aware Attention Network for Graph Generation
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Graph Foundation Models and the Workshop on Structured Probabilistic Inference & Generative Modeling, ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
summary: Graph generative models commonly use graph-specific Transformer architectures to jointly update node and edge features. However, these architectures do not directly benefit from recent hardware-aware attention implementations, limiting their scalability. The adaptation is, however, non-trivial: edge and graph-level features must be injected into pairwise attention scores, graph masks must be respected, and dynamic edge updates remain a major source of quadratic memory usage. We propose an edge-aware attention layer for graph generation that incorporates structural information through head-wise score modulation, while updating edge representations with a lightweight residual mechanism that retains attention-score dependent edge updates. This layer can be effectively implemented using PyTorch's FlexAttention. We achieve similar generation quality to our baseline while reducing peak GPU memory by around 65% and substantially improving training and sampling throughput. These results suggest that the proposed architecture is a practical step toward scalable graph foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种边感知注意力层，通过头级分数调制注入结构信息、轻量残差机制更新边表示，借助PyTorch FlexAttention实现，在保持生成质量的同时降低约65%峰值显存并提升吞吐。
AI.motivation: 图生成模型常用图专用Transformer联合更新节点与边特征，但无法直接利用硬件感知的高效注意力实现，限制了可扩展性。直接改造有难点：边/图层特征需注入成对注意力分数、需遵守图掩码、动态边更新带来二次方显存开销。
AI.method: 设计边感知注意力层：用head-wise分数调制引入结构信息；用轻量残差机制更新边表示，同时保留依赖注意力分数的边更新；整体可用PyTorch FlexAttention高效实现。
AI.result: 生成质量与基线相近，峰值GPU显存降低约65%，训练与采样吞吐显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该架构是迈向可扩展图基础模型的实用一步。

title: Learning from Automatic 3D Gaussian Splatting Edits for Online Bayesian Scene Change Detection
summary: Online scene change detection requires integrating incoming observations to determine which regions have changed relative to a reference scene. We update change beliefs as new images arrive using generalised Bayesian evidence fusion. However, the prior probability of change and evidence models are unknown beforehand, and numerical Bayesian inference can be costly. We address these challenges by learning offline from automatic edits to a reference 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model. These edits generate labelled training views without manual annotations. Together with unchanged reference observations, they provide supervision for learning scene-specific evidence models and estimating the effective pixel prior and response statistics. Online prediction combines current evidence with historical support, while closed-form local Bayes factors, parameterized by the learned response statistics, update an accumulated 3D Gaussian field. Object-guided refinement produces the final change masks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on PASLCD and CCS3D, with $67.64\%$ and $75.82\%$ mIoU, respectively. On PASLCD, the complete pipeline runs at $17.2$\,FPS over complete query sequences, the fastest among the evaluated online methods.

AI.tldr: 提出基于广义贝叶斯证据融合的在线场景变化检测方法，通过离线编辑3DGS模型自动生成带标签训练视图，学习场景特定的证据模型与先验/响应统计，在线结合历史支撑更新累积3D高斯场，并用目标引导精炼生成变化掩码，在PASLCD和CCS3D上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 在线场景变化检测需融合新观测判断相对参考场景的变化区域，但变化先验与证据模型未知，且数值贝叶斯推断代价高。
AI.method: 利用对参考3DGS模型的自动编辑离线生成无需人工标注的带标签训练视图，与未变化参考观测一起监督学习场景特定证据模型并估计有效像素先验与响应统计；在线预测将当前证据与历史支撑结合，用学习响应统计参数化的闭式局部贝叶斯因子更新累积3D高斯场，再经目标引导精炼得到最终变化掩码。
AI.result: 在PASLCD和CCS3D上达到SOTA，mIoU分别为67.64%和75.82%；在PASLCD完整查询序列上以17.2 FPS运行，为所评估在线方法中最快。
AI.conclusion: 通过自动编辑3DGS实现无标注自监督学习，结合闭式贝叶斯因子与3D高斯场累积，兼顾了在线变化检测的精度与实时性。

title: Planning under Noise with Neural Operators
summary: Planning under uncertain control execution noise requires reliable feedback policies across diverse environments. We introduce Planning Under Noise (PUN), a neural operator that learns noise-aware value fields for planning in unseen geometries. Building on an established screened-Poisson formulation of stochastic optimal control, we address two challenges: specifying boundary conditions that support navigation across varying geometries and efficiently computing fields with reliable gradients. Zero-Dirichlet obstacle boundaries terminate sampled paths at walls, weakening the goal signal along long routes and making it harder to estimate reliably. We instead impose reflecting Neumann conditions on obstacles and a Dirichlet condition at the goal, allowing sampled paths to continue exploring free space until they reach the target. To solve the resulting PDE without a configuration-space mesh, we extend a Monte Carlo (MC) solver, Walk on Stars (WoSt), to higher dimensions. However, local MC fluctuations can reverse estimated gradient directions and cause planning failures, making direct planning require costly sampling. PUN amortizes this computation by learning geometry-to-field mappings from noisy, partially converged Monte Carlo labels, avoiding expensive convergence for every training example. At inference, test-time scaling uses bounded local search guided by the predicted global field. We evaluate PUN on planning tasks across dimensions. Across four noise levels, PUN matches or outperforms all compared planners, achieving 95-100% success on the 4D replanning benchmark while maintaining the lowest runtime. At the highest tested noise level in 4D, PUN achieves 10.7-60.6% relative gains in success rate over other methods while running 3.29-32.15 times faster.

AI.tldr: PUN 是一个神经算子，能从含噪、未完全收敛的蒙特卡洛标签中学习噪声感知的价值场，用于在未知几何中的不确定性规划。
AI.motivation: 在控制执行噪声不确定下规划需要可靠的反馈策略。已有 screened-Poisson 随机最优控制表述存在两个挑战：一是在不同几何中如何设置边界条件以支持导航；二是如何高效计算场并获得可靠梯度。
AI.method: 用障碍物上的反射 Neumann 边界条件和目标点处的 Dirichlet 条件替代零 Dirichlet 障碍边界；将 Monte Carlo 求解器 Walk on Stars 扩展到更高维以在无网格条件下求解 PDE；再用神经算子 PUN 从含噪、部分收敛的 MC 标签学习几何到场映射，避免每例昂贵收敛；推理时用预测全局场引导的有界局部搜索实现测试时缩放。
AI.result: 在多个维度的规划任务、四个噪声水平下，PUN 匹敌或优于所有对比规划器；4D 重规划基准成功率达 95-100% 且运行时间最低；4D 最高噪声水平下，成功率相对提升 10.7-60.6%，速度快 3.29-32.15 倍。
AI.conclusion: PUN 展示了学习噪声感知价值场是应对执行噪声规划的有效途径，兼顾成功率与计算效率。

title: GazeLens for Efficient Egocentric Video Question Answering with Simple Gaze-Driven Adaptive Token Reduction
summary: Smart glasses can help users understand their activities and surroundings, but small vision-language models must preserve useful evidence within limited computation. This is difficult because redundant frames consume the visual budget, while aggressive spatial compression can discard relevant details. Although gaze identifies the wearer's focus, the question may require evidence from the surrounding scene. To address these constraints, we propose GazeLens, which combines frame selection with gaze- and question-guided token reduction. First, HOG transitions and image sharpness select frames before visual encoding. For each selected frame, Gaussian pooling then forms gaze-focused and complementary summaries. Because their relevance depends on the question, a lightweight gate blends them into a primary token. Together with a global scene token, this retains both focused and contextual summaries within two tokens per frame. On StreamGaze, GazeLens achieves higher macro and micro accuracy than the evaluated full-grid and token-reduction baselines, with lower input-forward FLOPs than the shared-backbone token-reduction baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出GazeLens，一种面向智能眼镜的帧选择与注视/问题引导的token压缩框架，在极低视觉预算下保留聚焦与上下文证据。
AI.motivation: 智能眼镜需用小规模视觉语言模型理解用户活动与周围环境，但计算预算有限：冗余帧浪费视觉预算，而激进的空间压缩又会丢失关键细节。注视可指示用户焦点，但问题答案往往还需要周边场景证据。
AI.method: 两阶段：先用HOG变化与图像清晰度进行帧选择，再视觉编码；对每个选中帧用高斯池化生成注视聚焦摘要与互补摘要，并由轻量门控依据问题相关性将二者融合为主token，配合一个全局场景token，使每帧仅用两个token同时保留聚焦与上下文信息。
AI.result: 在StreamGaze数据集上，GazeLens的宏/微平均准确率均高于所评估的全网格基线和token压缩基线，且输入前向FLOPs低于共享骨干的token压缩基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，结合帧选择与注视-问题引导的token压缩，可在低计算成本下有效提升智能眼镜场景中的视觉语言理解性能。

title: OPLoRA: Orthogonal Projection LoRA Prevents Catastrophic Forgetting during Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient fine-tuning of large language models but suffers from catastrophic forgetting when learned updates interfere with the dominant singular directions that encode essential pre-trained knowledge. We propose Orthogonal Projection LoRA (OPLoRA), a theoretically grounded approach that prevents this interference through double-sided orthogonal projections. By decomposing frozen weights via SVD, OPLoRA constrains LoRA updates to lie entirely within the orthogonal complement of the top-$k$ singular subspace using projections $P_L = I - U_k U_k^\top$ and $P_R = I - V_k V_k^\top$. We prove that this construction exactly preserves the top-$k$ singular triples, providing mathematical guarantees for knowledge retention. To quantify subspace interference, we introduce $ρ_k$, a metric measuring update alignment with dominant directions. Extensive experiments across commonsense reasoning, mathematics, and code generation demonstrate that OPLoRA significantly reduces forgetting while maintaining competitive task-specific performance on LLaMA-2 7B and Qwen2.5 7B, establishing orthogonal projection as an effective mechanism for knowledge preservation in parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: OPLoRA通过SVD对冻结权重分解，将LoRA更新限制在top-k奇异子空间的正交补内，从理论上保证预训练知识保留，显著缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: LoRA微调大模型高效，但其更新会干扰编码预训练知识的主导奇异方向，导致灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 对冻结权重做SVD分解，用双侧正交投影P_L=I-U_kU_k^T、P_R=I-V_kV_k^T约束LoRA更新落在top-k奇异子空间的正交补内；并证明该构造精确保持top-k奇异三元组，引入ρ_k度量更新与主导方向的对齐程度。
AI.result: 在常识推理、数学、代码生成任务上，LLaMA-2 7B和Qwen2.5 7B实验中，OPLoRA显著减少遗忘同时保持有竞争力的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 正交投影是参数高效微调中知识保留的有效机制，为减少遗忘提供理论保障。

title: Deep Learning-Based Road Lane Quality Assessment from Egocentric Dashcam Video
summary: Reliable lane markings are important for both human drivers and automated driving systems, but their condition is still commonly assessed through manual inspection. Existing autonomous-driving datasets primarily support lane detection and scene understanding and usually lack maintenance-oriented labels for lane-marking visibility, continuity, or degradation. In this study, we present a geo-referenced smartphone dashcam dataset and baseline framework for lane-marking quality assessment. The dataset contains 63,839 road-facing frames collected across South Texas using a GPS-enabled dashcam application. A subset of 3,339 frames is matched with OpenStreetMap-derived lane-count labels, which are used as weak supervision for lane-count regression and map-consistency evaluation. We propose three lane-quality measures: Contrast Stability Index (CSI), which captures lane-background contrast using Laplacian responses; Line Continuity Ratio (LCR), which estimates structural continuity using edge and Hough-line evidence; and Regression Lane Confidence Score (RLCS), which measures agreement between predicted and map-derived lane counts on matched frames. The baseline prediction models attained strong performance, with CSI (MAE $0.039$, $R^2=0.97$) and LCR (MAE $0.093$, $R^2=0.84$). Notably, CSI and LCR are no-reference, segmentation-derived quality metrics that can be computed without dense human labels. In a pilot validation using 50 human-ranked images, these proposed lane-specific metrics show stronger rank agreement with human lane-quality ordering (e.g., Spearman's $ρ=0.7316$ and Kendall's $τ=0.5472$ for LCR) than general image-quality measures such as PSNR, SSIM, BRISQUE, NIQE, and LPIPS. We believe the dataset, metrics, and baseline provide an initial step toward scalable, low-cost, location-aware lane-marking quality assessment. Data and code: https://github.com/Shaif95/Road_Quality

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个地理参考的智能手机行车记录仪数据集及基线框架，用于车道标线质量评估，并设计了三个无参考车道质量指标（CSI、LCR、RLCS），验证其与人工排序的一致性优于通用图像质量指标。
AI.motivation: 车道标线状况对驾驶员和自动驾驶系统至关重要，但目前仍依赖人工巡检；现有自动驾驶数据集主要面向车道检测与场景理解，缺乏面向维护的车道标线可见性、连续性和退化标签。
AI.method: 构建南德州采集的63,839帧GPS行车记录仪数据集，其中3,339帧与OpenStreetMap车道数标签匹配作为弱监督；提出CSI（基于拉普拉斯响应捕捉车道-背景对比度）、LCR（基于边缘与Hough线估计结构连续性）和RLCS（预测与地图车道数一致性）三个指标，并训练基线预测模型。
AI.result: 基线模型表现良好：CSI（MAE 0.039，R²=0.97）、LCR（MAE 0.093，R²=0.84）。在50张人工排序图像的试点验证中，所提车道专用指标与人工质量排序的一致性（LCR的Spearman ρ=0.7316、Kendall τ=0.5472）优于PSNR、SSIM、BRISQUE、NIQE、LPIPS等通用图像质量指标。
AI.conclusion: CSI与LCR为无参考、分割衍生的质量指标，无需密集人工标注即可计算。该数据集、指标与基线为实现可扩展、低成本、位置感知的车道标线质量评估迈出了初步一步，但人工验证样本仅50张，规模有限。

title: Half-Truths Break Similarity-Based Retrieval
summary: When a text description is extended with an additional detail, image-text similarity should drop if that detail is wrong. We show that CLIP-style dual encoders often violate this intuition: appending a plausible but incorrect object or relation to an otherwise correct description can increase the similarity score. We call such cases half-truths. On COCO, CLIP prefers the correct shorter description only 40.6% of the time, and performance drops to 32.9% when the added detail is a relation. We trace this vulnerability to weak supervision on caption parts: contrastive training aligns full sentences but does not explicitly enforce that individual entities and relations are grounded. We propose CS-CLIP (Component-Supervised CLIP), which decomposes captions into entity and relation units, constructs a minimally edited foil for each unit, and fine-tunes the model to score the correct unit above its foil while preserving standard dual-encoder inference. CS-CLIP raises half-truth accuracy to 69.3% and improves average performance on established compositional benchmarks by 5.7 points, suggesting that reducing half-truth errors aligns with broader gains in compositional understanding. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/kargibora/CS-CLIP

AI.tldr: CLIP等双编码器存在"半真"漏洞：在正确描述后追加貌似合理但错误的细节，相似度反而升高。作者提出CS-CLIP，通过组件级（实体/关系）监督微调修复该问题。
AI.motivation: 理想情况下，描述中追加错误细节应降低图文相似度。但实验发现CLIP在COCO上仅40.6%偏好正确短描述（关系细节时降至32.9%）。根源在于对比学习只对齐整句，未显式约束单个实体与关系是否被图片真实支撑。
AI.method: CS-CLIP将caption分解为实体单元和关系单元，为每个单元构造最小编辑的"替身"（foil）负样本，微调模型使正确单元得分高于其替身，同时保持标准双编码器推理结构不变。
AI.result: 半真准确率从基线提升至69.3%；在现有组合性基准上平均提升5.7个点。
AI.conclusion: 减少"半真"错误与提升组合理解能力方向一致，组件级监督是有效且可落地的改进路径；代码已开源。

title: SenseAlign: Understanding Vision and Touch through Language at Test Time
summary: Tactile-visual-language models combine vision and touch through a shared language space to recognize objects and materials. In real-world deployment, changes in lighting, contact quality or sensor hardware can shift visual or tactile inputs and degrade recognition performance. When both modalities contribute to a prediction, an unreliable modality can override correct evidence from the other. Since labeled data are generally unavailable during deployment, test-time adaptation offers a way to recover recognition performance from unlabeled observations. In this setting, we find that comparing accumulated observations with the text embeddings of candidate classes reveals modality reliability differences that confidence can miss. Refining features against competing classes also improves recognition beyond geometric alignment alone. These findings motivate SenseAlign, which uses a common semantic reference for test-time modality weighting and feature correction. Alignment Trust weights each modality according to its support for shared predicted classes. Anchor Realignment uses the same class text embeddings to fit a shared feature correction that separates predicted classes from alternatives. Both modules use the same unlabeled history while keeping all encoders frozen. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate strong recognition performance under both natural shifts and controlled corruptions.

AI.tldr: 提出SenseAlign，一种测试时自适应框架，利用共享类别文本嵌入对触觉-视觉-语言模型进行模态加权与特征校正，提升光照、接触质量、硬件变化等分布偏移下的识别性能。
AI.motivation: 部署中光照、接触质量或传感器硬件变化会造成视觉/触觉输入偏移，导致识别性能下降；当两模态共同参与预测时，不可靠模态可能覆盖另一模态的正确证据。且部署阶段通常无标注数据，需要测试时自适应，而置信度无法揭示模态可靠性差异。
AI.method: SenseAlign包含两个模块，均使用相同无标注历史且冻结所有编码器：1) Alignment Trust——通过与候选类别文本嵌入比较累积观测，按各模态对共享预测类别的支持度进行加权；2) Anchor Realignment——用同一类别文本嵌入拟合共享特征校正，使预测类别与备选类别分离。
AI.result: 在多种数据集上，无论自然偏移还是受控损坏条件，均展现出强劲的识别性能。
AI.conclusion: 与文本嵌入对比可揭示置信度难以捕捉的模态可靠性差异；相对竞争类别细化特征优于仅几何对齐；以共同语义参考实现测试时模态加权与特征校正有效恢复性能。

title: Touch-JEPA: Tactile Representation Learning from Hand-Object Video with Limited Tactile Supervision
summary: Understanding contact and tactile magnitude in hand-object interaction is a key step toward physically intelligent systems, yet learning such representations is limited by the cost and restricted coverage of tactile measurements. We present Touch-JEPA, a framework for learning tactile representations from hand-object videos with limited tactile supervision. We first introduce a self-supervised pretraining objective that learns from video alone without tactile supervision. Using video-derived hand geometry, Touch-JEPA predicts masked visual features at corresponding hand-surface locations from spatial and temporal context, encouraging the representation to capture latent contact dynamics. We then extend this formulation to joint representation learning, where masked prediction is applied to all videos while tactile supervision is available only for a labeled subset, grounding the shared representation in measured contact and magnitude. With self-supervised pretraining alone, simple supervised readouts on frozen Touch-JEPA features outperform supervised baselines in contact discrimination and tactile magnitude estimation across three human-hand benchmarks, and transfer to robotic hands without robot tactile training data. Joint learning with limited tactile supervision further improves contact and magnitude estimation on the human-hand benchmarks. Together, these results show that hand-object video can provide scalable self-supervision for tactile representation learning, while limited tactile measurements provide complementary physical grounding.

AI.tldr: Touch-JEPA：从手-物视频自监督学习触觉表征，仅用少量触觉监督即可实现接触判别与触觉幅值估计，并可零样本迁移到机器人手。
AI.motivation: 理解手-物交互中的接触与触觉幅值是物理智能系统的关键，但触觉测量成本高、覆盖范围有限，导致触觉表征学习受限。
AI.method: 提出自监督预训练目标：仅用视频，借助视频导出的手部几何，从时空上下文预测手表面相应位置的被掩码视觉特征，从而捕获潜在接触动态；进一步扩展为联合表征学习，对所有视频做掩码预测，仅对标记子集施加触觉监督，将共享表征锚定在实测接触与幅值上。
AI.result: 仅自监督预训练+冻结特征上的简单监督读出，即在三个人手基准的接触判别与触觉幅值估计上超过监督基线，并可无机器人触觉训练数据迁移到机器人手；有限触觉监督的联合学习进一步提升人手基准性能。
AI.conclusion: 手-物视频可为触觉表征学习提供可扩展的自监督，而有限触觉测量提供互补的物理基础。

title: Latent Bridge: From Video Latents to 3D Geometry via Feature Alignment
summary: Video generation and feed-forward 3D reconstruction typically use separate representations, requiring RGB decoding and visual re-encoding to recover geometry from generated latents. We propose Latent Bridge, which connects video generative latent spaces with geometric feature spaces to directly predict 3D geometry from video latents. We develop representation-specific bridges for Wan2.1 and V-RAE, enabling feed-forward prediction of cameras, depth, and 3D point clouds without the intermediate RGB pathway. Each bridge is trained on RGB videos through feature distillation, while the video encoder and geometry model remain frozen. Training requires neither ground-truth geometry nor execution of the downstream geometric aggregator or prediction heads. At inference, the same video latents support both RGB decoding and geometry prediction. The same trained bridge can be reused for image-to-video and text-to-video generation within the same video latent space, without bridge retraining. Experiments on Co3Dv2 and WildRGB-D demonstrate competitive geometric reconstruction quality, efficient end-to-end generation and reconstruction, and faster latent-to-geometry decoding, highlighting latent alignment as a practical and reusable interface between video generation and 3D reconstruction. Our code is available at: https://github.com/hustvl/Latent-Bridge.

AI.tldr: 提出 Latent Bridge，将视频生成潜空间与几何特征空间直接连接，从视频潜变量直接预测相机、深度和点云，跳过 RGB 中间通路。
AI.motivation: 视频生成与前馈 3D 重建使用不同表征，从生成潜变量恢复几何需先 RGB 解码再视觉编码，冗余且低效。
AI.method: 为 Wan2.1 与 V-RAE 分别设计表征专用 bridge；仅用 RGB 视频通过特征蒸馏训练，视频编码器与几何模型冻结，无需真值几何，也不运行下游聚合器/预测头。
AI.result: 在 Co3Dv2 与 WildRGB-D 上达到有竞争力的重建质量，端到端生成+重建高效，潜变量到几何解码更快。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间对齐可作为视频生成与 3D 重建之间实用且可复用的接口；同一 bridge 可复用于 I2V 与 T2V 而无需重训。

title: Copyright Leakage Detection in AI Generated Videos
summary:
Video generation models can create realistic-looking video footage from images and text prompts. Some of the recent advances have raised concerns about the reproduction of copyrighted visual content. However, copyright leakage detection in generated videos remains largely unexplored.
  In this paper, we introduce a new benchmark data set for copyright leakage detection, comprising 50 copyrighted concepts, each with 5 images. For each concept, we have 5 videos created using the image+prompt video generation model and the prompt-only video generation model. Following that, we develop an AI toolset based on a contrastive retrieval framework that formulates copyright leakage detection as a video-to-image retrieval problem by matching aggregated video frame embeddings against a database of copyrighted image embeddings. Our method uses a single similarity threshold and retrieves the most similar copyrighted reference as supporting evidence.
  We conducted experiments showing strong retrieval and detection performance, achieving 99.6\% detection accuracy with only a single false negative. These results show the effectiveness of the retrieval-based method for scalable and explainable copyright leakage detection in AI-generated videos. Data can be accessed publicly from https://zenodo.org/records/21386117 and the source code for this project is publicly available at https://github.com/Shaif95/video-cp-Leakage.

AI.tldr: 提出首个用于AI生成视频版权泄漏检测的基准数据集（50个版权概念×5图，每概念5个视频），并基于对比检索框架将版权泄漏检测转化为视频到图像检索问题，达到99.6%检测准确率。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型（图像+提示词、纯提示词）能力增强，引发对受版权保护视觉内容被复现的担忧，但生成视频中的版权泄漏检测几乎未被研究。
AI.method: 构建新基准数据集：50个受版权保护概念，各5张图像；每个概念用图+文模型与纯文模型各生成5个视频。开发AI工具集，采用对比检索框架，将视频→图像检索问题化：聚合视频帧嵌入并与受版权图像嵌入库匹配，使用单一相似度阈值并返回最相似参考作为支撑证据。
AI.result: 检索与检测性能强，检测准确率99.6%，仅1个假阴性。数据与代码公开（Zenodo、GitHub）。
AI.conclusion: 基于检索的方法为AI生成视频的版权泄漏检测提供了可扩展且可解释的方案，单阈值+证据返回便于实际部署与审查。

title: CoGaussian: Open-Vocabulary Gaussian-based Collaborative 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Collaborative perception enables agents to retrieve the scene semantics and geometry beyond the field of view of any individual agent. This broader scene understanding enhances transportation safety and improves efficiency in multi-robot systems. However, existing collaborative semantic occupancy methods rely on dense 3D voxel annotations and are limited to recognizing objects within a predefined set of semantic classes. To overcome these limitations, we present CoGaussian, an open-vocabulary Gaussian-based collaborative semantic occupancy prediction framework. CoGaussian represents a scene as a set of foundation model-aligned sparse 3D Gaussians, which serve as a compact representation for communicating and fusing geometric and semantic information across multiple agents. On the Semantic-OPV2V benchmark, our method outperforms existing open-vocabulary single-agent approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of open-vocabulary collaborative scene understanding.

AI.tldr: CoGaussian提出基于高斯表示的开词汇协同语义占据预测框架，用基础模型对齐的稀疏3D高斯作为多智能体间几何与语义信息通信融合的紧凑表示。
AI.motivation: 现有协同语义占据方法依赖密集的3D体素标注，且只能识别预定义语义类别集合内的目标，限制了扩展性和泛化能力。
AI.method: 将场景表示为与基础模型（foundation model）对齐的稀疏3D高斯集合，以此作为跨多个智能体传输和融合几何与语义信息的紧凑表示，实现开词汇的协同语义占据预测。
AI.result: 在Semantic-OPV2V基准上，该方法优于现有的开词汇单智能体方法，验证了开词汇协同场景理解的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以高斯表示替代密集体素并结合基础模型对齐，可在协同感知中实现高效的开词汇语义占据预测，展现协同感知在开放类别场景理解上的潜力。

title: Predictive Latents for Autoregressive Language Models: Possibility, Gauge, and Obstruction
summary: Autoregressive language models are trained by next-token cross-entropy, yet several recent systems also iterate a hidden state without emitting a token: continuous thoughts, pause steps, and recurrent depth. This note separates three risks on one latent process. The token risk $R_{\mathrm{tok}}$ scores a readout. The teacher-forced latent risk $R_1$ scores a one-step map that sees the true hidden state. The open-loop risk $R_H$ scores the same map after it has been iterated on its own outputs. If the Bayes next-token posterior is a function of a $k$-dimensional statistic with full-rank covariance, a width-$k$ latent, a linear least-squares transition, and a refit unembedding match the Bayes token predictor. The statistic is identified only up to an invertible gauge: whitening the residual stream does not change the token law once the unembedding is refit. The matching obstructions are sharp. A constant latent drives $R_1$ to zero while token cross-entropy falls back to the marginal entropy.
